This is the meaning of "I am weary with groaning; I cannot endure it" <note>original: *nlati kalkel*; a reference to Jeremiah 20:9</note>, which is related to the expression "too small to contain" <note>original: *katon me-hachil*</note>.

We have learned that Above, there is only the "Right" for merit and the "Left" for liability. Yet, everything is Right and everything is Left according to the preparation of those below. These are the "Upper Branches" that became physical for the honor of Israel; they are the Ten Commandments, through which God is called from every side, direction, and corner. **And it is possible** that when the Sages speak of "Right and Left" regarding prayer, they are directing our focus toward the "Crowns" <term>Keter: the highest Sefirah, representing Divine Will</term>—the connection from which Crowns are made for our Masters, acting as a spring for the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: the immanent aspect of God that dwells within the world</term> and called by its name, as will be explained. 

Abraham called the angels "My Lord" <note>original: *Adonai*</note>, and the commentators explained that he spoke to the greatest among them, or perhaps it was due to the "Glory" hovering over them. We, too, offer our greeting of peace to the "Glory," facing the Right and Left of that Ministering Angel. Similarly, Joshua bowed before the angel Michael because of the Divine Presence seen with him. Furthermore, we have seen in the "Book of the Creator" <note>original: *Sefer ha-Notzer*</note> that He formed shape within shape. It says that just as the Earth is surrounded by the elements and the celestial spheres, and the heart is surrounded by the other organs of the body, so is the "Diadem" <term>Atarah: another name for Malkhut, the lowest Sefirah</term> adorned by the rest of the Sefirot. This view does not conflict with the beloved illustration we mentioned in the first chapter, and their agreement is clear from what we mentioned in the previous gate.

### Chapter 4
We have said that the most famous and agreed-upon arrangement among the Kabbalists for illustrating the Sefirot is the configuration of "Crown, Wisdom, and Understanding" <note>Keter, Chokhmah, and Binah</note> in the shape of a *Segolta* <note>A Hebrew vowel mark consisting of three dots in a triangle pointing up: ∴</note>. Beneath them are "Greatness, Power, and Beauty" <note>Gedulah (Chesed), Gevurah, and Tiferet</note> in the shape of a *Segol* <note>A Hebrew vowel mark consisting of three dots in a triangle pointing down: ∵</note>. Below those are "Endurance, Splendor, and Foundation" <note>Netzach, Hod, and Yesod</note> in a second *Segol* shape, with "Sovereignty" <note>Malkhut</note> beneath them in the center. Despite this, there is always a descent from the Right to the Left, such that they actually descend and evolve one from the other.

**It is found** that Wisdom is within the Crown, Understanding is within Wisdom, Greatness is within Understanding, Power is within Greatness, Beauty is within Power, Endurance is within Beauty, Splendor is within Endurance, Foundation is within Splendor, and Sovereignty is within Foundation. This is the order of their inclusion in "Direct Light" <term>Or Yashar: the downward flow of divine energy from the source to the creation</term>. 

Likewise, in "Returning Light" <term>Or Chozer: the ascent of consciousness or energy back toward the source</term>: Foundation is in Sovereignty, Splendor is in Foundation, Endurance is in Splendor, Beauty is in Endurance, Power is in Beauty, Greatness is in Power, Understanding is in Greatness, Wisdom is in Understanding, and the Crown is in Wisdom. For they all need one another to balance the Divine governance in truth. And the Infinite <note>Ein Sof</note>—they all need Him, but He needs none of them.

**And behold**, the relationship of the Cause to the Effect is like a soul within a body. This second order works well for this approach. Nevertheless, it is also correct to say that the Cause encompasses the Effect (according to the first approach), so that its nourishment is provided in "secrecy" because of the "External Forces" <term>Chitzonim: the "Outer Ones" or forces of imbalance and evil that seek to siphon divine energy</term>. Because the Cause encompasses its Effect, a spark is drawn forth, and it contracts its light and its nourishment so that the Effect can bear it. If this were not so, the Effect would be unable to stand before its Cause due to its intense brilliance; it would be like a mustard seed in a vast desert, as will be verified in every...

<column-break/>

...curtains. (The explanation of the verse "and fifteen curtains..." means drop by drop. Regarding the Tabernacle, "ten curtains" for every four curtains; for every part of the Tabernacle there shall be ten curtains.) This is similar to the number ten, which includes the ten days of Repentance. (The explanation: Do not be surprised that I say ten, for Sovereignty includes ten, and Understanding includes ten, and the ten days are in Understanding along with Understanding itself.) These are called "Understanding" in the collective sense of ten, and the tenth is the tenth of the Sefirot, similar to the "Full Divine Presence" (which is the Tabernacle). 

The six curtains collectively represent the nine Sefirot within it. They are called the "Sloping Heavens" <note>original: *Tippah Raki'im*</note>, as they are slanted, overlapping, and surrounding one another like the celestial spheres. As mentioned in that discourse, there are six heavens, which correspond to the six directions of the world <note>the six Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</note>. But they are the primary governors of the world. Above them is the seventh heaven, which is the most praised of them and is called "Clouds" <note>original: *Arvot*</note>. It is explained that two attributes—Fire and Water—are called "Beauty" <note>Tiferet</note>. Above these is the seventh heaven, which "rides" upon them all and directs them all, and it is called "Understanding" <note>Binah</note>, which is the "Heavens" riding upon the "Clouds" as a rider on a horse.

### Chapter 6
Know that even though the levels of the Sefirot descend one by one in the way of Cause and Effect—like a chain, a ladder, and a descent—one should not perform an act of connection <note>original: *kesher*</note> except with its "Branch," and not with the branch of its branch. Some explain that for each and every one of them, there is a path and a total connection with all of them. Even Sovereignty <note>Malkhut</note>, which is the most external and lowest, has a connection with the Crown <note>Keter</note>, which is the most elevated of all. 

From each one of them, the whole is included—each within the other, and the other within the first—and they are joined in a single unit. The reason is that the Crown contains the "Ten Foundations" (the ten Sefirot), specifically the "Crowned Crown" (with the Crown), and the "Strength in the Crown" with the "Strength in the Strength." In this manner, the levels are arranged for all the Sefirot. Thus they are tied together as one in pleasantness, and all the Sefirot are straightened by the "Cause of all Causes" in two ways. 

First, through their straight connection in the "Hidden Realm," for high above are the "Upper Souls" of the Hidden Realm from which the Sefirot expand. This comes from the side of the "Light of the Hidden Worlds" that spreads from them, which is a simple, indivisible Godhead. It only appears divided through the Sefirot, as explained in the Gate of "Essence and Vessels" <term>Atzmut ve-Kelim: the debate over whether the Sefirot are God's actual essence or just his tools/instruments</term>. The Cause spreads out and is unified in its source, like the union of a drop in the place of its own essence, or like the soul prepared in the هیולי <note>original: *Hiyuli*; Greek *hyle*, meaning primordial matter</note> that spreads through the body. The Sefirah itself is unified with the Essence that spreads through it in a total union, just as the soul is unified with the body to become a single living being, as will be clarified in the Gates of the Soul.

### Chapter 7
According to the orders of the descent of the levels of Emanation <term>Atzilut: the highest of the four worlds, the realm of pure divinity</term>, one attribute flows to another in the way of Cause and Effect, as explained. This describes the order of the Sefirot as being one beneath the other (for the Infinite is the Cause of all, the First Emanation from Him is the Crown, the Crown is the Cause of Wisdom, and so on until Sovereignty). 

However, it is proper to know that this order has another purpose. The reason is that every Sefirah has two "causes." Even though the Sefirot were emanated according to the order of "Crown, Wisdom, Understanding," their "Nurturing Cause" might be Kindness <note>Chesed</note>, for from it comes its root, its sustenance, its life-force, and the uprightness of its actions. This applies to the rest of the Sefirot as well. We will explain this according to two systems: 1) The system of the order of Emanation, and 2) The system of Nurture and Influence. Therefore...

<meta>This page transitions from the general arrangement of the Sefirot (the divine emanations) discussed in Gate 6 to a specific technical analysis of the "Channels" (Tzinorot) that connect them. It explores how divine energy flows through the system and why certain connections are hidden or emphasized.</meta>

-># Pomegranate Slice | Nectar of Pomegranates<-
->## Gate 7: The Channels<-

The general consensus among many is that there are twenty channels, and they are as follows: Three from the **Crown** <note>original: *Keter*; the highest emanation</note> to **Wisdom**, **Understanding**, and **Beauty**. **Wisdom** <note>original: *Chokhmah*</note> sends three to **Understanding**, **Greatness**, and **Beauty**. From **Understanding** <note>original: *Binah*</note>, two flow to **Might** and **Beauty**. From **Greatness** <note>original: *Gedulah*, also called *Hesed* or Kindness</note>, three flow to **Might**, **Beauty**, and **Victory**. From **Might** <note>original: *Gevurah*</note>, two flow to **Beauty** and **Splendor**. From **Beauty** <note>original: *Tiferet*</note>, three flow to **Victory**, **Splendor**, and **Foundation**. From **Victory** <note>original: *Netzach*</note>, two flow to **Splendor** and **Foundation**. From **Splendor** <note>original: *Hod*</note>, one flows to **Foundation**. From **Foundation** <note>original: *Yesod*</note>, one flows to **Kingdom** <note>original: *Malkhut*</note>. Some depict two channels from Victory and Splendor directly to Kingdom, but this is not agreed upon, for it is not proper to attribute any influence to Kingdom except through the Foundation.

**This is the secret of the Ark** <note>referring to Noah's Ark</note>, which has no existence of its own except through **Noah** <note>representing the Sefirah of Yesod</note>. Its measurements in length, width, and depth follow the secret of the "Covenant of the Tongue" with Noah, which is the "Small Vav" <note>the Hebrew letter ו, associated with the male principle/Yesod</note> that enters into it. Note that the word "Tongue" <note>original: *Lashon*</note> is here spelled without the *Vav*, representing its three dimensions along with the Ark itself, which follows the secret of the letter *He* <note>ה</note>; together their numerical value is equal to **Divine Presence** <note>original: *Shekhinah*; both total 385 in Gematria</note>. When the word is spelled in full, it equals *Shekhinah* plus the "total" <note>a Gematria method adding 1 to the sum</note>. From the statement "to a cubit you shall finish it from above" (Genesis 6:16), we learn that every "cubit" <note>original: *Amah*</note> descends to its own place. The sum of the Ark's dimensions together is 450,000, following the secret of the **Name of 45** <note>original: *Mah*; the Tetragrammaton expanded to equal 45</note>, which is the *Vav* that influences it, found in both Beauty and Foundation.

**It would have been fitting** to count a channel from Understanding to Kindness, and many have agreed not to count it explicitly among the general channels—not to deny its existence, but to indicate its hiddenness. It is hinted at in the name of the angel **Michael**, the angel of Kindness: *Mi* <note>Who</note> refers to Understanding, and *El* <note>God</note> refers to Kindness. The channel between them is hinted at by the letter **Khaf** <note>כ</note>, which indicates similarity and equality between them. Furthermore, every channel includes ten sub-aspects, and it rises from the effect to the cause and back from the cause to the effect; twice ten equals twenty, the value of the letter *Khaf*.

**The reasons for hiding this channel** are many. First, to teach that there is no complete, direct flow between the "Hidden Realms" <note>the upper three Sefirot</note> and the "Revealed Realms" <note>the lower seven</note>. Second, to show the difference between specific nourishment and general nourishment, so that Kindness does not behave solely by the power of Understanding, but rather as a "son among sons." Third, to preserve the general ratio, ensuring that the channels of Kindness and Mercy are more numerous in the Tree than the channels of Judgment. Fourth, so it is not thought that Kindness is submissive or surrendered before the Judgment that awakens from Understanding. Fifth, because Kindness is the "one who opens the womb" <note>referring to the first of the lower Sefirot</note>, emerging into the light of the world from the power of the Father <note>Wisdom</note>, His "first fruit of strength," who made the Mother <note>Understanding</note> a vessel for his children. Sixth, to teach that this channel is more excellent than the other channels emerging from Understanding; for her influence on Might and Beauty is not from her very essence in the same way as her influence on Kindness. While she gives them life and flow, the actual leadership through vessels is beneath her; but to Kindness, she breathes from her very essence. This is Mercy, even though judgments are awakened from her. This is the reason for the statement in the *Tikkunim*: "From the side of the Father, Kindness is grasped; from the side of the Mother, Might is suspended." Kindness is grasped in the essence of Wisdom, but Judgment is merely suspended in the power of Understanding, not grasped in her essence. For Being <note>original: *Havayah*</note>, which is Mercy, when spelled with the vowels of *Elohim* <note>Judgment</note>, awakens Judgment, serving as the "soul" for the name *Elohim* in its letters, shining through Might. Thus, this channel is hidden but not absent.

**Among the respected authors**, including the sage who wrote the "Short Introductions," some have publicized this channel like...

This is the "Understanding of the Sefirot" <note>original: *Binun Sefirot*</note>; look at the beginning and the presence of the light that appears to every "Face" and draws it, and through this, the distant matter is seen. ## Chapter 8: Although

It has been explained that the **Sefirot** <term>Sefirot: the ten creative powers or attributes through which the Infinite interacts with the universe</term> are included within one another in the manner of **Cause and Effect** <note>original: *Ilah ve-Alul*</note> and **Emanator and Recipient** <note>original: *Mashpia ve-Mushpa*</note>. God forbid a student should allow it to enter their mind, in a moment of great intellectual folly, to say that these matters stand independently—each one existing as a separate, detached entity <note>original: *perud*</note>. God forbid, for this would be an act of "cutting" and "dividing" the Unity that is required of the **Infinite Cause of All** <note>original: *Ein Sof*</note>, may He be blessed. Rather, everything is a perfect, simplified unity.
They are bound to one another like a flame bound to a coal. They are tied together like the powers of the body—interlinked, unified, and spreading into one another as one. There is no existence for the body without the soul. In this way, the emanations and their vitality... the **Crown** provides vitality and strength to the existence of **Wisdom**; from the vitality and strength of **Wisdom** comes the existence of **Understanding**; from the vitality and strength of **Understanding** comes the existence of **Kindness** <note>original: *Chesed*</note>, and so they all proceed down to **Kingdom** <note>original: *Malkhut*</note>, whose existence and vitality come from the vitality and essence of **Foundation**. For they are all chained to one another in the manner of cause and effect. This one is the strength and cause of that one, and that one is the resultant and effect of the other; this one is the interior of that one, and that one is the garment of the other. They are all established and tied together as one.
The Holy One, blessed be He, is the "Light of the Radiance" mentioned in the portion of *Terumah*... <note>referring to a section of the Zohar</note> Since **Might** is a "weak" power <note>ironically, as it represents restriction</note>, how can it possess the power of life? Only through what we have said: the power of **Kindness** is within **Might**.

According to this, the power of the **Crown** is found in **Wisdom**, and the power of **Wisdom** is in **Understanding**, and so on until **Kingdom**, wherein the power of **Foundation** resides. Likewise, it is found that **Kingdom** is [actually] **Foundation**, and **Foundation** is **Splendor**, and **Splendor** is **Victory**, and they all ascend this ladder until the **Crown**, which is hidden within the **Infinite** <note>original: *Ein Sof*</note>. Not only this, but the **Infinite** spreads through all of them, so that one cannot say "this is Kingdom and not the Infinite," God forbid. This applies to all of them.
Furthermore, the Light of the **Infinite** spreads and shines through all the **Chariots** <note>original: *Merkavot*; the structures of the angelic worlds</note>, all the hosts of angels, all the firmaments, all the celestial spheres, and all the elements—from the first point of the emanations to the very lowest point. Regarding this, it is explained: "one light enclothes them all." The explanation is that He <note>the Infinite</note> is present in all, and He gives life to them all. This is the secret of the "Continuous Act of Creation," where the Simple Influence <note>divine energy</note> always acts to sustain and stand and vivify [creation] in its depths. For from Him, and from His power, and by His will, everything exists. Without Him, all locations and everything else are nothingness. No level, place, or thing—whether general or specific—is vacant of Him. He is "Outside the Sefirot" and "Inside the Sefirot" and "Between the Sefirot." He is within the Chariots and between the Chariots; within the angels and between the angels; within the spheres and between the spheres; within the elements and between the elements. He is the Unity that is one and unique, above and below, and in the four directions of the world.
So they said in the *Tikunim* <note>referring to the *Tikunei HaZohar*</note>: "He is the Master over them all... the Lord of the Sefirot of the world of Emanation <note>original: *Atzilut*</note>..." Their words continue regarding the hosts of angels, the spheres, etc. He does not change according to these "garments," God forbid. Just as each Sefirah contains the power of the one above it, so too each lower being contains the power of the higher one from which it came. The power of **Kingdom** is in **Foundation**, the power of **Foundation** in **Splendor**, the power of **Splendor** in **Victory**, and so on.
However, we cannot say that the power of the **Crown** is in the **Infinite**, even though they are all unified in Him as one (as will be explained in the Gate of Rotations). This is because the secret of the matter follows the principle: "Understanding in the lower realms is a high necessity." This means the **Crown** "needs" **Wisdom**, for from the perspective of the influence toward **Wisdom**, the **Infinite** (blessed be He) influenced it to be built in this aspect, such that **Wisdom** is the "cause" for the **Crown** [to act], and thus the power of **Wisdom** is found in the **Crown**. In this way, all the other Sefirot [interact]. (Thus, it is found that the power of **Kingdom** is in **Foundation**, for the [higher] attribute itself is forced to turn and receive from the secret in order to influence it; so too all of them up to **Wisdom**, which is the "cause" for the **Crown** in this aspect). But this cannot be said of the **Infinite**, for He is the First Cause and the Root of all roots, the source of all influences, lights, and blessings. He influences our world and all who need Him, but He is not in need of anyone else.
These two general principles we have explained—the power of the higher in the lower, and the inclusion of the power of the lower in the higher—are found in the *Zohar*... <note>The text here cites specific Zoharic passages from portions *Vayechi* and *Vayetze* regarding the "Tree" and the "Twelve Buildings" where everything is included in its companion</note> and in the *Song of Songs*... regarding the "two kisses."

# Nectar of Pomegranates: Gate 7, The Channels, Pomegranate Slice

The others, because the end of the Sefira is present in the world—and your sign for this is "Blessed is He who broadens Gad" <note>original: "ברוך מרחיב גד"; a reference to Deuteronomy 33:20, used here to explain the expansion of divine light</note>—for Moses ascended at his death to this channel. This is the **Fiftieth Gate**, positioned above the forty-nine gates <note>Kabbalistic tradition speaks of 50 Gates of Understanding; Moses attained 49 in life and the 50th at death</note>, which are seven times seven. "Like a lioness he dwells" <note>Numbers 23:24</note>; the lion <note>original: *Lavi*</note> is the secret of **Kindness** <note>original: *Chesed*</note>, thus "like a lioness" is numerically similar to the name of the angel Michael <note>Michael is the angelic representation of the Sefira of Kindness</note>. 

It broadens and diminishes the hidden channel between the third and fourth Sefirot—that is, between the **Supernal Trio** <note>original: *Gimmel Rishonot* or *GaR*; the three highest Sefirot: Crown, Wisdom, and Understanding</note> and the lower ones. The word "prey" <note>original: *taraf*</note> implies mixing and sharing. The "arm" <note>original: *zroa*</note> refers to **Kindness**. Even the "skull" <note>original: *karkapta*</note> refers to the secret of the skull that originates from **Understanding** <note>original: *Binah*</note>.

There are those who add a channel from **Wisdom** <note>original: *Chokhmah*</note> to **Severity** <note>original: *Gevurah*</note>, mirroring the channel that runs from **Understanding** to **Kindness**. However, this is not strictly necessary. Others omit the straight horizontal channels across the "Tree" <note>The "Tree of Life" diagram</note>—from Wisdom to Understanding, from **Greatness** <note>another name for Kindness</note> to Severity, and from **Victory** <note>original: *Netzach*</note> to **Splendor** <note>original: *Hod*</note>. These scholars argue that there are seven straight channels and twelve diagonal ones. They do not mention channels from Wisdom to Severity or Understanding to Kindness; rather, the two they draw from Victory and Splendor to **Kingdom** <note>original: *Malchut*</note> complete the diagonals. This final "Tree" is full of wonders, as we found it explained with great precision using a compass <note>referring to the geometric precision of the diagrams</note>; its laws are many, and we shall discuss them shortly to provide space between these complex matters.

### Chapter 2: The Sage wrote in *The Doubling of Wisdom* that the Sages of the West have a Tree of 600,000 channels

He did not explain further, but we have found and seen a Tree that is much superior in how it is drawn with honor, glory, and precision. Many laws are explained within it. Here is the summary of his words, according to our usual method of learning and teaching concisely with Divine assistance:

->Initially, he chose the general channels: seven straight and twelve<-
->diagonals, as we mentioned at the end of the previous chapter. He made the channel<-

extending from the **Crown** <note>original: *Keter*</note> to **Beauty** <note>original: *Tiferet*</note> wide and double the width of the other channels, calling it the "Wide Channel." Regarding the two channels going from Wisdom and Understanding to Beauty—which are drawn in the book *The Doubling of Wisdom* <note>original: *Kiflayim la-Tushiya*</note> as emerging from the circles of Wisdom and Understanding to reach the circle of Beauty—the author of this specific diagram had them reach only the middle of the "Wide Channel" mentioned above. This is correct, for the flow of Wisdom and Understanding is aimed toward **Knowledge** <note>original: *Da'at*</note>, which is perfected there.

Furthermore, he drew in the Sefira of the **Crown** 620 channels; in **Wisdom**, 342; in **Understanding**, 150; in **Kindness**, 248; in **Fear** <note>another name for Severity/Gevurah</note>, 365; in **Beauty**, 84; in **Victory**, 6; in **Splendor**, 6; in **Foundation** <note>original: *Yesod*</note>, 10; and in **Kingdom**, 524 channels. 

He then wrote concisely: "Inside each of the ten large circles, a small 'Tree' is drawn with all the channels we mentioned; and inside each circle of those two, another smaller Tree." These are his words. He did not intend to prevent us from adding to them further in the way of God, even to infinity; rather, this number is sufficient for a vast calculation without over-extending ourselves.

### Chapter 3: The channels of the Crown mentioned in the previous chapter; this is their order within the specifically designated Large Circle

<column-break/>

Regarding the aspect of "birth," <term>Foundation</term> <note>original: *Yesod*</note> produces "offspring" in <term>Kingdom</term> <note>original: *Malchut*</note>, which are the "offspring of souls." When Kindness is absent, offspring are still produced, and this is called "rest." It is written "Noah" <note>Noah's name means "rest"</note> twice: once for Understanding to Foundation, and once for Foundation to Kingdom. This is the secret of the "labor of offspring" <note>original: *chelat toledot*</note>. 

The "Merciful Ones" <note>original: *Rachamanim*</note> cause our life; Foundation produces offspring according to the inclinations of Kindness and Mercy toward Kingdom. There is a nature within Foundation toward Kingdom that allows for the "Correction" <note>original: *Tikkun*</note> and adornment of the Kingdom, separate from the act of "mating" <note>original: *revi'ah*</note>. This is for the benefit of the "segments" and "strands" <note>symbolic terms for the structure of the soul-vessels</note>. This Kindness adds a nature that allows for the birthing and union of the souls of the "Silver" order <note>a specific level of soul-hierarchy</note>. 

Just as there is a third type of "mating" intended to grow and glorify the "wings" and "horns" <note>metaphors for the spiritual extensions of the soul</note>, so too does this nature exist to grow and glorify the souls with intention and zeal within the Kingdom. This nature joins with the "wings" to glorify them. This is the secret of the soul being given in the "lodging of the moon" <note>referring to the Sefira of Kingdom/Malchut</note> as explained in the *Tikkunim* <note>The *Tikkuney Zohar*</note>. This occurs at times for "unions" <note>original: *chibburim*</note>, such as on a day that is entirely "Grace" <note>original: *Chen*</note>. 

To Foundation belongs the "Covenant of Holiness" <term>Brit Kodesh</term> <note>the sign of the circumcision, linked to Yesod</note> and to Kingdom the "Female." Regarding this, it is said "twice," for all the nature of Foundation acts in the first aspect as a sign of "birth," where it alone produces offspring and includes the "Merciful Ones." The second aspect of Foundation is with the Kingdom, the nature that flows into her for her union and existence alone. Foundation in this nature is the "Crown" <note>original: *Katar*</note> and your sign is "The Righteous is the Foundation of the world." 

The third aspect is "Peace," as its sign is "the child playing with the snake" <note>Isaiah 11:8</note>, where "milk" flows from above and is channeled through Foundation. This is the secret of the "Offspring of Peace," as in the "Covenant of Peace." In this Wisdom, it is called "Life." Because "Voice" produces offspring, and Kingdom is the "Voice of the speech of the Foundation of the World," we mentioned that "Voice" places "Peace" in the world so that a flood will never again come to destroy all flesh. This is the general rule: Foundation alone, even without Kindness, produces offspring in Kingdom and flows into her; she receives from him and not from Kindness directly. Even though in many places it is said that Kindness is the cause of the flow to Kingdom, the intention is not that the nature is drawn to Kingdom directly, but rather that the nature is distributed from those attributes and travels through the Foundation to enter the Kingdom. For it is the way of Foundation to give life and pass through all the nature that comes to the Kingdom from all the higher Sefirot.

# Chapter 8
Our predecessors, may peace be upon them, taught us of two paths in the final channel of the "Standardized Tree" <note>The Tree of Life diagram</note> that we mentioned in the first chapter. These are hinted at by the two heads of the Hebrew letters **Ayin** and **Tzadi**. The right side corresponds to the "Flavors of the Torah" <note>original: *Ta’amei Torah*; the musical cantillation marks and their inner meanings</note>, about which it is said: "Let all who are thirsty come to the waters" <note>Isaiah 55:1</note>—waters sweeter than honey and the drippings of the honeycomb. From there, the **Divine Presence** <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note>, all the prophets, and the pious draw their nourishment. From there, the angels and the souls of the righteous were created, according to the opinion of the Kabbalists. 

The left side, however, is for the strengthening of the powers of **Judgment** <note>original: *Din*</note>. The "External Forces" <note>original: *Chitzonim*; the spiritual realms of impurity</note> suck from these bitter waters, the "wine of their libations," and thus the wicked prosper in this world. This is the secret of the "Great Ayin" <note>original: *Ayin Rabati*; a large letter Ayin found in the Torah</note> in the verse "so that the wicked may be cut off from it" <note>Psalm 104:35/Job 38:15</note>. 

From our own flesh, we can perceive these two entries <note>A reference to Job 19:26: "From my flesh I shall see God," meaning human anatomy reflects divine structures</note>: through the passage of the pure and holy seed, and the funnel that casts out water <note>urine</note>. Both exist within the same organ <note>original: *Ammah*; a term for the male reproductive organ, associated with the Sefira of *Yesod*</note>, and between them is a thin membrane. If it is punctured in the slightest, it becomes disqualified, and its blemish nullifies the reproductive power. One path opens while the other closes, depending on the preparation. Therefore, they said of it: "This is a disqualification that can return to fitness." 

Those who ate the **Manna** in the desert would take it in but not excrete it, following the secret of holiness, which contains no **Husk** <note>original: *Klipa*; the shell of impurity</note> at all. Conversely, within the power of the Husks, there is a lowly creature—the **gnat**—which takes in but does not excrete. Regarding this, it is written: "To a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet" <note>Proverbs 27:7</note>. Thus, every thing is drawn to its source and root, according to the preparation of its place and time. 

It is known that the Husk does not enter the Holy Palace, Heaven forbid. Rather, this channel—which is the root of Faith and Unity—is also the root of "the rebellion of the slanderer who separates the Master" <note>original: *mifrid aluf*; a reference to Proverbs 16:28, interpreted as separating God from His Presence</note>. This ensures that the Assembly of Israel does not ascend with good spirits, but like a poor woman cast far off, tasting the "Bitter Other Side" <note>original: *Sitra Achra*; the side of evil</note> from outside the camp, with no return, becoming a "river ruined and dried up." 

From what has been explained, the totality of Kingship is found at the head of the organ, in the letter of its **Glans** <note>original: *Tzaba*; referring to the "Crown" or tip of the organ</note>, to crown the Righteous One (*Tzaddik*). All agree that the Righteous One is never truly defiled. Now, the eye sees and the ear hears that the "Crown" is not defiled, for it is very far from the "Worthless Man" <note>original: *Adam Belial*; a personification of evil</note> whose station is outside all the holy camps. 

Or consider this way: the woman whom God has designated to sustain the seed receives the drop from the boundary from which it comes to that where it goes, in a hidden manner, and it does not defile at all, Heaven forbid. Rather, it is only that the "Sludge of the Matter" must be purified; the residues that depart with the discharge require immersion and the setting of the sun. None of this exists in the world of **Emanation** <note>original: *Atzilut*; the highest spiritual world</note>, not even a fraction of it; it exists only in the lower worlds, each according to its nature.

**However**, the relationship of the left channel we mentioned—its secret and its reason—is that in this aspect above, the **Foundation** (*Yesod*) does not bestow upon **Kingship** (*Malchut*) except with great contraction (*tzimtzum*). This is what is required for the maintenance of existence. It is an aspect of pure Judgment. He does not embrace her with the "Right Hand" in a way of affection and delightful love; on the contrary, he barely bestows upon her, and "his heart is not with her" <note>Proverbs 23:7</note>, for there is no one "doing good on the earth." Indeed, the Perfect Man is a "High Necessity" without doubt. 

In any case, through this bestowal, absolute holiness does not come to her; rather, it is not an abundant flow "according to the King’s hand." The contraction itself causes accusations from the "External Forces," and may our God have mercy. 

A hollow man may be emboldened <note>Job 11:12</note> by the sin of the "son of the Israelite woman, whose mother's name was Shelomith daughter of Dibri" <note>Leviticus 24:11</note>. The Sage <note>The Zohar</note> said below: "Dan, daughter of Dibri" <note>wordplay on "Dan" meaning judgment and "Dibri" meaning speech</note>. He was the son of an Egyptian man whom Moses killed with the Explicit Name <note>the Tetragrammaton</note>. They placed him in custody because it had not been specified what to do. Moses "turned this way and that" <note>Exodus 2:12</note> and said: "This is how it is for the one who raises himself above all: Yossi shall strike Yossi" <note>A cryptic Talmudic expression regarding judgment</note>. God acted so that they should fear Him, and not more than this. 

My son, be careful, for "the heart has not revealed it to the mouth." Blessed is the portion of the righteous who know the matter and keep it for God. Behold, these two holes were sunken into the **Righteous One** <note>the Sefira Yesod</note> who was the leader and bestower to the upper and lower realms twice—even to the external forces, providing food for all before the exile of the Shekhinah, and even afterward when she "leans upon her beloved" <note>Song of Songs 8:5</note>, to grow and strengthen everyone.

# Chapter 9: Who (*Mi*)
One should meditate on the connection of the Sefirot in their equality, which each one has with all of them, as will be clearly explained. For the channels change according to the "Aspects" <note>original: *Bechinot*</note> and multiply into the thousands and tens of thousands. Their layering one over the other follows the way explained regarding the Sefirot. For the channel that exists between **Crown** (*Keter*) and **Wisdom** (*Chokhmah*)—by virtue of the Crown being included in both of them—is superior to a similar channel included from the side of Wisdom. 

Similarly, when the Crown unites with all the Sefirot, and we wish to draw the Mercy of the Crown into all of them, we unify Wisdom with the Crown, and Understanding with the Crown (specifically the "Crown aspect" within them). We unify **Kindness** (*Chesed*) with Wisdom and **Strength** (*Gevurah*) with Understanding through the aspect of the Crown, and so on for all of them in their roots. 

According to the abundance of this "Inclusion," so the "Recipient Mirror" <note>original: *Mar’ah HaMekabelet*; the Sefira of Malchut</note> will receive in its highest point—which is the "Crown of the Daughter" within her—and she will bestow upon the "Crown of Kingship" within her, to maintain the equality from Crown to Crown. The Crown itself will be unified in all of them. Thus one examines whenever one intends to connect another attribute with all of them, or some of them, according to the measure set and according to the aspect of Kindness, Judgment, or Mercy. Everything is in perfect equality: the Kindness or Judgment within all of them, and so on for all specific aspects without end.

A channel is never considered to exist between two distant Sefirot unless the intermediary Sefira between them participates with them. Many such cases exist. However, the flow that comes to the destination boundary is from the power that recognizes the essence of the Sefira of the originating boundary, and the boundary in between agrees with them. Furthermore, no intellect prevents another intellect, for there is no "collision of physical bodies" there. The middle Sefira would never act as a barrier or partition, Heaven forbid. Sometimes it is observed that the Crown bestows from the "Crown within it" to the "Wisdom within Wisdom," and from there to the "Understanding within Understanding," and so on. 

What I have shown you to know regarding the "Tree" in general applies to its fellow: to the ten Sefirot within every single Sefira. With this, we clearly know the agreement of all the Sefirot in the conduct of all actions. The practitioner should visualize before him a **Segolta** and two **Segols** <note>Vowel marks ( ֪ and ֶ ) used here as geometric templates for Sefirotic diagrams</note> and **Kingship**. Around every attribute, he should draw ten Sefirot in their order in an encompassing nest. He should direct the "Faces" he desires—these across from those—and his heart will understand what no man can speak, and what no ear can be filled with hearing.

### Chapter 6: Channels
<margin>Two from here and there to the channel coming to it from Lovingkindness and one between the two diagonals belonging to Beauty and Foundation.</margin>
**Victory** <note>original: *Netzach*</note>, **Splendor** <note>original: *Hod*</note>, **Foundation** <note>original: *Yesod*</note>, and **Kingship** <note>original: *Malchut*</note>—this is their arrangement within the circle of **Victory**. Six circles emerge through their channels, with one corresponding to them from the outside, and one between the channel leading to **Foundation** and the channel leading to **Kingship**, and one corresponding to it from the outside. There are six corresponding to these in **Splendor**. These are the twelve borders of **Beauty** <note>original: *Tiferet*</note>, which is divided between the two of them. **And within** the circle of **Foundation**, ten circles emerge through their channels: five on the right side (two above and three below) and similarly on the left side. That is, above between the channels of **Beauty** and **Victory**, and below between the channel of **Victory** and **Kingship**, and likewise on the other side. From the six lower circles, they draw the abundance for the six days of the week, which are found within the Tree of Purity.

**And within** the circle of **Kingship**, twenty-four circles emerge through their channels in the permutations of the Name *ADNY* <note>The divine name of Lordship associated with Malchut</note>. With the Great Circle, they are twenty-five, following the secret of "So shall you bless" <note>original: *Koh* (כה = 25); Numbers 6:23</note>, which is a title for them. Two are between the channel of **Victory** and **Foundation**, and likewise two between the channel of **Splendor** and **Foundation**, and ten extensions below this on each side. From these twenty lower ones, four circles emerge from each, totaling eighty, according to the secret of the letter **Pe** <note>numerical value 80</note>, of which it is said: "Face to face" <note>original: *Pe el Pe*; Numbers 12:8</note>, and "Face to face I will speak with him." This is also called *Af* <note>meaning 'nostril' or 'anger'</note>, which is the small letter *Aleph* in the word "And He called" <note>original: *Vayikra* (Leviticus 1:1); written with a small Aleph</note>. It is also called "Mouth" <note>original: *Pe*</note> along with the circle of **Kingship**, which is the small letter *He*. From the four inner circles, five circles emerge through their channels from each, totaling twenty. Together with the eighty mentioned before, these are "From the Lord" <note>original: *Me'et Adonai*; the word *Me'et* can be read as 'One Hundred'</note>—the one hundred blessings. From these hundred, four emerge through the channels of each, according to the secret of the letter **Tav** <note>numerical value 400</note>, the final letter of the alphabet and the finality of the Structure. With the hundred, they total five hundred, according to the secret of the "thickness of the firmament which is a journey of five hundred years." The total number of all of them together is five hundred and twenty-four, as stated.

### Chapter 7: To Satisfy
To satisfy the longing soul who wishes to hear the words of the ancients, I have expanded the discussion on these channels. Every wise-hearted person will understand and perceive that these matters are without measure. If we were to assign channels to every inquiry regarding each and every Sefira, they would multiply without end. It is almost a redundant teaching, for so wrote Rabbi Abraham <note>likely Rabbi Abraham ha-Levi Berukhim</note>, of blessed memory, the student of the Sage <note>Rabbi Moshe Cordovero</note>, in a response. These are his words: "Know that the study of Channels is not found in the words of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>the traditional author of the Zohar</note>, but only from the earlier Kabbalists. When our master Rabbi Moses [Cordovero] turned his hand to the introductions in the book *Elimah*, he did not mention them because the channels are only necessary in the Order of Emanation in a different manner. We possess a secret and an order of emanation in ways so startling that the secret of these channels does not even enter the 'Sabbath limit' <note>a metaphor for a minimal range or comparison</note> of those matters." Whoever diligently studies the words of Rabbi Shimon in the *Zohar* and the *Tikkunim* will find the flow of the Attributes and their nourishment in various types. My teacher <note>Cordovero</note> depicted them in his illustrations in the explanation of *Elimah* according to the way of the "Surrounding Lights" <note>original: *Makifim*</note>. Thus far are the words of Rabbi Abraham. One should also look at the book *Elimah*, in a long and honorable chapter at the end of *Ein Shemesh*.

Behold, the Sage <note>Cordovero</note> did not cease loving the study of the Channels until he repeatedly addressed them, even in the "Tree of Surrounding Lights." After he opened channels for them from one Surrounding Light to its neighbor in order from cause to effect without an intermediary—which are the channels of direct causes—Rabbi Moses [Cordovero] inquired into the channels that come by "leaping" <note>skipping over an intermediate Sefira</note>. He began with a leap of one Sefira, following the secret of the "remote cause," as we already mentioned in the Fifth Gate. This was from **Crown** to **Understanding**, from **Wisdom** to **Lovingkindness**, from **Understanding** to **Strength**, from **Lovingkindness** to **Beauty**, and from **Strength** to **Victory**, following the secret of the "Decisive Scale" and the diagonals explained in the Third Chapter of the First Gate. Also from **Beauty** to **Splendor**, and from **Victory** to **Foundation**. Thus far. He concluded by saying there is no channel from **Splendor** to **Kingship** except through **Foundation**.

**Afterward**, he explained the "leaps" of two: from **Crown** to **Lovingkindness**, from **Wisdom** to **Strength**, and from **Understanding** to **Beauty** (which we will see later). Likewise from **Lovingkindness** to **Victory**, from **Strength** to **Splendor**, and from **Beauty** to **Foundation**. He said that from **Victory** to **Kingship**, a channel would not be appropriate, as we mentioned above. Nevertheless, the Sage did not refrain from counting a channel from **Strength**, **Lovingkindness**, **Understanding**, **Wisdom**, and **Crown** to **Kingship**. He explained regarding **Strength**, **Lovingkindness**, and **Understanding** that they pass through **Foundation**. Even though he did not explicitly state this condition for the first two <note>Crown and Wisdom</note>, it is either so that the hidden may be learned from the explicit, or for a sufficient reason regarding the supernal realms—that **Kingship** might ascend and change to meet them. In any case, it is possible in this way that we too might posit channels from **Victory** and **Splendor** that reach her via **Foundation**. Just as we will soon add a channel based on logic from **Beauty** to **Kingship**, for what is the difference?

**He mentioned** in the leap of three: from **Crown** to **Strength** (and said "this we have not heard, and it is very strange"); from **Wisdom** to **Beauty** (common and essential); from **Understanding** to **Victory** (very strange, unless through another attribute, as in "Pleasantness is at Your right hand forever" <note>Psalm 16:11</note>—meaning the pleasantness comes from **Understanding** and through it, that which is **Lovingkindness** is drawn to **Victory**); and from **Lovingkindness** to **Splendor** (explained above in Gate 1, Chapter 3); from **Strength** to **Foundation** (Isaac, the end of life, the Living God, the Covenant of Circumcision—all one). We must add from **Beauty** to **Kingship**, which the Sage did not mention because it too is via **Foundation**, as we noted.

**And in the leap** of four: from **Crown** to **Beauty**, from **Wisdom** to **Victory**, from **Understanding** to **Splendor**, and from **Lovingkindness** to **Foundation** (as it is explicitly stated in the *Idra* <note>a section of the Zohar</note> that **Foundation** is the extension of **Lovingkindness**), and from **Strength** to **Kingship** (which is "lower Strength" from "upper Strength"), though it is via **Foundation**. In the leap of five: from **Crown** to **Victory** and from **Wisdom** to **Splendor** (both very strange). However, from **Understanding** to **Foundation** is the secret of the number eighteen <note>original: *Chai* (חי)</note> and there is its essence; and from **Lovingkindness** to **Kingship** via **Foundation**, where its essence lies.

**And in the leap** of six: from **Crown** to **Splendor** (strange and not found); from **Wisdom** to **Foundation** (found in the secret of the letter *Yod*, as it is written:

The vessel is built from three *Vavs* <note>The Hebrew letter 'ו', which has the numerical value of 6, often representing the six directions or the central Sefirot</note>, as will be explained later. **Furthermore**, they said in the *Tikkunim* <note>referring to the *Tikkunei Zohar*, a classic Kabbalistic text</note>: "When this Stone <note>original: *Avna*; a symbol for the Sefira of Malchut (Kingship)</note> seeks to execute judgment upon Amalek <note>the biblical archetype of evil and doubt</note> or upon other 'Other Sides' <note>original: *Sitra Achra*; the realms of impurity</note>, and likewise upon the wicked, it draws from **Strength** <note>original: *Gevurah*</note>, and all the Sefirot are included within it and are called 'Strengths.' They explained that all [the Sefirot] agree with the attribute of **Strength** in the reality they possess within the **Kingship** <note>original: *Malchut*</note> that conducts the world. However, in their own source, they do not change their function. As they said: no Sefira is ruled by another unless it is included within the ten during its own governance. This proves that all of them have the power to perform opposite actions—sometimes in judgment and sometimes in mercy. In truth, they all agree to the actions that extend below, for not one of them acts at all except through all of them together, by their mutual agreement through **Kingship**. The expression for this is that each one of them is "included of ten," for behold, **Lovingkindness** <note>original: *Chesed*</note> is included of **Strength**, and the other attributes. And **Strength** is included of **Lovingkindness** and the other attributes. Thus, **Strength** is bound to **Lovingkindness** in one of two ways: either through the 'Strength within Lovingkindness'—which is the 'Strength within Strength' <note>likely a scribal error or nuance regarding the nested attributes</note>—or the 'Lovingkindness within Strength' is bound to the attribute of **Lovingkindness**, which is 'Lovingkindness within Lovingkindness.' Likewise, **Beauty** <note>original: *Tiferet*</note> is bound with both of them in the two ways we mentioned: from the side of Lovingkindness and Strength within Beauty, and from the side of Beauty within Lovingkindness and Strength.

# Chapter 2

We find many times that the Sefirot are grouped in the Emanated Body <note>the structure of the Divine realm</note> according to the needs of an action. Sometimes this occurs through the revelation of only three Sefirot, which are **Lovingkindness**, **Judgment**, and **Mercy**. Sometimes from four, which are the three mentioned—hinted at by **Fire**, **Wind**, and **Water**—and one that includes them all, which is the **Foundation** <note>original: *Yesod*</note>, the fifth, according to the principle that it includes the three of them. This is the secret of the four letters of the [Divine] Name, where the fourth letter serves the first ones. Sometimes they are grouped as five, like the "five crossbars of the Tabernacle" <note>Exodus 26:26</note>: **Lovingkindness, Strength, Beauty, Victory, and Splendor**. Sometimes as six, which are the "six extremities" <note>the spatial dimensions</note>. Sometimes as seven, from **Lovingkindness** unto **Kingship**. Sometimes as eight, including **Understanding** <note>original: *Binah*</note>. Sometimes as ten, from the **Crown** <note>original: *Keter*</note> downward, or from **Wisdom** <note>original: *Chokhmah*</note> downward, with **Knowledge** <note>original: *Da'at*</note> completing the count. This is not merely a simple inclusion, for there are never fewer than ten; rather, the intention is that all of them are blended into three or four, and thus the light and revelation appear specifically in that attribute. **Furthermore**, there is a general division of the ten Sefirot into three "Worlds":
1. The **Intellectual** <note>original: *Mushkal*</note>, in **Wisdom** and **Understanding**, in the reality of the Roots.
2. The **Emotional** <note>original: *Hurgash*</note>, in **Beauty** <note>the six central attributes</note>, the secret of the Actions.
3. The **Natural** <note>original: *Mutba*</note>, in **Victory, Splendor, and Foundation**, which are the messengers to reveal the actions.
**Kingship** is included in the "Natural" and receives from all of them through the **Foundation**. We say **Wisdom** and **Understanding** are in the Intellectual, and the **Crown** includes them above, just as **Kingship** includes them below. They are also divided into three lines: **Wisdom-Lovingkindness-Victory** (the Line of Grace); **Understanding-Strength-Splendor** (the Line of Judgment); and **Knowledge-Beauty-Foundation** (the Line of Mercy). The **Crown** and **Kingship** include them all. **And in the Portion of Vayechi**, Rabbi Eliezer said: "The Divine Presence <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note> does not dwell amidst sadness," as it is written: "But now bring me a musician. And it happened, when the musician played..." <note>2 Kings 3:15</note>. The word "musician" <note>original: *menagen*</note> is mentioned three times to awaken the spirit from perfection...

...the Eye, whose function is to distance them, through many changes: for a good life, for a bad life, for a bound life, for a diminished life. And **Understanding** is in this, in the form of movement within **Understanding**, and a rectification for the actions of the other Sefirot. <margin>Five</margin> corresponding to the five afflictions of Yom Kippur <note>The Day of Atonement</note>, and they are the five simple ones like **Lovingkindness**, and between them is **Lovingkindness**. ## Chapter 2: On being Sefirot

Without end to all things and the "ends" <note>original: *sofim*</note>, therefore they are called *Sefirot*.
1. From the language of **Sapphire** <note>original: *Sapir*</note>, which receives all colors (and see that it has no specific color of its own, and even if each one has a known color, nevertheless, in this aspect, they have no specific color in the Sefira).
2. And some say they are called *Sefirot* from the language of "The heavens **declare** <note>original: *mesaprim*</note> the glory of God" <note>Psalm 19:2</note>, for they perceive the thoughts of the worlds and the revelations of creatures and the depths.
3. And some say they are called *Sefirot* from the language of **Story** <note>original: *Sippur*</note> and Speech, because the storytelling and speaking about them is more [possible] than it is with the Infinite <note>original: *Ein Sof*</note>.
4. And some say they are called *Sefirot* from the language of **Number** <note>original: *Mispar*</note> and lack, for they are distinguished by number and boundary. Even though they are infinite in relation to boundaries, in relation to the Godhead, they are within a boundary.
5. And some say they are called *Sefirot* from the language of "Border" <note>original: *Sefar*</note> which is close to "Number," meaning a boundary; for through them, we understand within a boundary that which has no boundary—and all this is in relation to the Emanator, as mentioned above.

**And even though** we explained that every single Sefira has its own strength and action, know that the Sefira does not perform an action on its own without the agreement of all of them as one, so that there should be no separation or division between them, God forbid. When it is said that an action is done by a certain Sefira, the meaning is that when **Lovingkindness** prevails in the Sefira that receives the **Kingship**, then the action occurs, and then all of them will be within "Kindnesses," and all will agree—save for the Lovingkindness from which the action is performed. And so it is with all other actions attributed to the other Sefirot. Thus Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai explained in the book of *Tikkunim*, of blessed memory: "When this Stone seeks to execute judgment upon Amalek or upon other 'Other Sides,' and likewise upon the wicked, it draws from **Strength**, and all the Sefirot are included within it and are called 'Strength.' And when it seeks grace and lovingkindness in the world, it draws from **Lovingkindness**, and all the Sefirot are included within it and are called 'Kindnesses.' And when it seeks to have mercy upon the world, it draws from the **Middle Pillar**, and all the Sefirot are included within it and are called 'Mercies.'"

**If** one should doubt: how is it possible that the attribute of Lovingkindness should agree and turn into Judgment, and the attribute of Judgment agree and turn into Mercy, etc., when the attributes of the Sefirot are opposites of one another? Know that the matter is not exactly so, but because each one of the Sefirot is included of ten, the power of all is within each one. Through the equality of this inclusion, they can become unified and participate with one another. And the matter of what we said—that each one is included of ten—the intention is not that Lovingkindness is a part of flesh and Strength, or Strength a part of Lovingkindness... for if so, the matter would be a division into separate parts. # The Eighth Gate: Essence and Governance

## Chapter One: The Inclusion of the Attributes within One Another, occurring in Three Aspects

**First**, by the inherent virtue of their source <note>original: *machatzav*; literally "the quarry" from which they were hewn</note>, they are never lacking; even for a moment, all of them are included within the **ten** <term>Sefirot (the ten divine emanations or channels of light)</term>. **Second**, and more refined, is when they unite "face to face." There are distinctions in this: in the **General Governance**, sometimes seven [lower attributes] shine within seven, and sometimes seven shine within ten. At times, all ten shine and reveal themselves through the seven lamps <note>a reference to the seven lower Sefirot, often compared to the Menorah</note>, and when goodness increases, ten shine within ten. However, in **Particular Governance**, the dominant attribute shines toward the specific place of desire. **Third**, which is more constant than the first and more refined, is that as the [Divine] Emanation spreads, the reality of the descending attributes is formed within all of them; they unite and are awakened from every "face" they encountered during their passage.

**This** inclusion is hinted at regarding the **Kingship** <term>Malchut (the final Sefira, associated with the Divine Presence on Earth)</term> in the *Tikkunim* <note>The *Tikkunei Zohar*, a classic text of Jewish mysticism</note>. On the verse "God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering of the waters He called Seas," they said: This is the "hope <note>original: *mikveh*; also means 'gathering' or 'ritual bath'</note> of Israel, its savior in time of trouble." The source of the flow comes from that "Seed" drawn from the **Supernal Mind** <note>the Sefira of *Chochmah* (Wisdom)</note>. This "drop" is the small letter *Yod* [י]. When it leaves the Mind, which is **Wisdom** <note>original: *Chochmah*</note>, every Sefira takes its portion until it is divided into nine points. Once each has taken its portion, a tenth remains from all those drops. This is taken by the "Dry Land" <note>representing Malchut</note>, and she is the "Tenth" who is the canopy for all the other nine of the ten, etc. 

And they said: "In the beginning" <note>original: *Bereishit*</note> refers to the **Torah**, of which it is said, "The Lord possessed me at the beginning of His way." This refers to the **Lower Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah (the indwelling presence of God)</term>, who is the "Beginning" for the created beings, but the "End" for the **Supernal Wisdom**. Regarding her structure, it is said: "Declaring the end from the beginning." When she receives from **Crown** <note>original: *Keter*</note>, she is called the "Diadem of Beauty" <note>the crown on the head of the Sefira *Tiferet*</note>, a crown on the head of every righteous person, the "Crown of the Torah Scroll." Regarding her, it is said: "One who makes [unauthorized] use of the Crown shall pass away." When she receives from **Supernal Wisdom**, she is called by its name, **Wisdom**. When she receives from **Understanding** <note>original: *Binah*</note>, she is called **Discernment** <note>original: *Tevunah*</note>. When she receives from **Lovingkindness** <note>original: *Chesed*</note>, she is called the **Written Torah**, which is on the right, as it is written: "From His right hand went a fiery law for them." When she receives from **Strength** <note>original: *Gevurah*</note>, she is called the **Oral Torah**. Thus the masters of the Mishnah established: "The Oral Torah was given from the mouth of Strength <note>original: *HaGevurah*; a traditional Rabbinic name for God</note>." Only a "mighty one" who stands in the breach can master it—one who is mighty in the "war of Torah" and mighty over his own [evil] inclination. 

On the third day <note>of Creation/Revelation</note>, she descended to the **Middle Pillar** <term>Tiferet (the attribute of Balance/Beauty)</term> through Moses; as it is written: "And it came to pass on the third day, when it was morning." She appeared in the two tablets of stone, **Victory and Splendor** <note>original: *Nezach* and *Hod*</note>, as it is written: "Written on both their sides." These are the two "Prophets of Truth." From the side of the Middle Pillar, they are called "Prophets of Truth," and the Divine Presence is the "Torah of Truth," as it is written: "The Torah of Truth was in his mouth." She is also called the "Vision of Prophecy" and the "Holy Spirit" from the side of both of them. (On the seventh day she was given; this is the **Righteous One**, the **Foundation** <note>original: *Yesod*</note> of the world. In his degree, the **Kingship** spoke with them. They established that even ten kings could not speak with a single mouth; He touched the [letter] *Bet* and included within her all the ten.) Until here [is the quote]. And they said: In her degree, she returns [to her source], having also the thousand "faces" of herself... for she flows through the letter *He*... for this reason, He "touched the *Bet*" <note>referring to the first letter of the Torah</note>, for in the *Bet* [numerical value 2] are the two [letters] *He* of the Divine Name...

## Chapter 1: On the Explanation of the Attributes of the Sefirot

Know that the Sefirot act as a power of "good" for all things, but also for their opposites and reversals, by the power and will of the Good Name <note>God</note>. They receive kindness and rest, or anger and strengthening, and all things and their opposites. Thus, the Sefirot are the power prepared to receive and enact **Judgment**, **Mercy**, and the like—many diverse and varied actions. Although the source of these actions is one, the Sefirot act in all things and their opposites. Does not the Blessed Lord have the power to bring forth all things? Why then were they [the Sefirot] emanated? 

It may be said: They were emanated as ten Sefirot so that created beings could perceive and benefit from the light of the flow of the Great King, and to recognize His power... as explained in Gate 3. Furthermore, even though every Sefira is a name that includes many "faces," nevertheless, every name and power has a specific order, time, boundary, restoration, virtue, action, and precious quality, so that their paths might be equal and the faces do not clash. All of this is for the need and benefit of the created beings, as His Wisdom (blessed be He) decreed. For even though the actions are many, they are all directed toward the benefit of the world... these things are **Kindnesses**, and yet they are revealed in the **Crown**. 

Likewise, **Repentance** <term>Teshuvah</term> has its root in **Understanding** (*Binah*). (And there is the essence of forgiveness and atonement, by the power of the Crown that flows upon it. So too, every Sefira has different actions.) What was said above—that there is a power including all opposites—is like the action of "Preparation," which must enact many opposites. For example, in Repentance, it must receive the penitent. There are many levels in Repentance itself: there is one who performs "Great Repentance" in the light of the King... his level rises to the place where the level of David <note>King David</note> rose. And there is one who performs "Small Repentance," whose level cannot reach that same place. 

Thus, every Sefira has an action unique to it. Therefore, His Wisdom (blessed be He) decreed to increase the general categories and the specific attributes, to oversee every single thing with a specific power. (Furthermore... the Sefirot are the revelation of the Supernal powers... and this is the meaning of the Names: "The Merciful," "The Gracious," "The Mighty," "The Great," "The Splendid," and "The Kingdom." These are attributes included within Him... like the limbs of a body, Heaven forbid, as explained in Gate 2.) 

When a person asks: Why did He make man in his "garment" <note>the physical body</note> with two eyes and two hands, or ten fingers? The answer is that since the body is the garment for the soul, the garment was required to correspond to all its limbs. (So too, the Sefirot are the "garment" for His attributes and actions.) The body was required to have all its limbs, joints, sinews, and skins... to be "garments" for the Sefirot, whose actions are revealed through these details... They said in the *Zohar* that if there is a matter below, it is because there is a corresponding matter above... for the action directed from the Sefirot must effect many changes, like the **Eye**...

# The Eighth Gate: Essence and Governance

The highest level and its "vapor" <note>original: *ido*; likely referring to the subtle emanation</note> in the **Crown** <term>Keter (the highest Sefira, representing the Divine Will)</term> consists of Ancient Light, Pure Light, and Refined Light. There too, the Sefirot exist as a reflection in the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>, and in the point of **Wisdom** <term>Chochmah</term> of this Crown, they exist in a hidden state within the secret of "The Knower." They are then prepared in the point of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> within it, in the secret of "The Known." This Understanding, in its totality, is the Crown, where judgments are absent and the Sefirot are in a state of concealment. The Crown and Wisdom, which ascend to the "Crown of Understanding," are entirely stripped of judgments. However, the **Infinite** <term>Ein Sof (God as He is in Himself, beyond all definition)</term> is stripped even of the Sefirot themselves. See the book *Elimah* at its beginning, where he expanded greatly on this inquiry; this is the essence of his intent:

**The ancients explained that in the Crown there are 620 Pillars of Light, corresponding to the numerical value of:**
-> The Lord reigns, the Lord reigned, the Lord will reign forever <-
and ever <note>The Hebrew word for "Crown" (Keter) has a numerical value (Gematria) of 620, which matches the number of letters in the Ten Commandments</note>. There is no doubt that they descend one from another through hints of Cause and Effect, and all are contained within the first Effect. Corresponding to them are the 620 letters in the first set of the **Ten Commandments**. Every pillar is full and perfected by these three "Existences" <note>The three tenses of God's kingship: past, present, and future</note> that we mentioned—from the inside, which is its **Inner Light**, and from the outside, in the **Surrounding Light**, which is equal above but perceived through its boundaries as it extends downward.

Every one of them has a "Rectification" and a "Permutation." Rectification <note>original: *Tikkun*</note> is their arrangement from beginning to end, and Permutation <note>original: *Tzeruf*</note> is the changing of their order, placing the last first and the first last, like the six permutations of the name Y-H-W <note>The three-letter root of the Tetragrammaton</note>, and every word like it consisting of three letters. Go and calculate the permutations of 620 pillars—no mouth or tongue can describe their magnitude! This is the "Rectification that comes to Permutation," and afterward, one must return the Permutation to the Rectification to unify all the "branches" <note>the extended details of creation</note> with their "root," aside from the transformation of the Rectification and all its permutations into the twenty-two alphabets. From all these, utterances, totals, and calculations arise beyond investigation.

**The foundation** of this secret is that as long as there is an individual spiritual force, and when letters are gathered together, the perfection of the word is elevated according to their number. Their virtue is increased by the power of the gathering. All permutations of a word are branches of the spirituality included in the Rectification. So too, these pillars are examined one by one, and every pillar permutes with every other one, and with every two, until the end of the gathering, which is the total of 620 pillars. This is the height of their stature; there is no end to their subtlety due to the many branches that unify in the Cause—or the Cause of Causes—both far and near. If these are for Rectification alone, and for Permutation thus and so, what then of the "Utterance," the "Total," and the "Calculation"?

**Everything** emerges from the "Source of the Flame." It is possible that this is the inheritance of the "Y-D" <note>The letters Yud-Dalet, equaling 14</note> within the Name. The "Flame" <note>original: *Shalhevet*</note> is the sum of the branches spreading from its hidden vapor, which is the Crown, where the concealment of all branches exists. With the addition of concealment in their unification with the **Infinite**, whose comprehension is impossible, it is the "Hidden Darkness." Comprehension only begins from Wisdom downward, through three changing attributes, each a species unto itself. These are a "Rectification" for the Transformations and Permutations, for the Transformations are attributes and the attributes are Transformations—they are revealed in the patterns of the "Sphere" and the "Heart." From them, we recognize the hidden things that rest upon the Crown itself in its unity with the **Emanator**. By returning things to the "Source of the Flame," one knows—through the power of the Permutation—the height of the levels and the multitude of secrets possible to grasp from a single word of the Torah. All the branches return to its hidden light, though we cannot see the "Superior Faces" within the branches of the root.

<column-break/>

They are themselves (and thus Isaac is explained from seven rotations, like seven pearls; eighteen for him, eighteen seventy times eighteen, and sometimes a "ledge" <note>original: *karkov*</note>... like the numbers "precious" and "as fermented"). They are like generalities... and he will remove seven pearls, seven ceremonies... and sometimes the "holy" as its general total... Joseph will ascend like the "Holy Joseph"... this indicates impressions that were more hidden than revealed... for the saving of the branches. **Furthermore**, there are "Conveyors" <term>molichiyot (forces that transmit influence)</term> that are generalities... and they bring about its longing at the time of coming into being. It descends... in the order of its birth... as will be explained in the Gate of Conveyors. There are also "Realities" for them, but in the Cause, in the levels above the assigned level... this longing has "Conveyors" as well, but in the Crown and Understanding, the Conveyors are from the "Pruning" <note>original: *mikanah*</note>, and that is the level that is known and found. This is in the totality of Conveyors. **Furthermore**, sometimes in the aspect of the three "Lines" <note>the right, left, and center pillars of the Sefirotic tree</note> from the side of Judgment and Mercy, they are included... and the "Turning" <note>original: *nesibah*</note> is the essence of the spiritual branch... and in the "Turning" downward... in the inclusion of the six edges they will be included in the five... and when included in the ten they will be 160. These revealed things are explained in the *Gate of the Essence* and in the *Tikkunim* (see there).

### Chapter Three: After we have explained the matter of the attributes of the Sefirot in a general way, we will explain the attribute of Strength and Wisdom in the Crown.

**The ancients** grasped the **Crown** as complete Mercy without any Judgment whatsoever. One should not wonder how the "Answer" <note>original: *onah*</note> could be from the side of **Strength** <term>Gevurah (the attribute of Judgment or Power)</term>, which is the eighth from the Crown. Since Strength is Judgment, how could it be included in the Crown? One can say that although Power <note>original: *kavod/gevurah*</note> possesses a side of Judgment, it manifests as special qualities and good actions, like the "Power of Rain" <note>original: *Gevurot Geshamim*</note>. Although they come from the attribute of Power, they are a mercy to the world.

Similarly, the "Strong One" who conquers his evil inclination—that strength comes from the attribute of Strength, yet it is complete Mercy, for it does not allow the Evil Inclination to double its power. This is similar to what the Sages said in the *Tikkunim* regarding the "Green Creature" <note>a mystical being in the Chariot</note>, that it has the power of Strength to overcome the Evil Inclination and turn it toward the "Coveted One" <note>the good</note> so it does not rule over it. Thus, the Crown in its totality is "pure" from the side of precious and good qualities unique to it. When Strength is awakened, the Crown influences from the totality of Strength toward it, passing the Strength through to perform an action...

**Furthermore**, it can be said that the Crown will always be from the side of **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>. It is known that complete Mercy will overcome the totality of Strength, nullifying its harshness and sweetening it. All things will be blessed... just as in the physical elements, a soul is not cold simply because it has the quality of coldness; rather, it is composed of three elements... and in the nature of water there is heat... **Furthermore**, it can be said that even though the attribute of Strength is harsh below in its own place as Judgment, above in its source—in its Cause—it is simple, subtle, and pure Mercy, because it is close to and held within its "Coupling." For "in the light of the King's face there is life."

Regarding what the **Remaz** <note>original: *Ha-Remaz-Zal*; likely referring here to the Rambam (Maimonides) as the following quote is from his *Mishneh Torah*</note> wrote concerning the composition of the four elements in all physical matters (in the fourth chapter of *Foundations of the Torah*): all are composed of the four elements, and all contain cold, heat, moisture, and dryness. Regarding what is arranged in the Sefirot: from the Sefira, then, by cause of the internal or external within it, it is called by a name according to its actions. For in their place above, no Sefira stands except in its own essence and its essential temperament, which the **Cause of Causes** <term>The highest source of Divinity</term> extended into it at the time of Emanation. This is a total unity, not separated, in the manner of the composition of the essential temperament of the four elements... and this is its action.

This is the precision of the ruling of **Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai**: "and they were all included in it and called 'Kindnesses'" <note>original: *Chasadim*</note>. This means that first they are included in her—which is Kingship—and then they are called Kindnesses (and they are called so because she is a totality of ten). In another place in the *Tikkunim* <note>Tikkunei Zohar</note>, it says: "There is no Sefira that is not included in the rest, each one in its own place" (and he was precise in the language "its own place"), meaning that it is mentioned therein as being founded and active.

This means the **Crown** <term>Keter</term> is included of ten from the side of the "Rectifications" <note>original: *Tikkunim*</note>. How was it... it is explained therein as they understood. ### Chapter 3: The Crown

**Severity** <term>Gevurah/Din (Judgment)</term> is included in it [the Crown] only from the side of the good influences that come to the world through its power—wealth, sustenance, and strength over the **Evil Inclination**, as explained in the *Tikkunim*. However, when Severity is awakened below, the existence within the Crown is awakened corresponding to it in the aspect of Severity; "like finds its like," and it is awakened below in the aspect of Judgment as well.

**The Truth** that is agreed upon is that all aspects of Severity, when they are hidden in the "Light of the King's Face" and the **Ancient of Days** <term>Atik Yomin (the most hidden aspect of the Crown)</term> sits "and his garment is like white snow," they too are simple and included in Mercy. Not only that, but they prevail against the powers of Judgment. They said in the *Idra* <note>a section of the Zohar</note> regarding the Ancient of Days: "His throne is sparks of fire" to subdue them through the power of the **King's Forehead**. And when they say sometimes that "The Ancient One is not revealed and judgments are prepared," the intention is only regarding his concealment in the "warp" of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>.

He gazes from there upon the "Six Extremities" <note>the lower six Sefirot</note> from the side of Severity. However, in a "Time of Favor," the mercies of the Crown shine through the power of the **Infinite** <term>Ein Sof</term> via **Wisdom**, and the judgments are hidden.

**We conclude** that the source of Judgment from above is by the Will of the Emanator, and He is devoid of it, for "in the light of the King's face is life," and Judgment is absent as well in the Crown. It is also absent in Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge. **Kindness** is a cause close to it, just as water exists and then gives birth to darkness. Judgment does not judge in essence until the place of its revelation in the Sefira of **Severity**. In this way, the [other] Sefirot are found to be absent in the Crown: Wisdom-within-the-Crown is the secret of the "Head of the Crown" hidden in the Infinite, and so too with Understanding-within-the-Crown, which is called the **Supreme Crown**.
