<meta>This page continues the exploration of the Divine Union (Yichud) and the structural dynamics of the Sefirot. The previous page discussed the constant nature of joy in the higher realms; here, the text moves into the specific mechanics of how the masculine and feminine aspects of the Divine (Tiferet and Malchut) interact to channel souls and blessings into the lower world.</meta>

-># Pomegranate Slice / Gate of Essence and Conduct / Juice of Pomegranates<-
<meta>image quality: good; catchword: Wisdom</meta>

The awakening comes from the souls of the righteous in the lower world, which brings about this Union. Preceding this are the preparations known as the "Embrace," achieved through **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> and **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>. The mystery is hinted at in the verse: *“His left hand is under my head”* <note>Song of Songs 2:6</note>. This means that initially, the flow of **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> is poured into **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> <note>The central, masculine Sefirah</note> to unite with him. Afterward, **Beauty** is drawn toward **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term> to unite with her. Thus, the Groom is united with his two arms. This is a rectification that precedes **Beauty**'s descent from above to below; he first acts with kindness to open the way for merit, and then girds himself with strength to include it within his own power. Through this, he receives the Bride with his left arm first. Here, the verse is interpreted as the left hand coming first because **Strength** extends toward **Kingship** <term>Malchut</term> to influence her. Afterward, the flow of **Kindness**—the right arm—is drawn to her. Thus, the left is below and the right embraces from above. This is the aspect of the "Kiss," and there is no doubt that this is the "cleaving of spirit to spirit" <note>original Aramaic: "deveikut de-rucha be-rucha"</note>, which is the secret of the union of the reality of **Kingship** within **Beauty**, and likewise within **Kingship**. The benefit of this union is immense; from it are drawn male souls from the male side and female souls from the female side, as our Sages of blessed memory taught. The **Covenant** <term>Yesod/Foundation</term> also attaches itself to this union. Through this union and the Divine Names hinted at therein, these various unities were explained previously in Chapter 11.

**Behold**, the functions of **Victory** <term>Netzach</term>, **Splendor** <term>Hod</term>, and **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> are close to the functions of **Greatness** <term>Gedulah/Chesed</term>, **Strength**, and **Beauty**. This is because **Victory** draws from **Kindness**, **Foundation** from **Beauty**, and **Splendor** from **Strength**. However, the flow of **Beauty** also participates with both **Victory** and **Splendor**, while the flow of **Kindness** and **Strength** participates with **Foundation**. Therefore, **Foundation** is sometimes judged as right-leaning and sometimes as left-leaning. These three participate in the "Coupling" <term>Zivvug</term> to give birth and to "ripen the seed" of the male and female. They are called "Grinders" <term>Shachakim</term> <note>A play on words: Shachakim is a name for the heavens, but also implies grinding or wearing down</note> because they "grind" manna for the Righteous One and for Justice. Together they have one name that is never separated: the name **Lord of Hosts** <term>Tzabaot</term>.

### Chapter 13: The Kingship. Her nature was explained previously as the 
### Female principle, the Element of Earth, and the Attribute of 

Relaxed Judgment <note>original: "Din Ha-rafeh"</note>. It is in her power to reward and punish according to the higher directives, for both the good and the bad seek her out to fulfill the needs of the Kingdom. In the *Tikunim* <note>The Tikunei HaZohar</note>, they said: "There is no Sefirah among all the Sefirot that has authority to pour out blessings or influence the lower beings except for **Bat Sheva** <note>Literal: Daughter of Seven; a title for Malchut as she receives from the seven Sefirot above her</note>, because she is the bond of all the Sefirot. Because of this, it is written: 'In this let him who glories glory'" <note>Jeremiah 9:23, referring to the Sefirah of Malchut</note>.

**And regarding her**, it was said: *“The well which the princes dug”* <note>Numbers 21:18</note>—these are **Crown, Wisdom, and Understanding** <term>Keter, Chokhmah, Binah</term>—*“through the noble of the people”*—**Greatness, Strength, and Beauty**—*“with the lawgiver”*—**Foundation**—*“with their staffs”*—**Victory and Splendor**. *“And from the wilderness, a gift”* <note>Numbers 21:18</note>: she gives of herself to herself. *“And from the gift, Nachaliel”*: she returns and ascends in the "reflected light" to the triad of **Victory, Splendor, and Foundation**. *“And from Nachaliel, Bamot”* <note>High places</note>: to the triad of **Greatness, Strength, and Beauty**, as the Zohar explains the verse *“And He will lead me on my high places”* <note>Habakkuk 3:19</note>. In the "High Places of the Valley," there are the "Higher Three": the letter **Gimmel** for **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, **Yod** for **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>, and **Aleph** for **Crown** <term>Keter</term> <note>These letters spell "Gya" or Valley</note>. This is a hint to the three highest aspects within **Understanding**, in the aspect of the "feast for Wisdom." This is the "Field of Moab"—do not read it as Moab, but as *Me-Av* ("from the Father" <note>Chokhmah</note>), which is the top of the peak. As the Rabbis said: "The Father <note>Chokhmah</note> founded the Daughter <note>Malchut</note>," and she gazes into the higher faces so that they may also hear the comprehension.

**And thus** the Rabbis praised his holy sacrifice at the time of his departure from the world:

<column-break/>

And also through the powerful influence of the souls from the "Higher Constellation" <term>Mazal Elyon</term>, which is the secret of the **Crown** <term>Keter</term>. This is the mystery of the saying: "The matter does not depend on merit, but on luck/constellation" <note>A famous Talmudic dictum interpreted here kabbalistically</note>. For the "Merit" refers to the Sefirah of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, while "Luck" <term>Mazal</term> refers to the **Crown**. It does not depend on the "Pool" (which is the placement of the souls, meaning **Beauty**). As the Rashbi <note>Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai</note> said: "Look toward the Constellation," and he inclined toward it like a pillar of light... and the matter is that it is necessary for the purity of our prayer to ascend to the "Constellation" which is the **Crown**, and from there, the "Connector of Souls"—which is the **Holy One, Blessed be He** <note>Tiferet</note>—is given. (The reason is that He is the Master of Souls and they are His own vessels; therefore, it is not fitting to give the souls except by the permission of the Master of the Fruit). And so too, by the power of the influence of the "Existences of the Souls," such as the union with **Kingship** and the union with **Wisdom** and **Understanding**... (And this union is not a union of Kindness like the other Sefirot, but rather it is **Foundation** that provides, for the three [higher Sefirot] must participate and unite at the time of the Coupling, so that the flow of the Influencer within her comes from the flow of her Foundation, which includes everyone. This is because from the side of the union of **Wisdom** and **Understanding**, all distant existences and desires come into being. For the union of **Wisdom** and **Understanding** is the desire of the six "Existences" within **Understanding**—including the "Son" and "Daughter" <note>Tiferet and Malchut</note>—who are sustained by it. From her, they receive the "Kindness" that was delayed there for twelve months... due to her great power (which is the twelve months as our Sages explained), corresponding to the twelve constellations/stars. This is the matter of the "Cycles of the Sefirot" within **Understanding**, which consist of Kindness and Judgment, appearing in the cycles of the twelve "Edges" of the soul, like the four elements... (as explained in the *Book of Pillars*). Thus, the "Externalities" <term>Chitzoniyot</term> dwell during the time of the Union, drawing between **Kindness** and **Understanding**.

**And if** the Kindnesses were to overpower, they say that the "Existences of the Souls" would be through the union of **Beauty** and **Kingship**. This leads further to the discussion of the union of **Wisdom** and **Understanding**, for immediately at the time of the supplications, the union is awakened to provide a cause... (but now after the "eating," what does it help? For there is no) aspect of this union toward the Flow. For the Flow is not the union (rather, from the union of the "Eye of the Abyss" which never closes). But the whole point of the union is that this essence should be shared. If so, what is the connection to the "Element of Earth" and the "Attribute of Judgment" <note>Malchut</note>? And furthermore, this is the **Foundation**... and from here they are separated to the worlds. What is the nature of their existence? And I brought the Kindnesses and rectified them, etc.

**Know** that if **Understanding** were not "clothed" in **Wisdom** and **Understanding**, it would be impossible for the "Externalities" to exist at all. The reason is that there is no "Covenant" or "Fixing" without Male and Female, as explained in the *Idra* <note>A section of the Zohar</note> of *Ha'azinu*. Even the reality of the Soul would not exist until it was rectified by the **Crown** as "Male and Female" within itself. From it, the reality of "Good and Female" is supplied... (and they are included in the **Crown** as the male "Constellation" within her, and the Kingship). The Sefirot of the "Building" <note>The seven lower Sefirot</note> were not completed until they were rectified through the "Princes" as Male and Female (which are **Wisdom** and **Understanding** in their place).

**And because** the primary existence of the "Externalities" is through the Kindness and the higher Kindnesses within her—just as in the union of the lower beings, where the woman desires to conceive from the man—so too **Wisdom** and **Understanding** intend to bring forth the "Soul of Emanation" <term>Nishmat Ha-Atzilut</term> to give life to the "Building." Their union is not always for this purpose, but also to sustain and grow the Existences... and through their union, **Beauty** and **Kingship** are awakened in the mystery of the "Crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding" <note>Song of Songs 3:11</note>, so that they may desire and connect. For a man is only "crowned" with that crown of "Unitive Gatherings" of his lights and their couplings through the Sefirot, through **Understanding** and **Wisdom**.

To say they are "intertwined" <note>Hebrew: nislahot</note> to indicate the foundation of the **Sefirot** <term>Divine emanations</term>. Then comes the holy union, which is the pairing according to the divine will, never to be separated for eternity. In this context, it is not appropriate to say "they accompany each other," because since they are one for all eternity, the term "accompanying" is irrelevant; they never part and are always united in the ultimate foundation.

### **Chapter 10: The Seventh Sefirah** (Now we shall speak of the seven extremities—
the first of the seven extremities) which is called **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>.
(Its action is through kindness/mercy.) Its nature is to act with kindness, even toward one who is not worthy according to strict law. Therefore, its path is to act with grace to subdue the power of the accusers. (Since this attribute gives to both the wicked and the good without strict judgment, the "prosecutor" <note>The Sitra Achra or Accusing Angel</note> later cries out and complains about him, mentioning his sins, and then great shame and rebuke would result. Therefore, the Blessed One's wisdom acted to give this attribute the power to subdue the accusers.) Regarding this, it is said: "And then he shall be saved from every day of the accusers, to subdue him." This is the secret of the "Living" <term>Chay</term> <note>Numerically 18</note> mentioned, for the "husk" <note>Klipah - impure shell</note> is the source of the falsehood that accompanies every kindness (in order to enrich the world from all the impurity of the evil spirit). From this attribute, the influence, the chain of light, understanding, and logic are drawn. The hint of "light" is to humble the "children." And the surroundings of the union are in the Upper world and the **Foundation of Water** <term>Yesod ha-Mayim</term>. All white things and all pearls, whose virtue is whiteness, belong here. Therefore, these will be in the **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> which is included in the name "Greatness" <term>Gedulah</term>. These are the "seventy-one verses" as will be explained in the Gate of Names. **And the Holy Sefirah** (And it is the second of the seven extremities)
which is called **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>. Its nature is to perform judgment (to discipline human beings and bring them to the service of the Blessed Creator). It is full of awe, and from it flows all the "masters of judgment" <note>spiritual entities of strict justice</note>, both external and internal. However, it is pure gold (silver) <note>Gold is traditionally associated with Gevurah, Silver with Chesed; the text notes a internal/external distinction</note>. The internal aspect is holy, and the external aspect is like the dross of gold (and dross). It brings Israel to their Father in Heaven, as it is written: "In God we shall do valiantly" <note>Psalm 60:14</note>. From it comes the influence and chain of the "multitude" and "the table that is set in the North" <note>The Altar/Table in the Temple; North is the direction of Gevurah/Wealth</note>.
The "Smallness" <term>Katnut</term> and the "Strength" are planted and awakened. Therefore, one who wishes to become wealthy should turn to the North. The chain of union between a man and his wife is derived from here. It is appropriate that the "Upper Foundation of Fire" <term>Yesod ha-Esh</term> and all red things belong here. Thus, this attribute signifies the "hearing" of prayer and outcry. Therefore, "hearing" is associated with both Judgment and Mercy in the name *Elohim* <term>God (in the aspect of Judgment)</term>: "And God heard the voice of the youth," "And God heard and it was gathered before me." This applies to both Kindness and Judgment and Mercy. (The sign for this is the letters of the word "Lion" <term>Aryeh</term>, which are the letters of "Seeing" <term>Re'iyah</term> in **Kindness**, and the letters of "Fear" <term>Yirah</term>... <note>the text here plays on the Hebrew roots</note>). And in it will be the power of the name "Seventy-Two," which are the 216 letters that branch out into 72 Names, as will be explained in the Gate of Names.

### **Chapter 7: The Eighth Sefirah** which is the third of the seven extremities, which is called **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>. Its nature is
to decide and mediate peace between Kindness and Judgment. From it
flows the influence and chain of blessing and the "All." It is the central pillar that
is balanced between North and South. Engagement with it is the nature of this attribute. All beauty, glory, and splendor, and all composite things come from it. Therefore, its color is green like a leek... and the "Elder" is born to Israel through this attribute, as it is written regarding the "Great Foundation" <term>Yesod ha-Gadol</term>, "An Elder from the Heavens," which is **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> and...

### **Chapter 12: Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> influences light and wisdom and love
upon the world. Its power is great to silence the enemy,
as it is written: "And God is indignant every day" <note>Psalm 7:12</note>. The "indignant" one refers to the "oppressors of vanity" mentioned earlier. **Kindness** is the root of the **Foundation of Water** <term>Yesod ha-Mayim</term> that spreads through the 72 [Names].
They are hinted at in the 72 Names: *VHV, YLY, SIT*... <note>examples from the 72 Names of God</note>. They are called "bridges" in the literal shape of the letter **He** [ה]. Just as a bridge has two sides that descend here and there, while its roof is above and far from the water, so too these Names have two ends: **Kindness** and **Mercy**, which are the combinations *V"V, S"E, Y"V, S"E, Y"T*. These are "straight" from above to below. But the middle letter, which is the word from the verse "And he came" <note>Exodus 14:20, associated with Gevurah/Judgment</note>, does not spread downward. This is because the letters of that verse are collected in reverse order to prevent the spread of Judgment, the Flood, and all such types of punishment that come through water. The "strap" of **Kindness** is what comes to purify the "rust" of the world. Behold, the beloved nature of the Upper Union truly awakens from natural Kindness. Your sign for this is: "And he loved her," as is written regarding Isaac; no one preceded him in this description. Even with Abraham, we only find "whom you love, Isaac." Nevertheless, its root is in the "Mountain of Kindness" <note>Chesed</note>, for all faces turn toward it. From it are made those who love, who are soft-hearted and very delicate in "love that does not depend on a [selfish] thing." From the actions of this attribute are all things whose color is white, which are predisposed toward **Kindness**.

### **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term> influences wealth
and sustenance, following the idea that "the table is in the North." From its power comes heat, fire, and redness. All precious stones of a red hue are predisposed to cast awe upon creatures. This attribute delivers the righteous to be bridled with the "Fear of Heaven" and empowers the "Good Inclination" over the "Evil Inclination." It is written: "Through God we shall do valiantly, and He shall tread down our enemies" <note>Psalm 60:14</note>—all this is through the secret of **Pure Gold** that flows from **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>. The "dross" on the outside is influenced by **Strength**. In it is the hearing of prayer and the judgment of whether it is worthy to be accepted, all through the power of **Understanding**. However, "Seeing" sometimes serves Judgment, but its root is in **Kindness**, for the combination of its letters is "Lion" <term>Aryeh</term>, which are also "Fear" <term>Yirah</term>. In the *Tikunim* <term>Zoharic commentaries</term>, they return the Lion to the East, which leans toward **Kindness** and illuminates the world with its power.

### **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> makes
peace in His heights, through the secret of the Written Torah placed in the Ark between North and South. The Torah and the study of it depend on it. From its actions come beauty and splendor, following the idea of "white and red" <note>the mixture of Chesed and Gevurah</note> whose composition and blending are in this attribute. Likewise, the color green, like the yolk of an egg, and the precious stones associated with it, derive their virtue from it. From it come the "mighty ones from heaven" to the "generation of knowledge." Here is the "channel of children" from the "Upper Fortune" <term>Mazal</term>, as it is written: "And she prayed upon the Lord" <note>1 Samuel 1:10</note>, for the true place is in this attribute. From it comes the influence of **Souls** <term>Neshamot</term> through the union of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> and **Kingship** <term>Malchut</term>. There is also a union between **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> and **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, which are unified by the secret of the **Ancient Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term> that mediates between them. Its existence is in the "path that no bird of prey knows" <note>Job 28:7</note>. The benefit of this union is the survival of the **Sefirot** and their renewal, for they are constantly renewed through their root submerged in the depths of **Understanding** and **Wisdom**. It also extends to the secret of the **Soul** which is from **Understanding**. From their union also comes the **Crown** <term>Atarah/Malchut</term> with which the "Mother" <term>Binah</term> crowns the "Children" <term>Tiferet/Malchut</term> at the time of their wedding, as it is written: "Go forth and see, O daughters of Zion..." <note>Song of Songs 3:11</note>.

The awakening of **Understanding** is from **Kingship**, and the union of **Beauty** and **Kingship** needs an awakening...

-># Gate 8: Essence and Conduct — *Juice of Pomegranates*<-

And when the light and the abundance <term>Shefa: the flow of Divine energy</term> of the Attributes reach down to the soul of the righteous person, it changes them. It then returns and is transformed from below to above, through the stages of its descent, according to the secret of the "reversal of light," until it returns to its source. On its path upward, it becomes part of that light, joined to it, and is adorned and refined as it faces upward. Through the preparation of these "adornments" <note>This refers to the spiritual merits and "Female Waters" raised by the soul</note> directed upward, her "Husband" <note>The masculine aspect of the Divine, Tiferet</note> is aroused and joins in union with her.

To this, they alluded with the letter *Dalet* <note>The 4th letter of the Hebrew alphabet, often representing the feminine Sefirah, Malchut</note>, meaning the "filling" of the letters *Heh* and *Yod* of the *Dalet*. <margin>A</margin> <note>The margin note explains that the word "Well" (Be’er) hints at being filled with abundance. It describes the mystical shape of the word, where the letter *Vav* represents the flow of "Male Waters" from above, and the "Female Waters" (the actions of the righteous) rise from below to meet it.</note> The word "Well" <note>Hebrew: *Be’er*</note> refers to the foundation of *Yesod* as it receives and is raised up by the letter *Vav* <note>The 6th letter, representing the masculine</note>. The "upper moisture" comes from the "Male Waters," while the second kind comes from the "Female Waters" <term>Mayin Nukvin: the spiritual arousal initiated by humans below</term>. The *Vav* receives them, and thus it becomes a "well of living waters." Know that His "two hands" are placed upon this union.

(The explanation now details what was said: "upper from Male Waters, lower etc." because within the "Well" there is a *Vav*, which is above, and "Kindness" <term>Chesed</term> is in the middle.) The word "Well" signifies the fullness of abundance in his covenant, according to the secret of the letter *Heh* which is included in the "Well." There are two additional *Yods* added to the *Vav*, making the word "Well" <note>A mystical spelling calculation</note>. When it is empty, it is just a pit, but when the two *Yods* are added—one from below as "Female Waters" (the deeds of the righteous) and the upper *Vav* as "Male Waters" (the flow of peace)—the word "Well" indicates the greatness of the abundance, as it is said: "A well of living waters." <note>original: "Be'er mayim chayim"</note> (Meaning: the filling of the *Vav*, which is the cavity of the well, is only achieved through others, which are the two *Yods* mentioned.)

Some explain this as the three attributes of "Strength," "Victory," and "Majesty" <term>Gevurah, Netzach, and Hod</term> which are included within the Foundation <term>Yesod</term>. They travel together as the "Chariot," as seen in the verse: "And He did thus..." <note>Referencing a liturgical or scriptural description of Divine movement</note>. See the *Zohar* regarding this, how the Holy One, Blessed be He, delights with the souls of the righteous—meaning those who are righteous in their deeds—because they provide the "Female Waters." They shine and radiate. It is said in the *Zohar* that the "will of the upper lights" is directed toward these souls. This "delight" is similar to the taste of "falling on one's face" <term>Nefilat Apayim: a part of the prayer service involving total surrender</term> as mentioned in the *Zohar* (Parashat Noah and Parashat Vayakhel). This is the secret of the "Blessing of Peace," for there peace resides. They fall on their faces to offer their souls to Him, so that they may become the "secret of the souls that receive abundance." From above, they are "adorned"—this is the abundance of the male, the "Male Waters"—and from below, the "Female Waters," as explained in the *Zohar* (Parashat Terumah).

**And the arousal**, as mentioned above, which rises from below to above, is the secret of the "Female Waters" to initiate the union of the Feminine to receive from the Male. In the holy *Zohar*, they called Joseph "The Righteous" <note>Joseph is traditionally associated with the Sefirah of Yesod</note> above in the secret of "Male Waters," and the "Righteous One below" <note>The earthly tzadik</note> in the secret of "Female Waters." Thus, the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term> is found between the two.

**And if** one should doubt this—that the chosen ones arouse this union as mentioned in several places by the Sages, of blessed memory—behold, the soul rises and spreads out with the souls of the righteous below. The Holy One, Blessed be He, wraps Himself with the souls of the righteous at the "midnight hour." Even the souls of the dead are included, as we said regarding the time of the Standing Prayer and the "falling on the face." Regarding the souls of the living: know that this "midnight hour" refers to the Attribute of Sovereignty <term>Malchut</term>, sometimes called the "Holy One, Blessed be He," or the fullness of the "Lower Mother" within *Malchut*.

The secret is even deeper: the "Spark" that is trapped within the husks <term>Kelipot: shells of impurity</term>—may they not rise into the world of emanation—is refined and purified by the souls and the "will" of each person according to their level. There, the Holy One, Blessed be He, is revealed and delights with the souls. This results in the drawing down of light and abundance to *Malchut*, but this is not the same as the light and abundance generated by the "Union" <term>Zivug</term>. Nor is it the same process as the Union described previously. Therefore, in the *Zohar's* discussion of this union, it does not mention the "Female Waters" rising, but only the delight with the righteous. Furthermore, this delight and union occur through the souls of the living, not just those who have passed; for when the righteous depart from this world, they are initially with the "Lower Mother" through the "kiss of death" as they ascend. However, the intent of "Female Waters" in most places refers specifically to the souls of the dead and the upright. Through the souls of the living, it is fitting that this delight, union, and abundance should never be lacking, so that they may shine and be established without hindrance from the "accusers" or the "wicked."

# Chapter 2: The Reason
The reason for the necessity of arousing the "Upper Union" is that abundance and blessing do not dwell in the upper realms except through the side of the lower realms. As the Sages said: "The calf wants to suckle more than the cow wants to nurse." <note>A famous Talmudic metaphor: the giver's desire to give exceeds the receiver's desire to receive</note>. Therefore, as long as there is someone below to receive, the flow continues. If there were no one to receive, the lower righteous ones would be like "nurselings" at the "breasts of the Mother." Through the persistence of this "nursing," there is an increase of abundance from above toward *Malchut* itself. (This is the secret of the verse regarding Joshua: "Give them, O Lord—what will You give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.") This is the point: there is no light or abundance revealed unless there is a "vessel" to receive it. The light that is increased (from below by the lower righteous) and turned upward becomes a "throne" and a "vessel," and thus the Upper Light can dwell within it.

In times when there is no "vessel" prepared below through the light of life, the Upper Light is forced to retreat upward and will not return to be revealed. Abundance only descends to *Malchut* to provide "sustenance for the lower worlds," but for man alone.

**It is explained** in the *Zohar* (Parashat Lech Lecha) on the verse: "I am my beloved's, and his desire is for me" (Song of Songs 7:11). The text states: "I am my beloved's"—to draw him close to a place first, and afterward "his desire is for me." For the blessing only rests upon a place that is prepared. The desire of the "lower ones" causes the "Female Waters" to rise. She says: "I have prepared the place for the flow; it is not for myself alone, but so that it may be shared." (But in truth, I do not know how blessings can be aroused above in an empty place. But below, you have a "Source," a place where blessings can be found.) Therefore, the "Throne" <note>Malchut</note> should never be empty of the "countenance" <note>The presence of the righteous</note> even for a single moment. Upon this, the "matter of blessing" rests; the Throne must not be empty, so that the blessing can dwell upon the "preparedness" of the lower world. Just as there is a need for arousal through the "Waking of the Dawn" for the union of the "Beauty" and "Sovereignty" <term>Tiferet and Malchut</term>, so too is an arousal needed from *Malchut* to awaken "Wisdom" and "Understanding" <term>Chokhmah and Binah</term>, as mentioned in the Song of Songs.

**And if** one asks whether the union of *Tiferet* and *Malchut* only comes from the arousal of the souls of the righteous and not from *Chokhmah* and *Binah*... if so, how was the soul of Adam first created? For at that time, there was no one to arouse the upper powers. How was he created? It must be said that it was by the "Will of the Cause of all Causes" that the soul of Adam was created.

**Wisdom** and **Understanding** are as mentioned in the *Zohar*, in the portions of *Balak* and *Emor*. Previously, the **Crown** <note>The 'Atarah' usually refers to Malchut, the final Sefirah</note> was unified and strengthened for the "sons" <note>The lower Sefirot</note> in a time of merit. Since the "Kings" <note>The lower Sefirot</note> are somewhat hidden traces within **Understanding**, these traces are actually the lower Sefirot that will eventually become revealed. **Furthermore**, **Beauty** and the **Crown** are joined in the "Tree of Life." From this, two "crowns" are derived: one from the side of the cleft <note>original: 'mubaka'</note>, which is the **Mercy** within the **Divine Presence**, and one from the side of **Understanding**, which is the **Severity** within **Understanding**. These two crowns will be the trace of **Mercy** in **Wisdom** and the trace of **Severity** in **Understanding**, as mentioned in the portion of *Ha'azinu* at the time of the passing of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, may his memory be a blessing.

### Chapter 18: Understanding the Way of the Union

Know that the union of **Beauty** and **Kingdom** cannot occur except through an "arousal from below" <note>Human actions or prayers that trigger a divine response</note> from the two tribes, which is for the future, as we said above. This is like the union that existed for Israel—that is, peace—and likewise on the holiday of **Shavuot** and similar occasions. This is explained in the *Zohar* in the portion of *Bereshit* on the verse: "For the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was no man..." (Genesis 2:5). The reason for the creation of the First Man with two "faces" <note>Du-Partzufin: the idea that Adam and Eve were originally created back-to-back as a single being</note> was so that he could turn face-to-face. Without this, the initial state was not effective, and he had to be repaired afterward. 

Initially, the union was not "face-to-face" because **Foundation** <term>Yesod: the Sefirah of connection</term> was not yet elevated to join **Beauty** with **Kingdom**. (In this state, there was no union in the world of Emanation/Atzilut because there was no knowledge of the "repairs" <term>Tikkunim</term> and various aspects, since there was no arousal from the lower beings). The verse "And there was no man" means there was no man in that state of perfection called "Man," where the male and female are face-to-face. Therefore, the Lord (representing **Beauty**) drew down upon the earth (representing **Kingdom**), but the desire was not yet gathered in the **Foundation**. 

It says further that this is the secret of the letter *Yod* regarding the creation of man, hinting at the "Upper Heh" <note>Binah</note> upon which man relies. This *Yod* is a small help and assistance for the preparation during the time **Foundation** moves "face-to-face." Thus, in the "dream" <note>referring to the deep sleep of Adam</note> his faces were separated, for so it was above with **Beauty** and **Kingdom**. Why were they so? Because the arousal of the lower beings had not yet occurred. Thus, the union of **Beauty** and **Kingdom** is impossible except through the arousal of the lower beings.

(And the arousal of this union is the scent of the **Incense** and the good deeds of those below). **Chapter 19: As explained** in the *Zohar*, portion of *Noach*: "Rabbi Shimon said: Now the Holy One, blessed be He, is crowned with His crowns; He is crowned from above and from below. From above—from the 'Depth of All' <note>the highest Sefirot</note>; and from below—by the souls of the righteous." He drinks, rejoices, and is blessed, and all is within the "Crust" <note>original: 'Kahrag'</note>. Why is it called "Crust" here? For it is only called "empty" when it is not filled with water. Rather, the intent is that this is a place for the poor to gaze upon; it is called a "Pit" <note>Bor</note> which has nothing of its own, but only what is given to its children. And so it is with the **Righteous One** <term>Tzaddik/Yesod</term> who acts as a "Crust," borrowing from all sides. He is the "Inner One," the "Upper One." (And the image of the Holy One being nourished by the souls of the righteous, etc.) as they say, it is written from below, from the souls of the righteous. (The matter of the Crown is as mentioned in Chapter 10, needing only to speak of what was said there regarding the Crown). The "Depth of All" refers to **Wisdom** and **Understanding**. There, it will be "empty of goodness" for the righteous in this world <note>meaning the righteous do not seek material benefit in this world</note>. In this day, light is flowed upon her from above through the stages of evolution <term>Hishtalshelut</term>, from level to level, nursing the sparks from **Beauty** until it reaches the Tenth Kingdom...
and as a crust...

<column-break/>

...of the world, for he did not enjoy even his small finger. This is the **Crown** of which Hillel the Elder, the head of the lineage, said: "He who uses the crown perishes." For all that these holy Princes labored their whole lives to repair the character of their generation was for a "High Necessity" <note>for the sake of God</note>, and they did not allow any "Canaanite" <note>impurity/materialism</note> to enter the House of the Lord of Hosts at all. Our Holy Teacher <note>Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi</note> testified about himself at the moment of his death, raising his ten fingers toward heaven to open for himself the channels of the "Upper Pool of Water," so that his deeds might purify him from the "filth of the snake" <note>original sin/mortality</note>. Thus, no impurity could take hold of him at all, similar to the "Death by a Kiss" said of the Patriarchs of the world, over whom the Angel of Death had no power. On the day Rabbi [Yehuda] died, the Priesthood was abolished; yet while all Princes are equal in this law, Rabbi was singular in his own merit—beyond the merit of his office—as we mentioned: he did not enjoy this world even with his small finger.

**And so** we find with King David, peace be upon him: when he commanded at the time of his death to crown Solomon, the "Evil Inclination" <note>the Yetzer Hara</note> sought to kill him with a spiritual death, heaven forbid, and incited him with **Abishag** <note>the young woman brought to warm the elderly King David</note>. She said to him, "Is this the way of kings?" He said to them, "Call for me **Bathsheba**." And it is written: "And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber" (1 Kings 1:15). Rabbi Yehuda said in the name of Rav: At that moment, Bathsheba wiped herself with seven cloths. Behold, he drew down upon Bathsheba the merit of thirteen "Upper Sources" with his intention toward Heaven, just as in the physical act, Bathsheba ascended to the "King in the Chamber"—the Palace containing the hidden treasures in the secret of **Understanding**. 

And behold, the word **Chamber** <note>Hebrew: H-D-R</note> is an acronym for **Mercy** (*Chesed*), **Judgment** (*Din*), and **Compassion** (*Rachamim*), which are flowed from her. The definite article "The" (*Heh*) in "**The** King" points to the "North Gate" that is open from **Understanding** to **Severity**. The "The" (*Heh*) in "**The** Chamber" points to the "South Gate," in the secret of "His left hand is under my head, and his right hand embraces me." The final *Heh* points to the drawing down of the "Dew" to the thirteen "Rivers of Pure Balsam" through the small path. It is written, "And the king was very old," meaning the **Beauty of Israel** <note>Tiferet</note> was elevated to the **Ancient Holy One** <note>Atika Kadisha</note>, the source of the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy. **Abishag** was also included in the upper existence of the "Male World." There is a tradition regarding the verse "Let sinners be consumed from the earth"—the word "consumed" <note>Hebrew: 'yitammu'</note> can also be read as "perfected" <note>'yita'amu'</note> in the levels of holiness. There are thirteen words in this verse, counting "Bathsheba" as one word. This is sufficient.

**Understanding** is simple in the feminine collective, and from the perspective of the collective, it is called the "Voice of the Simplicity of **Kingdom**," <note>The "Voice" represents the transition from internal thought (Understanding) to articulated reality (Kingdom).</note> until all of its receptivity is found to be dependent on the side of **Wisdom**. ### Chapter 22
And after we have explained the "Middle Way," we shall explain the "Way of Union" at the end. <gloss>Explanation: Know that the foundation of the Union of the Supernal Male and Female—which are **Beauty** and **Kingdom**—is where the holy aspects are formed and the male and female are completed as one.</gloss> This is because the purpose of the fullness of the spiritual flow is for **Wisdom** to be the proper environment for the Male, acting as the flow to **Beauty**. That which is proper to be the Female shall be the flow to **Kingdom**. <gloss>Explanation: It is known that the primary aspects are **Understanding** and **Kingdom**. **Beauty** and **Kingdom** exist within **Understanding** in a state of great refinement, like the soul within a body. The Male aspect and the Brain [Wisdom] are related. The Female aspect, which resembles the Male in secret, is the **Direct Light** <term>Or Yashar: Divine energy flowing downward from the source</term> from above to below. The secret of the Female is the **Returning Light** <term>Or Chozer: Energy reflecting back upward from the recipient</term> from below to above. Therefore, when the soul-flow is influenced toward **Beauty**, it is increased by the secret of Direct Light, and then these aspects are "males"—meaning, it is a flow fit to become a male aspect, and that Right-hand light (which is considered **Beauty**) receives it. When the flow of **Wisdom** is influenced toward **Kingdom**, it is influenced by the secret of Returning Light, and then the aspects are "females"—meaning, a flow fit to become a female aspect, and the Left-hand light (which is **Kingdom**) receives it.</gloss>

This flow does not exist without the "Secret of the Collective." Rather, it exists in the environment as a flow similar to the power of the seed-flow that descends from the brain through the spinal cord. <gloss>This is drawn from the brains. The existence of **Understanding** in its form consists of two powers, Right and Left, where **Beauty** and **Kingdom** are balanced through the sweetening of the Male and Female.</gloss> Regarding the secret of this flow, the observation of these aspects returns to the Right side. Once **Beauty** and **Kingdom** are unified as one, **Beauty** will emerge from the "Cord of Pure Seed" mentioned above, flowing from top to bottom through the **Foundation** <term>Yesod: The Sefirah of connection and procreation</term>, the "Sign of the Holy Covenant." This level is arranged in the secret of the Male and the secret of the Right-hand masculine energies. **Kingdom** shall also be formed from the reversal of light from below to above, in the secret of Returning Light and the feminine Right-hand energies.

Everything shall be sanctified within **Kingdom**, into the "eight" <note>Refers to a specific numerical configuration of the Sefirotic sub-levels</note> of its collective parts. There, that "seed" will awaken the boundaries of Male and Female, each in its own form. All its connections are "pulsing" according to their place. The inclination of the Male comes from the portion of the flow drawn to **Beauty**, and the inclination of the Female comes from the strengthening of the flow drawn to **Kingdom**. By the power of **Kindness**, **Beauty** and **Kingdom** will be unified as one. This occurs in the Palace of the **Sapphire Brick** <note>original: 'Livnat HaSapir' – a visionary level mentioned in Exodus 24:10</note> through the secret of the twenty powers included in them—eight to the Right and **Kindness** to the Left. Within them, **Beauty** and the Right will be clothed, and **Kingdom** to the Left, as explained. These are unified and prepared from the side of the "Pure Seed" of **Understanding**, which moves and rests between the "Holy of Holies" in the Palace. 

Through the unification of **Beauty** and **Kingdom** as one, supported by these two powers, **Understanding** becomes hidden in the form of "distant connections" <note>original: 'rachak'</note>, shaped like the original hollows and depths of Male and Female, each in its form. They are included in one another until they separate and descend to this world, each standing on its own. According to this, all the visions of the existence of these aspects are revealed until the Palace of the Sapphire Brick, where they are "depicted." This is explained in the *Zohar*, portion of *Pekudei*, regarding how **Kingdom** provides "eyes of the intellect" to those who seek them. It is also established with what is pleasant in the portion of *Tazria*.

Since these aspects are included and crowned through the union of **Beauty** and **Kingdom** via the awakening of the lower realms, a difficulty arises: why do the aspects return to the collective in the portions of *Yitro* and *Bereshit*? It was proper for them to be given to **Adam HaRishon** <term>The First Man: The primordial human soul containing all humanity</term>, as explained in the *Zohar*, portion of *Lech Lecha*. Within this, it is explained that the aspects there are depicted in the collective as a revealed form. He did not see the "Seal of Prophecy" as humans were destined to see later. This is proven by the fact that he did not see the "Seal" at the standing at Mount Sinai with the Tablets. This is because Israel did not reach that level <gloss>to see those aspects</gloss> because they were "turned back" by the sin. The Tablets were greater things <gloss>which are the aspects of the Holy One, Blessed be He, and the secret of the "Dew of Resurrection," the union that produces the aspects before Adam was even created.</gloss> For then, the union was perfect until the creation of Adam and Eve. Afterward, all aspects return to the "Point," just as Adam was created in his form. Such was the state of the Tablets before the fall of Adam.

It may be said that when the aspect of Adam was included and created, he was a collective composed of **600,000** <term>Shishim Ribbu: The traditional number of the souls of Israel</term>, corresponding to the expansion of the generation as one, according to the opinion of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai. Thus he explained in the *Tikkunim*: as long as our ancestors were multiplying, their soul was expanding within them, and Adam lacked nothing. This is the reason for "death" for all who follow him, for they were all included in the 600,000 aspects, and he moves further away through all the generations. 

<gloss>This is a proof for this:</gloss> **Moses our Teacher** (peace be upon him) is "Seth" <note>A Kabbalistic tradition that Moses is a reincarnation of Seth, son of Adam</note> as stated in the *Tikkunim*. Seth was included in the 600,000 within his father, as it is written: "He begot in his own likeness and image." Therefore, Moses is weighed against all of Israel. He brought the 600,000 out of Egypt. Through the "intention of the heart," the phrase "I have carried this people" refers to **Understanding** which is drawn from the Heart. Its "birth" is opposite **Beauty**, which is the "Man" who begets. On this, the letter *Qof* <note>Numerical value 100</note> is made, for **Understanding** is pregnant. 

Thus it is explained regarding the verse "And she continued to give birth" in the *Tikkunim*: Moses spreads through every single generation in the secret of the 600,000, in the form of "a generation goes and a generation comes," and his Torah shines within them. This is the secret of the "Faithful Shepherd" <note>Ra'aya Mehemna: Moses</note>; Moses is the body built among Israel. The language used for Torah scholars is that the letter *Vav* <note>symbolizing the flow of Truth</note> was interrupted in them, but his Torah returns and shines within them. Where they are "between the people of the land," then Moses lives as a collective reincarnation. <gloss>As it relates to our subject: the power of Adam was included in the 600,000, which is the measure of a single generation. This is the secret of the Midrash: "Until Adam was an exile, the Holy One showed him every righteous person destined to arise," some hanging from his hair, some from his clothing, etc.</gloss> After the Holy One established him in our form and measure, the aspects included in him spread out in the Garden of Eden. They stand in their existence until they are purified and given bodies to clothe them in this world. It is possible that no more than 600,000 were created in him, and when Israel exceeds 600,000, they are "in the stones" <note>perhaps referring to souls waiting for bodies</note> and are sent to the Sanctuary day by day through the "Supernal Union." Likewise, through the Supernal Union, holy aspects will be sanctified in the future time when the Holy One comes to sanctify His world, as our Sages said.

## Gate 8: Essence and Conduct from *Asis Rimmonim* <note>original: "Asis Rimmonim" (Pomegranate Nectar), a condensed summary of Rabbi Moses Cordovero’s vast Kabbalistic system, the Pardes Rimmonim.</note>

In the first part of this, it will be explained that when the rectification <term>Tikkun: the process of repairing and balancing the divine realms</term> occurs within the "Rectifications" according to the way of divine conduct, it takes the form of the **Supernal Man**. This is because the **Female** <note>referring to the Sefirah of Kingdom</note> is as explained in the *Zohar*, portion of *Terumah*. For since the aspect of **First Adam** <note>the primordial spiritual prototype of humanity</note> was at the pinnacle of a high place, he did not require a physical union. Rather, the rectification occurs through the "delighting" of **Beauty** and **Kingdom** to increase the aspect of the "First Loving-kindness" and to remove the "thorns" that cling to them. It can be said that when they are "back to back" <note>original: "achur be-achur" — a state where the divine male and female energies are connected but not facing each other, representing a diminished state of flow</note>, they are like raw matter. The matter of this union will be explained through **Wisdom** and **Understanding**. For in the secret of union, there is an "arousal from below" <term>Itaruta de-Letata: the Kabbalistic principle that human deeds on earth trigger divine responses above</term>. Without this lower arousal, the **Daughter** (the **Kingdom**) would turn her face away from **Beauty**. After she turns her face toward him, he too will turn his face toward her, as we shall explain in this work. Or, alternatively, if the **Kingdom** does not have an arousal from the side of the deeds of those below, she will not have the power to turn her face toward **Beauty**... and if **Beauty** also does not turn his face toward her, the portion he would have bestowed upon her becomes her "natural sustenance" <note>meaning a basic, survival-level energy rather than a transformative, intimate flow</note>, similar to the secret of the "Hand" in Kabbalah, which has four faces within it. Because they do not turn "face to face" <note>original: "panim be-panim" — the ideal state of direct divine revelation and intimacy</note> toward one another, this type of union is called, in the secret of **Hanukkah**, a "Dream Union." <note>A "Dream Union" refers to a partial or subconscious connection that happens when the world is in a state of darkness or spiritual slumber.</note>

And as we have explained part of the union, and to return to **Israel**, he sent **Adam** and **Eve** refined to return "back to back." For at the time when sins are divided, they will be "Greeks," etc. <note>This likely refers to the "darkness" of the Greek exile mentioned in Midrashic and Kabbalistic literature regarding the Hanukkah story.</note> And by seeking in the aspect of the "Eighteen" <note>the Shemoneh Esrei prayer</note>, the covering of **Beauty** is removed from **Eve** <note>Kingdom</note>, and she is established "face to face." This arousal rises from below in the aspects of Loving-kindness, and in the Kabbalah, this is "face to face."

Know that there are three aspects of "arousal from below":
1. **The First Aspect:** When the merits of those below are greater. Then the **Kingdom** adorns herself, is aroused, and creates "Female Waters" <term>Mayin Nukvin: the spiritual energy or "longing" sent up from the lower realms to trigger a divine union</term>. This is the secret of the union in the secret of the "overpowering of the flow of Mercy," and the flow is poured down from above in abundance.
2. **The Second Aspect:** When the merits and commandments of the people of the world are balanced <note>half-sinful and half-meritorious</note>. In this case, she does not have the ability to arouse herself until **Beauty**, in his great mercy, is aroused by himself, and from him, the "White Light" <note>original: "tzach" — pure radiance</note> arouses her. This is like the sounding of the Shofar <note>the ram's horn</note> that arouses the last [Sefirah]. Even with the few [righteous] who exist in the generation, even if there are many accusers saying, "These are idol worshippers and those are idol worshippers," etc., the "Flow of Life" is aroused, and the flow bestowed upon her from above comes from the side of **Judgment**, as explained in the *Zohar*, portion of *Tazria*.
3. **The Third Aspect:** When sins are many, heaven forbid. The **Powers of Judgment** <note>original: "Gevurot"</note> then prevent the union of the side of **Loving-kindness** and **Mercy**. All the "Gates of Judgment" are opened, and there is a flow of "Blows of Judgment." The masters of Kabbalah pray and plead to the **Kingdom**, but she does not spread her wings and claims "bitter feedings," for that flow is the secret of "menstrual blood" <note>original: "dam ha-niddah" — symbolizing a state of separation and ritual impurity in the divine realm where the flow is blocked by sin</note>. She distances herself and ascends, and does not join in union until she is cleansed of the stains of that blood. After she is purified, she returns to nurse from the "Waters of Loving-kindness" and **Mercy** from the right-hand powers.

### Chapter 21
And after we have explained the way of arousal for union, we shall explain the way the union is bonded. Know that no union is blessed unless it is preceded by a **"Hug."** <note>The "Hug" and "Kiss" are metaphors for the preparatory stages of divine connection, representing the merging of different spiritual qualities.</note> The meaning of this "hug" is that **Loving-kindness** (Chesed) first bestows into **Beauty**, from the side of the "Foundation of **Understanding**" <note>Yesod of Binah</note> that is unified within him. Afterward, **Judgment** (Gevurah) bestows into **Beauty**. 

The reason for this "hug" is that **Beauty** and **Kingdom** always receive from **Loving-kindness** and **Judgment**. They receive from **Loving-kindness** in the aspect of "Wisdom over her" and from **Judgment** in the aspect of "**Understanding** over her." Between them, **Beauty** is crowned. Then the power of **Judgment** in **Beauty** spreads out and "takes" the **Kingdom**. Afterward, the power of **Loving-kindness** in **Beauty** spreads out and "takes" and "binds" the **Kingdom** until **Kingdom** and **Beauty** are hugged: "His left hand is under my head, and his right hand embraces me" <note>quoting Song of Songs 2:6</note>. This means **Judgment** (the left) comes first, and afterward **Loving-kindness** (the right) embraces. The reason for the order of the hug is because the **Kingdom** has the power of the "Element of Earth," which is cold and dry. **Beauty** is the "Element of Air," which is hot [and moist]. They cannot be tempered together because they are opposites. Therefore, **Loving-kindness** (which is the Element of Water—cold and moist) and **Judgment** (which is the Element of Fire—hot [and dry]) intervene to create a balance and a mixture. 

The matter of the "Hug" is the inclusion of the aspects between the "Supernal Father and Mother" <note>Wisdom and Understanding</note>. This "Hug" is according to what is said in the *Zohar* in several places, particularly in the portion of *Bereshit* on the verse "Let us make man in our image." The manner of the hug is for the purpose of their union to give birth to souls. 

<margin>The Foundation <note>Yesod</note>... as explained in the *Zohar* portion of *Be-midbar*... and Afterward... regarding the letters of "Shema Yisrael"... one should intend that the **Kingdom** is unified in the **Foundation** which is **Beauty**... and then the intention of "One" (*Echad*)...</margin>

After the "Hug" and before the actual Union, the **"Kiss"** must come first. The matter of the "Kiss" is in the mouth: the cleaving of spirit to spirit (*ruach be-ruach*) and saliva to saliva. The "Mouth" always exists in the **Kingdom**, whether in the Male or the Female. In the Male, because he is hidden until the "Foundation," the mouth is in the **Kingdom** that is hidden within **Understanding**. Through this, the "Inner Saliva" <note>representing the subtle life-force</note> is drawn forth. In the Female, since she is the **Kingdom** with all her components, the mouth is in the aspect of the "World of Kingdom" itself. Through the cleaving and binding of these two, the "Kiss" occurs. 

Through the "Kiss," the power of **Judgment** is aroused in the secret of the nature of **Understanding**, and the "Wine of Union" is drawn and spreads through all the Sefirot until the inner essences of the Sefirot are aroused. This is the cleaving of "mouth to mouth" and "saliva to saliva." 

Know that there is no union between **Beauty** and **Kingdom** except when the **Kingdom** receives from the side of the "Kiss." For at a time when the **Judgments** are "in the mouths," as explained in the *Tikunim*, there will be no union for them. It is forbidden for a scholar to be [unbalanced]... and even though in the secret of the "Hug" the **Kingdom** receives from **Judgment**, it is from the **Judgment** of the "Foundation of **Understanding**" within him...

<meta>This page continues the technical breakdown of the Sefirot (divine emanations) and how they function as a system of "worlds." It moves from the structural definitions into the mechanics of how divine energy is funneled to our reality through the Sefirah of Foundation (Yesod) into the Kingdom (Malchut).</meta>

# Gate 8: Essence and Conduct from the *Pomegranate Nectar* <note>original: "Asis Rimmonim"</note>

**Wisdom** [Chochmah], **Loving-kindness** [Chesed], and **Endurance** [Netzach] constitute the **World of Construction**. The three of **Understanding** [Binah], **Severity** [Gevurah], and **Splendor** [Hod] <note>original abbreviation: ב"גה (Binah, Gevurah, Hod)</note> constitute the **World of Judgment**. The three of **Knowledge** [Da'at], **Beauty** [Tiferet] <note>original abbreviation: ת"פ (Tiferet)</note>, and **Foundation** [Yesod] constitute the **World of Mercy**—and **Kingdom** [Malchut] receives from them all.

Above **Loving-kindness** is the "General Loving-kindness," which is the secret of Mercy. Therefore, the scripture <note>likely referring to a specific Kabbalistic proof-text</note> includes **Judgment** within **Loving-kindness**, because the secret of "She" <note>the feminine aspect of the divine</note> is included in **Understanding**, which is the root of Judgment. However, it is not considered actual Judgment here, but rather a "General Judgment" as explained above. The matter of **Knowledge** [Da'at] is that it arises to fill the place of the **Crown** [Keter]. Because the **Crown** is entirely "simple" <term>Pashut: in Kabbalah, this refers to a state of pure, undifferentiated energy without parts or qualities</term>, we do not attribute to it either judgment or mercy. Since the function of Mercy is to decide and balance between **Loving-kindness** and **Judgment**, and the **Crown** is the ultimate simplicity, it is not referred to as the "Place of Mercy." Therefore, in the place of **Knowledge**—which exists because of the inclusion of **Beauty** and the balance between **Wisdom** and **Understanding**—it decides between them and ascends and elevates until the **Crown**. This is because its species <note>its spiritual nature</note> is the root of its powers. Since **Knowledge** spreads out, is crowned, and ascends into the **Crown**, it fulfills the place of the **Crown**. **Kingdom** [Malchut] then includes all these aspects below. Just as **Wisdom**, **Understanding**, and **Knowledge** fulfill the place of the **Crown** and establish the secret of potential actions within the **Crown**, so too the lower Sefirot establish the secret of actions in practice. Within the "General," these actions are hidden. Consequently, the **Crown** is the hidden root for **Beauty**, **Wisdom** is the hidden root for **Greatness** [Chesed], and **Understanding** is the hidden root for **Severity** [Gevurah]. **Loving-kindness** is the hidden root for **Endurance**, and **Severity** is the hidden root for **Splendor**. **Beauty** is the hidden root for **Foundation**, and **Foundation** is taken from it and becomes the hidden root for **Kingdom**, which is the inclusion of them all.

->(Chapter 26: The General Rule, etc.)<-

What is given by the Blessed Name <note>original: בשי"ת (Be-Shem Yitbarach)</note> is imprinted in the lower Sefirot, which spread into the lower triad <note>Netzach, Hod, Yesod</note>. **Foundation** [Yesod] receives from them all, and their power is concentrated within it. It then imprints from itself into **Kingdom** [Malchut]. No Sefirah has the form <note>the permission or capacity</note> of another Sefirah in its specific intent and action. No Sefirah has the authority to influence the lower realms except through **Kingdom**. If they were to influence without her, it would cause "separation" in the divine rectifications. **Kingdom** would not be unified and would not receive from any Sefirah, even from **Foundation** and the flow of the **Righteous** <term>Zaddik: The "Righteous One," a common title for the Sefirah of Yesod (Foundation), which funnels divine energy</term>. Through the **Righteous One**, **Loving-kindness** is unified with **Kingdom**, and he flows into her from what he receives. If one were to ascend from each individual Sefirah and give these "voices," they would mean that **Foundation** and **Kingdom** are unified as one, like male and female. Know that the **Righteous One** [Yesod] is **Loving-kindness**; for if **Kingdom** did not receive the flow according to her needs, there would be no sustenance or help for the worlds. We must remember that **Kingdom** provides for and sustains the world from the flow she received before the "Exile" <note>original: Galut</note>. The reason is that holiness must expand and multiply, not diminish. Therefore, that same flow does not cease from producing fruit in the world, as it expands from one existence to another infinitely. 

This is like a gardener who doubles the seeds he sows in the earth, which then wait and grow on their own for the coming year, or from the eve of the Sabbath for the Sabbath, as explained in the *Zohar*, portion of *Terumah*. Even though the holiness that **Kingdom** received previously continues to expand from her—and through it the worlds are blessed—the flow of blessing that draws from "seeds sown on their own" is not like the flow drawn from "seeds sown by a gardener." When it grows on its own, it is a separate existence, and it does not possess the "Secret of the Thread" <note>a connection to the divine source</note>. For when the "Secret of the Thread" remains closed in its place, it becomes independent. But when the **Righteous One** [Yesod] stands within his garden and waters it, that seed-place will have a continuous "thread" without interruption, and the world will be nourished from the very Essence of the "Thread" itself, rather than from its mere offshoots. Through these "Threads," things multiply, increase, and expand without end. 

If one were to ask: "Since in this time [of exile] there is no supernal union, how can the unions of the Commandments add or produce anything?" Know that if there were a complete cessation in this time, there would be no existence or blessings found at all. Nevertheless, the action [of the Commandments] brings down nourishment from above and "supports" the **Kingdom**, as explained in the *Zohar*, portion of *Shemini*. This support is why **Kingdom** is called the "Fallen Booth of David" <note>original: Sukkat David HaNofalet</note>—meaning it is falling, and one supports it and doubles its strength through the unions performed upon it. For the flow it received previously will last as long as it is nurtured by the **Foundation**; but if it is not supported, it will gradually spoil and diminish, Heaven forbid. Therefore, there is no day without its curse being greater [than the last], and its memory sleeps, for the "Female" <note>Malchut</note> is weakened. Because of this, she needs "Supports" so that she does not fall entirely. This "Support" is achieved through the flow of a bit of **Loving-kindness**, which sustains her from above little by little until the **Kingdom** is unified above. Even though she is not at the level of the "Great Union" that existed when the Temple stood, she still has a "Secret Sanctification," and everything is according to the time and the deeds of the **Righteous** in this world.

<meta>This page continues the technical exposition of the Sefirot from the work "Asis Rimmonim" (Pomegranate Nectar), an abridgment of Rabbi Moses Cordovero’s "Pardes Rimmonim." It specifically focuses on the lower Sefirot—Netzach (Endurance), Hod (Splendor), Yesod (Foundation), and Malchut (Kingdom)—and how they function as the "limbs" of the divine structure to facilitate union and the flow of blessing to the lower worlds.</meta>

# Gate 8: Essence and Conduct from the *Pomegranate Nectar* <note>original: "Asis Rimmonim"</note>

And after this, [it is explained] that **Foundation** [Yesod] is the intended axis and the "Small Unifier" and the General Principle. And there is no doubt that **Kingdom** [Malchut] has three aspects: her height, her state, and her relationship to **Foundation**. She also has aspects related to **Greatness** [Chesed], **Severity** [Gevurah], **Endurance** [Netzach], and **Splendor** [Hod]. For just as in **Foundation** there is the secret of the "sign of the covenant" and its three aspects, so too in the Female [Malchut] there is a corresponding order in the arrangement of the "thighs" and the "legs." Thus, in the Higher **Foundation**, they are arrayed and cherished, one corresponding to the other, as explained in the *Tikunim* <note>The *Tikunei Zohar*, a classic Kabbalistic text</note>, Tikun 58. It is further explained in the *Tikunim* that the desire of the Divine Presence [Shekhinah] is always to be unified with her Husband [the Holy One, Blessed be He]. Her Husband leads her to her canopy, and by His power, He unites with her. Thus, our Queen descends to unite with our King, for the Shekhinah is the "limbs" of the body in the same way that a human has 248 limbs; so too there are 248 supernal powers. Furthermore, in the *Tikunim*, there are three foundations for **Wisdom** [Chochmah] and **Understanding** [Binah]—meaning in three places—and likewise for **Beauty** [Tiferet] and **Kingdom** [Malchut]. From the side of **Understanding**, there is a separation into the "right side" and the "left side," in the manner of male and female. These lean toward the right and those toward the left, and around them, they are cherished in the **Crown** [Keter] and in **Foundation**. They are divided into **Greatness** and **Severity**—meaning into Loving-kindness and Gevurah—and are cherished in the "Body of the King," which is **Beauty**. They then divide into **Endurance** and **Splendor** and are cherished in the middle, in the **Foundation** of the "Body of the King." This is all based on the four aspects included in the Holy Names <note>original: "Y-H-V-H" and "A-D-N-Y"</note>. **Foundation** bestows light upon light, and the **Foundation** of the "Body" joins with the name associated with **Kingdom** to act above as a pillar of light. Therefore, they separate toward **Endurance** and **Splendor**, this one to the right and that one to the left, and around them, they are cherished in **Foundation**. This is the secret of the "Triple Union."

### **Chapter 24: And the Sefirah...**

The seventh and eighth [Sefirot] are those called the "thighs" <note>The supports of the divine body</note>. **Endurance** [Netzach] is called "support" on the right, beneath **Loving-kindness** [Chesed], because it is an offshoot of Loving-kindness. **Splendor** [Hod] is established on the left, beneath **Severity** [Gevurah]. Their qualities are a form of tempering, so that their actions are not too harsh, since both of them draw sustenance from **Beauty** [Tiferet], which is comprised of both Loving-kindness and Judgment. By drawing from this balance, their qualities are sweetened by the "Triple Union." <margin>The branch of Netzach draws from Loving-kindness, but also draws from the Beauty within it. Likewise, Severity [Gevurah]—therefore, the action of Netzach does not overpower the Loving-kindness within Loving-kindness itself. Similarly for Hod, for it only draws from Severity, and it also draws from the Beauty within it, where Loving-kindness is included. Therefore, the action of Hod does not overpower the Severity within Severity itself. This is the explanation of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, of blessed memory.</margin> It is explained that they are called "open streets" because they are the channels for the flow of divine energy. This is also how Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai explained it: to look above regarding the Shekhinah and to be bound to the "Right Arm," which is Life. And regarding the "Left Arm," there too is the union. This is what is meant by these two qualities: they are not separate actions, but are unified as "two halves of a single body." Unlike the other Sefirot, where each is distinct, **Endurance** and **Splendor** are uniquely paired. Know that they have three aspects: 1) the aspect of the "thighs" that connect to the body; 2) the aspect of the "kidneys" where the "seeds" of divine energy are stored; 3) the aspect of the "vessels" that bring the energy toward the **Foundation** [Yesod], the sign of the Holy Covenant, to prepare for the divine union [Zivug]. This is why they are called "two halves of the body." Even the sages of the nations <note>Non-Jewish philosophers/scientists</note> agreed that one cannot give birth without both male and female [principles], and even if one entity contains both potentials, they are still two distinct powers working as one.

### **And the Sefirah...**

The ninth is the Sefirah of **Foundation** [Yesod], and its level is the "Covenant of Peace," an offshoot of **Beauty** [Tiferet]. Its qualities and actions are like those of Beauty. The sign for this is: "Whatever happened to Jacob [Tiferet], happened to Joseph [Yesod]." Even though its actions are related to the "birth" or manifestation of Beauty, it possesses powers from all the Sefirot, for in it, all the forces and actions are gathered and refined.

### **And the Sefirah...**

The tenth is the Sefirah of **Kingdom** [Malchut]. Its qualities involve all the actions that relate to the **Crown** [Keter] and to providing for the inhabitants of the world. It encompasses all souls, whether righteous or wicked; all are included in the matter of the tenth Sefirah.

### **Chapter 25: And After...**

Now that the form of the Sefirot has been explained, know how they are divided and included in three aspects for their "Head" and three aspects for their "Path." The three aspects of their path are: **Crown**, **Wisdom**, and **Understanding**—the **Intellectual World** [Olam HaMuskal]. The three [middle ones]—**Loving-kindness**, **Severity**, and **Beauty**—are the **Felt World** [Olam HaMurgash]. The three [lower ones]—**Endurance**, **Splendor**, and **Foundation**—are the **Natural World** [Olam HaMutba]. And **Kingdom** receives from them all.

And his elevation was exalted; the Levites were from the side of **Severity** [Gevurah] and their portion was the Priest, the strength of **Kindness** [Chesed]. The Middle Line decided between them, yet it did not end the distinction through its decision. "And the Lord pardoned the School of Hillel" <note>Referring to the Talmudic dictum that while both views are "words of the living God," the law follows the School of Hillel.</note>. Therefore, some believe that what was said about "these and those" <note>The phrase "Both these and those are the words of the living God."</note> and the essence of the "decision" means that they were divided by the strength of a "bad neighbor" and He extended to both of them. This is like what was done to the head of their lineage, so that it would not be lost in the decision (however, the dispute is fixed for the sake of Heaven). This is the dispute between the School of Shammai and the School of Hillel. The School of Hillel were [the side of] **Kindness**, and the School of Shammai were [the side of] **Severity**—judgment.

And their virtues were established according to their qualities: one of them was humble and patient <note>Hillel</note>, and the other was fastidious <note>Shammai</note>. Their dispute was "for the sake of Heaven," to receive the "decision," so that their words would be enacted. Therefore, the School of Hillel merited to establish the law [Halakha] according to their view. The foundation of the Law is the **Divine Presence** [Shekhinah] <note>The Sefirah of Malchut, which governs physical action and legal reality.</note>, which is the side of **Kindness** and is nourished by it.

Therefore, the "words of the living God" are "living," meaning the **Shekhinah**, and from her, the "Second Building" is extended. Then our honor and our foundations—these are called "these" and "those." Some forbid and some permit. And through this, the forbidden and the permitted are explained in every matter. The root is in the Great Mountain <note>A metaphor for the higher Sefirot.</note> and they require a "decision" [mediation]. Everything is from the **Shekhinah**. When one side prevails—Kindness over its opposite—these three lines become the Law according to it.

Therefore, between the one who declares "impure" and the one who declares "pure," each one examines his words. Sometimes the Law follows the School of Shammai, as mentioned in the merit of the full measure. This is because the world follows the School of Hillel for leniency and the School of Shammai for stringency, according to the purity of the qualities. Sometimes there is a sharpening; sometimes the rule of **Severity** dominates alone, or **Kindness** dominates alone, and there are times when they require a decision. There are two [types of decision]: the first is between three, and the second is between the School of Shammai and the School of Hillel. For Hillel and Shammai are the branches of **Kindness** and **Severity**.

Even their merits and virtues require a decision, just as their foundations were Water, Salt, and Air. So too in the souls, the foundations are the root of the world. And even though their actions were not as potent as the actions of the first Patriarchs, the decision between the three would be through **Beauty** [Tiferet]. (It has three states: one is the simple state, which is the essence of **Beauty** before the line of Judgment or the line of Mercy, without leaning toward any power at all. This does not "decide" because it is a line unto itself. Its essence is the number six, and it is a composition of three hidden lines. And with this, it decides because it leans toward one of the powers.)

Regarding this decision, the *Book of Creation* [Sefer Yetzirah] says: "Three mothers: Aleph, Mem, Shin [AMSh]. Their foundation is a scale of merit and a scale of guilt, and the tongue of decree decides between them" <note>Sefer Yetzirah 3:1</note>. The meaning of **AMSh** is Air, Water, and Fire—which are **Beauty**, **Kindness**, and **Severity**. The "tongue" is the foundation of the Law, which is **Earth**, because it includes both the second and the last. Within the realm of the "Earth," her glory is only according to the weight. So too in the matter of the external forces, which are generally divided into three parts: Water (the side of Mercy), Fire (the side of Judgment), and Air (the side of Mercy/Breath). The action of these forces is clarified from the three of them.

But in the aspect of the "Holy One" <note>The Divine realm</note>, where there is no composition of "what" or "who," they are unified as one. And it says "their foundation is a scale," etc. Meaning, the foundation and the action of these essences, which are **AMSh**, is the "scale of merit" (which is **Kindness**) and the "scale of guilt" (which is **Severity**). The "tongue of decree" is **Beauty**, which is praised as a "tongue" from the side of **Understanding** [Binah]. Its essence is the entire decision. Between these are the "offspring of Knowledge" [Da'at] within **Understanding** and above. And the "Decree" [Chok] is the **Foundation** [Yesod], which is also a decider, as will be asked further. Know that there is no perfection in the decision of **Beauty** except through **Kingdom** [Malchut]. (And the secret of the matter is) that the abundance that was there was the foundation of "Water," which is easy and light, and he is the master of total **Kindness**.

Separation—which is included in all levels of the "Husk" [Klipah] in the secret of the "Evil Glow" <note>The *Nogah*, a mixture of good and evil.</note>, which is no less than ten [levels], like a monkey in the presence of a human. "But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn" <note>Proverbs 4:18</note>. In the book *The Wars of the Lord*, it says: "Eth and Heb in Suphah" <note>Numbers 21:14. A cryptic verse often interpreted kabbalistically to mean that God's love appears even at the end/storm.</note>. The two disputants shall be "twinned" <note>A pun on "Te'omim" (twins) and "Ta'amu" (they agreed/matched).</note>. Even though the School of Shammai usually leans toward stringency and the School of Hillel toward leniency, nevertheless, the Sages taught "from the leniencies of Shammai and the stringencies of Hillel." And sometimes the Law follows Shammai's stringency, following the reason of "Here I am, my son," as written regarding the Binding [Akedah]. Abraham acted with "cruelty" <note>Severity</note> toward his son, and Isaac acted with "kindness" and became one who suffers his own death to save his children from Judgment.

In the Zohar, Parashat Terumah, on the verse "Let there be light": "Light" is in **Kindness** [Chesed]. "And there was light" is a language of pain <note>Because "Vayehi" (And there was) often implies sorrow in midrashic interpretation.</note> in **Severity** [Gevurah]. "And God saw the light that it was good"—this is the Middle Column that stands in the center, which stands and grasps this side and that side. When there was the perfection of the three sides, it is written of it "that it was good," which was not said of the others, because there was no perfection until the "Third Light" came and perfected all sides. Once this third one came, it then separated the dispute of the Right and the Left.

Up to this point, they attributed two aspects to **Beauty** [Tiferet]. The first is that it stands in the center in the secret of "Essence," which is the Third Line—Mercy. The second is that it stands and grasps this side and that side, being comprised of them and composed of three colors. Here you can discern the leaning toward the side of the "Decision." In this, Jacob is called a "Simple Man" <note>Genesis 25:27. "Tam" can mean simple, whole, or balanced.</note>, and it says "it was good" in the perfection of the three sides. This is why the word "stands" is doubled: once for the first aspect and once to join with its two ends.
