# Slice of the Pomegranate: Gate 18 — The Diminishing of the Moon

It shall be like a branch of the whole; therefore, the manifestation of **Malchut** <note>Kingship; the tenth Sefirah, associated with the Moon and the Divine Presence</note> was initially revealed through the mystery of the "filling" <note>The spelling out of a Hebrew letter's name</note>, because the triad of **Keter-Chochmah-Tiferet** <note>Crown, Wisdom, and Beauty/Harmony</note> was hidden within the **Malchut**. For so it was with everything, and because of this, the higher triad existed in her externally. The "filling" of the letter *Yud* <note>Spelled Yud-Vav-Dalet</note> hints at this: the *Yud* refers to **Malchut**, the *Vav* to **Tiferet**, and the *Dalet* back to **Malchut**. Between the **Tiferet** and its filling, they are clung to one another like the matter of the "Two Faces" <note>An early state of the Sefirot where the masculine and feminine aspects were joined back-to-back</note>. This is the secret of the four configurations in their totality. They are the existence of the *Yud* as **Malchut**, a reality revealed to the point that illuminates the circle.

And the reality of **Da'at** <note>Knowledge; the bridge between the upper and lower Sefirot</note> of **Tiferet**—when **Tiferet** was over **Malchut**—it was within **Chochmah** like the aspect of the first *Yud* that extends through the world. Its "filling" in its writing is like a cluster of grapes in a circle. This is the secret of the "argument in our blessing" <note>A reference to the moon's complaint in the Midrash</note> to reveal things further and to refine the inheritance from that level. Because the reality of the "Crowner" <note>Keter</note> was still a unity in oneness, the **Da'at**, which is the reality of the upper triad, and the Sefirah of **Malchut** stood alone like **Chochmah**. This was so because the cause of the "externalities" was due to the hiddenness—meaning that from the power of the "ends and limits," like a circle, things are revealed. Therefore, the hidden triad preceded the manifestation, and the concealment preceded the "escape of the end." In the place of the four configurations, **Tiferet** alone was covered.

In this matter, there is no "before" or "after," for everything occurred in a single moment. Everything follows the precedence of spiritual rank and the hiddenness of existence. This precedes the "radiance of the voice" <note>The primordial light</note>. When the upper triad preceded in **Binah** <note>Understanding</note>, **Binah** waited to receive **Malchut** from **Chochmah**. **Malchut**, as it is "Face to Face," was then recognized upon the "ledger," and the ledger opens beneath it. This is why it is said that "He divided the rock into two parts"—that is, **Binah** was there. This alludes to **Binah** being the "Holy of Holies." Afterward, **Malchut** follows, like "pressing the wine of the blood," for there was its nourishment from the "Holy Tiferet" below. This is numerically equivalent to "Adam" <note>The Hebrew word Adam (45) matches the value of the name of God (Mah)</note> with the name *BN* <note>A specific spelling of the Tetragrammaton associated with Malchut</note>, filling the cup of *Yud-He-Vav-He*. There, the union of husband and wife <note>Tiferet and Malchut</note> is sanctified, Face to Face in a perfect union, where the heart gives life to its aid in the future, as it is written: *And the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun* <note>Isaiah 30:26</note>.

Then the Male aspect was upon the point of his foundations, for all who grasp it shall merit. From there, his gate was born to be like a man whose feet are upon a horse’s wheel. According to what has been explained, it emerges that **Malchut** precedes the "spreading out" of existence within **Chochmah**, because she was the primary intention of the world. Therefore, her revelation preceded there. But **Tiferet** precedes **Malchut** in its existence below, for he was the cause of the revelation and the secret of his righteousness. This aligns with the one who says in the Talmud <note>Tractate Hagigah, chapter "Ein Dorshin"</note> that "Heaven was created first," and the one who says "Earth was created first." They do not actually disagree: in **Chochmah**, the revelation of **Malchut** (Earth) came first, but in the world of **Atzilut** (Emanation), the upper triad (Heaven) came first. And those who say "both were created as one" are also correct, for in that realm there is no precedence of time, as the emanations do not fall under the category of time. There is no "earlier" or "later" in the matter at all, but rather everything follows the precedence of rank and the hiddenness of existence. The Zohar hints at this: "The Compassionate One created the world... clouds and thick darkness are round about Him" <note>Psalm 97:2</note>, and then "God said, 'Let there be light.'"

The Zohar says: Before the creation of "these," you shall make a crown for Him. One might say: There is no work for a King that strengthens the heart like a crown of praise and glory. It arose in His "Thought" <note>Machshavah</note>, and as is known, "Joshua from the tribes," etc. The meaning is that **Malchut** was crowned with the Divine Light, as the verse says: "Light, light..." always.

->Ledgers<-

<column-break/>

The discourse "If every living thing," Part 1—for here, brevity is beautiful. There have already been great errors by various "wise men" in their own eyes, but not in the eyes of the Blessed God. May the Merciful One forgive their iniquity, for they too intended their words for the sake of Heaven, though they did not serve [their teachers] sufficiently.

**In the world** of the senses, where the conduct of Mercy and Judgment exists, each one reveals its power and overcomes its opposite. Thus, the famous argument recorded in the chapter "Elu Terefot" <note>Talmud, Tractate Chullin 60b</note> is justified: "It is impossible for two kings to use one crown." This applies when the flow of **Binah** <note>Understanding; the source of Judgment</note> is equal to both of them. For **Binah** is the root of Judgment (*Din*), and from this side, it would be thought that Judgment should have the upper hand. And in the natural world, where the essence of choice (*Bechirah*) exists over all actions, the arguer would certainly think that two kings cannot coexist without the absence of one, to use the "Crown of a Good Name"—which is **Malchut**—rising above them both equally. Rather, it is "Majesty" (*Hod*), which is her nature and her attribute, where "Righteousness shall lodge in her," that would cause Judgment to overcome Mercy for those who possess free will.

**The answer** came that absolute free will and permission are given to the "Chosen People"—who are all righteous according to the Torah. The Torah itself is His Blessed Knowledge. We should not think that choice is a matter of lawlessness or absolute abandonment, Heaven forbid. For if one could imagine that it were possible to cast off the yoke of the Torah and commandments entirely under the guise of "absolute choice," the name of Israel would nearly be mentioned no more. There is no greater blemish or insult to the Kingdom of Heaven than this! Concerning this, Joshua said: *And what will You do for Your great name?* <note>Joshua 7:9</note>. Even though he only said this to be saved from the war with the seven nations, the argument is essentially the same, without any difference. Shortly, more will be explained that will suffice to silence the "demolishing questioner," according to the intent of this chapter.

**Rather**, certainly, a "good gift" from the treasury of the King of kings, the Holy One Blessed be He, was given to us: Free Will. This was given so that we might merit to diminish our desires of our own volition and become submissive to the Supreme Wisdom. For all are His servants, and from Wisdom comes life and goodness. She is the one who recognizes and "chooses life," as in the sense of "my heart chooses." "Diminish yourself"—this means that the *intellectual* choice should diminish the *practical* choice, using a "bit and bridle" to restrain it. For lawlessness is not choice, but rather servitude and eternal imprisonment with a "snake in a basket." That is undoubtedly the cancellation of choice, as in the sense of *He sent them into the hand of their transgression* and *I will visit their sin upon them*. However, "Fear of Heaven," which is not in the hands of Heaven <note>A famous Talmudic dictum: "Everything is in the hands of Heaven except the fear of Heaven"</note>, is "engraved on the tablets." You have no truly free person except for one who attaches themselves to the Torah to diminish, by their will and choice, the "abandoned choice" that lacks intellect. This is truly "double choice": that the practical choice should agree with the intellectual choice's counsel, and its desire shall be fulfilled. With this, one shall "rule by day and by night," and its owners will merit "two tables" <note>Prosperity in both this world and the world to come</note>.

**And as for** the claim: "A lamp at noon, what benefit does it provide?" <note>Aramaic: *Shraga b'tihara mai ahani?*</note>—meaning, it is written, *The Lord knows the days of the innocent* and *For the Lord knows the way of the righteous*. What then does choice—which is the "lamp of a commandment"—avail in a matter already known before Him and clear as the sun that it will certainly be so? To this, the answer comes...

The one who is brazen enough to be arrogant <note>Referring to the "Moon's complaint" in the Midrash, where the moon argued it should not be equal to the sun</note> has provided us with distinct signs. For those who are rich in Torah and commandments will sit in a lowly place of their own will, because they diminish themselves—and that is their praise. In them, the Name of Heaven <note>original: ש"ש - Shem Shamayim</note> is glorified by the memory of their humility before Him. "Jacob is small" <note>Amos 7:2</note> and the generation is small; however, He, blessed be His Name, knows the secrets of the heart. He does not assist one who has not learned but wants to teach. When such a person comes to teach, he is found to be gluttonous and closes the door before himself. This is to clarify that in the future, one will give an account until he learns from the merchants of his master <note>A metaphor for scholars or spiritual teachers</note> and returns to the words of the Sages.

## The Gate

It shall act for itself as explained above. Regarding what they receive, it returns to the "Living Grace" <note>original: ח"ח - Chiut Chesed</note> as mentioned, like tools to strip away the **Judgment** <note>original: Din</note>, leaving a place for **Mercy** <note>original: Rachamim</note>, and **Mercy** in the place of **Judgment**. For the receiver requires strength in order to have pity and to cover. This is the argument for the "filling" <note>The internal expansion of a Divine name</note>, to carve out their secret. Around it, the lack of "smallness" weighs heavily upon the "Living Grace." Regarding the "Two Kings" <note>Tiferet and Malchut</note> using the **Crown of Grace**, the Holy One, Blessed be He, left for her from the "Two Kings" aspects like **Netzach** <note>Endurance</note> and **Hod** <note>Splendor</note>. This is a wonder beneath their "feet," meaning beneath the **Yesod** <note>Foundation; the ninth Sefirah</note>, which acts mostly through **Mercy** because its inclination is toward **Grace**. Furthermore, the "Luck" <note>Mazal</note> of **Tiferet** <note>Beauty/Harmony</note> blocks the **Judgment**. Therefore, as a reception of **Grace**, the goat <note>The New Moon sacrifice</note> is offered for the "Se'ir" <note>original: שעיר - referring to Esau/Judgment</note>, because there was a "sucking" <note>Spiritual nourishment</note> for the external forces in her strength. Her Husband <note>Tiferet</note> gave to her, for he receives with a sweetness; with her Husband, she was sometimes above him. They move from the power of the "Se'ir" to the "Living Grace." For a memory, she gave to her Husband so that she would rise to the **Judgment** and break the **Klippah** <note>The "shell" or husk of evil/negativity</note>.

## Chapter 6: And Know

That this "Complaint" <note>original: קטרון - Kitron; the moon's protest against being equal to the sun</note> is not a matter of light-headedness, God forbid. Especially regarding the ancient and pure external forces, the seven "rests" of the "Apple Orchard" <note>A Kabbalistic name for Malchut/the Divine Presence</note> were removed from the Passover... and so on. As it is written later: to perform strong **Judgment** and not to perform **Mercy**. This is to reveal the beginning of the "Supporting One." For **Tiferet** in its vitality will prevail over her and cancel her action. The greatness of the "Nights" <note>Malchut’s domain</note> was the greatness of her action in strong **Judgment**, until she could not give "White Nectar" <note>Pure spiritual influence</note>. For the nature of things is that **Grace** is found in her. Thus, everything she receives will become more "sustenance." In the future, the "light of the moon will be like the light of the sun," for her **Judgment** will be sweetened as she stands in the embrace of her Husband. This is the "Complaint of the Moon" in these matters against **Tiferet**. He prepared for her to have great compassion, which is Will and Desire, to nourish the "chicks" <note>The souls or lower worlds</note> over the "sons." He did good for her... and you shall awaken the Higher Mercies. The secret of the "womb" <note>original: רחם - Rechem, related to Mercy</note> for the "anointing" is the sweetening of **Judgment**. She performs the actions of **Judgment** in her perfection. There is no one to subdue her from above. For the **Zohar**, she was a swift helper, and she hurried from within her fullness without any interruption. It is written that through the **Se'ir** <note>the goat sacrifice</note>, the Sanctuary is atoned and purified from the covering of **Judgment** and the **Klippot**. Through this principle, she unites with her Husband as she was before the "diminishing," and the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun. So shall it be always, when the power of **Judgment** is lacking, and she performs the action of desiring the strength of **Judgment** and **Gevurah** <note>Severity/Strength</note>. This is the benefit of the "Ending and Completion" that gave her a voice of higher stature in her diminished state as in her first place. Because the nature of **Judgment** is "smaller" than **Mercy** when being influenced from above, her action also flows. Therefore, for the "Greenery" <note>a stage of spiritual growth</note>, there is a burden in the connection to the firmaments. For all the actions of **Tiferet**, which is her life, are through the secret of the Name... called **Israel**. According to the decree of things, actions are done through strength and the sum of the "Twelve Boundaries," which are the twelve permutations of the Divine Name <note>original: הויות - Havayot</note>. In them is the secret of "Smallness" <note>Katnut</note>. They chose to call the righteous by Your Name... for through clinging to them, her Husband, the King, unites with her. And "Man knew" <note>Genesis 4:1</note> his place... and sometimes she was...

# Slice of the Pomegranate: Gate 18 — The Diminishing of the Moon
### 36
-> Catchword: Who dwells <-

The heavens and the earth, for everything is acquired by Him, blessed be He. In this same way, Abraham is considered one "acquisition" to teach that from the seed of Israel, not even one individual is subtracted from His acquisition, blessed be He, even at the end of the world. "He devises means so that the banished one is not cast out from Him" <note>2 Samuel 14:14</note> until the end of all generations. There is a choice here in the building of the Holy Temple, which does not accept converts; therefore, it too is one "acquisition." Thus, the five acquisitions <note>Referring to the five things the Mishna in Avot describes as God's special possessions: Torah, Heaven and Earth, Abraham, Israel, and the Temple.</note> return to being one, to teach us that nothing is eternal in the works of heaven and earth except that which relates to the Torah. It is written: "Or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you?" <note>Isaiah 50:1</note> For who is it that requires repayment? If they give him money, he will be appeased. Rather, "you were sold for nothing" by your own doing, as it is written, "for your iniquities you were sold" <note>Isaiah 50:1</note> in the passive sense. It was taught in the chapter titled "The One Who Withdraws" <note>original: Ha-Choletz - a chapter in Tractate Yevamot</note>: they [the nations] do not "acquire" you; therefore, the sale is void. There is no other "buyer" to turn the curse into a blessing and to contemplate the kindnesses of the Lord. With this, there is no need to strengthen the attribute of **Judgment**, for **Choice**—in the way we have explained—is given to all creatures. A person’s day is the house of their life, in the sense of "life received and sustained." The Wise King <note>King Solomon</note> has already explained this: "To everything there is a season, and a time to every purpose" <note>Ecclesiastes 3:1</note>. For I am here hinting at "leaping and skipping over the snow," and the truth will show its way.

**The generality** of this inquiry is what the elders of Israel asked Ezekiel, using the argument of "a slave whose master sold him" <note>A midrashic reference where the Jews argued that since God "sold" them to Babylon, they were no longer bound by His laws; Ezekiel refutes this.</note>. He replied to them: "As I live, says the Lord... surely with a mighty hand... will I reign over you" <note>Ezekiel 20:33</note>. The reason "I will reign over you" is used is so that the "Righteous will be called by Your name," as it is written: "And your people shall all be righteous" <note>Isaiah 60:21</note>. They are naturally and inherently inclined toward the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven—a heritage of the congregation of Jacob. They are permitted control over all the details of their actions day by day so that **Choice** may rule over all the commandments and warnings in their proper time. Though "a generation goes and a generation comes" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:4</note>, whether good or sinful, we do not know what the judgment of the Supreme Justice and His work will be. "The earth stands forever" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:4</note>, and "the sun rises" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:5</note> through the deeds of the righteous, and "the sun sets" through the deeds of the wicked. But ultimately, "it pants toward its place" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:5</note>; it scatters [the wicked], for the beds of the wicked are full of regrets. And behold, regret suspends punishment, and sufferings cleanse, until the "Master of the House" <note>God</note> brings out His vessels and collects His debt according to our measure in its place. This is in the sense of "And I shall separate you to be Mine," like one who winnows his threshing floor. This is among the wonders of Divine Providence to tell that "the Lord is upright."

**There is** a similar concept in human laws regarding "turning away from evil and doing good," which are the foundational principles of the entire Torah. For we have learned in the tractate *Arachin*: Those obligated to bring a Burnt Offering or Peace Offering are coerced [to bring them] through a lien. And even though it does not atone for him until he is willing—as it says "for his acceptance" <note>Leviticus 1:3</note>—we apply the same logic as we do to Bills of Divorce for women. This refers to those whom the law compels to divorce; these fall under "turning away from evil." We coerce him until he says, "I am willing." All of this is a model within the Torah for any upright observer regarding what we have explained concerning the Laws of Heaven.

**And regarding** this response from the verse "Righteousness in its name," one certainly must not question it, for it is a matter entrusted to the "One who sees into the heart," the Creator who "fashions their hearts alike and understands all their works" <note>Psalm 33:15</note>. He knows and witnesses the plots and thoughts of all creatures in the world: who is truly righteous with a whole heart, and who is merely pretending to be so for the sake of

<column-break/>

examination. This refers to the **Vitality of Kindness** <note>original: ח"ח - Chiut Chesed</note> for rectification. Just as in a kingdom below, there was a division in the aspect of the measure... because the Holy One, blessed be He, opened with the numerical value of "Who is like You" <note>original: מ'כ'י' - Mi Camocha</note> and gave twenty parts of this to **Understanding** <note>original: Binah</note> and the **Vitality of Kindness**. As is known, this word "Kindness" <note>original: Chesed</note> emerges from the **Kingdom** <note>original: Malchut</note>. These are the "generations" of the abridged form, and **Beauty** <note>original: Tiferet</note> is this and that, and it contains no secrets of **Understanding**. For this reason, there were aspects within **Understanding** during the word "Kindness" originally, and it became "soiled" in it like a Sefirah... and Heaven forbid that it be diminished, as it is locked for the sake of sustaining the deed. From the aspect of the "Olive Tree," they inherited from **Wisdom** <note>original: Chokhmah</note> alone, taking the hiddenness... for the sake of the Diminishing [of the Moon]. The reason for the "wiping away" <note>A reference to the moon's loss of light</note> was so that she could be gathered and joined with her husband "face to face" <note>A Kabbalistic term for a perfect union between Tiferet and Malchut</note>, and so that he might grace and soften your faces... the reason he sent at the beginning... down from the aspect of the measure of the **Foundation** <note>original: Yesod</note>... in order to perform the hoped-for action. For through her "wiping away," the existences would be revealed... and because of the "wiping," it was below the aspect... until they would live according to the law in the place of **Judgment**. With this, it is explained that some of the softening and the "weapons" occur through the connection in the ladder... and the "softening of faces." The essence of the matter was the connection, and regarding this—that is to say, **Kindness**—for he merits this chest-connection. For the intent of **Kindness** was not to be a Foundation... this is the secret of the "Covenant of Death," according to the Rambak <note>Rabbi Moshe Cordovero</note>, of blessed memory. The matter is connected... and by his merit, etc., for it is **Kindness**... on the altar to be the leadership in **Crown** <note>original: Keter</note> and primarily in **Wisdom** and **Understanding**... and through **Beauty** and **Kingdom** which are sanctified through the merit of the secret of **Kindness**. Afterward, all parts of existence will be mended in the pairing of **Beauty** and **Kingdom**, and the secret of its cause... the fillings... everything depends on merit.

### Chapter 5: Since the way of the Emanation of Beauty and Kingdom has been explained

Within the **Crown**, regarding the matter of the **Diminishing of the Moon**, etc. And now, since in **Kindness**, **Wisdom**, **Beauty**, and **Kingdom**, this and that are "face to face," meaning the Divine Presence <note>original: Shekhinah</note>... Kindness upon the luck of her husband... they unify the essential **Foundation** for her... the masculine and feminine powers as generalities... like one Sefirah. And the Sefirot were wiped away... and furthermore, how does the verse call them "the two great luminaries" <note>Genesis 1:16</note>? Rather, they were two Sefirot and were unified in their action as one. That is to say, when the dwelling of the "Male" is toward the wicked, it means an abundance of **Mercy**; and when the "Female" seeks judgment, it means an abundance of **Judgment**. The actions of Judgment and Mercy act as one through the Presence. If **Judgment** was being channeled, it was through **Beauty** and **Kingdom**, but all that was mentioned was from the **Kingdom**, whose action stems from Judgment. And if **Mercy** was being channeled, it was likewise channeled through both of them, but all that was mentioned was from **Beauty**, whose action is Mercy. In this way, **Beauty** stood on the right and **Kingdom** on the left. Because the **Kingdom** was beneath **Beauty**... and **Beauty** was above **Kingdom**, it would always tip the balance toward **Kindness**. Thus, she could not perform her actions—the actions of Judgment—completely. And so it arose in the mind of the "Yarei'ach" <note>The Moon / Malchut</note> to complain... that they should be equal in their actions, so that each one could perform her action in perfection: this one Judgment, and that one Mercy.

...their essences; however, all the Holy Names indicate the character of the hidden worlds. Truly, regarding the Emanator <note>The Infinite Source, or Ein Sof</note>, blessed be He, "He and His life-forces are one in them" <note>A famous phrase from the Zohar: *Ihu ve-chiyohi chad behon*</note>. ### Chapter 2: In the Zohar
In the section of *Mishpatim* <note>The Torah portion of Exodus 21:1–24:18</note>, Rabbi Abba told Rabbi Elazar what Rabbi Shimon <note>Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, the traditional author of the Zohar</note> taught him in a dream. "Come and see: I saw the four letters of the Name and their forms." This is his language: "Come and see, I saw Him in my dream, and I asked before Him: regarding the letter *Yod* <term>Yod: The smallest letter of the Hebrew alphabet, numerical value 10</term>, I have learned before the Master that it represents **Wisdom** <note>original: Chokhmah</note>, and so it is certainly. But why is the letter *He* <term>He: The fifth letter, often representing the feminine or expansive principle</term> called **Understanding** <note>original: Binah</note>?" He said to me: "Come and see, is it not written: 'And a river went out of Eden to water the garden' <note>Genesis 2:10</note>? Who is the river that goes out of Eden? This is **Understanding**. Therefore, that river is the *Yod* made manifest. From the expansion of that river in all its sides, a 'Son' was brought forth beneath it, which is the letter *Vav* <term>Vav: The sixth letter, representing the 'Son' or the central pillar of the Sephirot</term>. In this manner, the *He* afterward gave birth and brought forth this Son and placed him before her. Therefore, the sequence is *Yod-He-Vav*, for the child stands to be nursed by her. Concerning this, we learned in our Mishnah: The *He*, which is the Mother, joined with the *Yod*, the Male, and conceived a Son, being called *He*. Afterward, she brought forth and gave birth to that Son, and he stands before her. Concerning this, it is written: 'A river went out of Eden'—it comes out from there and goes to water the garden, to nurse it." Thus far his words.

Behold, Rabbi Abba had no doubt at all about the presence of the *Yod* in **Wisdom**, for due to its subtlety and hiddenness, it is attributed to a small letter—a raw form without a defined shape. **The Crown** <note>original: Keter</note>, being even more hidden, is depicted by the tiniest "tip" <note>The *kotz* or serif on top of the letter Yod</note>. It would have been appropriate for **Understanding** to be depicted by an intermediate letter... <unclear>not that it was</unclear>... the letter *Vav* in the **Beauty** <note>original: Tiferet</note>... which is joined more closely to **Understanding**. The reason for the first *He* representing **Understanding** was known to him by the necessity of the *Vav* in **Beauty**, and the final *He* in **Kingdom** <note>original: Malkhut</note> was also settled. Therefore, he only needed to ask about the *first He*.

Rabbi Shimon answered him through the verse "A river went out of Eden," regarding which there are many interpretations. First: The river is **Wisdom**, and "out of Eden" is **The Crown**. "To water the garden" is **Understanding**. With the *Yod* and *Vav*, "Eden" is in the **Crown** <note>original: Keter Elyon</note>, which is truly wondrous and concealed; therefore, it is said of it, "Eye has not seen" <note>Isaiah 64:4</note>. As it appears in the *Tikkunim*, the "closed Mem" <term>Mem: The letter M; the 'closed' final form is used to represent hidden depths</term> is the river—a description that does not sit easily with **Wisdom**, and saying "it goes out" also departs from its literal meaning, because **Wisdom** is not yet so revealed. Others explained: "A river" is **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note>, "going out of Eden" which is **Understanding**, "to water the garden" which is **Kingdom** <note>Malkhut</note>. "Eden" is also used as a distant metaphor... <note>referring to the Sephirah of Yesod/Foundation</note>. If we say the river is **Beauty** coming from the **Crown**, its exit into the revealed world only occurs through **Understanding**. Therefore, it is necessary to interpret the "river" as **Understanding** coming out of "Eden," which is **Wisdom**. This settles well, for "Eden" is sometimes a metaphor for **Wisdom** and sometimes for **Understanding**. When we interpret it as **Wisdom**, it is close to its supernal reality, and the description "river" and the verb "goes out" are explained correctly. The "garden" then settles as the general term for the "plantings" unified in **Beauty**. The Supernal Mother <note>Understanding</note> nurses the *He*, and the rest of the discourse is understood.

In the *Tikkunim* <note>Tikkunei Zohar</note>, they said: The Holy One, blessed be He, descends during the reading of the *Shema*. It is said in a vision, "And I heard the sound of their wings" <note>Ezekiel 1:24</note>. There are ten types of Psalms <note>The 10 musical terms used in the Book of Psalms</note>:
1. A **simple song**, which is the *Yod* (**Crown**).
2. A **double song**, which is *Yod-He* (**Wisdom and Understanding**).
3. A **triple song**, which is *Yod-He-Vav* (**Kindness, Strength, and Beauty**).
4. A **quadruple song**, which is *Yod-He-Vav-He* (**Endurance, Splendor, Foundation, and Kingdom**).
Therefore, it is called the "Unique Name" <note>The Tetragrammaton</note> because all Ten Sephirot are unified within it... it is a secret, for there is no Sephirah where there is not *Yod*, *Yod-He*, *Vav*, and *Vav-He*... and this requires everything to be gathered together...

<column-break/>

The intention regarding Himself... <unclear>as is known</unclear>... the intention regarding the Sephirot in general, for it includes the entire essence of the Sephirot. For it is known from the concept of the **Hyle** <term>Hyle: A term borrowed from Greek philosophy meaning 'prime matter,' used here to describe the most basic spiritual substance</term> that His name shall be... and heaven forbid that one should find it difficult that every interpretation that emerges points to the essence of the Emanator Himself. For just as the name "Isaac" will be "Isaac"... <unclear>weakness</unclear>... in which there will be the grasp of the Male principle... Heaven forbid that it should be difficult for every interpretation that emerges to say so, for His thought is not like ours. The **Hyle** through the "voids" <note>referring to the spiritual vacuums created during the process of emanation/Tzimtzum</note>, blessed be He, facing the voids, there will be a "handle"... more of His essence, blessed be He. "Behold, I have learned before the Master" that all of you... the Name will include all the voids in their generality and their detail. Therefore, in relation to His life-force... and it will not be like the names of the hidden <unclear>world</unclear> which are called by humans... the name will not point to the character and matter of the hidden world at all. For these are names given to every person... so too with all the names... all of them indicate the matter and the special property of the thing that we refer to. Therefore, they said that the name of the hidden world should not point to the essence of the Emanator, for it is impossible for it to contain His essence, His existence, and His unity...

**Chapter 2**
And regarding the fact that many different interpretations and sermons have been made regarding the Name, as mentioned above, all the Kabbalists agreed on this: that this Name includes all the Sephirot in its four letters.
The Sephirot are included in all the emanations in this way:
**Crown** <note>Keter</note>, **Strength** <note>Gevurah</note>, **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note>, **Kingdom** <note>Malkhut</note>, **Understanding** <note>Binah</note> is the *He*, **Wisdom** <note>Chokhmah</note> is the *Yod*. **Foundation** <note>Yesod</note> is the *Vav*.
The *He* and *Yod*... the *Vav* and *He*... the *Yod* and *Vav* are a hint to the **Crown**, **Foundation**, and so it is found in the "Old Man" <note>referring to the *Idra* sections of the Zohar</note>... a hint to the "Nothingness" <note>Ayin</note> and the "Source"... This hint is for all aspects of the influence that is prepared. And in **Understanding**, her visitation upon her is called "Grace" <note>original: Chen - a word made of the letters Chet and Nun</note>, which is the aspect of her unification with **Wisdom** and **Understanding**. This is the meaning of:
*   *Aleph-Yod-He*: **Crown, Wisdom**.
*   *Yod*: **Understanding**, which is in the "Kesher" <note>knot/connection</note> of writing... a hint to the Mercies.
*   The letter *Yod* itself hints at **Wisdom**.
*   The *He* hints at **Understanding**.
*   The small *He*, which is the final one, hints at **Kingdom**.

The reason for its reading and its name... all five Sephirot are as one. The reason for the four letters is that they are hinted at specifically in the four places mentioned above, and the Sephirot of the emanations in value and in general... in the four systems... as was explained in the Gate of the Order of Emanations. Every interpretation of the Name will hint at the totality of the Sephirot through their generalization and their hints... **Kingdom**... as will be explained. **Foundation** is in the *Tikkunim*...
*   **Crown**: Simple *Yod*.
*   **Wisdom and Understanding**: "Double song" *Yod-He*.
*   **The Three Patriarchs** <note>Hesed, Gevurah, Tiferet</note>: "Triple song" *Yod-He-Vav*.
*   **The Four Foundations/Lower Sephirot**: "Quadruple song" *Yod-He-Vav-He*.
And this is the secret of the three lines: **Kindness**, **Judgment**, and the **Patriarchs** <note>the Middle Pillar</note>... before they had a beginning... before they had a floor... before they had a proximity... and this is the ten types of Psalms.
Furthermore, the Rabbi <note>referring to Rabbi Moshe Cordovero himself or his teacher</note> explained that there are ten "fillings" <term>Fillings: *Milui* - the method of spelling out the names of letters to reach specific numerical values (e.g., Yod = Y-V-D)</term> of the Name... which are the letters and the Sephirot... which is *Yod-He-Vav-He*. This encompasses the 12... the totality... all from the **Wisdom**. That is to say, when the light of **Wisdom** resides in the Sephirot, one should intend the Name... it is divided into each one of them as a totality of the Sephirot, totaling the ten of his own revelation. Therefore, the Name is filled with ten letters <note>referring to the spelling of Y-H-V-H that equals 45, known as *Mah*</note> corresponding to the totality of the ten Sephirot received in each one of them. Likewise, this Name will rise to the sum of "Adam" <note>Man - value 45</note> as was explained... at the end... **Kindness**... when the Name is in the totality of the twelve... from the light of **Understanding**... and it will be clarified in four letters alone. That is to say, when the light of the "One" is revealed in these Sephirot from the light of **Understanding**, the totality of the Sephirot will not be revealed in each one specifically... as if the light of the Sephirot were not in the general totality...

->And regarding this, the Scripture says: "Bring an atonement for Me" <note>original: "Alei Kaparah." This refers to a famous Midrash in the Babylonian Talmud, Chullin 60b, where God asks for an atonement because He diminished the moon's light</note>. # Gate Nineteen: The Four-Letter Name

---

### Chapter 1: Explaining the Four-Letter Name according to the Zohar, Sitrei Torah, Section 10: That this is the Unique, Essential Name, Honored and Pure.
<gloss>Note: This is the unique and honored Essential Name that purifies.</gloss>

The Holy Names—all other Holy Names are considered "titles" or "appellatives" <note>original: Kinnuyim</note> and descriptors of Divine actions. Sometimes they are even used in a secular sense. For example, *El* <term>El: A name for God often associated with power or Loving-kindness</term> can be used for greatness, as in "the mighty mountains" <note>original: k’hararei El (Psalm 36:7)</note>. Similarly, *Elohim* <term>Elohim: A name for God associated with Judgment/Justice</term> can be used for judges or even false gods. Between *Shaddai* <term>Shaddai: Almighty</term> and *Elohim*, one must distinguish... just as one distinguishes between *Elohai* <note>My God</note> and secular powers. Regarding the term *Ehyeh* <term>Ehyeh: "I Will Be" (Exodus 3:14)</term>, it is often associated with the Crown <note>Keter</note> or Mercy. This name is sealed because it supports the letters of the unique Name. Where there is a small manifestation, the name *Y-H-W* is used...

Furthermore, all the Holy Names were hidden... like the Priestly Blessing. The reason the Unique Name is not written like other Holy Names is that the other names represent the governance of the world, like a handle to a vessel. But the four-letter Name represents the pure, abstract Essence and its action. Therefore, when the intellect perceives it as it does other names, it is written as it is. However, other names are permitted to be mentioned more freely, even though mentioning them spreads spirituality upward and changes the atmosphere. Even though the "Palace" is established by its letters, the Name resides within it. But the four-letter Name, due to its immense holiness, is not known in the "air" of the world. This is because its intention is hidden and honored. It is a secret to be mentioned... and your blessing will be within the atmosphere of the *Shekhinah* <term>Shekhinah: The Divine Presence, the feminine aspect of God</term>, and it will be clothed there in holiness. This is the meaning of "And the Lord is in His Holy Temple" <note>Habakkuk 2:20</note>. The word "Palace/Temple" <note>original: Heikhal</note> has the numerical value (65) of the name *Adonai* <term>Adonai: My Lord</term>, which is the *Shekhinah*. The Name clothes itself in the atmosphere that introduces all things to be sanctified... and it is forbidden to mention it casually, for it is awesome and transcends the secular and the holy. This is the secret of the Foundation... for it has four letters to subdue the "husks" <note>original: Klipot; the forces of evil/impurity</note> and to fulfill "and His kingdom rules over all." They call it the "Unique Name" <note>Shem HaMeforash</note>, a name of "foundation" from the language of "measure" and "distinction." Other names are based on them and prove them... and it is possible that the Name is expressed through its vitality, flaring up on the Day of Atonement. Furthermore, one must know that when they said the Holy Name (Blessed be He) is called the "Essential Name," they meant...

<meta>The text continues on the nature of the Name's essence.</meta>

<column-break/>

### Chapter 1 (continued): All those who seek the secrets have agreed that the Unique Four-Letter Name is the Essential Name, very awesome—who can contain it?

This is Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note>. The first reason is what we explained in truth and uprightness in the Fourth Gate, chapters 2 and 3: that the other Names, which may not be erased, still have a translation and an intellectual meaning, and the Scripture uses them in secular contexts. For example, *Ehyeh* <note>I Will Be</note> can be used as a verb. The name *El* and its derivatives signify greatness, as in "the mighty of the land" <note>Eilei Ha’aretz</note>. *Elohim* is used for Pharaoh <note>Exodus 7:1</note> or "they sacrifice to demons, not to *Eloah*" <note>Deuteronomy 32:17</note>. *Shaddai* comes from the language of "destroyer" <note>Shoded</note>, but it also appears in secular contexts meaning "sufficiency" or "sustenance," like the "breasts" <note>Shadayim</note> that provide nourishment to a child when it leaves its mother's womb. We also explained the Holy Name *Tzevaot* <term>Tzevaot: Hosts/Armies</term> in the first gate as referring to "will" and "legions," as in "all the hosts of the Lord went out." *Adonai* <note>Lord</note> is translated by Onkelos as "Master" <note>Rabboni</note>. 

However, this Honored and Awesome Name <note>The Tetragrammaton</note> has no secular translation or mundane meaning at all. Even *Yah* <note>Y-H</note>, which is half of the Unique Name, is never found in a secular context. Furthermore, all other names are pronounced exactly as they are written in every place and time, whether in the Torah or in prayer. Their spirituality spreads from above and clothes itself in the light of this world... for they lead the world. But the four-letter Name alone, when complete, is so holy that its spirituality does not spread or reveal itself except in the Holy Temple <note>Beit HaMikdash</note> for a great necessity, such as the Priestly Blessing. Once every seven years, the Sages would transmit it to their students in the Houses of Study, where the holiness is severe and the glory of the *Shekhinah* dwells. 

This is the reason for the prohibition of engaging in Torah or prayer, even through thought, in an unclean place—so as not to join the "Holy of Holies" with the "profane of the profane." To separate from the forbidden is a great thing, to subdue them in their place. The "Explicit Name" <note>Shem HaMeforash</note> is so called either from the language of "separation" <note>Hafrashah</note>, because it is separated from our intellectual grasp, or because we are separated from pronouncing it. Or it comes from the language of "clarity" <note>Peirush</note>, because its holiness is clear and distinct. We are commanded to hide it, as it is written: "This is my name forever" <note>Exodus 3:15</note>, where the word "forever" <note>L’olam</note> is written without the letter *Vav*, allowing it to be read as "to hide" <note>L’alem</note>. Furthermore, it was "clarified" by the holy priests... we have revealed this to emphasize the distance of the Names from the Emanator (Blessed be He). For the Holy Names are not merely agreed-upon signs like the names of people, which mostly do not indicate the essence of the persons...

### Chapter 5: The Writing
The Author of the *Orah* <note>referring to *Sefer Ha-Orah* or Joseph Gikatilla’s *Sha’arei Orah*</note> writes that the Unique Name <term>Unique Name: The Tetragrammaton, Y-H-V-H</term>, blessed be He, has a "Square Permutation" totaling 206 letters <note>original: "R-V" (ר"ו). Historically, this often refers to the 216 letters of the 72-fold name, but the text specifies 206 here</note>. These are like a soul to the 206 letters of the verses *And he moved*, *And he came*, and *And he stretched out* <note>Exodus 14:19-21. Each verse contains 72 letters, totaling 216. The transcription's "206" may be a variant or a scribal error</note>. Within these 454 permutations <note>original: "T-N-D" (תנ"ד)</note>, all things in the world are included, and they provide for the needs of all creatures through the Name *Adonai* <term>Adonai: The name of God associated with the physical world and sovereignty</term>. This is their order:

| | | | | | | | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Y-H-W-D | Y-W-D-D | Y-D-D-W | Y-W-D-W | Y-Y-D-W | Y-Y-D | W-Y-W-D | W-D-W-Y | W-Y-W-R |
| D-Y-W-D | D-Y-D-W | D-D-W-Y | Y-W-D-Y | Y-D-Y | Y-D-Y-W | W-D-Y-W | W-D-W | W-D-W-Y |
| W-Y-D-R | W-D-Y-D | W-D-D-Y | D-Y-Y-W | D-W-Y | D-Y-W-Y | Z-Y-W-D | Y-W-D-W | Y-D-Y-W |
| D-D-Y-W | D-W-Y-D | D-W-D-Y | W-Y-Y-D | W-Y-D-Y | W-D-Y-W | D-Y-W-N | D-W-W-Y | D-Y-Y-D |

<column-break/>

The intention here is to teach us the intensity of its attachment to its source. One should not wonder at this, even though the "garment" <note>the external form or vocalization</note> is different in its vowel-pointing from the essence. Furthermore, the intention of drawing down spirituality through the writing of the letters or through speech is what causes the effect. Therefore, one should focus on the *Cholam* vowel <note>the 'o' sound</note> for the inner dimension of the Attribute, and on the explicit vowel-pointing for the garment. 

This is the excellence of the "Act of the Daughter" <note>likely referring to a specific tradition of scribal precision</note> which we learned regarding the Name: to write it in one go with four pens held within five fingers. A Torah scroll in which the Divine Names <note>original: "Azkarot"</note> were not written with specific holy intent is worth nothing. One who is writing the Name—even if a king greets him—he shall not respond, so as not to interrupt the holy channels <note>original: "Tzinorot"</note>, Heaven forbid. 

If one intended to write the name *Judah* <note>original: "Yehudah," which is spelled Y-H-W-D-H, nearly identical to the Tetragrammaton Y-H-V-H but with an added 'Dalet'</note> even in a place where the Divine Name is required, and he only wrote the first four letters <note>Y-H-W-D</note>, he may suspend the 'D' <note>Dalet</note> between them. He is permitted to erase it, provided that the 'D' remains established and well-marked while he erases the other letters. 

According to what has been explained—that the Four-Letter Name is the source of all and all other names are its garments—the Author of the *Orah* asked: "Is not the name *Ehyeh* <term>Ehyeh: 'I Will Be,' the name associated with Keter/The Crown</term> the essence and the source?" He answered that the Four-Letter Name is like the trunk of the tree on which all branches take hold and in which they find glory. The name *Ehyeh* is the essence of the tree and its root. It is the way of branches to spread from the trunk, while the root is most hidden. He reasoned well, but we must still ask: Why is the Four-Letter Name with its explicit vowel-pointing (which in the Tiferet is a palace for the inner Y-H-V-H) not pronounced, while the palace of the *Keter* <term>Keter: The highest Sephirah, 'The Crown'</term>—which is undoubtedly higher and more excellent—is pronounced by its letters? Heaven protect us from the opinion of those who think the Supernal Crown is merely a branch of Tiferet!

**However**, with the foundation of this inquiry—that within the World of Emanation there is also a very subtle inner "Being" <note>Hovayah</note>—every doubt is settled. Because of the great hiddenness of the Crown, the Name that is revealed from it does not limit or define its spirituality through its pronunciation as the Four-Letter Name and other names do. Rather, it indicates hiddenness along with expansion, having no graspable form at all. The meaning of the name *Ehyeh* is "I stand ready to be and to be revealed below" through Wisdom and Understanding, the twins at its end. The Geonim <note>early medieval rabbinic leaders</note> interpreted "Keter" from the phrase "Wait for me a little" <note>Job 36:2; "Katar" can mean 'to wait' or 'to crown'</note>. The intention is: "Wait and do not delve too deep into it, for it is a wonder." 

Thus, its pronunciation serves as a sign of its excellence—that its branches are not fully revealed through it. But with the Four-Letter Name, its spirituality expands through its pronunciation. Therefore, we...

### Chapter 4: And After
The symbol is *Kuvutz* <note>a vowel</note>, and part of the "filling" is the secret of the letter *Yod* at the beginning, indicating that which rises and delights. For such is the way of the Kingdom <term>Malkhut</term>, which hides and conceals its voices. Its secret was explained through a permutation that reveals more than the *Yod*. The 72-letter name <note>original: "Ayin-Bet"</note> of the Tetragrammaton is filled with the letter *Yod* in the Crown, and with the letter *Aleph* in Wisdom, for one is more revealed than the other. 

It is truly established in the "Rectifications" <term>Tikkunim: Likely the Tikunei Zohar</term> that there is no Sephirah that does not have a "Rectification" of Y-H-W. The *Yod*, *He*, and *Waw* are the sign of the "Measure of the Line." This means that in its foundation, it lacks ten lines; the ten Sephirot shall be aligned as one, having no vowel-pointing of their own. This is the secret of "reaping what he reaps" <note>a metaphorical phrase for drawing divine energy</note>. The letter *Yod* includes everything within its letters. 

To understand the matter, one must know that the Name of Being <term>Havayah: Y-H-V-H</term> sustains all worlds. The ten Sephirot are included in the Four-Letter Name, which is why it is called the "Name of the Essence." As explained elsewhere, the foundation is that specific vowels are assigned to specific Sephirot. This is because every Sephirah is composed of ten, and the Name includes four. These four letters act as the generalities of the specific Sephirot, each standing for itself, and "the spirit shall not play or live" <note>likely an idiom for staying within boundaries</note>. 

I will explain: when they are numbered, and when the letters are viewed according to their function, the Kingdom <term>Malkhut</term>—since its function is based on what it receives from the higher spirits—includes its ten Sephirot without being vowel-pointed. Therefore, each and every Sephirah will have a vowel indicating the change of its Sephirot's function from its companion. 

In the Kingdom, it remains unpointed until it is included in the power of the higher aspects. Then it takes their vowel and clothes itself in their word to perform its actions. 
- In **Crown** <term>Keter</term>, everything is *Kamatz*, from the language of "closing" <note>kometz</note>, for it is sealed and has no revelation at all. 
- In **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>, everything is *Patach*, from the language of "opening" <note>petach</note>, for Wisdom opens and reveals, being the beginning of revelation. 
- In **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, everything is *Tzeire*, for understanding distinguishes and splits... <note>the text continues with the correspondence of vowels to the remaining Sephirot</note>... 
- In **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>, it is *Segol*, indicating a "treasure" <note>segulah</term>... 
- In **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>, it is *Shva*... 
- In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, it is the point <note>Cholam</note> that rises above the head of the letter... 
- In **Endurance** <term>Netzach</term>, it is *Chirik*... 
- In **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, it is *Shuruk*... 

Thus, the spirituality of the Sephirot is the soul, and the letters are the body.

### Chapter 3: Continued
It was explained in the *Tikkunim* <note>Referring to the *Tikkunei Zohar*, a core Kabbalistic text</note> that there are ten instances of the Divine Name <term>Divine Name: The Tetragrammaton, Y-H-V-H</term> with varying vowel points corresponding to the ten *Sefirot* <term>Sefirot: The ten divine attributes or emanations in Kabbalah</term>. For behold, the Divine Name of *Keter* <note>Crown, the highest emanation</note> has all four of its letters vocalized with the *Kamatz* vowel; that of *Chokhmah* <note>Wisdom</note> with the *Patach*; that of *Binah* <note>Understanding</note> with the *Tzere*; that of *Chesed* <note>Kindness</note> with the *Segol*; that of *Gevurah* <note>Might/Judgment</note> with the *Shva*; that of *Tiferet* <note>Beauty/Harmony</note> with the *Cholam*; that of *Netzach* <note>Victory/Endurance</note> with the *Chirik*; that of *Yesod* <note>Foundation</note> with the *Shuruk*. The Divine Name of *Malchut* <note>Kingship/Sovereignty</note> is without any vowel points at all, for she is the totality of them all; "the love of your bridal youth" <note>quoting Jeremiah 2:2</note>, as may be seen in the Book. **And behold**, it is known that any name that includes more than its fellow is holier than it. Therefore, the Divine Name that includes everything is also not revealed through any specific vowel point. However, in terms of its "filling" <term>Filling: A Kabbalistic method (Milui) where each letter of a name is spelled out as a word</term>, it requires the vowels *Cholam*, *Segol*, and *Kamatz* to make the pronunciation of the letters pleasant, one by one, to be expressed by the lips. This does not mean it is permitted to mention the four of them as understood one after the other, for this too is included in the prohibition of "pronouncing the Name by its letters." These are the nine vowels: *Cholam* and *Segol*; four *Yods* <note>The letter Yod (י)</note> from the mouth in the secret of *Chesed*—*Keter*, *Chokhmah*, and *Gevurah*; and two *Shvas*, which is *Tiferet*, the "firmament that divides between the waters" <note>quoting Genesis 1:6</note>; and the *Yod* beneath the *Kamatz* and the second *Segol*. There are four *Yods* from the mouth in the secret of Judgment: *Gevurah*, *Netzach*, *Hod*, and *Yesod*. The letters themselves are hinted at in *Malchut*, which takes form through all the vowel points as we mentioned. The vocalization of the chest adds to the hiddenness, for the letters hint at the intended meaning through their shapes, unlike the vowel point, which exists entirely as a single, very thin and hidden *Yod*. However, the ten Divine Names we mentioned are vocalized according to the secret of the flow of their actions. Nevertheless, those vowel points have no governance over the pronunciation; rather, the vocalization rests upon all the letters to indicate the power of their unity and the distance of any change from them.

### The Geonim
The *Geonim* <note>The leaders of the Babylonian academies, roughly 6th-11th centuries CE</note> instructed that the writing of the letter *Tzadi*—which is shaped like three points—should have a numerical value of thirty-four, corresponding to the forty and twenty spiritual internal forms, and to the number of the twenty-four books of Prophecy <note>The Hebrew Bible</note>: twelve givers and twelve receivers. These are in the secret of "the tribes of Yah, a testimony to Israel" <note>quoting Psalm 122:4</note>. Each and every vowel point has three heads, and three holy letters rise with their crowns to the number of the Hidden Name, which is forty-five <note>The "Name of Mah" (45), associated with the human archetype</note>. With the crowns of the final letter, they all rise to the number of the Honored Name called Seventy-Two <note>The "Name of Av" (72), associated with the highest level of emanation</note>. This concludes their words. **There is** a basis for this in the *Tikkunim* regarding the twenty-four points, for they said that three Divine Names total seventy-two. Similarly, they depicted "Y-H-V-H" "Y-H-V-H" "Y-H-V-H" in circles totaling the value of forty-five. They also said that everything was created and established through the Name of Y-H-V-H, which is "the heavens" <note>The Hebrew word for "the heavens," ha-shamayim, is treated as an acronym</note>. This is the meaning of "Yah" in the heavens, as it is written: "Let the heavens be glad" <note>original: "Yismachu Ha-Shamayim"</note> and "Yah" "on the earth," "and the earth shall rejoice" <note>original: "V'tagel Ha-Aretz"</note>. It is known that "Et" <note>The Hebrew untranslatable direct object marker</note> is a title for *Malchut*, and "Heavens" refers to *Tiferet*. "Yah," which are *Chokhmah* and *Binah*, provide flow to the Heavens, and *Tiferet* provides its own flow and the flow appropriate for her to *Malchut*, and the hint is "Y-H."

has been explained in the first Gate, Chapter 10, we know that the Divine Name which is entirely *Cholam* hints at the divisions of *Tiferet* as it clothes itself in another Divine Name with an explicit vowel point. The understanding

Through these generalities, all the emanations are revealed in four [aspects of] mercy alone. Therefore, they should be as hints in the Name of four-letter Names only. The filling of their letters is discussed further in the *Tikkunim* regarding the Name of thirty Divine Names, corresponding to thirty emanations, such as: *Yod-Vav-Dalet*, *Heh-Yod*, *Vav-Yod-Vav*, *Heh-Yod*. <meta>This page continues the exploration of the permutations of the four-letter Divine Name (the Tetragrammaton). Having discussed the vowel points in the previous chapter, the author now examines how specific arrangements of the letters—such as *V-H-Y-H* (Ve-hayah) or *H-V-Y-H* (Havayah)—correspond to different spiritual dynamics, the actions of the Patriarchs, and the mechanics of divine mercy versus judgment.</meta>

That she <note>referring to a specific emanation or letter</note> joins with the letter *Heh* and becomes pregnant with a "son" <note>the letter *Vav*, representing the emanation *Tiferet*</note>, bringing him forth below, while his spouse <note>the final *Heh*, or *Malchut*</note> stood behind. **"And it was"** <note>Hebrew: *Ve-hayah*, spelled *Vav-Heh-Yod-Heh*</note> corresponds to the right side, *Chokhmah* <term>Chokhmah: Wisdom, the second emanation</term>, as in the verse "the Written Torah [came] from His right hand, a fiery law for them" <note>Deuteronomy 33:2</note>. This is what we mean when we say "the Son is drawn from the Brain of the Father." The first *Heh* <note>the "Higher Mother" or *Binah*</note> is to the left, and from there the Oral Torah was given—meaning, it is external to it. 

Furthermore, this arrangement hints at the secret of "and the two of them went on" <note>Ruth 1:19</note>. Regarding *Tiferet* <term>Tiferet: Beauty or Harmony, the central emanation</term> when it ascends to *Chokhmah*, it is said, "Why, O Lord, do you stand far off?" <note>Psalms 10:1</note>. To Him we pray, "may our prayer come before You," for prayer is His spouse <note>the Shekhinah</note>, and her request should not be hidden. 

There is also in this the secret of "And the man [Adam] knew" <note>Genesis 4:1</note>. The *Yod* knew the *Vav*, [acting upon] the "small" *Heh* <note>the lower emanation, Malchut</note>, while this [other] *Heh* is the "higher" *Heh* <note>Binah</note>, following the secret of completing the balance of the roots previously mentioned. **"And it was"** (*Ve-hayah*): the Father descends toward the Son in the secret of "when brothers dwell together" <note>Psalms 133:1</note>. The Higher *Heh* rules over the *Yod*, and through this, there is a union of *Tiferet* and *Malchut* (represented by the letters *Vav* and *Heh*). When this follows the order of *Chesed* <term>Chesed: Loving-kindness</term>, the "King God" is present; however, he is then influenced by *Din* <term>Din: Judgment</term> through the secret of the letters *Heh-Yod* from the name *Elohim*.

In the *Tikkunim* <note>the *Tikkunei Zohar*</note>, it is explained that this specific configuration of the Name (*H-V-Y-H*) fixes the "damage" mentioned previously. It says that for this reason, Man [Adam] came through the three Patriarchs, who are the branches of the Tree, its body, and its fruit. He repaired what had been uprooted. He descended into Abraham and planted within him the *Heh*, which represents the branches of the Tree. He descended into Isaac and produced "fruit," which comes from Isaac <note>representing *Gevurah* or Strength</note>. He then descended into Jacob and planted within him the *Vav*, of whom it is said, "and the God of Jacob for a choice." 

Then came Moses, who is the *Vav* (numerically equivalent to the word "flesh" [*basar*], which is also the totality). He brought down the Five Books of the Torah, which are the root of the Tree, and he completed the Tree with the name *Y-H-V-H*. Because of this, the Name was completed through him as "And it was" (*Ve-hayah*), as it is said, "And they shall say to me: What is His name? What shall I say to them?" <note>Exodus 3:13</note>. For they might say, "The Lord [Y-H-V-H] did not appear to you," since He was not revealed to the Patriarchs in this way. Because the Name was not yet "complete" during the time of the Patriarchs, it was not revealed to them, as it is written: "but by my name Y-H-V-H I was not known to them" <note>Exodus 6:3</note>.

**"Present"** <note>Hebrew: *Hoveh*, spelled *Heh-Vav-Heh*</note> refers to the "four watches of the night." From the side of the Left, the *Heh* represents the *Tefillin* <term>Tefillin: Phylacteries, ritual leather boxes containing Torah verses</term> upon the *Vav*—the Mother over the Son. For within her, *Tiferet* is established: "He established the heavens with understanding" <note>Proverbs 3:19</note>. *The Father [Chokhmah] is the Tefillin upon the Son*, for through him [the Son] is built, as it is written: "The Lord by wisdom [Chokhmah] founded the earth" <note>Proverbs 3:19</note>. This is the opposite of the Name *Y-H-V-H*, which is for the "salvation of His anointed." With the "voice of my beloved knocking," they ascend and descend. This is the configuration *D-H* <note>perhaps *Dalet-Heh*</note> or *H-V-Y-H*. 

The Father descends into the *Tzaddik* <term>Tzaddik: The Righteous One, associated with the emanation Yesod</term> to guard the *Shekhinah* <term>Shekhinah: The Divine Presence in the world</term> in exile, as explained in the "Faithful Shepherd" <note>a section of the Zohar</note>. It is also possible to explain that *Tiferet* departs toward the Mother, and the "Head of the Righteous" (*Yesod*) departs with him, drawing away the blessings. This follows the secret of the letter *Yod* being influenced by *Chokhmah*, leaving the final *Heh* dry and lacking everything. This is the secret of "Hew down the tree, and cut off its branches... nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth" <note>Daniel 4:14, 23</note>. The "stump" is the Lower *Heh*. The letters *H-V-Y* depart, and only the *Heh* remains. Therefore, "the night has three watches," and in every watch, the *Heh* of the night ascends and roars. Where there is *H-V-Y*, there is surely "Being" (*Hoveh*).

There is also in this the secret of the Repair <note>Tikkun</note> hoped for speedily in our days, when the name *Y-H-V-H* is transformed from the "diminishment of the moon" into a "name and praise" in its fullness. This is the crown of the Torah scroll. We then call upon it: "Praise the Lord" (*Hallelu-Yah*), for the letters *Yod-Heh* hint at Abraham and Isaac, the "rocks" of Israel, while for the rest of their [other] children, they bring "death." Regarding Jacob, who is Israel and surely the *Vav* in the Name, it is said: "and you shall tread upon their high places" <note>Deuteronomy 33:29</note>. 

The letters ***Y-H-V***: The Father descends toward the Son, and the Daughter ascends to the first [position], with Understanding (*Binah*) behind and Sovereignty (*Malchut*) behind. *Tiferet* is then in the state of Judgment (*Din*), with no union, except that the letters *Heh-Yod* still influence the *Heh*. This is not a total reversal like the word **"Present"** (*Hoveh*), but rather a specific type of union. 

There is also the order of the four letters of the Name *K-V-Z-U* <note>a common protective cipher for the Tetragrammaton, often found on the back of a Mezuzah</note>, which is an acronym for "Blessing" (*Berakhah*). From the side of the power of Judgment, it serves as a "garment" for the Name *E-H-Y-H* <note>"I Will Be"</note>. This is explained in the section on the Palaces (*Heichalot*) in the portion of *Pekudei*, following the order of "King, Helper, Savior, and Shield." One can also interpret the order of the letters [to mean] only with the *Yod* can one grow and establish a decree for all.

## Chapter 7: "And It Was" (*Ve-hayah*)

This is the secret of those who transform the Attribute of Judgment into the Attribute of Mercy. For even though *Y-H-V* precedes the *H*, this configuration is within the secret of Union, and it is straightforward. 

Furthermore, as previously mentioned, the *Y* represents *Y-H-H* on the right and *H-Y* on the left. Behold, *Tiferet*, which includes them both, is *H-V-Y-H*. When the right side of *Tiferet* is joined to *Chesed* (Kindness), it forms *V-H-V-H*. When the left side of *Tiferet* is joined to *Gevurah* (Might), it forms the *V-H-Y-H* that we will discuss. 

There is also in this *H-V-Y-H* the secret of the "fire of his mother and father" when *Malchut* ascends toward *Keter* <note>the highest emanation</note> in the secret of "fear of sin." It also contains the secret of Charity (*Tzedakah*) and the "evil" of a "simple nun" <note>referring to a Hebrew letter shape</note> to be given. He <note>the giver</note> is the *Vav* of the Name, surely with five fingers <note>the *Heh*</note>, and the coin is the *Yod*, and the hand of the poor person is the other *Heh*. Thus, "the work of charity shall be peace" <note>Isaiah 32:17</note>. This implies that the poor person unifies the name *Y-H-V-H* with the householder. Whereas the householder [on his own] does not unify with the poor person except in the secret of the *Heh-Yod* over the *Yod*, and the poor person [puts] the *Yod* over the *Heh*. This is the meaning of [the phrase] "that you have done with him" found in the Midrash of the Sages.

*V-H-H* is the secret of "and the two of them went on." The Father and the Son depart. Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai explained in the *Tikkunim* that man desires a "house" from *Y-H-V-H*; the *Yod* departs and it becomes *V-I* <note>perhaps *Vav-Yod*</note>. Furthermore, sometimes during the Exile of both of them, the Father descends into the *Tzaddik* to guard the *Shekhinah*. It is possible to interpret this *H-V-Y-H* as the "embrace" that precedes union, in the secret of *Tiferet*, "Greatness," and the "Crown of Salvation" from the Sabbath afternoon prayer. 

[Regarding the configuration *H-V-H*]: We explained it in the seventh *Havayah*. It indicates that the right-side *Heh* prevails and influences the left-side *Heh-Yod*, but *Chesed* does not prevail so much as to bend the Left and transform it into the secret of *Y-H-V-H* that we explained. 

The final *H-V-Y*, from which the *H-V-Y* has departed: We explained it in the fifth *Havayah*. It can also be explained according to what was stated in the eighth *Havayah*, except that in this one, there is not even a small amount of influence or mercy during the Exile. In that state, there would be "two males over two females," yet without union. 

It is also possible to explain the secret of "there is no evil below a plague" (*nega*). For behold, the River of *Binah* is the first *Heh*, and the Garden (which is the totality of the plantings and the beloved ones) are "back to back" and not "face to face." Behold, the "miracle" (*nes*) separates the River and the Eye (*ayin*), which is the opposite of the third *Havayah*. 

The configuration *H-H-Y-V* is generally similar to the previous one according to our first explanation, except that the *Vav-Aleph* is not entirely hidden above the *Yod* in the secret of *V-Y*, but rather remains *V-V*. 

*H-V-H-Y* is the secret of "On three things the world stands" <note>Pirkei Avot 1:2</note>. It is the final *Heh* upon the *Yod*, which is like an "exedra" <note>a porch open on one side</note> in the secret of three reeds: Torah (*Chokhmah/Tiferet*), Service (*Gevurah/Avodah*—since their actions are in the North), and Acts of Kindness (*Chesed/Gedulah*). In this *Havayah*, there is also the existence of Judgment and "Reflected Light" entirely. Regarding it, the secret of "In all the streets they shall say *H-V-H*" <note>Amos 5:16</note> and the secret of "Reeds and Pride" apply. When the wheel turns back to the secret of *Y-H-V-H*, it is said: "The stone the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone" <note>Psalms 118:22</note>. 

However, the acronyms of these configurations hint at *Chokhmah*, *Chesed*, and *Netzach* with three *Yods*; at *Binah*, *Gevurah*, and *Hod* with three *Hehs*; and at *Keter*, *Tiferet*, and *Yesod* with three *Vavs*, etc.

# Gate 2: The Names

*And all of them [the names] are recipients and elevators of the spirituality of the Sefirot* <term>Sefirot: The ten divine emanations or channels through which the Infinite interacts with the world</term> *just as it was previously [explained] regarding the Shekhinah* <term>Shekhinah: The Divine Presence, often associated with the final Sephira, Malchut</term> *and as mentioned regarding the movement from the Shekhinah to the Sefirot, specifically to that Name and its associated permutations mentioned above; that is to say, the forms that sustain the spiritual artistry of that Name which arouses the spiritual essence of the matter, provided there is no hindrance there, as will be explained with God’s help in the Gate of Intentions.*

**There is** another way regarding the permutations of "Existence" <note>Hebrew: *Havayah*, a rearrangement of the Tetragrammaton Y-H-V-H</note>. In the *Tikkunim* <note>referring to the *Tikkuney Zohar*, a classic Kabbalistic text</note> they said: whoever learns these "Existences" [permutations] must learn how to build with them a "Building" for the Holy One, Blessed be He. Of this it is said, "the altar of the Lord that was broken down" <note>1 Kings 18:30</note>, and the secret of the matter is that [sins] can "break down" the letters of the Name. As it is written, "lest they break through to the Lord" <note>Exodus 19:21</note>. Because they [the letters] were broken down by their sins, one must rebuild them through their prayers. 

The letter *Yod* is the foundation stone of the building. *Y-Y* <note>two Yods</note> comes from *Yod* and *Yod*, and with them, the "Whole Stone" <note>referring to a perfect building block</note> shall be built, which is *A-H-A* <note>the first letters of the name Ehyeh</note>. The *Vav* is the beam and the pillar to support the House. Because of this, the interpretation of the three letters is: *Bet* is the "Building" <note>Hebrew: Binyan</note>, *Yod* is the "Foundation" <note>Hebrew: Yesod</note> of the building, and *Tav* <note>it seems to mean "Tikrah," the ceiling</note>. And these are within *Malchut* [Kingdom] etc. 

The source of these permutations is the numerical value of *Chesed* <term>Chesed: Kindness, the fourth Sephira, with a numerical value of 72</term>. With them one must build the Building, for they derive from the *Chesed* of the "Source of Existences." These are [the Name expanded with Yods]: *Yod-Vav-Dalet*, *Heh-Yod*, *Vav-Vav*, *Heh-Yod* <note>the expansion of Y-H-V-H totaling 72</note>, which rise to the value of 72 (*Ayin-Bet*). These permutations are all considered "Stone," "Beam," and "Building" which are built by both of them. These are the 72 "Existences" that emerge from the name expanded by *Yod*. **It is written** regarding these "Existences," however, that in most transcriptions they are corrupted [contain errors], but the Sage <note>referring to a specific teacher or the author himself in the third person</note> arranged them thus:

| YDV YVD DVY DYV VYD VDY |
|--------------------------|
| YVD DVD DYY DDYYD DYD DDY |
| VDD DVD DDY VDR DVD DDVY |

| YVV VYV VYV | YNV VYV VYV | VYV VYV VYV |
|-------------|--------------|-------------|
| VYV YVYV VYV | VYV VY YV VY | YYY VYV VYYYYR |
| VYV VVDV VVD | DVN VDV VVD | VYY VDY VVD VVD |

**And one** should not wonder at the doubling of these permutations, for the letters are not equal in their secret meaning and their hints. Behold, the source of everything is the name expanded by *Yod* <note>spelled YVD-HY-VV-HY</note>, which in Gematria <term>Gematria: A system where Hebrew letters have numerical values</term> equals 72. In it, there are four *Yods*, three *Vavs*, and two *Hehs*. From these, *Y-H-V* and *Y-H-V* are joined. 

Behold, the first *Y-H-V* joins into six "houses" [permutations] as is known. Likewise, the second *Y-V-Y* joins into three houses, totaling 15. Furthermore, we join the four *Yods* in this name, each to the two *Hehs*, making four permutations, each being *Y-H-H*. These four combine into three houses, which are 12—bringing the total to 27. 

Furthermore, we join each of the three *Vavs* to the two *Hehs*, making three permutations, each being *V-H-H*. These three combine into three houses, which are 9—bringing the total to 36. 

Furthermore, we join the four *Yods* to the two *Vavs*, making four permutations of *Y-V-V*. These four build three houses, which are 12—bringing the total to 48. 

Furthermore, we join the three *Vavs* to the two *Yods*. These three make three houses, which are 9—bringing the total to 57. 

Furthermore, we join each of the two *Hehs* to the two *Yods*. These two build three houses, which are 6—bringing the total to 63. 

Furthermore, we join each of the two *Hehs* to the two *Vavs*. These two build three houses, which are 6—bringing the total to 69. 

Furthermore, we join the total letters of the "Rectification" <note>Hebrew: *Tikkun*</note>, which are four *Yods*, three *Vavs*, and two *Hehs*, into three houses, which are *Y-Y*, *V-V-V*, and *H-H*—bringing the final total to 72.

## Chapter 6: Already

We have already mentioned that the four-letter Name [the Tetragrammaton] joins its letters into 12 permutations and no more, even though four [unique] letters would build twenty-four houses. However, the doubling of the letter *Heh* reduces the count by half. 

This is their order with an explanation of some of their hints from the *Tikkunim*: **Y-H-V** indicates absolute Unity and the direct flow of influence from Father to Mother, and from both of them to the Son and Daughter—a "Sacrifice to the Lord," as we have already mentioned regarding this. 

**Y-H-H-V**: Its secret is "the Father (*Abba*) chastises the Daughter (*Barta*)." This refers to the "Small *Heh*" <note>Malchut</note> which is close to Him in this existence. She is the "second" one, as in "established the heavens with understanding" <note>Proverbs 3:19</note>. This is in the order of Emanation (*Atzilut*). It is also the secret of "I will not enter the city" <note>Hosea 11:9</note> which was explained in the Eighth Gate, Chapter Ten. It is also possible to explain in the order of this existence that the Higher *Heh* <note>Binah</note> precedes the Lower *Heh* <note>Malchut</note> in the secret of "the Hand" <note>Hebrew: Y-D, numerical value 14</note>...
