# The Pomegranate Slice: Gate 19 — The Four-Letter Name

Which is joined with the letter *He* <term>He: The second and fourth letters of the Name Y-H-V-H, often representing the feminine aspects of the Divine</term> and became pregnant with a son, bringing him forth below, while his spouse stood behind him. Regarding the permutation **V-H-V-E** <note>original: והוה</note> and **Y-A-Y-H-Y** <note>original: יאיהי</note>: to the right is Wisdom <term>Chokhmah: The Sephira of pure intuition and the "Father" principle</term> and the "Written Torah," as it says, "From His right hand a fiery law for them." The letter *Aleph* is what we call "the Son" who is drawn from the brain of the Father. The "Higher *He*" <term>Binah: The Sephira of Understanding and the "Mother" principle</term> is to the left, and from there the Oral Torah was given—the explanation being that it is "outside" of Him. Furthermore, this hints at the secret of the verse "And they both went" <note>referring to Ruth and Naomi, symbolizing two divine levels moving together</note>. Regarding the Sephira of Harmony <term>Tiferet: The central Sephira, often called the "Son" or the Holy One, Blessed be He</term> which ascended to Wisdom, it is said: "Why, O Lord, do You stand afar?" To Him we pray, "May our prayer come before You"—she being His spouse <term>Malchut: The final Sephira, the Shekhinah or Divine Presence</term>—requesting that He not hide Himself. There is also in this the secret of "And the man (Adam) knew Eve": the *Yod* knew the *Vav* and the "Small *He*," and this is the "Higher *He*" in the secret of completing the balance of the roots previously mentioned in the light. 

**H-V-H-E** <note>The letters of "Havayah" rearranged</note>: The Father descends toward the Son in the secret of "When brothers dwell together." The Higher *He* rules over the *Yod*, and with this comes the unification of Harmony and Sovereignty <note>Tiferet and Malchut</note>, which are the letters *Vav* and *He*. Their way is to be in the secret of Kindness <term>Chesed: The Sephira of love and expansion</term>. Sometimes the name *Eloah* <note>God</note> or *Hu* <note>He</note> is influenced by Judgment, in the secret of the letters *He-Yod* from the name *Elohim*. In the *Tikkunim* <note>Tikkuney Zohar</note>, it is explained that in this "Existence" <term>Havayah: A term for the Name Y-H-V-H</term> the repair of the "damage" is found, which we will mention shortly. It says: For this reason, Adam came through the three Patriarchs, who are the branches of the Tree, the body, and the fruit of the Tree. He repaired what had been uprooted. He descended into Abraham and planted in him the *He*, which represents the branches of the Tree. He descended into Isaac and produced the fruit from Isaac. Then He descended into Jacob and planted in him the *Vav*, of whom it is said, "And the God of Jacob." Afterward came Moses—who is numerically equivalent to the word "Flesh" <note>Hebrew: *Basar* (בשר) = 502, same as "He is flesh" (Bshagam)</note>—and he brought down the Five Books of the Torah, which are the root of the Tree. He completed the Tree with the Name Y-H-V-H. Because of this, the Name was completed through him as **V-H-V-E**, as it says, "And they shall say to me, 'What is His name?' what shall I say to them?" For the Patriarchs said, "The Lord (Y-H-V-H) has not appeared to you," because the Name was not complete in the days of the Patriarchs and was not revealed to them. This is what is written: "But by My name, the Lord (Y-H-V-H), I was not known to them."

**H-V-H-E** signifies the four watches of the night. From the side of the Left, the *He* represents the *Tefillin* <term>Tefillin: Phylacteries worn during prayer</term> upon the *Vav*—the Mother over the Son—because through her he is built, as it is written: "He established the heavens with understanding (*Binah*)." The *Yod* (the Father) is the *Tefillin* upon the Daughter, for through him she is built, as it is written: "The Lord by wisdom (*Chokhmah*) founded the earth." This is the reverse of Y-H-V-H, which is for the "salvation of our Messiah." At the sound of "My beloved knocks," there is a knocking, an ascent, and a descent. This is **D-H** "Existence" <note>a specific permutation</note>. The Father descends into the Righteous One <term>Yesod: The ninth Sephira, representing the foundation and the "Righteous One"</term> to guard the Divine Presence in exile, as explained in the *Faithful Shepherd* <note>Ra’aya Mehemna, a section of the Zohar</note>. It is also possible to explain that Harmony (*Tiferet*) ascends to the Mother (*Binah*), and the "Head of the Righteous One" ascends with it, drawing blessings through the secret of the *Yod* influenced by Wisdom. Then the final *He* remains dry, with nothing left. This is the secret of "Hew down the tree and cut off its branches... nevertheless, leave the stump of its roots in the earth," which is the Lower *He*. The letters *H-V-Y* depart and only the *He* remains. For this reason, there are three night watches of "Woe!" <note>The Hebrew word for "woe" is *Oy* or *Hoy*, resembling the letters of the Name</note>. In every watch, the *Vav-He* of "Halleluyah" ascends and roars in three watches, for we have learned: "Woe (*Hoy*) is there, woe certainly." There is also in this the secret of the Repair <term>Tikkun: Restoration or rectification</term> hoped for speedily in our days, when *Y-H* and *H-H* are reversed from the "diminishing of the moon" to "fame and praise" in its fullness. This is the "Crown of the Torah Scroll," and we read in it "Halelu-Yah," for the *Yod* and the *He* hint at Abraham and Isaac, the "rocks" of Israel, and hint at the rest of their children. Regarding Jacob, who is "Israel," the *Vav* in the Name, it is certainly said: "And you shall tread upon their high places."

**V-H-V-O**: The Father descends toward the Daughter, and the Daughter ascends toward him, with Understanding behind her and Sovereignty behind Harmony (*Tiferet*). This is in the secret of Judgment, where there is no unification yet, except that the letters *H-Y* still influence the *V-A* and the *Vav*. It is a complete reversal, like **H-V-H-Y**, but in pairs as mentioned. It also contains the secret of the four letters of the Name *K-V-Z-V* <note>a coded version of Y-H-V-H used on the back of the Mezuzah</note>, the guardians of the source of blessing. From the side of power and judgment, it serves as a "garment" for the Name *Ehyeh* <note>I Am</note>. This was explained in the *Heichalot* <term>Heichalot: "Palaces," referring to early Jewish mystical literature</term> of the portion of *Pekudei*, regarding the secret of "The King who helps, saves, and shields." One can also expound on the order of the letters to make them great and strong for all.

### Chapter 7: And It Shall Be (Ve-haya)

This is the secret of those who transform the Attribute of Judgment into the Attribute of Mercy. Even though the *Yod* precedes the *Y-H-H*, it is still in the secret of Unification, and this is simple. Furthermore, as previously mentioned, **N-H-Y-H** <note>original: נהיה</note> is the secret where the line of *Y-H* is on the right and the secret of *H-Y* is on the left. Behold, Harmony (*Tiferet*), which includes them both, is **H-V-H**. When the right side of Harmony is joined to Kindness (*Chesed*), it forms **V-H-H**, and when the left side of Harmony is joined to Strength (*Gevurah*), it forms **V-H-H** as will come before us. Furthermore, in this "Existence" is the secret of "A man shall fear his mother and his father," regarding the ascent of Sovereignty (*Malchut*) to the Crown (*Keter*) in the secret of "Fear of Sin." It also contains the secret of Charity (*Tzedakah*), with the "stretched out right arm" to give. He is the *Vav* in the name *Ve-haya* (And it shall be); the five fingers are the *He*, and the coin is the *Yod*, and the hand of the poor man is the other *He*. Thus, "The work of charity shall be peace," for the poor man unifies *Y-H* with the "Master of the House" <note>the giver</note>. The Master of the House does not unify with the poor man except in the secret of *H-Y* over *Yod*, while the poor man is *Yod* over *H-I*. This is the reason for the phrase "That I have done with him" in the Midrash of the Sages.

**V-H-H** is the secret of "And they both went." The Father and the Son departed. Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai explained in the *Tikkunim* that it contains the letters of *V-H* and *H-V-H*, but the *Vav* departed and became **V-Y**. Furthermore, sometimes in exile, both [Father and Mother] descend into the "Righteous One" to guard the Divine Presence. One can also expound on this permutation as the "hug" that precedes unification, in the secret of "Harmony is greatness" and the "Crown of Salvation" from the Sabbath afternoon prayer.

**V-H-H-Y**: We explained it in the seventh "Existence." it indicates that the right-side *H-H* overcomes and influences the left-side *H-Y*. However, Kindness (*Chesed*) does not overcome so much that it bends the Left and transforms it, in the secret of "And the Lord is God" which we explained.

**H-H-V-Y**: The secret of the final *He* from which the letters *H-V-Y* have departed. We explained this in the fifth "Existence." It can also be explained according to what was stated in the eighth "Existence," but here there is not even a bit of influence or mercy in the exile, for there would be "two males over two females," yet without unification. It can also be explained as the secret of "There is nothing in evil below a plague (*Nega*)," for behold, the River of Understanding (*Binah*) is the first *He*, and the Garden—which is the sum of all plantings and generations—is the excess. There is no "face to face" here; the *Nun-Samech* <note>meaning "miracle" or "departing"</note> separates the River and the Spring. This is the opposite of the third "Existence."

**H-H-Y-V** is generally similar to the previous one according to our first explanation, except that the *Vav-Aleph* is not entirely hidden above the *Yod* in the secret of *V-Y*, but remains *V-V*.

**H-V-H-Y** is the secret of "On three things the world stands." It is the final *He*, **Y-H-Y**, which resembles an "Exedra" <note>a porch or hall</note> in the secret of three reeds: Torah (Harmony), Service (Strength)—for their actions are in the North—and Acts of Kindness (Greatness). In this permutation, there is also the existence of Judgment and "Reflected Light" entirely. In it is the secret of "In all the streets they shall say: *H-H Y-H-V*," and the secret of "Reeds and Pride," and the "Selection of the Sphere." Regarding the name **Y-H-V-H**, it is said: "The stone the builders despised has become the chief cornerstone."

**However**, the initial letters of these "Existences" hint at Wisdom (*Chokhmah*), Kindness (*Chesed*), and Victory (*Netzach*) with three *Yods*; at Understanding (*Binah*), Strength (*Gevurah*), and Glory (*Hod*) with three *Hes*; and at Crown (*Keter*), Harmony (*Tiferet*), and Foundation (*Yesod*) with three *Vavs* and three *Hes*.

# Gate 2: The Names

...and so on. These are the receivers and conductors of the spirituality of the verse, just as the Temple was a sanctuary for the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: The immanent, feminine aspect of God that dwells within the world</term>. This is similar to how one mentions the designated names of the spheres of the book, such as the various names of the Creator and their vocalization, all of which serve as "Beings" <note>original: "Havayot," a play on the name Y-H-V-H</note> of Kindness <term>Hesed: The Sephira of expansive love and benevolence</term> to bring about a spiritual resurrection within it when there is one who awakens their power and the spirituality of the matter—provided there is proper intention <term>Kavanah: Meditative focus or mental direction during prayer or ritual</term>, as will be explained in the "Gate of Intention," with the help of God.

|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| D-D-V-V D-V-D-V D-V-V-D | Y-V-V-D Y-D-Y-D Y-D-D-Y | Y-Y-Y Y-Y-V Y-V-Y |
| V-V-D-D V-D-V-D V-D-D-V | D-D-Y-Y D-Y-D-Y D-Y-Y-D | Y-Y-V-V Y-V-Y-V Y-V-Y-Y |

->And likewise for the Name *Ehyeh* <note>I Am / I Will Be</note> and its permutations, they are these:<-

|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| A-H-Y-H A-Y-H-H A-H-H-Y | A-A-H-H A-A-H-Y A-Y-H-A | Y-Y-A-H Y-Y-H-A Y-A-Y-H |
| H-A-Y-H H-A-H-Y H-H-Y-A | A-Y-A-H A-H-Y-A A-H-A-Y | Y-A-H-Y Y-H-A-Y Y-H-Y-A |
| Y-A-H-H Y-H-A-H Y-H-H-A | H-A-A-Y H-Y-A-A H-A-Y-A | A-Y-Y-A A-Y-H-Y A-H-Y-Y |
| H-H-A-Y H-Y-A-H H-Y-H-A | Y-A-A-H Y-H-A-A Y-H-A-H | H-A-Y-Y H-Y-Y-A H-Y-A-Y |

| Y-H-Y-H Y-H-Y-H Y-H-H-Y | H-H-A-A H-A-H-A H-A-A-H | A-A-Y-Y A-Y-A-Y A-Y-A-A |

There is another way regarding the permutations of the Name <note>Havayah/Y-H-V-H</note>. In their place, the sages said: "Whoever learns these 'Beings' <note>permutations</note> must learn them in order to build a building for the Holy One, Blessed be He." Concerning this, it is said, "The altar of the Lord that was broken down" <note>1 Kings 18:30</note>, and the secret of the matter is that they are able to "break down" the letters of Heaven. This is the meaning of "lest they break through to the Lord" <note>Exodus 19:21</note>. Because they "break them down" through their sins, one must "rebuild them" through their prayers. The letter *Yod* is the foundation stone of the building: *Yod, Yod, Yod-He*. From the letter *Mem* and *Nun* and *Vav-Yod*, it shall be a "tested stone" <note>Isaiah 28:16</note>, a complete building of *A-H-A* and *A-Y*. This is the wall and the pillar to support the house. Because of this, the four letters in the building are selected: *Yod* is the foundation of the building, *Yod-Tav* (it seems to me this means the ceiling), and these are in the Sephira of Sovereignty <term>Malchut: The final Sephira, representing the physical world and the manifestation of Divine will</term>, and so on.

The source of these "Beings" <note>permutations</note> is numerically equivalent to Kindness <term>Hesed: Numerical value of 72</term>. Through them, one must build the building, for they derive from the *Hesed* of the source of the "Beings," which are the expansion of the Name: *YOD HEI VIV HEI* <note>The Name Y-H-V-H spelled out with the letter Yod, which totals 72</note>. They rise to seventy-two "Beings," totaling the numerical value of *Hesed*. All of them are "stone and beam," a building built with both. These are the seventy-two "Beings" that emerge from *YOD HEI VIV HEI*. Regarding the writing of these permutations, however, in most transcriptions they are corrupted, but the sage, peace be upon him, arranged them thus:

| | |
|:---:|:---:|
| Y-D-V Y-V-D D-V-Y D-Y-V V-Y-D V-D-Y | Y-D-V Y-V-D D-V-Y D-Y-V V-Y-D V-D-Y |
| Y-Y-V Y-V-Y V-Y-Y Y-D-D D-Y-D D-D-Y | Y-D-D D-Y-D D-D-Y V-D-R D-V-D D-R-V |
| Y-D-D D-Y-D D-D-Y V-D-R D-V-D D-R-V | V-D-R D-V-D D-R-V V-D-D D-V-D D-D-V |

| | |
|:---:|:---:|
| Y-V-V V-Y-V V-V-Y  Y-V-V V-Y-V V-V-Y | Y-V-V V-Y-V V-V-Y  Y-Y-V Y-V-Y V-Y-Y |
| Y-V-V V-Y-V V-V-Y  Y-Y-Y Y-Y-V Y-V-Y | Y-Y-Y Y-Y-V Y-V-Y  D-Y-Y Y-Y-Y Y-Y-D |
| D-Y-Y Y-D-D Y-Y-D  D-V-V V-D-V V-V-D | D-Y-Y V-D-V V-V-D  Y-Y-Y V-V-V V-D-V |

One should not wonder at the doubling of these permutations, for the letters are not equal in their secret meaning or their hints. Behold, the source of everything is the expanded name *YOD HEI VIV HEI*, which has a numerical value <term>Gematria: A system of assigning numerical value to Hebrew letters to find deeper meanings</term> of 72. In it, there are four *Yods*, three *Vavs*, and two *He's*.

From these, one can combine *Y-H-V* and *Y-H-V*. The first *Y-H-V* can be permuted into six "houses" <note>arrangements</note> as is known, and likewise the second. The triplet *V-Y-Y* permutes into three houses, making 15. Furthermore, we permute each of the four *Yods* in this name with the two *He's*, creating four permutations, each being *Y-H-H*. These four combine into three houses, which is 12, totaling 27. Furthermore, we permute each of the three *Vavs* with the two *He's*, creating three permutations, each being *V-H-H*. These three combine into three houses, which is 9, totaling 36. Furthermore, we permute the four *Yods* with the two *Vavs*, creating four permutations of *Y-V-V*. These four build three houses, which is 12, totaling 48. Furthermore, we permute the three *Vavs* with the two *Yods*, and these three make three houses, which is 9, totaling 57. Furthermore, we permute each of the two *He's* with two *Yods*, and these two build three houses, which is 6, totaling 63. Furthermore, we permute each of the two *He's* with two *Vavs*, and these two build three houses, which is 6, totaling 69. Finally, we permute the general letters of the "Correction" <term>Tikkun: The process of spiritual repair or alignment</term>, which are the four *Yods*, three *Vavs*, and two *He's*, making three houses—*Y-Y, V-V, H-H*—making 72.

### Chapter 6

We have already mentioned that the four-letter Name <note>Y-H-V-H</note> can be permuted through its letters into twenty-four arrangements and no more. Although four distinct letters would build twenty-four "houses," the doubling of the letter *He* reduces the number to half <note>12</note>. This is their order, with an explanation of some of their hints from the *Tikkunim* <note>referring to the Tikkunei Zohar</note>:

**Y-H-V** indicates absolute Unity and the direct emanation from "Father" <term>Abba: The Sephira of Chokhmah/Wisdom</term> to "Mother" <term>Imma: The Sephira of Binah/Understanding</term>, and from both of them to the "Son" and "Daughter." This is the "offering to the Lord," as we have already mentioned.

**Y-H-H**—its secret is "Father established the Daughter" <note>Aramaic: Abba yasad berata</note>. This refers to the "Small *He*" <note>the final letter of the Name</note> which is mostly inclined toward Him in this permutation. She is the "second who established the heavens with understanding." This occurs in the order of Emanation <term>Atzilut: The highest of the four spiritual worlds, closest to the Divine source</term>, and also in the secret of "I will not enter the city," which was explained in Gate 8, Chapter 10. It is also possible to explain this order of "Being" as the "Higher *He*" preceding the "Lower *He*" in the secret of the hand <note>Yod-Dalet</note>.

# Slice of the Pomegranate &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 20: The Names &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Nectar of Pomegranates

...itself, through the influence of the Unification, in order to sweeten the Judgment. **The order** of its explanation is found in the *Tikkunim* <note>Tikunei Zohar, a mystical commentary on the beginning of Genesis</note> regarding the concept that "fear of sin precedes wisdom." They said there: I will first place the *Shva* <note>a vowel point consisting of two vertical dots</note> which is "Awe" <note>original: *Yirah*</note> within the Name "Y-H-V-H to love." For the *Shva* comes from the side of *Gevurah* <term>Gevurah: The Sephira of Might and strict Judgment</term>, for "by fire is the Lord judged." The *Kamatz* <note>a vowel point associated with expansion/mercy</note> is on the right, and "the Priest shall arise," because we elevate in holiness and do not descend. For this reason, the 365 negative commandments (which are Awe/Fear) precede the 248 positive commandments (which are Love/Mercy). This is the meaning of "This is My name forever" <note>Exodus 3:15</note>: "My name" <note>original: *Shemi*</note> with the letters Y-H equals 365, while "My memorial" <note>original: *Zichri*</note> with V-H equals 248. The intention is to "turn away from evil" first, and then "do good," following the order of precedence in the fulfillment of commandments—moving from the "Returning Light" (whose foundation is Judgment) to the "Straight Light" (whose foundation is Mercy).

The Torah states when teaching the Children of Israel the Unique Name: "This is My name." It is known that the word "Name" <note>Shem</note> refers to *Malchut* <term>Malchut: Kingship/Sovereignty, the lowest Sephira representing the manifest world</term>, which is the "name" of *Tiferet* <term>Tiferet: Beauty/Harmony, the central Sephira</term>. "My name with Y-H" is to mention the quality of the Day within the Night. "My memorial" is the secret of Kindness and the Masculine; with V-H, it represents the quality of the Night within the Day.

One should contemplate what is written in the *Tikkunim* at the beginning of the section on "The Sword": The *Yod* is the head of the sword. The *Vav* is the body of the sword. The two edges of the sword are the two *Heh*s. The *Heh* is also the sheath of the sword. The sword, when it is the Name Y-H-V-H, and when the *Shekhinah* <note>The Divine Presence</note> is in a state of Judgment, cuts from every side. But when it enters the sheath, it becomes Mercy and does not cut down the Judgments. This is the secret of the sword in its sheath: the Name *A-H-Y-H-V-H* <note>an intertwining of the names Ehyeh and Y-H-V-H</note>. Truly so! When Y-H-V-H is outside of the *Shekhinah*, it is said of Him: "For the Lord your God is a consuming fire," for He takes from the side of *Gevurah* to burn the world.

The truth is that the sword does not cut with its "head" (the *Yod*), nor with the "Kindness of the Face," nor with its "body" (the *Vav*), except by way of agreement. Rather, Judgment is enacted through the secret of the two *Heh*s: *Binah* <term>Binah: Understanding, the "Mother" Sephira</term> influencing *Gevurah*, while *Tiferet* takes from *Gevurah* in an unusual way, and *Malchut* acts in Judgment. However, when Y-H-V-H is unified with *Malchut*, everything becomes Mercy through the secret of the name *Y-H-H-V-H*, and this is a very awesome name.

**In the Zohar** on the Song of Songs, they said: The image of the patriarch Jacob is the secret of the Name Y-H-V, who inherits the legacy of the "Father" and "Mother" <note>Hokhmah and Binah</note>. He is magnified within them and walks before them in the "modest way of the world." This is seen in the arrangement of the letters of the Master of All. Just as they are ordered in Y-H-V-H, it is the way of the Creator to always "roar" <note>express power</note> toward the Female before Him, to gaze upon her and not depart from her, so that she is not left desolate, and He does not cast His eyes upon another woman. The "Word of the Lord" is the Female. The Y-H is the Female before the Creator so He may look at her constantly. The Son <note>Jacob/Tiferet</note> walks before his Mother to cover her from sight, for the sake of her honor and the honor of his Father. Your sign for this is "Joseph is a fruitful bough," as it is written: "And afterwards Joseph and Rachel drew near." Joseph stood before his mother to protect the "Female." He placed her before Him to gaze upon her, as it is written: "The eyes of the Lord your God are always upon her," so that she should not depart from Him for a single moment. This is the arrangement of the holy letters, forming the order of the upper and lower worlds.

**The reason** for this discourse is that the essence of the Four-Letter Name consists of the first three letters included in the essence of *Tiferet*. This is why he "inherits from Father and Mother." As Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai explained in the *Idra* of *Ha'azinu*: when Kindness is emanated from Wisdom, its reality remains within it, and likewise for the reality of Might within Understanding. Just as *Tiferet* balances the extremes and includes them in their place, so too it rises in the secret of *Da'at* <term>Da'at: Knowledge, the bridge between the upper and lower Sephirot</term>, balancing their realities above, including them, and inheriting from Wisdom and Understanding. And through this...

<column-break/>

*And the intention is to focus on adding to her life-force, Y-H on their own. For Y-H in Malchut—that is, Y-V-D H-Y—has the numerical value of 66, corresponding to the number of... the life-force is V-H... and the construction of the threshold is completed as mentioned in the books of Horeb and "He Shall Sow." The construction is written such that Y-H is not exchanged for the "Yod of Life" as written in the secret of the Kings... a little of the "Nectar of Pomegranates" and the "Chapters of the Chariot" <term>Merkabah: Early Jewish mysticism focusing on the Divine Chariot-Throne</term>... the inner spiritual force can attain the Shekhinah, which is the vessel that receives the spirituality... and therefore, it is sanctified and not erased. However, some of the order of the Names is not sanctified because it is not a vessel that contains the spirit... and therefore is not treated with the same sanctity as the names that are not erased.*

### Chapter 4
*The Four-Letter Name vocalized with Holem <note>a dot above the letter representing an 'o' sound</note> is in Binah and includes the 540... which is the Name Y-H-V-H in its spiritual aspect. And Malchut, which is the Name Elohim, is the garment of Judgment in Malchut... in Wisdom on the right, and further influences the Zohar to teach that Binah was once... and Judgments and Gevurah are awakened from her. Therefore, within the Yod... and in the Name Y-H-V-H in the Torah there are two dots... Hinting at Hokhmah and Binah... and in the "Tikkunim" regarding Kindness... for the Sword is the body of the battle, and Elohim is the sheath for the sword. This is when the sword is drawn and reveals its face in Judgment... but when it is in the sheath, which is the name Elohim, in the secret of the Judgment that is in the silver... to strike a covenant... and placing it in the sheath strengthens the Mercy in the secret of the Yesod <term>Yesod: Foundation, the Sephira associated with the procreative and connecting forces</term> and the Tikkun. This is the secret of the Kamatz... the influence of Tiferet in the secret of Yesod... and this is also in the Name "BaLaK" <note>numerical value 102</note>... This is because Yesod of Tiferet and Malchut... the secret of the Crown (Keter) and Wisdom (Hokhmah)... to conquer the Judgment and turn it toward the side of Compassion through Mercy. This was the state of Binah... and in the Zohar it explains that the final Heh was without vocalization, and because it has no known independent action, but rather everything depends on what she receives, her action changes accordingly. This provides a beautiful reason for the many "Havayot" (Beings/Names) that have no foundation except in the final Heh... and the reason why it is read as "Elohim" but written as "Y-H-V-H" and not the reverse.*

### Chapter 5
*The Four-Letter Name contains three hints of pure Kindness, representing the goodness and kindness that flows from Him and proceeds through Wisdom until all the forces of Judgment are conquered and transformed. As it is said: "And God is indignant every day"—meaning, let there be no indignation for the forces of Judgment on any day. This is associated with the names "El Elyon" (Most High God), "El Shaddai" (Almighty God), and "El," following the verse... as in "El Melech" (God the King) etc. For in the Zohar, this is in Binah who sits and surrounds...*

<meta>This page continues the technical analysis of the Divine Names and their relationship to the Sephirot (Divine emanations). Having previously discussed the vowels of the Name Y-H-V-H, the author now transitions into the specific meanings of the names Ehyeh, Yah, El, and Elohim, emphasizing their roots in the Supernal Crown (Keter) and their descent through Wisdom (Chochmah) and Understanding (Binah) into the world of action.</meta>

# Nectar of Pomegranates &nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 2: The Names &nbsp;&nbsp; Slice of the Pomegranate

...regarding the matter of the "poor one" <note>Hebrew: *Helekh*, often used in Kabbalah to refer to the Sephira of Malchut in a state of poverty or reception</note>, which is to say *Malchut* <term>Malchut: "Kingdom," the tenth and final Sephira, representing the physical world and the vessel for Divine light</term>, and to explain its surroundings—the matter of the Names in general, as a sort of seal, and a bit in detail for each and every one individually.

### Chapter 2: And These ###

The names are **Ehyeh** <note>original: *A-H-Y-H*, meaning "I Will Be"</note>, which hint at the Supernal *Keter* <term>Keter: "Crown," the highest Sephira, representing Divine Will and the Infinite</term> and indicate that everything is hidden within it. This means there is no revelation of anything within it, like a hidden crown, but it is destined to be revealed, and all that will be revealed shall come from it. This is why it says, "I Shall Be That Which I Shall Be" <note>Exodus 3:14</note>, as explained in the *Zohar* <term>Zohar: The foundational work of Jewish mysticism</term> on the portion of *Emor* regarding the verse "I Shall Be That Which I Shall Be." It says there that *Ehyeh* is in *Keter*, which includes all the "Existences" <note>Hebrew: *Havayot*, permutations of the name Y-H-V-H</note> included in *Keter* prior to the spreading out of the *Sephirot*. These "Existences" were in *Keter* in concealment, and the Life-Force was what revealed the Holy. It all includes three points: the point of *Keter* which includes *Chochmah* <term>Chochmah: Wisdom</term> and *Binah* <term>Binah: Understanding</term>. They were not revealed there in a literal sense, but only came into being there in concealment. These points are the Supernal ones, and while they are there, they are called *Alin* <note>Supernal/Hidden ones</note> because the "Existences" are more hidden than their written forms. Thus, when they are hidden in *Keter*, they are called by the name **Ehyeh**, for it is destined to be revealed in the future through *Binah*. This first *Ehyeh* is ready to be revealed and to give birth through *Binah*. The word "That Which" <note>Hebrew: *Asher*</note> is in *Chochmah*, in the entry of *Chochmah* to listen to *Binah*. And *Binah* is called by the second *Ehyeh* in its aspect of looking toward *Chochmah* and returning to it—the aspect of *Binah* that awakens and is ready to be revealed now. That which was hidden—namely, in *Keter*—will now be revealed in *Binah*. This is the explanation of "I Shall Be (*Ehyeh*) That Which (*Asher*) I Shall Be (*Ehyeh*)." Afterward, Moses sought to know the "Existences" in their concealment in their place—that is, this second name *Ehyeh*, which indicates the revelation of the "Existences." After the completion of the "Correction" <note>Hebrew: *Tikkun*</note>, the "Existences" were no longer mentioned by the names of *Ehyeh*, but only by the name Y-H-V-H. Therefore, the name *Ehyeh* is not mentioned again in the Torah, only the four-letter Name <note>the Tetragrammaton, Y-H-V-H</note>, which is all the "Existences" in its four letters. Just as *Ehyeh* indicates concealment, the four-letter Name indicates its expansion. Therefore, the name *Ehyeh* remains in *Keter* because it indicates concealment. Know that even though in the legal tradition it is written that the name *Ehyeh* and the four-letter Name should be vocalized with the *Kamatz* vowel <note>a vowel of expansion/mercy</note>, these names exist in *Keter* in the aspect of its essence. However, its essence is accompanied by *Chochmah* and *Binah* which are included and hidden within it. Regarding the circle of its essence, no name hints at it. Between them, it is called by the name *Kah* <note>Lamed-Heh</note> from the side of the Hidden Source. *Chochmah* is generally within it and is called by the name *Ehyeh* full of life... *Ehyeh* on the source, which is *Binah* that flows and covers. And the world in which *Chochmah* is included is because the light of *Chochmah* is revealed in *Binah*. Even though *Binah* is lower than *Chochmah*, it is associated with the name *Ehyeh* which indicates more concealment than the name hinting at *Chochmah*, because *Binah* conceals it.

### Chapter 3: And Y-H ###

The letters **Y-H** hint at *Chochmah*. It is a language of expansion, like the "Flame of Yah" <note>Song of Songs 8:6</note>. **Y-H** indicates the descent and expansion of the Supernal ones. It also indicates that the foundation of *Chochmah*—namely the letter *Yod*—with *Binah*—namely the letter *Heh*—will be constant. As it is explained in the *Zohar*, "The *Yod* and the *Heh* are never separated" because *Chochmah* brings out the *Heh* and is hidden in it; they are species that never part. This is the meaning of the letters in the verse, "A river went out of Eden" <note>Genesis 2:10</note>: "Eden" is *Chochmah*, and "River" is *Binah*. Alone they are straight, and in them are indicated the attributes of the world... and it is always with it... the first two and the last two. The two names *Ehyeh* there hint at the expansion of *Keter* in general within them. The root of every "Heh" in the explanation is that they were in the Supernal "Heh" <note>Binah</note>, and this will be the influence of all the lower *Sephirot* through the name H-V <note>the latter half of the Tetragrammaton</note> where the drawing down of the three Supernal ones stopped. And there it will be...

<column-break/>

->Slice of the Pomegranate<-
->Gate 2: The Names<-

"These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created" <note>Genesis 2:4</note>. Do not read "when they were created" (*be-hibaram*) but "with Abraham" (*be-Abraham*). They exist through the awakening of Abraham. When Abraham awakens in the world, all those Judgments that are found every single day are pushed outside and do not stand before him. This is what is written: <margin>Psalm 7:12</margin> "God is indignant every day." It does not say "indignation every day" but "indignant," meaning there is indignation every day, and the Judgments are found, but he pushes them outside. This is what sustains the world, as it is written: "By day the Lord commands His loving-kindness" <note>Psalm 42:9</note>. Were it not for this, the world could not stand even a single moment. Therefore, everything stands for the sake of Abraham. Thus far <note>a citation from the Zohar</note>. And the name **El Gibbor** <note>Mighty God</note> refers to two attributes: *El* is in *Chesed* <term>Chesed: Loving-kindness</term> and *Gibbor* is in *Gevurah* <term>Gevurah: Strength/Judgment</term>. Therefore it says *El* in every place is the radiance of the Supernal Wisdom in the aspect of *Chesed* that expands within *Chesed* through *Chochmah*, in which there is no Judgment at all. Therefore, the name *El* is never truly used for *Gevurah*, even though in the descriptive titles it is possible to apply the term of one to the other. Some struggle to explain *El Gibbor* as being in *Gevurah*, just as we explain "The Great God" (*Ha-El Ha-Gadol*) as being in *Chesed*. It is possible to explain *El Gibbor* as *Chesed* being compelled by *Gevurah*, or that it performs Judgment to complete a task of *Chesed*, like the plagues of Egypt which were to save Israel. Further, it is explained: **El Elyon** <note>God Most High</note> is in *Keter*, *Chochmah*, and *Binah*; **El Melech** <note>God the King</note> is in *Binah*; and **El Olam** <note>God of the World</note> is in *Binah*, *Yesod*, and *Malchut*. It appears that *El Elyon* is in *Chesed* as it is influenced by and unified in *Binah*. So too *El Olam* and *El Melech*; when *Chesed* is connected to it, the name *Chesed* is attributed to it. Regarding this, they said in the *Zohar* that she <note>Binah</note> sits upon the "Throne of Mercy." **And the name** **Elohim** is known to be called so because of Judgment (*Din*). The letters *M-Y* <note>meaning "Who"</note> hint at *Binah*, combined with the "three ancestors" <note>Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, representing the three Sephirot below Binah</note> who are called *Eleh* <note>meaning "These"</note>. This name is appropriately applied to *Binah*, *Gevurah*, and *Malchut*, and it all hints to these three places of Judgment. See in the book *Pardes Rimonim* <note>by Moses Cordovero</note> in the Gate of Wisdom, where these two names are investigated. There in Chapter 4 it is explained that even though **Elohim** everywhere is Judgment, it is nevertheless known that the world is never conducted by the attribute of Judgment alone, but it is always inclusive of Mercy, and "He does not stir up all His wrath." Therefore, the letters of *Elohim* never change their vocalization (vowels), because the letters themselves hint at the partnership of Mercy and agreement. See there in chapters 7, 8, and 9. However, the four-letter Name <note>Y-H-V-H</note> everywhere is Mercy (*Rachamim*). It does not change in its essence, but sometimes the action drawn from it changes according to the preparation of the recipients, and the vowel points indicate this. Therefore, sometimes the Name is vocalized with the vowels of *Elohim* <note>the vowels of "God" as Judge</note> which is Judgment, and sometimes with the "explicit" vocalization <note>the vowels of "Lord" as Merciful</note> which is Mercy, as will be explained shortly.

### Chapter 3: The Name ###

The Name Y-H-V-H with the "explicit" vocalization <note>the traditional vowels used for the Tetragrammaton</note> is attributed to *Tiferet* <term>Tiferet: Beauty/Harmony, the central Sephira that balances Mercy and Judgment</term>. All agree that it is Mercy, as is proven in the *Zohar*. Its vocalization indicates its unification in His Palace over His hosts. Behold, His Palace is influenced by Him in three aspects: whether from His own side in the secret of the *Cholam* vowel <note>the dot above the letter, representing Tiferet</note>, or from *Chesed* which "contracted" (*Kamatz*) its source, or from Judgment in the vowel point *Shva*. Therefore they said that *Malchut*, when she is "visited" from the side of *Kamatz*, takes from *Chesed*; when the point is from the side of *Shva*, she takes from *Gevurah*. And when the point is from the *Cholam*, she is from the side of the "Middle Pillar" <note>Tiferet</note>. Up to here <note>Zoharic quote</note>. We have a sign for this matter: the *Patach* <note>a horizontal vowel line</note> that is added in the Palace near the *Shva* is in the form of a *Vav*, indicating the revelation of *Tiferet* itself.

# Slice of the Pomegranate &nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 20: The Names &nbsp;&nbsp; Nectar of Pomegranates

The essence for the two "Eternities" <note>Hebrew: *Netzachim*, a play on the Sephira *Netzach* (Endurance), which shares a root with "eternity"</note> is that both are called **Tzevaot** <note>Hebrew: *Tzevaot*, often translated as "Hosts" or "Armies"</note> and nothing else. The word itself indicates plurality, for one does not use the term "host" for a single individual. All their various grammatical forms are shared to show the equality of their actions when "brothers dwell together" <note>A reference to Psalm 133:1, implying the unity of the Sephirot *Netzach* and *Hod*</note>, such as "channels," "two boughs of the willows," and the like. The Four-Letter Name <note>The Tetragrammaton, Y-H-V-H</note> as well as the name **Elohim** <note>The Name of God associated with Justice and Nature</note> are borrowed for them in their capacity as a "throne" and a "foundation"—this one for *Tiferet* <term>Tiferet: The Sephira of Beauty or Harmony, the central trunk of the Sephirotic tree</term> and that one for *Malchut* <term>Malchut: Kingdom, the final Sephira that receives and manifests the divine light</term> when they are united by the *Yesod* <term>Yesod: Foundation, the Sephira that acts as the funnel or connector to Malchut</term>. 

As they said in the *Tikunim* <note>The *Tikunei Zohar*, a later layer of the Zoharic literature</note>: "Come and see: 'Y-H-V-H Adonai' are the Holy One, Blessed be He, and His Presence (*Shekhinah*). They are in the two legs: 'Y-H-V-H' on the right, and 'A-D-N-Y' on the left. They are the radiant mirror and the mirror that does not radiate. Both are in the 'Righteous One' <note>The *Tzadik*, another name for the Sephira *Yesod*</note> as one: 'A-D-N-Y-H-V-H'."

**It has already** been explained that these two mirrors are the secret of "the face of Moses is like the face of the sun, and the face of Joshua is like the face of the moon." <note>A Talmudic metaphor for the transition of leadership and the level of prophecy</note>. All prophecy resides in *Netzach* and *Hod*, the "two true prophets." In most places where we find the combination "Y-H-V-H Elohim," they indicate *Tiferet* and *Malchut*, or *Chochmah* (Wisdom) and *Binah* (Understanding) respectively. It is therefore appropriate to associate them with *Netzach* and *Hod* for this reason. However, the name "A-D-N-Y Tzevaot" is not associated with *Hod*, because the name *Adonai* indicates the secret of Unity, as we mentioned in the eighth gate. *Elohim* resides in *Malchut* from the side of the Left, as previously stated.

**In the portion** of *Vayikra* <note>The Book of Leviticus</note>, it says that the seventh and eighth [Sephirot] are **Tzevaot**. Because of this, "Y-H-V-H is near" to all, as one on all sides. Sometimes it says "Y-H-V-H Elohim," because *Tiferet* is near to *Gevurah* <term>Gevurah: The Sephira of Might or Judgment</term>. And sometimes "Y-H-V-H Tzevaot," because *Tiferet* is near to *Netzach* and *Hod*, which are called "Tzevaot." It is said that the words of the faithful prophets were recognized by their mouths: when one said, "Thus says Y-H-V-H Elohim," and another said, "Thus says Y-H-V-H Tzevaot," they knew from which place the words originated. From *Tiferet*, which is called "Y-H-V-H Tzevaot" when it joins with *Netzach* and *Hod*, we may infer "Elohim Tzevaot," for *Malchut* is near to *Netzach* and *Hod* when she is elevated above them.

**In the Zohar** it is proven that "Tzevaot" is also borrowed for *Tiferet*, from which influences and souls are drawn into *Netzach* and *Hod*. It is also borrowed for *Yesod*, which reveals them below. This is similarly explained in the *Zohar* on the Song of Songs, speaking of the level of *Yesod*: "Because it brings forth rivers and sparks and creates their species, this radiance is called **Tzevaot**."

### Chapter 5: El

**Chai** <note>Hebrew: *Chai*, meaning "Living"</note>. These two names are associated with *Yesod* for the reason previously mentioned in the first gate, chapter 10. The author of *Ha-Orah* explained that *Yesod* is called **El Chai** <note>The Living God</note> because it draws Kindness (*Chesed*) and Life from all the upper attributes through the power of *Binah* and Greatness (*Gedulah*) toward *Malchut*. In the *Raya Mehemna* <note>A section of the Zohar titled "The Faithful Shepherd"</note>, it is proven that the name **Shaddai** <note>The Almighty</note> is from the side of *Yetzirah* (the World of Formation), the Tree of Knowledge, which is in the guard-post; but from the side of *Atzilut* (the World of Emanation), the Tree of Life is in *Yesod*. Furthermore, there the name "Shaddai" is associated with *Malchut*. It says: "The Presence (*Shekhinah*) is called a *Mezuzah* from the side of the Middle Pillar <note>Tiferet</note> from the letters of Y-H-V-H, and from the side of the 'Righteous One' (*Yesod*) she is called **Shaddai**—Shaddai is the wisdom of the King, who is Y-H-V-H." The intention is that in her capacity as the Gate to God, she is called *Mezuzah*, but when she is united with the King’s seal—the secret of the *Tzadik* and the Covenant of Circumcision which draws the power of the body onto her—she is called **Shaddai**. 

**Adonai** is associated with *Malchut*, and in the Zohar it is called the "external keys."

<column-break/>

*Binah* (Understanding) through the triad of *Chesed* (Kindness), *Din* (Judgment), and *Rachamim* (Compassion), from which the five Sephirot beneath her exist. This *Binah* is called **Elohim**, meaning she is an essential revelation learned from the language of "Eleh" <note>Hebrew: *Eleh*, "These"</note>. And behold, when the ten holy days are unified with *Binah*—that is, the unification of two aspects—*Binah* is called by the name **Elohim**.

### Chapter 9: More

The names included in scriptural passages under the name **Y-H-V-H Elohim**: in the secret of *Binah*, the forty winds blow from the influence of the ends, which are the four elements. In the secret of *Malchut*, there is "space" <note>Hebrew: *Revach*</note> that she receives from the name Y-H-V-H through the filling of the letter *Yod*. *Binah* lacks [nothing], and the secret of this aspect applies to *Malchut* from the five aspects through *Binah*. These are the laws of the three "Lives"; *Binah* influences them, and *Malchut* is the tribute collector <note>Latin/Hebrew loanword: *Lumus/Limes*?</note> who receives from there. The reason for this name and the "Eye," which is compassion—the secret of being associated with *Elohim*—is the secret of Judgment. For from top to bottom, it is Life, but it is also Compassion. Furthermore, these ten points are for the revealed [world], for when the name precedes the letter *Lamed*, it indicates an ascent. Even though it is "below" because of the "S" <note>Secret/Other</note> sides, they are compassion through delays. But when the Name precedes, it is necessary that the hidden things be exalted and blessed in three names and four sides. The [letter] *Heh* precedes the *Yod* to show that her glory is mentioned in the *Tikunim*, and in the end, they return above. *Malchut* receives from the six extremities, and the secret is the letter *Heh*. Behold, the occurrence of the extremities has no repair in this, for she has an aspect that receives from the depths and the secret of the Sephirot.

### Chapter 10: And There

**Y-D-V-D** <note>A permutation of the Tetragrammaton Y-H-V-H</note> is *Keter* and *Chochmah*, and it is total compassion. We rely on the words of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai (may his memory be for life), that "He who sits is He who nourishes and sustains everyone," as mentioned in the *Tikunim*. "And He sat at the gate"—the letter *Vav* is the body, at the gate of the two *Hehs* <note>The two letters Heh in the Name Y-H-V-H</note>. These are the two mouths like... to Y-H-V-H, etc. That is, the *Chazan* <note>Overseer or Cantor</note> in *Malchut* receives from the point of the *Mubtza* <note>Unclear/Technical term</note> and the vessel, which ascends to the ten of compassion and kindness. This is *Chochmah*, which is compassion. Therefore, it has no part in the attribute of Judgment except when one says *Y-D-V-D*. When it is said in... the book of the letter *Kof* and the letter *Beit*, it means when the *Tav* receives from the *Tevunah* (Insight) and is influenced by *Binah* as Judgment, and *Malchut* acts as Judgment. But when *Tiferet* is unified, everything is compassion. He is the one who is unified in the 248 [limbs] in the holy name Y-D-V-H-S-V-Y. The secret of the Song of Songs regarding the horse... Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai explained in the fourth row that the "Resurrection of Jacob" <note>Hebrew: *Yukumah de-Yaakov*</note> is in the spirit of Y-H-V. The compassion of the garments of *Binah* that we made... the portion of the connection of the light that is constant within the living... and there shall be no other eye. The "second woman" <note>Hebrew: *Nukba*</note> Y-H-V is the key to the creator's compassion, to look upon it constantly, for she is the vitality to subdue [the judgment] from *Binah* for her honor... for the primary letters of this name in *Tiferet* are the letters **Y-H-V**. The reason the *Yod* is external and not in the middle is because there was a "space" in the middle which decides the *Tiferet*—to decide below in its repairs between the Garden... and to decide above between them. For they are mixed with Kindness (*Chesed*) above and harshness in the left in the aspect of the attributes of *Gevurah* within *Chesed* in *Binah*. After being elevated in the secret of *Da'at* (Knowledge), which is Y-D-V-T-H from *Chochmah* and *Ima* (Mother)... his foundations and his strength... kindness is drawn to the kindness in that aspect... and from it to the *Gevurah* of *Binah*... and therefore he is called by the name **Y-H-V** because he decides between them and includes all the aforementioned...

# Nectar of Pomegranates &nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 20: The Names &nbsp;&nbsp; Slice of the Pomegranate

Indeed, He Himself is called Y-H-V-H, and how is He increased within them? In the secret of the "Third Line" <note>The central pillar of the Sephirotic tree, usually associated with Tiferet (Harmony)</note> which is influenced by the **Crown** (*Keter*); therefore, the letter *Vav* (ו) is depicted in it. However, the "final *He*" (ה) is in the secret of union with **Kingdom** (*Malchut*). For this reason, it would have been appropriate for the *Vav* in the Name to be placed between the *Yod* and the *He*, but he said <note>Referring to the Zohar or a classic commentary</note> that the "original path" is a path of modesty for the world. Thus it appears according to the order of the letters of the Master of All in the secret of the "Hidden Name of Four Letters" which includes all of Emanation, as previously discussed. Since this order is mandatory based on what will be explained, it is appropriate never to change the order. It is the **way** of the "Male" <note>The active, giving principle in Kabbalah</note> to increase Mercy—represented by the letter *Yod* (י)—over the letter *He* (ה) to watch over and bestow influence upon her in the secret of "Direct Light." This is to remove from her any "suspicion," which is the secret of the "Husk" <term>Klipah: An outer shell or "husk" representing forces of negativity or judgment that can attach to holiness</term> that was prophesied to Moses when he was in the "Upper House." When the order is reversed in the secret of Judgment—the *He* over the *Yod*—there will be no affliction in the "Other House." For when the Light of **Wisdom** (*Chokhmah*) departs and does not bestow influence upon **Understanding** (*Binah*), it returns as a "stalk" facing upward. This state is considered an "Other House" for him. It is possible that when the supernal flow is withdrawn and returns because there is no place for it in the lower realms, it is then appropriate for it to rest upon him. Then, dross is drawn down into a "foreign well" <note>A metaphor for the external, non-holy forces</note>, even though Wisdom does not bestow influence there, God forbid; rather, it is the "hiding of the Face" that causes this.

### [Chapter?]
It is written further: "The 'I am that I am' (*Ehyeh*) spreads over the eye, not the eye of the void." <note>This is a complex play on the name Ehyeh and the Hebrew word for eye, 'Ayin'</note> For when the name Y-H-H is joined, the "Evil Eye" is what causes the two messengers of the "Mother" and the "Daughter" <note>Representing the Sephirot Binah and Malchut</note> to "walk together," as mentioned previously. Understand this. The "Watch" honors her so that the flow of influence does not cease from her, and he honors his "Father" in the secret of the Divine Presence (*Shekhinah*) in the lower worlds for the sake of a "Higher Need." Understand also that he "guards his female," which is **Kingdom** (*Malchut*). She requires extra guarding so that His eyes do not depart from her for even a single moment, due to her proximity to the "Husks." This is not the order of the holy letters in every place in the secret of Direct Light and Mercy. In the **Tikunim** <note>The Tikunei Zohar</note>, they interpreted the letters of this "Honored Name" (Y-H-V-H) in various ways, here and there, like the "Head of the Leviathan": The body is the *He*, the *He* is the two fins. Likewise, the *Yod* is the "Head of a Bird," the *Vav* is the "Body of the Bird," and the two *He*s are its two wings, etc. Or the "Stem of a Rose": The *He* is five inner petals and five outer petals. Or the "Apple": The body of the tree, the *He* as the branches of the tree, the roots of the tree, the fruit of the tree, and so forth. They expanded on this at length, and we have widened the scope of the intended meaning.

### Chapter 4
The name **Tzevaot** <note>original: "Tzevaot," meaning "Hosts"</note> is shared by **Endurance** (*Netzach*) and **Splendor** (*Hod*), as explained in the Zohar. When joined to the Four-Letter Name (Y-H-V-H), it hints at *Netzach*, and when joined to *Elohim*, it refers to *Hod*. The commentators gave a reason for them: that *Netzach* is for Preservation and *Hod* is for Judgment, as is well known. They said that "hosts" of upper and lower beings are drawn from them. According to their words, a difficulty arises: Why is *Netzach* not called "El Tzevaot" after the name of **Kindness** (*Chesed*), just as *Hod* is called by the name of **Fear** (*Pachad/Gevurah*)? It is not enough to answer that the name *El* is always Mercy, whereas *Elohim* contains both Judgment and Mercy. Since *Netzach* and *Hod* are "blended" Sephirot, no name that is purely Judgment or purely Mercy would be entirely accurate for either of them. After all, even the name *El* "is angry every day," as we mentioned in Chapter 2, and it is sealed by the name of Gabriel, the Angel of Judgment. **However**, the truth is that the Name <meta>catchword: Himself</meta>

on the Throne of Mercy... and "Holy, Holy..." is sufficient for the world, and so on. This will be explained further in the **Gate of Categorized Titles.**

### Chapter 6
In the *Zohar* on the Song of Songs, it implies that the name **El** corresponds to this Sephira [Kindness] and calls for caution. For on the Tablets, the "Width of the Doors" is 108... and 72 in **Kindness** (*Chesed*). This 108 includes all the letters in it... and 72 is the inclusion of all the letters in Kindness, which is the reception of the branching out on the Tablets. The "branches" are the 20 fillings, the inclusion of the Ten Names in complete unity hinted at by the two *Yods* and the *Vav*, which is the "Line of Transition"... For when he wrote the 22 [letters] on his Tablets, the Sephirot of the Right... and in every Sephira there are more than 50 seals... which indicates the foundation of the 50 [Gates of Understanding] that establishes the verdict of Judgment and Mercy. All of this is in Kindness (*Chesed*), for the foundation of their Tablets is pure. This is the ultimate branching on the Tablets and the "branches of the doors," as mentioned, which emerged and spread out from Kindness. Regarding the matter of the "Voice" (*Kol*): the *Yod* in every "Right Side" is the Voice of Kindness. The *Vav-Yod-Dalet* in every "Left Side" is the Voice of **Severity** (*Gevurah*). The "Line of Transition," the *Yod* and the *Chet*, hints at **Beauty** (*Tiferet*). Every "Blast of the Shofar" (*Tekiah*)... for how can it hint at the three "Garments" with *Yod*, *Chet*, and *Yod*? Since life-forces normally unite... rather, the *Yods* are in the 50 [Gates]. It can be said that Kindness... and they will need to order the *Yod* and the "Diagonal Line" whose measure is two *Yods*, which indicates its foundation as a composite of reclining. And its existence... Kindness in Kindness, which is the union of *Tiferet* and his Female [Malchut], meaning the "Outer Line" is the voice of *Tiferet* and the "Lower Point" of the conclusion is the *Yod-Dalet* and the *Tekiah* is the voice... and the "Upper Yod" is **Understanding** (*Binah*)... For the *Yod* has a tip above and a tip below. On the Tablets, this hints at the 50 "Streets" and Kindness where **Kingdom** was united with **Beauty**. Then their secret is upon him—the Upper *Yod* which is *Binah*. All this is hinted at by the 72 in Kindness. The Tablet... hints at the Veil (*Parokhet*) to the place that is in the "Vapor" from his right and his left it is sealed... and the Voice and the inclusion of the Veil in the Tablet... Binah, which is called so because her mouth "blossoms" (*Porachat*) and gathers over *Tiferet*... Between Binah and the Female... and they cut into this further, for "life" is male in the revelation of the "Star"... the *Chet* is male, the *Lamed* is female. And regarding the fruit: the 70 "Worlds" are the union of male and female... and one must be careful of the "Female Night" in the intention of the order that nullifies the branches.

### Chapter 7
And there, in the parts mentioned regarding the Tablets in the commentary on the Song of Songs: "A cluster of henna..." etc. The explanation of the letters *Samekh-Samekh-Kaf-Vav-Tet-Samekh* <note>These appear to be mystical letter combinations or permutations</note> is the *Yod* of the arousal of the "Supernal Union" by way of the **Foundation** (*Yesod*). All the "Husks" are surrounding... and a voice in a voice of Judgment that sweetens... a "male" and Mercy. A voice full of that which awakens the union, good in Mercy, flowing... and filled with pearls in the world through good deeds. Furthermore, *Samekh-Samekh* hints at the Tablets when they were broken... and the ten holy Sephirot in the depth of Kindness... and influences the final *Samekh-Samekh*, which is **Kingdom** (*Malchut*). Therefore, one acquires through Severity... the explanation of the "Living" (*Chai*) and Kindness... from the dwellings.

### Chapter 8
Furthermore, there, the "Dwellings"... hint at two aspects of sweetening and revelation. One is through the "Conceptualizer" and **Understanding** (*Binah*). It is at the time of raising the "Simple Will" before Him, may He be blessed, to save and to reveal **Understanding** (*Binah*).

# Slice of the Pomegranate &nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 20: The Names &nbsp;&nbsp; Nectar of Pomegranates

The essence for eternity, both of them are **Tzevaot** <note>original: "צבאות", meaning "Hosts"</note> and no other. The word indicates plurality, because "Host" is not said of an individual. All its grammatical forms are shared to elevate their actions when "brothers dwell together" <note>A reference to Psalm 133:1, implying the unification of different divine forces</note>, such as "water channels," "two willow branches," and the like; and the Name of Four Letters <note>The Tetragrammaton, Y-H-V-H</note> and the Name of God <note>Elohim</note>...

### Chapter 9: Further

They are beneficial to them in the sense of being a "Throne" and a "Base"—this one for **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) and that one for **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*)—when they are unified by the **Foundation** (*Yesod*). As they said in the *Tikunim* <note>The Tikunei HaZohar, a classic Kabbalistic text</note>: "Come and see: Y-H-V-H and Adonai <note>The name for Lord</note> are the Holy One, Blessed be He, and His Shekhinah <note>The Divine Presence</note> in the two legs <note>The Sefirot of Netzach and Hod</note>." Y-H-V-H is to the right and Adonai is to the left, and they are the "Illuminating Mirror" and the "Non-Illuminating Mirror" in the **Righteous One** (*Tzadik*, a title for the Sefirah of Yesod) together; and it is written "My Lord" <note>original: "אדנויה" (Adonoya), a hybrid name combining Adonai and Y-H-V-H</note>.

It has already been explained that the two mirrors are the secret of "The face of Moses is like the face of the sun, and the face of Joshua is like the face of the moon." All prophecy is rooted in **Victory** (*Netzach*) and **Splendor** (*Hod*), the "Two True Prophets." Behold, in most places where the name "Y-H-V-H God" is found, it refers to **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) and **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*), or **Wisdom** (*Chokhmah*) and **Understanding** (*Binah*) according to their names. It is therefore appropriate to relate them for this reason to **Victory** (*Netzach*) and **Splendor** (*Hod*). The name **Adonai Tzevaot** [Lord of Hosts] is not related to Y-H-V-H because the name **Adonai** indicates the secret of Unity, as we already mentioned in the eighth gate; and **God** (*Elohim*) is in **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*) from the side of the Left, as previously stated.

In the portion of *Vayikra* <note>The Book of Leviticus</note> it says: "The seven [lamps] and the Menorah... and she prepared this **Tzevaot** [Hosts]." On this, Y-H-V-H is near to everything, brothers to all sides. Sometimes "Y-H-V-H God" appears because **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) is near to **Strength** (*Gevurah*); and sometimes "Y-H-V-H of Hosts" because **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) is near to **Victory** (*Netzach*) and **Splendor** (*Hod*), which are called "Hosts." It has been stated that the words of the faithful prophets are recognized by their mouths: when one says "Thus says Y-H-V-H God" and when one says "Thus says Y-H-V-H of Hosts," they knew from which place the words were coming. From the **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) which is called "Y-H-V-H of Hosts" when it connects to **Victory** and **Splendor**, we compare it to "God of Hosts," for **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*) is near to **Victory** and **Splendor** when she ascends above them. In the Zohar, it is proven that **Tzevaot** is also borrowed for **Beauty** (*Tiferet*), from which the influences and souls are drawn to **Victory** and **Splendor**. It is also borrowed for **Foundation** (*Yesod*), which reveals them below. This is clarified in the *Zohar on the Song of Songs* regarding **Foundation** (*Yesod*): "And because he brings forth radiant sparks and produces fruit, this radiance is called **Tzevaot**."

### Chapter 5: El

The connection of both of them is attributed to the **Foundation** (*Yesod*) for the reason mentioned in the first gate, tenth chapter. The author of *The Tent* explained that **Foundation** is called **El Chai** <note>Living God</note> because he draws Kindness (*Chesed*) and Life from all the upper attributes, through the power of **Understanding** (*Binah*) and **Greatness** (*Gedulah*), to the **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*). In the *Faithful Shepherd* <note>Ra'aya Mehemna, a section of the Zohar</note> it is proven that the name **Shaddai** <note>Almighty</note> is from the side of the World of Formation (*Yetzirah*), the Tree of Knowledge, which is in the angel Metatron; but from the side of Emanation (*Atzilut*), the Tree of Life, it is in the **Foundation** (*Yesod*). Furthermore, there the name **Shaddai** is attributed to **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*), and this is the language: "His Shekhinah is called **Mezuzah** <note>The scroll placed on doorposts</note> from the side of the Middle Pillar [Tiferet]... and from the side of the **Righteous One** (*Tzadik* / *Yesod*) she is called **Shaddai**; **Shaddai** is the wisdom of the King, which is Y-H-V-H." The intention is that in the aspect of her being the "Gate to Y-H-V-H," she is called *Mezuzah*; but when she is unified with the King's seal—the secret of the **Righteous One** and the Covenant of Circumcision, which draws the power of the Body upon her—she is called **Shaddai** like him. **Adonai** is attributed to **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*), and it is called the "Radiance of the Outer Keys."

<column-break/>

<gloss>She prepared through the three lines of Kindness, Judgment, and Mercy, which are the beginning of the ten Sefirot beneath her, and in this preparation she is called **Hannah** <note>original: חנה, interpreted as an acronym for Challah, Niddah, and Hadlakat HaNer—the three women's commandments</note>, which means she is a self-revelation like a "loaf" (*Challah*) which indicates the submission of the dough. And behold, in the unification of the ten days of the cycle with the preparation, which is the **Foundation** (*Yesod*), these two aspects are called the "Preparation of the Loaf" (*Hachanat HaChallah*):</gloss>

### Chapter 9: Further

<gloss>The name **Shaddai** in **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*) is the secret of the "Living Animal" (*Chaya*). For when the Tetragrammaton (Y-H-V-H) is prepared as a hint to the Divine Presence, it influences the four corners, which are the four elements. When it enters **Kingdom**, its anger is calmed, and it receives from the letter *Yod* (י), just as the life of the *Yod* of Kindness is for Understanding. Furthermore, the intention is to elevate the "Tablets" <note>The Ten Commandments/Law</note>, a sign from the encompassing light through the preparation. These are the Patriarchs—the three lines—the Shekhinah influences them and the **Kingdom** of Tablets that needs them. The reason for this being "Judgment" and "Mercy" is that when it is below in the world, it is the secret of Judgment, for from above the **Foundation** (*Yesod*) it is the letter *Yod* of God and it is Mercy. Furthermore, the letter *He* (ה) precedes the letter *Zayin* (ז) to show the revelation, for the Kindness comes before the seven days of the world's creation. For although the seven Sefirot are seven sides, they are not yet revealed. When it is revealed, it is revealed as four sides. The *He* precedes the *Zayin* to show that she stirs the ten in her glory through her preparation. This is what we wrote above: that **Kingdom** receives from the five corners, which is the letter *He* (ה), and these are from the side of the secret. There is no individual mention of any extra house in it, for she is stripped of her essence and the Sefirot remain.</gloss>

### Chapter 10: And There

<gloss>The number fourteen [Yad/Hand] is in the Crown (*Keter*), and one should intend for complete Mercy. What we mentioned in the words of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>original: "הרשב"י", the traditional author of the Zohar</note>, this Y-H-V-H is outside of its usual form... like the *Vav* (ו) of the body, and the *He* (ה) are the two mouths [openings]... this is when **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) receives from the influenced and prepared Crown. This is why it says the *Yod* (י) is the head of Kindness, which is **Wisdom** (*Chokhmah*), and it is Mercy. Therefore, one should not grasp the attribute of Judgment, but only in Kindness. The *Vav* is the body, which is **Beauty** (*Tiferet*). The "two mouths" indicate the two influences—that is, when **Beauty** receives from **Strength** (*Gevurah*), it influences Judgment and the **Kingdom** which performs the Judgment. But when unified, **Beauty** with her becomes all Mercy. This is the secret of the "Holy Unification" <note>original: "יחודא קדישא"</note>... Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai spoke of "Abraham and Isaac to Jacob," and the sign is "Fear Isaac"... and Mercy was aroused to preserve them. One should not turn his eyes to another [power]... for the letter *Yod* (י) of the name is the Male and the *He* (ה) is the Female... and one should look at her constantly as one looks at his wife to sustain her. This is to provide her with influence... just as one calls to his wife... and not to another. The meaning is that the main letters of the Name that reside in **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) are the letters *Yod-He-Vav*. The reason is that the *Yod* is hidden and is not manifested properly when it is a hint to the **Foundation** of the King, **Beauty**, to decide below on the right and also to decide above... as there is the unity of Kindness in Wisdom and the Sovereignty of Strength in Understanding. After he ascends in the secret of **Knowledge** (*Da'at*), he takes the "Fear of Isaac" and brings the letter *Lamed* (ל), meaning he is recognized and includes the two attributes of Kindness: one for Kindness in Wisdom to show its action, and one for Strength in Understanding. Therefore, he is called by the name **Y-H** (י"ה) when he decides between them...</gloss>

# Nectar of Pomegranates &nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 20: The Names &nbsp;&nbsp; Slice of the Pomegranate

Thus, he himself is called **V** <note>The letter Vav (ו), representing the central pillar of the Sephirot</note>, and he was within them in the secret of the "Third Line" <note>The middle path of the Sephirot tree</note> which is influenced by the **Crown** (*Keter*); therefore, he is depicted as a **V**. However, the "Last **H**" <note>The final letter He (ה) of the Name Y-H-V-H</note> is in the secret of her unification with the **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*). Because for this reason it was proper for him to be the **V** of the Name between the **Y** (*Yod*) and the **H** (*He*), it says: "She proceeds before them in the modest way of the world; thus it appears in the likeness of the arrangement of the letters of the Master of All" <note>original Aramaic: "ואזלא לקמייהו אורח צניעו דעלמא הכי אתחזי כגוונא דסדורא דאתוון דמארי כלא"</note> in the secret of the hidden Name of Four Letters <note>The Tetragrammaton</note> which includes all of Emanation, as previously mentioned. There, this path was necessary from what will be explained; it is proper, therefore, never to change the order. It is **the way** of the male to overpower with **Mercy** (*Rachamim*)—the **Y** over the **H**—to watch over her and bestow influence upon her in the secret of "Direct Light." This also removes from her any "suspicion," which is the secret of the <term>Husk (*Kelipah*)</term> of **Judgment** (*Gevurah*) below. This happens when the light from above returns in the secret of Justice—the **H** over the **Y**—and there will be no suffering in that path. For when the light of **Wisdom** (*Chokhmah*) withdraws and does not bestow upon **Understanding** (*Binah*), it returns empty toward the heights. This state is for him like "another woman" <note>A metaphor for an external or unholy influence</note>. It is also possible to say that when the supernal flow withdraws, returning because there is no place for it in the lower realms, it is then appropriate for it to rest upon him; then it is drawn down like the dross of refined metal below to a "strange well," even though Wisdom does not bestow life. Rather, it is the "hiding of the Face" that causes this.

### Bera <note>Likely a subheading or reference to the beginning of a section</note>

He proceeds before him. He said it is an "enclosure" for her, for when the name **Y-H-V-H** is joined, the "Evil Eye" is what causes the two messengers of the **Mother** (*Ima*) <note>The Sefirah of Binah</note> to act, and as is the law in the secret of "Her Kingdom," both of them are as previously mentioned—understand this. The "Watch" honors her so that the flow to her is not interrupted, and honors his Father in the secret of the **Divine Presence** (*Shekhinah*) in the lower worlds, which is a "high necessity"—understand this as well. He "guards his female," which is the **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*), and she requires extra guarding so that he does not look away from her for even a single moment, due to her proximity to the **Husks** (*Kelipot*). And this is the arrangement of the holy letters in every place in the secret of Direct Light and Mercy. **And in the Tikunim** <note>The Tikunei HaZohar</note>, they interpreted the letters of this honored **H** in various ways, here and there: like the head of a Leviathan being the **V**, the body being the **H**, and the two fins being the other **H**. Similarly, the **V** is the head of a bird, the **V** is the body of the bird, and the two **H**s are the two wings. Also, the **V** is the "stalk of the rose," and the two **H**s are five inner leaves and five outer leaves of its "apple" <note>The flower's bulb or center</note>. Likewise, the **V** is the body of the tree, the **H**s are the branches of the tree, and the fruit of the tree is the **V**, and so on. They elaborated on this at length; we have written the main point.

### Chapter 4: The Name [Tzevaot]

**Hosts** (*Tzevaot*) is shared by **Victory** (*Netzach*) and **Splendor** (*Hod*), as explained in the Zohar. Our choice for the name comes from the **V**, hinting at **Victory**, and the term **Hosts** (*Tzevaot*) for **Splendor**. The commentators gave a reason for this: because Victory tends toward **Kindness** (*Chesed*) and Splendor toward **Judgment** (*Din*), as is well known. They said that the upper and lower hosts are drawn from them. According to their words, it is difficult to understand why Victory is not called "God of Hosts" (*El Tzevaot*) after the name of Kindness, just as Splendor is called after the name of Fear (*Pachad*). It is not enough to answer by saying that **El** is always for Mercy, but **Elohim** contains both Judgment and Mercy, as seen above. Since Victory and Kindness are blended, it would not be accurate to use a name for either that is entirely Judgment or Mercy, for even **El** "rages a little" as we mentioned in Chapter 2, and he is sealed with the name of **Gabriel**, the angel of Judgment. **However**, the truth is that the essential Name...

### Chapter 6: And in the Zohar

Regarding the *Song of Songs*, because of the name of the **Sefirah**, and likewise for the "beams," for "flowing waters" <note>original: "נוזלות", a reference to Song of Songs 4:15</note> are from the "womb." The tablets are in **Kindness** (*Chesed*), for all the tablets are branches of the seven Sefirot. And the tablets of Kindness... <note>The OCR here becomes highly fragmented and cryptic, using abbreviations for divine attributes</note> in Kindness. And our Sages said that these "flowing waters" in Kindness include all the tablets within them. And it is in Kindness... the "Voice" (*Kol*) is the beginning of the expansion of the tablets and the branches... twenty signatures in their purity... the Voice is the fifth nest... for there are twenty signatures/seals of the Sefirot... and in every Sefirah there are fifty signatures more... and the inclusion of them all indicates the unification of Kindness, Judgment, and Mercy. And all this is in Kindness, especially in the inclusion of the "Voice," the beginning of the expansion of the tablets and the branches... their expansion is from Kindness. And we claim "Voice" (*Kol*) because they were thirty-four... the "Voice of Kindness." And the letter **Y** (*Yod*) at every beginning of a "Voice" is chosen, and the voice of the soul... for the "life of the pomegranate" <note>original: "חיר ירמון"</note> refers to the three loves... for their life is to give them life... in three **Y**s... for Kindness alone is "Voice" (**Y**), and Judgment alone is "Voice" (**Y-V**), and the "Voice of the Walking" refers to two **Y**s. The Voice indicates their sound... the Voice in the Sefirah that benefits... Kindness... that is the unification of the "Five Hundred"... the "thorn in the lower" which is the Kingdom (*Malkhut*). And the upper **Y** is the **Understanding** (*Binah*) with fifty mercies... a hand for good things for the world and the "Elder" below... hinting at fifty mercies... and it was explained that the power of the "Voice" in Kindness... indicates the place where they are received, the "Lower Binah"... which is able to divide... Binah is called so after its name "Divider" and "Hoverer" over the "Five Hundred" which is called "Power"... and it is proven in the inclusion of Kindness... and furthermore, there is a "Living Thing" in the female... the purity of the unification included in its branches.

### Chapter 7: There

**God** (*Elohim*) is in **Judgment** (*Gevurah*), as mentioned in the Zohar on *Song of Songs*... and the explanation there is that this name is **Judgment**, the awakening of the Supernal Union through the unification of the **Husks** (*Kelipot*) mentioned, and this is in the secret of the "Sweetened Judgment"... the awakening of the Righteous One (*Tzadik*). And the explanation of the **H** is male and Mercy. And the **Y-S** <note>Yod-Samekh</note> is the "Covenant" (*Milah*) that awakens the good union with complete compassion... through good deeds, etc. Generally, it hints there that **Elohim** is in the overpowering [of judgment]... and it will bestow upon her the last **Y-S**, which is **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*). And through this, the **Judgment** (*Gevurah*) is called the name **Elohim**, meaning Kindness and the **H** of the Kingdom.

And in the "Second Binah," it was at the time when the "Simple Will" arose before Him, may He be blessed, to feed and to reveal the **Understanding** (*Binah*)...

# Slice of the Pomegranate &nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 20: The Names &nbsp;&nbsp; Nectar of Pomegranates

As is heard there, for the prophet Habakkuk said: "Lord, I have heard the report of You and I was afraid" <note>Habakkuk 3:2</note>. And this refers to the space and the hidden places surrounding and encompassing the **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) <note>The central Sephirah representing balance and harmony</note> and the **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*) <note>The final Sephirah representing the physical manifest world</note>, for the establishment of the throne of the "men of truth" <note>Exodus 18:21</note> is from the side of the spirit of the "pleasing aroma to the Lord" <note>Numbers 15:3</note> in the "nose," and those who "hate unjust gain" <note>Exodus 18:21</note> correspond to **Beauty** (*Tiferet*), while the "voice" corresponds to **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*). The fourth aspect is the "First Man" <note>Adam Kadmon</note> who combined greatness and was honored with strength like a crown through the rectifications, and it is not to be diminished. According to this, it is fitting to "set over them rulers of thousands" <note>Exodus 18:21</note> from the side of the letter **Aleph** <note>numerical value 1,000 in this context</note>; "rulers of hundreds" from the side of the letter **Qoph** <note>numerical value 100</note> as the "voice" is to the "Lord" <note>original: אדנ"י (Adonai)</note> because they are all the **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*), for it is said that in the **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*) there are four hundred years <note>Genesis 15:13</note> that Israel was enslaved in Egypt in exile, to represent the ruler. Thus, the intended goal reaches **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) at times when it is rectified. And so it is called also, for example: *El Elohim Y-H-V-H* or *Elohim El Y-H-V-H* and the like; it indicates the union of the **Attributes** (*Middot*) according to the need of the influence. This is not the place to be lengthy.

## Chapter 13: And God
->Sing joyfully in the **Foundation** (*Yesod*); the small **Yod** <note>The smallest letter of the Hebrew alphabet, often representing a point of divine energy</note> will be born there<-
->From the greatness which is the name **El**, and the first drop from the **Divine Presence** (*Shekhinah*)<-

Which is the "Living God" (*Elohim Chayyim*) below towards the **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*). Also, the name **Shaddai** is in the **Foundation** (*Yesod*) because of what is below; and today **Metatron** <note>The highest archangel in Kabbalistic thought</note> is in the **Foundation** (*Yesod*) as our master, the **Prince** (*Sar*). And the name **Lord** (*Adonai*) is in the **Kingdom** (*Malkhut*), indicating that the dominion and influence are through the power of the Name which dwells within it, which is the "Will" and the "Temple" (*Heikhal*). For the name **Lord** (*Adonai*) and the word **Temple** (*Heikhal*) have the same <term>numerical value (Gematria)</term> <note>Both sum to 65</note>. Its letters testify to His dominion: **A** (*Aleph*) is the secret of the Master (*Aluph*); **D** (*Dalet*) is the secret of the poor (*Dal*); **N** (*Nun*) is the secret of the "Fiftieth Gate" of understanding; **Y** (*Yod*) is the secret of the **Foundation** (*Yesod*). The name **Lord** (*Adonai*) is the secret of all types of influence, forces, and the existence of all created things in the world. Everything is in the hand of the **Lord** (*Adonai*), as she receives influence from above and bestows it below. Furthermore, the letters of the Name indicate the first from the bottom to the top and the secret from the top to the bottom.
