## Gate Twenty-One: Details of the Names

<columns>2</columns>

### Chapter 1: The Great and Mighty Holy Names Mentioned in the Chapters of the Palaces and the Chariot

The names mentioned in the *Hekhalot* <note>Palaces</note> and *Merkavah* <note>Chariot</note> literature and their elevations are very great, even though the words are not understood by our weakened intellects. They are branches attached to the roots of the names that are not erased. They were revealed from Sinai to the elders and prophets through their wisdom, and to the Tannaic and Amoraic sages <note>The rabbis of the Mishnah and Talmud</note> who were pure of mind and clear of understanding. Their souls were pure and clear, isolating themselves to contemplate the path of the letters and the spirituality clothed within them. Through this, they recognized the connection of the worlds to know the glory of the majesty of the **Kingdom of Heaven**. But we, through our sins, have toiled and found no rest to contemplate the plain meaning of things in their inner depth. **The Geonim** <note>The leaders of the Babylonian academies, c. 600-1000 CE</note> and their students, who were always men of renown, hid the "Great Usage" (*Shimmusha Rabba*) and the "Lesser Usage" (*Shimmusha Zuta*) <note>Manuals for theurgical use of Divine Names</note> that they possessed, fearing lest an unworthy person might learn and use the names and be found destroying the world. The truth is that all letters depend on the **Name of Four Letters** (*Y-H-V-H*) to the point that some were even formed in its secret. For example, the letter **Aleph** (א) is two **Yods** and one **Vav**; their total is 26 <note>matching the value of Y-H-V-H</note>. Likewise, the letter **Lamed** (ל) is formed of a **Vav** over a **Kaf**. The letter **Teth** (ט) is similar, as is the **Qoph** (ק). Therefore, all the alphabets are joined with the letters of the Name. The secret of the <term>vowel points (Nekudot)</term> is very great; one must join every combination of one letter of the Name and one letter of the Alphabet with all the vowel points that can be carried, forward and backward, to unify all the branches in the Supernal Source to draw nourishment from it.

### The Kabbalists disagreed if we should combine only the five vowels

Which are an acronym, and every combination of two letters will comprise 25 gates forward and 25 gates backward; or if you should join the **Sheva** <note>a vowel representing a neutral or 'null' sound</note> as well, for it is a group unto itself, intermediate between the *Patach* and the *Segol*.

<column-break/>

### Chapter 1: On the Explanation of the Names of 42, 22, 12, and 72 letters mentioned in the Zohar and Other

Kabbalistic books: Know that all the letters are dependent on the **Name of Four Letters** (*Y-H-V-H*), to the point that even the shapes of the letters are derived from it. For example, the letter **Qoph** (ק) is a **Kaf** and a **Yod**, or two **Vavs** and a **Yod**, which sum to 26 <note>numerical value of Y-H-V-H</note>. Similar patterns exist in the rest of the letters. This concept hints at the transposition of the *Atbash* <note>a cipher where the first letter is replaced by the last, second by second-to-last, etc.</note> alphabet with the Name of Four Letters, to refine the purification and return things to their source, to draw influence upon them from the Supernal Source. It is known that spiritual and intellectual things were divided according to their source, and the refinement testifies to this, as explained in Gate: The Name of Four Letters, Chapter 1. Therefore, one should join a letter of the Name with a letter of the Alphabet and their hidden aspects with all the vowel points that can be carried, so that all the particular and general sources may be influenced by the Source. Regarding the method of combination, the Kabbalists disagreed. Some say they are only combined by the five motions <note>vowels</note>... and with this, when we join the letters with all the letters of the Name, and every combination is joined with all the aforementioned vowels, it will total 25 words forward and 25 words backward. Others say that the letters are combined with the aforementioned vowels, which are the five vowels *A, E, I, O, U* <note>Kamatz, Tzeirei, Chiriq, Cholam, Shuruq</note>. And when a letter is joined with each letter of the Name, and each of the combinations is joined with each of the vowels, including the "composite" vowels, the total combination of the Name will reach 1,080, as written by the author of *Ma'arekhet Elokim Chayyim*.

### Chapter 2: Which states that the combination of the Name of Four Letters with every single letter

of the Alphabet with the known vowel points is necessary. Through this calculation, the total will reach 1,080, corresponding to the "parts" <term>Chalakim</term> <note>the 1,080 divisions of an hour used in Hebrew calendrical calculations</note>...

### Chapter 2: It is Taught
In the **Book of Brilliance** (*Sefer HaBahir*) <note>One of the earliest and most important Kabbalistic texts</note>, Rabbi Amora sat and expounded: "They shall crown You"—this teaches that the Holy One, Blessed be He, has **72 Names**, and they are all fixed within the Tribes. Six names are on one stone, and the names of the remaining six are on the second stone. It is written: **"And the stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve"** <note>Exodus 28:21</note>. Just as these "stones of memorial" are twelve stones, they correspond to the 72, which in turn correspond to the 72 Names of the Holy One, Blessed be He. 

Why did he start with twelve? To teach you that the Holy One, Blessed be He, has **twelve Leaders**, and within each one are six [names], etc. And what are they? They are the **72 Languages**. The Holy One, Blessed be He, has one **Tree**, etc., with **twelve diagonal boundaries**:
*   The North-East boundary
*   The South-East boundary

*   The Lower-East boundary
*   The North-West boundary
*   The South-West boundary
*   The Upper-West boundary
*   The Lower-West boundary
*   The Upper-North boundary
*   The Lower-North boundary
*   The Upper-South boundary
*   The Lower-South boundary

These expand and go on forever; they are the "Arms of the World." Within them is the Tree. Up to here is the order of the praise of the Place <note>A common Rabbinic name for God</note>. It hints at three levels called: **Sky, Sphere, and Heart** <note>Original: "שמים תלי גלגל ולב". Technical terms from *Sefer Yetzirah* describing the structure of the universe, the zodiac/celestial dragon, and the human center</note>. The Tribes (peace be upon them) were a **Chariot** (*Merkavah*) for twelve upper forms found in the **Emanations** (*Sephirot*). Corresponding to them, Jacob took twelve of the "stones of the place" and they became **one stone** at his head, due to the intensity of their unity. Just as the two stones of the *Ephod* <note>The High Priest's shoulder cape</note> were engraved with six names on each, so too were the twelve stones of the Breastplate. Indeed, this aforementioned Tree is discerned through twelve boundaries, patterned after the parts of the felt body, which when joined, form a complete Tree in action. We consider it a perfect square to simplify the visualization and to project the truth of the intended balance.

### Chapter 5: Further
Rabbi Nehunia ben HaKanah attributed the **72** [Names] which are divided into **72 Streams**. Each river has its own unique name. They consist of **9 letters** derived from the verses "And he traveled," "And he came," "And he stretched," each of which has 72 letters. They include a letter of **Kindness** (*Chesed*) from each verse and combine them together to form a Name of Kindness, *A-L-A*, from the first verse of Kindness—the secret of Kindness. 

From the second verse—the secret of **Fear** (*Chet* - referring to *Gevurah*)—they begin taking letters from the start of the verse in direct order, joining them one by one. From the second verse—the secret of **Power** (*Gevurah*)—they begin taking the letters from the **end** of the verse, joining them in reverse order. All of them are the 72 Names. 

This Name is aligned like a reed (*Kaneh*); once it is included, the power of **Wisdom** is included from the start. Therefore, each of its nine letters—*A-L-A*, *Arachon*, etc.—is joined from the foundation, which is the "Pillar of Kindness." This is why he started with twelve, to teach you the twelve of Kindness and the five "Arms" of **Power** (*Gevurah*). Therefore, they are joined in reverse, which is the way of **Judgment** (*Din*). The letters of Power are placed in the **middle** so that they may be contained between Kindness and Mercy to sweeten their power, following the secret of the Shofar sounds: *Tekiah* (Simple), *Teruah* (Broken), *Tekiah* (Simple) <note>Kindness-Judgment-Kindness. In Kabbalah, the broken sound of the Teruah is "sweetened" or surrounded by the whole sounds of the Tekiah</note>. 

The 72 Names further spread into 228 branches... their total count is like the numerical value of "Judgment" (*Diyan*). In general, they equal 72, but in detail, the letters equal **216**, which is the numerical value of **Power** (*Gevurah*). According to this, the Name includes Kindness... the verses are like the form of a **Tree**. The verse, which is a collection of letters, is like a **Great Branch** spreading from the trunk of the Tree. The words, which are collections of letters, are like **Small Branches** spreading from the large ones. The letters themselves are the **Leaves** spreading from the small branches. 

The inner body is the core. That which is carved from it is its **Garment**. Thus, the entire Torah is like the "beast" <note>Perhaps referring to the living structure or "body"</note> of the Sephirot. The general introduction is the pattern for the verses; the verses are for the words; the words are for the letters. These receive from those, and these clothe those. The letters are **Judgment** because they spread from the "Smoke of the Altar" of Power. The branches are clothed in Power, for one rises to the other and one descends from the other; this one provides strength to that one, and that one provides holiness to this one.

### Chapter 3: An Investigation of the Ancients and an Explanation of Certain Matters Regarding the Names

# Nectar of Pomegranates &nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 21: Details of the Names &nbsp;&nbsp; Slice of the Pomegranate

...that the form of all existences may live and resemble the Higher One. Just as the soul of God directs the entirety of existence, so too does every man lead all the powers of his soul. After death, as our Sages interpreted—regarding the lowest level of the soul that dwells near the body from the verse "and his soul mourns over him"—it <note>the soul</note> does not perform any action there, for it is withheld from the flow of the Intellect. Likewise, whoever among the "holy ones" <note>prophets or masters of names</note> created a "prophet" <note>likely referring to a Golem or an artificial life form</note>, the men of power could not succeed in drawing the "Speaking Power" <note>the faculty of human speech and reason</note> into it. 

Some scribes join the Names of 72 and 42 and their companions to their supernal sources. There are those who join the letter *Aleph* with the *Gimel* <note>original: א' בג'</note> between the three "Airs" <note>original: *avirin*, referring to the spaces/vowels</note> within the letters of the Name of Being <note>The Tetragrammaton, YHWH</note>; and likewise the sequence *Yatz* <note>the second triplet of the 42-letter name</note> until the completion of the 42-letter Name. Some arrange the letters *Abg* <note>first triplet</note> on one side, *Yatz* on the other, and the Name of Being in the middle, and so on for all of them. 

Regarding the 72 Names derived from the verses "And he journeyed," "And he came," and "And he stretched out" <note>original: *Vayissa, Vayavo, Vayet* (Exodus 14:19-21)</note>, some join them with the three "Airs" of the Name of Being; others join them with the Name *Ehyeh* <note>I Shall Be</note>. Others add the Name *El* after every three letters. They learned this from the verse "Behold, the Lord of Hosts" <note>original: *Hineh Shel Malchei Tzeva'ot*</note>, using the acronym **Argaman** <note>an acronym for the archangels Uriel, Raphael, Gabriel, Michael, and Nuriel</note>, in addition to the well-known reason that these are the Names of **Lovingkindness** <note>original: *Chesed*</note>, which has a numerical value <note>gematria</note> of **72**. The name *El* is associated with the attribute of Lovingkindness, as is known. From here on, one should examine the book *Pardes* <note>The Orchard of Pomegranates, the primary work of Rabbi Moses Cordovero</note> with love and affection, for there are many great and honorable chapters in this Gate that need not be copied here; it is better for us to omit them out of the awe and honor we owe to the Awesome Names brought there.

## Chapter 2: It is Taught
->In the *Sefer HaBahir* <note>The Book of Brilliance, an early Kabbalistic text</note>, Rabbi Amora sat and taught:<-
->What is meant by the verse, "The heavens and the heavens of heavens cannot<-
contain You"? This teaches us that the Holy One, Blessed be He, has 72 Names, and all of them are fixed within the Tribes <note>the 12 tribes of Israel</note>: six of their names on one stone, and the remaining six names on the second stone. It is written: "And the stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve." This compares them: just as those stones of remembrance are for the twelve tribes, they are 72, corresponding to the 72 Names of the Holy One, Blessed be He. 

And for what reason did He begin with twelve? To teach you that the Holy One, Blessed be He, has twelve "Leaders" <note>directing forces</note>, and in each one there are six powers. And what are they? The 72 languages. The Holy One, Blessed be He, has a single **Tree**, and in it are twelve **Diagonal Boundaries** <note>The dimensions of space according to the *Sefer Yetzirah*</note>: the Eastern-Northern boundary, the Eastern-Southern boundary, the Eastern-Upper boundary, the Eastern-Lower boundary, the Western-Northern boundary, the Western-Southern boundary, the Western-Upper boundary, the Western-Lower boundary, the Northern-Upper boundary, the Northern-Lower boundary, the Southern-Upper boundary, and the Southern-Lower boundary. These extend and go on forever; they are the "Arms of the World," and within them is the Tree. This is the secret of the "Praise of the Place" <note>God</note> at the beginning. 

In it is a hint to the three levels called "Heavens," the "Teli" <note>the celestial pole or dragon</note>, the "Sphere," and the "Heart," which is bristling and clustered. The Tribes <note>may their souls rest in peace</note> were a **Chariot** for the twelve supernal forms found in the *Sephirot* <note>Divine emanations</note>, as we shall explain. Correspondingly, Jacob took twelve stones from the place and they became a single stone at his head, due to the intensity of their unity. Just as the two stones of the *Ephod* <note>priestly vest</note> were engraved with six names on each, so too were the twelve stones of the *Choshen* <note>Breastplate</note>. Indeed, the aforementioned Tree was identified by twelve boundaries, modeled after the parts of the physical body which, when joined, create a functional peace. We shall consider it as a perfect square to simplify the visualization and to apply the cubit of alignment.
->The Intended<-

<column-break/>

Lights, which are the source, are the 32 Paths [of Wisdom]. The power of Glory is like *Katbach* and *Kotz* <note>cryptic letter permutations</note> to show that they are included in Lovingkindness and Judgment. The word "Thorn" (*Kotz*) is used in the sense of a thorn that enters and cuts the curtains, as mentioned above; it is judged through prophecy.

## Chapter 4: Further
->Rabbi Moses shall explain, for according to the number, so is the Holy One, Blessed be He (may his memory be a blessing), regarding the three expanses<-

The explanation of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai (may his memory be a blessing): YHWH-Parts, etc. YHWH, "His right hand," "The Great Hand," etc. within them, etc. And it can be said that he divided it into seven further [parts] that will arise in the words of the Kabbalists (may their memory be a blessing), for from this Name branches extend, and they are like the number of its tablets. They are as written: The wind of *Rabbach*, and *Karihal*, the wind of *Atchal*, the wind of *Ba'archahal*, the wind of *Machyiel*, the wind of *V'achihal*, the wind of *Bochakihal*, the wind of *Porihal*, the wind of *Caspihal*, the wind of *Daniel*, the wind of *Vatrihal*, the wind of *Umalihaal*—end of the winds.

## Chapter 5: Further
->Rabbi Moses shall explain likewise: The Holy One, Blessed be He (may his memory be a blessing), with this, thus far.<-
->That which is divided is split into 72 branches, and each of the 72<-
has its own name. This name is derived from the verses "And he journeyed," "And he came," and "And he stretched out," for in each act of Lovingkindness there are 72 letters. We take one letter from each verse and establish them with another to form one name. However, the first verse represents Lovingkindness (*Chesed*), and the second verse is the secret of *Katam* <note>likely a reference to *Gevurah* or "concealed" power</note>; they begin taking letters from the beginning of the verse and go on taking "first-last, last-first." But in the **Menorah** <note>the seven-branched candelabra</note>, they begin taking letters and they add, and they take them in reverse, from the end. These are the 72 names mentioned above. Since we have included it in the Menorah-form, the aforementioned Name is called "The Sustenance of All Souls." 

Therefore, every set of five letters out of the twelve is like the first, resembling Strength (*Gevurah*), the aforementioned Name *Katam*. Thus they take them in the secret of the "Straight Path," which is the order of Lovingkindness, for Lovingkindness is spread out simply toward Lovingkindness. The middle letters resemble Strength (*Gevurah*), and therefore they take them in reverse, which is the secret of Judgment (*Din*). The letters of the middle *Gevurah* come so that they are included between Lovingkindness and Compassion to sustain the "Pulse" <note>divine life-beat</note> in the secret of the *Tekiah-Teruah-Tekiah* <note>the pattern of Shofar blasts</note>. And so His name is for him "South" or "Hi-Havayah" Lovingkindness. Furthermore, 22 Names shall spread out, included like *Kalach* or the Strength; they shall return among the whole, a hint in the Strength in the 43rd [gate] of the 7th foundation, the Name of the Chariot—meaning, in the inclusion of the "Established Middle," the Name resembles 72, the numerical value of Lovingkindness, but in its details it resembles Strength, the Name of 216 letters in the "Judgment" of Strength. 

According to this, the Name as a whole is Lovingkindness, the secret of the construction of the verses. They shall be like the image of a single **Tree**: the verse itself is the structure of the words, like a large branch splitting off from the branches of its tree; the verse is the structure of the letters, in the likeness of small branches extending from the large ones; and the letters are like leaves extending from the small branches. And that which is internal—take the Heavens, the Spirit that flows from it and not its strength—it is called by the name "Tree." Likewise, in the revelation of the Torah, it is like the soul of **Atzilut** <note>the world of Emanation/Proximity to God</note>. Its totality is the *Pascat* <note>curtain/division</note>, when the verses and their totality are in the words, and the totality of words are in the letters of the Tree, and they shall receive and return and begin and be blessed from His own. 

According to this, there is no difficulty in what is written regarding the Attributes of Mercy: the 216 letters are the "selection" of letters, meaning those that spread from Lovingkindness into Strength. And now the Name is praised through goodness, for this one rises to that one, and that one rises from this one, and everything is unified—and these are the "shells" <note>outer layers</note> of everything.

# Nectar of Pomegranates &nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 51: Details of the Names &nbsp;&nbsp; Slice of the Pomegranate

<margin>
The reason for 1,080 <note>original: "Ttr'p" - The number of "parts" (halakim) in a Hebrew hour. 1,080 parts equals 60 minutes.</note>: The power of the letter *Heh* with *Heh*, *Yod* with *Yod*, and *Chet* with *Kof* <note>Chet=8, Kof=100</note> is pointed as such. There is the letter *Vav* and a system for three groups of the array, and their number is 326. And *Chet, Kaf, Yod, Vav, Gimel*—this also equals 1,080 as is known. For the 112 <term>Havayot</term><note>Forms of the Name of Being, YHWH</note> of the "Star" <note>the planet Mercury/Kokhav</note> rotate in 112 steps to 1,080. There is also an error here <unclear>Kys</unclear>... and the exchange is at the end. Thus for every 112 forms, there are 13 units of 1,080 "faces" and 13 units of 1,080 "backwards." It shall be established as 12 steps of 1,080 for the 12 hours of the night.
</margin>

Regarding the <term>Segol</term> <note>a vowel mark consisting of three dots like an inverted triangle</note>, although we are not experts in it, its "gates" consist of 36 "faces" <note>forward permutations</note> and 36 "backs" <note>backward permutations</note>. The previous logic belongs to the author of the *Book of Pointing* <note>Sefer ha-Nikud</note>, and his words are transcribed in that book—let it be examined there. **The second** logic belongs to the author of *Divine Systems* <note>Ma'arkhot Elohim</note>, who wrote that there were permutations of the letter *Aleph* with *Yod*. Just as there are 36 in the rotation of the six vowel points we mentioned, so it is with the *Heh*, with the *Vav*, and with the second *Heh* <note>the four letters of the Tetragrammaton: Y-H-W-H</note>. Four times 36 are the "Ancient of His works from of old" <note>a play on Proverbs 8:22</note>, from the "Dwelling place of the God of old" <note>Deuteronomy 33:27</note>.

And behold, the 36 permutations of *Aleph-Yod* <note>A-Y</note> equal 396 in <term>gematria</term> <note>Hebrew numerology</note>; those of *Aleph-Heh* <note>A-H</note> equal 210; those of *Aleph-Vav* <note>A-V</note> equal 252; and the second *Aleph-Heh* <note>A-H</note> equals 210. The sum of them all is 1,080 <note>original: "Ttr'p" — though the math provided (396+210+252+210) equals 1,068, the text identifies the total as the significant 1,080 parts of the hour</note>. Similarly, there are 36 "Forms" <note>Havayot</note> that govern the 12 hours of the day in the secret of the "Inner Gates," and corresponding to them are the "Outer Gates" for the 12 Forms that govern the 12 hours of the night. For every single hour is comprised of "times" and "moments" within the inclusion of the Name. These are the secret of "Do not turn to idols" <note>Leviticus 19:4</note>—meaning, do not turn away from your own knowledge to chat or reflect on idle matters even for a moment. It is a commandment to think of the love of Heaven and the awe of Him while sitting, walking, lying down, and rising—which encompass all human speech in four activities, armed with the four letters of the Name. 

Just as we hinted regarding the letter *Aleph*, so should it be examined for all other letters. I calculate 144 permutations for the 22 letters, their number being 3,168. There are 231 "Gates" <note>combinations of two letters</note> in "Face" <note>direct order</note> explained in the *Book of Formation* <note>Sefer Yetzirah</note>. When you multiply them by the number we mentioned, they reach a great sum. Corresponding to them are the 231 "Gates" in "Back" <note>reverse order</note>, and from these, all languages rotate.

There is a great division in the <term>Nikudim</term> <note>vowel points</note> between the Angels and the Hebrews, and likewise between the simple and the quickened movements <note>vowels</note>. The number of them all together is 12 vowel points: <term>Kamatz</term>, <term>Patach</term>, <term>Tzere</term>, <term>Segol</term>, <term>Cholam</term>, <term>Chirik</term>, <term>Shuruk</term>, <term>Melafem</term>, <term>Sheva</term>, <term>Chataf-Kamatz</term>, <term>Chataf-Patach</term>, and <term>Chataf-Segol</term>. When we combine 12 with 36, they are the "Ancient of His works from of old." There is indeed a "Front Ancient" and a "Back Ancient" for the *Aleph* with *Yod*, and *Aleph* with *Heh*, and so for all four. By this rule, the letter *Lamed-Vav* <note>L-V</note> with all of them, and *Gimel* with all of them until their completion—go and calculate what the mouth cannot speak!

**However**, we have seen all the masters of vowel pointing agree with the first logic. Based on that secret, they drew the Name of "And he turned this way and that" <note>Exodus 2:12</note>... and <term>Rashbi</term> <note>Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, traditional author of the Zohar</note>, peace be upon him, gave signs for five great movements: "The openings of a seal" <note>Exodus 28:11</note>. He explained that these are the [Sephirot of] Greatness (Chesed), Strength (Gevurah), and Beauty (Tiferet) which includes Foundation (Yesod) and Sovereignty (Malkhut), and Victory (Netzach) and Splendor (Hod). Those who follow the second logic also saw among them the commentators of the *Book of Formation* regarding the creation of man, through the crowning of the letters over every single limb. Some said that the 36 movements of the <term>Lulav</term> <note>ritual palm branch</note> were based on the secret of the six combined vowel points.

**And in the Rectifications** <note>Tikkunei Zohar</note> they said: The <term>Sephirot</term> <note>divine emanations</note>, even though they are all holy names, were made like a covering for one another. For example, a son must serve his father and his mother and act as a limb for them, like a servant and a minister, placed in the middle beneath them. So it is with the Sephirot, one to another. Because of this, there is a "King" point and a "Servant" point to the King. For example, the <term>Sheva</term> vowel is a servant to the <term>Kamatz</term>; it runs on its mission and is moved after it, but in its own place, it is a king. **The rule of the matter**: The Holy One, blessed be He, and His House of Judgment were counted over every limb in man and established him on his base...

# Slice of the Pomegranate &nbsp;&nbsp; Gate 51: Details of the Names &nbsp;&nbsp; Nectar of Pomegranates

In the majesty of <term>Gevurah</term><note>The Sefirah of Strength or Judgment</note> within <term>Netzach</term><note>The Sefirah of Victory or Endurance</note>, from the South-East to the North-West; <term>Tiferet</term><note>The Sefirah of Beauty or Balance</note> leans toward <term>Chesed</term><note>Loving-kindness</note>, and the "Living One of the Worlds" <note>A title for the Sefirah of Yesod, the Foundation</note> inclines toward the Left.

# Clarification
From this, it is clear that the Tree <note>The Sefirotic Tree of Life</note> is the single root from which the holy souls are quarried. Its distances are three: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Together with their pairings <note>their female counterparts/Sefirot</note> and their rotations, they constitute the "Six Extremities" <note>The six emotional Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</note> and the twelve Tribes. Just as there were six sons of Leah who included six others—as stated in the **Zohar**—so too is the totality of the Tribes, which are the twelve diagonal boundaries. For all of them, there are two points on the sides; thus the foundation is twenty-four. Each point has three potential distances, making the specific count seventy-two. This is the secret of the "seventy souls that went with Jacob" and his width and height reaching toward the Matronita <note>The Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note>. Corresponding to them are the seventy Elders, with Moses presiding over them. "God <note>Elohim</note> stands in the congregation of God <note>El</note>," and there are seventy faces to the Torah, which depend on the two Torahs: the Written and the Oral. These twenty-four points are the eight "knots" at the four ends that stand straight in the corners. The secret of the name **"Ahdonay"** <note>A mystical spelling or combination of the name Lordship</note> includes Kindness, Judgment, and Compassion. It is unified by the Four-Letter Name <note>the Tetragrammaton, YHWH</note>, "each man by his hand at their feet," for the Chariot <note>the Merkavah</note> is the primary structure. Height and depth are attached to these, of which it is written: "and all their hinder parts were inward."

### Chapter 3: Further
They said there: in all these diagonals, there are corresponding officials, and they number twelve. Also, within the sphere <note>Galgal</note>, there are twelve officials. These are thirty-six officials along with the diagonals, and each one has another above it, as it is written: "For one high official watches over another." Thus, for the East wind there are nine, for the West wind nine, for the North wind nine, and for the South wind nine. This equals twelve and twelve and twelve, which are the officials in the two spheres and the thirty-two mentioned above. All of them are thirty-six; one is more praised than the other. Even though there are twelve in each of the three, they are all distinct from one another. All the thirty merits found in the first—which is the <term>Teli</term><note>The "Celestial Dragon," a cosmic axis in ancient Jewish cosmology</note>—if you seek them in the Sphere <note>Galgal</note>, you will find they are the same. Likewise, if you seek them in the Heart <note>Lev</note>, you will find them there. Therefore, each has twelve, found in the three mentioned above, and they revolve in a cycle. Thus, the power of each is within the other, and each has thirty-six. All of them are no more than thirty-six forms, and all are completed in the thirty-two <note>referring to the 32 Paths of Wisdom</note>.

# Transmission
Transmitted in the "heart of hearts" <note>Hebrew: Lev Levav, punning on the numerical value of Lev (32), totaling 64</note> and for the others, sixty-four. These are the sixty-four forms. How do we know they were delivered to the "heart of hearts"? Because it is written, "For one high official watches over another." If so, this is sixty-four—lacking eight to reach the seventy-two names of the Holy One, Blessed be He. This is why it is written "and there are higher ones over them." These are the days of the week, lacking one <note>the Sabbath</note>. And what is the "advantage of the place" from which the earth was quarried? It is the advantage over what previously existed. And what is this? It is the "advantage of every thing" in the world: when the people of the world are worthy to receive from its radiance, then it is an "advantage." And what is it? The stone from which the heavens were carved, which is the Throne of the Holy One, Blessed be He. It is a precious stone; it is the Sea of Wisdom. Corresponding to it is the blue thread <note>Tekhelet</note> of the prayer tassels <note>Tzitzit</note>. For Rabbi Meir said: "Why is blue different from all other colors? Because blue resembles the sea, and the sea resembles the sky, and the sky resembles the Throne of Glory," as it is said: "And they saw the God of Israel, and under His feet was like a work of sapphire brick, like the essence of heaven for purity," and it says, "Like the appearance of a sapphire stone was the likeness of the throne." He said that these three existences—the Teli, the Sphere, and the Heart—which will be explained later, each includes thirty-six boundaries through the power of its companions.

For each of its four letters and twenty-four names from the twenty-four permutations, they are "clothed" in eight boundaries and divided among the boundaries. Because of the permutations, the <term>Malchut</term><note>Kingdom/Kingship, the final Sefirah</note> is doubled, because the entire aspect of Malchut is like the measure of the standing structure, similar to <term>Tiferet</term>. Malchut is the letter *Yod* and the *Tav* is the measure relative to the *Yod*. Thus there are twelve males and twelve females; these are the influencers and those are the receivers.

### Chapter 6: And After
Having explained this introduction, we shall proceed to explain some of the matters regarding the "twelve [boundaries] of the twelve." Primarily, this concerns the dispute between Rabbi Meir and Rabbi Yose <note>referring to a classic Rabbinic debate regarding the layout of the tribes or the directions of the world</note>. To understand the matter, one must know that for the distinct foundation and the division, there is a basis in the **Six Extremities** <note>the six spatial directions: Up, Down, North, South, East, West, representing the six emotional Sefirot</note>. These extremities are: Up, Down, and the four winds <note>directions</note> of the world.
- **Up** alludes to the **Crown** <note>Keter</note>.
- **East** <note>original: צד, literally "side," but contextually the direction of Tiferet</note> alludes to **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note>.
- **West** <note>original: מתערב, "mixing," a common term for the West where the sun sets</note> alludes to the **Foundation** <note>Yesod</note>, where all the influences are gathered and mixed.
- **South** <note>original: דרום</note> alludes to **Loving-kindness** <note>Chesed</note>.
- **North** <note>original: צפון</note> alludes to **Strength** <note>Gevurah</note>.

### Chapter 7: And Just As
Every physical object possessing length, width, and depth has **six extremities**, and within it are found **twelve diagonal boundaries**. These are the twelve corners where two extremities meet. They are twelve, and one angle will be opposite another diagonally, until there are three sets of angles—six against six. Similarly, one perceives in the "kisses" <note>divine unions</note> within the Sefirot the **twelve diagonal boundaries**. 
How so? **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note> faces and projects toward the Foundation. When it is established with the North, it is for the "Voice of the Projected One" <note>a technical term for an aspect of Tiferet's light</note>. With the South, it is within **Loving-kindness** <note>Chesed</note>. With the "Up," it is toward the Voice of the Projected. With the "Down," it is toward the Voice of the Point.
Just as the North cannot strengthen itself with the South—meaning Loving-kindness—for if Mercy were cast into it, it would cancel the Judgment, so too the aspect of the Foundation of Tiferet does not extend with Loving-kindness or with Strength <note>meaning opposites do not merge directly but through diagonals</note>. Therefore, as the unity of Tiferet with Loving-kindness occurs, the aspect of the "Vav" <note>the letter representing Tiferet</note> will be softened, for Tiferet and Loving-kindness lean toward the side of Grace. Opposite this boundary, diagonally, will be a boundary where they mix freely—that is the aspect of the "burning" <note>Gevurah</note> with Strength. 
By these boundaries, all the orders of the limits are clarified until they reach twelve boundaries. For these specific details, it will be explained that in the place of the Male and Female <note>Zeir Anpin and Nukva</note>, the twelve are divided into four parts. Each part has three boundaries. These parts will be at the boundaries of the three winds: East, West, North, and South.

### Chapter 8: And Know
That the "nourishment" <note>the flow of divine energy</note> of the Six Extremities and the Twelve Boundaries comes from the "Projected One," which is the aspect of Tiferet, and in its dwellings. This is the way of the diagonals. 
Know that when the Six Extremities are in their full power and "kisses" <note>unions</note>, they expand into the **Kingdom** <note>Malchut</note>. In this construction, they correspond to the Sphere <note>Galgal</note>, the World, the Year, and the Soul <note>the three dimensions of reality in Sefer Yetzirah</note>. The power of the "Teli" <note>the celestial axis or "Pole-Serpent"</note> is the root of the extremities and all the boundaries in which Tiferet is projected. In the secret of **Knowledge** <note>Da'at</note>, which is the root of the Six Extremities between which "the World" exists.
Just as the "Sphere" <note>celestial cycle</note> is the root of the extremities in the world, the heart is the root of the life of the body. So it is in the wisdom of Kabbalah: the "Kingdom" <note>Malchut</note> is the root of the life of all the other extremities. These parts are six, intertwined in all constructions by the rotation of the extremities and their governance. There is a mixing in the East that appears in the West. This is the "casting" into the center. 
Corresponding to the twelve diagonal boundaries, there are names and permutations. In the East, there are twelve permutations <note>of the Name of God</note>, each associated with a boundary. Similarly, corresponding to the twelve boundaries in Tiferet, there are seven permutations, and in Malchut, there are also permutations for each...

<column-break/>

...intended to join its parts and its governance. Behold, one must first visualize in the "Tree" <note>the Sefirotic diagram</note> twelve lines extending diagonally, two by two, across its six extremities, riding over one another in the middle. One should "saw" this Tree at the place of the diagonal lines until we reach the central point from every side—the **Navel of the Tree**. This point is the center for the six points in the middle of the extremities. 
By "sawing" the diagonal lines, twelve equal "planks" <note>original: נסרים, slabs or boards</note> will come into our hands. The shape of each one is triangular toward four directions, but its fifth edge is the internal one, standing on its tip at the central point. The sixth edge is the upper one outside the Tree, extending the full width of the four triangles we mentioned, for it is a diagonal square. In its center, an upper line divides it into two triangles from the two ends of the Tree adjacent to each other. They are named according to their position, such as: **Upper North-East**, and so on for all of them. 
These connections are the twelve straight lines that limit the totality of the Tree: four standing on its four corners, four in its circumference across its width, and four for its depth. These are the twelve long forms of the "corners of the Tabernacle" <note>referring to the biblical Tabernacle construction in Exodus</note>. 
By our method, we have learned how the diagonals and these "bodies" are defined within the boundaries of the Tree as a whole. Their forms are etched onto the surfaces of the Tree, and their connections break into these angles. These divine, straight [lines] are limited by the corresponding points. The form of the Tree is examined in a single glance from its "navel" and its surface, which is the hidden central point—the root of everything.

**In the secret of the Sabbath and its boundary:**
Similarly, the virtue of the fruit is within its peel; one does not precede the other in time, even for a moment, but rather in "precedence of degree" <note>a logical or spiritual hierarchy, rather than a chronological one</note>. This is a great principle for all the Works of Creation, while maintaining the proper relationship, as explained in the chapter "One Does Not Expound" <note>original: אין דורשין, the second chapter of Tractate Chagigah in the Talmud</note> regarding Heaven and Earth: though they were created anew from nothingness, and in the aspect of their revelation Heaven preceded Earth, ultimately they were created as one. 
Therefore, the parts of this Tree are called "Boundaries" <note>Gevulim</note>, for they are parts that are equal to one another. Each of them can be considered the beginning or the end for the totality of the Tree, and their foundation and essence derive from the central point, as we mentioned.

Similarly, the word **Boundary** <note>Gevul</note> can be interpreted in three ways: Beginning, Middle, or End. 
1. If from the language of "kneading" <note>original: גובלין, from the Laws of Sabbath</note>, it refers to the "unformed mass" <note>Golem</note>, the beginning of existences. 
2. If from the language of "limitation" <note>original: הגבלית</note>, as in "reducing by a handbreadth" in the laws of Tents <note>Mishnah Ohalot</note>, it refers to the middle, meaning a "treasury." For the central point of the Sphere is truly the treasury of it all. As it is taught in the Tosefta there: "What is a boundary? All that is bent from here and from there, leaving over from the middle." 
3. If from the language of a "border" <note>original: גובל</note>, a handbreadth high in the laws of Diverse Seeds <note>Mishnah Kilayim</note>, it refers to the end of the garden bed.

**However, the secret of this Tree** "builds His upper chambers in the heavens" <note>Amos 9:6</note>. For the **Upper North-East** boundary is aligned with the **Lower South-West**, in the secret of the action extending from the union of Tiferet and Victory <note>Netzach</note>, which is opposite the Foundation and Majesty <note>Hod</note>. 
- **Lower East** to **Upper West**. 
- **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note> leaning toward **Majesty** <note>Hod</note> is opposite **Foundation** <note>Yesod</note> leaning toward **Victory** <note>Netzach</note>. 
- **North-East** to **South-West**: Tiferet girded with **Strength** <note>Gevurah</note> is opposite **Glory** and **Loving-kindness** <note>Chesed</note>. 
- **Upper South** to **Lower North**: Loving-kindness in Victory, Strength in Majesty. 
- **Lower South** to **Upper North**: Loving-kindness in Majesty...

...from the Kingdom unto the end of the levels. **And the [permutation] Y-H-V-H** indicates the Right side, meaning that *Vav-He* rules over the Left, which is *Yod-He*. And the three final *He's* are the secret of the Kingdom's leaning toward one of these three lines. **Chapter 16:** After we have explained all this, it has come into our hands that the [permutations of the] Name are twelve "crowns" <note>or "banners"</note>, corresponding to the twelve hours of the day and twelve of the night, and against the twelve months—three months in each season. And the four seasons are the four letters of the Name: The season of Nisan <note>Spring</note> is *Yod*; the season of Tammuz <note>Summer</note> is *He*; the season of Tishrei <note>Autumn</note> is *Vav*; the season of Tevet <note>Winter</note> is the final *He*. The permutations clarified above for the "World" consist of three months in each season. If we examine the seasons, elements, and the order of the months, it will be clarified that:
The season of Nisan is *Yod*, which is the South <note>Chesed/Mercy</note>, the element of Water. The order of months is Nisan (Aries/Fire), Iyar (Taurus/Earth), Sivan (Gemini/Air).
Likewise, the season of Tammuz is *He*, which is the North <note>Gevurah/Strength</note>, the element of Fire. The order of months is Tammuz (Cancer/Water), Av (Leo/Fire), Elul (Virgo/Earth).
Likewise, the season of Tishrei is *Vav*, which is the East <note>Tiferet/Beauty</note>, the element of Air. The order of months is Tishrei (Libra/Air), Cheshvan (Scorpio/Water), Kislev (Sagittarius/Fire).
Likewise, the season of Tevet is the final *He*, which is the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note>, the element of Earth. The order of months is Tevet (Capricorn/Earth), Shevat (Aquarius/Air), Adar (Pisces/Water).
Thus the months and zodiac signs are clarified in relation to the seasons as explained in the *Book of Formation* <note><term>Sefer Yetzirah</term></note>. All this is so that they may be counted together, so that each one is comprised of its fellow. Furthermore, the Sages, of blessed memory, spoke of four aspects of Metatron <note>the supreme angel</note> over the Tribes of Israel, as explained previously in Gate 29. Let this hint suffice us regarding these Names.

---

Know that the twelve boundaries in Understanding <note>Binah</note> are distinguished by the twelve permutations of the Name *Y-H-V-H*: three with the letter *Aleph* to the South, three with the letter *He* to the North, three with the letter *Yod* to the East, and three with the letter *He* to the West. This applies to the four-letter Name. However, the permutations of the Name *A-D-N-Y* <note>Adonai</note> are twenty-four: six for the letter *Aleph* in the South, six for the letter *Dalet* in the North, six for the letter *Nun* in the East, and six for the letter *Yod* in the West. It is famous in the words of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>the Rashbi</note> that the four-letter Name clothes itself in the letters of *A-H-Y-H* <note>Ehyeh</note> and in the five letters of *A-D-N-Y* until the "winds" return to face one another. The reason for the doubling of the permutations in the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note> compared to the permutations of Beauty <note>Tiferet</note> in its place within Understanding is because Beauty is a "full measure" while Kingdom is a "half measure"—one is a cubit and the other is a span <note>Zeret</note>, which is half a cubit. The *Vav*, the *He*, and the two *Yods* are six letters. It appears in the first Gate that Beauty is the "half shekel," being ten <note>the value of Yod</note>, and Kingdom is five <note>the value of He</note>, the half of ten. The secret of the letter *He* is three *Vavs* which are Victory, Majesty, and Foundation <note>Netzach, Hod, Yesod</note>; whereas in Beauty the secret is the Six Extremities. Thus, one permutation of Beauty includes six extremities, which is six times twelve, totaling 72 <note>the name of 72 letters</note>. The permutations of Kingdom include six extremities between the two of them, and three times 24 is 72. We have already mentioned that the permutations of the four-letter Name are also twenty-four...

---

### Gate
...for the *He* in Understanding is not equal to the *He* in Kingdom. The similarity between the two *He's* and their form is in the secret of the twelve hours of the day and twelve hours of the night; these receive and those influence. How so? *Yod-Vav-He-He* influences and *Yod-He-Vav-He* receives, except that in this one, Understanding precedes, and in that one, Kingdom precedes. Likewise, *He-Vav-He-Yod* influences and *He-Vav-He-Yod* receives, and so with them all. It is possible to explain this in the way of "Male and Female" <note>original: זכר ואמש נקבה באשם</note> as we learned in the *Book of Formation*.

# Nectar of Pomegranates &emsp; &emsp; Gate 21: Details of the Names &emsp; &emsp; Slice of the Pomegranate

And it descends from the verse "In the beginning" <note>Genesis 1:1</note> until the second letter *Bet* within it, in the joining of the parts of Understanding:

### Chapter 13

One does not join these except through the substitution of **Chalpa"t Binatam** <note>original: חלפ"ט בינת"ם; a Kabbalistic cipher where letters are exchanged to reveal hidden meanings</note> within Understanding. These are "Segol" <note>a vowel pattern of three dots</note> qualities and do not descend. If [the light] should descend and pass through the descending "Chalpa"t Binatam," it will return and ascend through the ascending "Chalpa"t Binatam." For all of this is a hint to the excellence of the Name. The matter of the ascent and descent of this cipher will be explained later in the Gate of Permutations, Chapter 6. It was also explained in the Torah portion of *Terumah* <note>Exodus 25:1–27:19</note> that the name lacks the letters **Chet and Tet** <note>original: ח"ט; often noted in Kabbalah because these letters do not appear in the names of the twelve tribes, signifying a lack of "sin" (Chet) or "deviation" (Tet)</note>. This is the secret of the Kingdom <note><term>Malchut</term>: the final Sefirah, representing the physical world</note> crowning itself in Understanding <note><term>Binah</term></note>, and Understanding rises to be crowned higher and higher. In this secret, the Name becomes a source, and that source leads to fifty other sources <note>referring to the 50 Gates of Understanding</note>.

So it is written in the *Tikkunim* <note>the *Tikkuney Zohar*</note>: "There is no Chet or Tet in the connection of the Image of the King" <note>original: דיוקנא דמלכא; the spiritual structure of the human form as a reflection of the Divine</note> which stands at its full height... according to the secret of "The pattern thereof was in writing" <note>1 Chronicles 28:19</note>. The Image of the King is the Voice, the Foundation <note><term>Yesod</term></note>, spelled out as *Yud-He-Vav-He* with various fillings of the letter *Yud*. These names total the numerical value of "Life" <note>original: ח"י (Chai), which equals 18</note>. This refers to the Foundation and the Kingdom and their "fillings" <note>the full spelling of each letter's name</note>. All of this lacks "Sin" <note>the letters Chet and Tet</note> because the Image of the King is found within the letters... it is doubled "Sin" <note>Chet-Tet</note> as a "Segol" <note>the vowel</note> and its filling equals 49 <note>referring to the 49 levels of purity</note>. There the Name is included in the mystery of "Existence" <note>Yeshut</note>, the 42-letter name... and from it comes the "Helmet and the Victory"... and it is explained through the substitution cipher of "Chalpa"t Binatam." 

There are ten names, and in each Kindness <note><term>Chesed</term></note> and a seal corresponding to the seven extremities and the six wings of the Seraphim. Through this writing, it ascends every night to the heights, and this is the secret for protection at night upon one's bed and at the time of passing from this world.

### Chapter 14

The name of 22 letters is the fullness of the Names of God... as found in the prayer of Rabbi Nehunya ben HaKanah <note>a 1st-century sage to whom early Kabbalistic works are attributed</note>. Within them are the 22 Living Creatures of the Chariot <note>the *Merkavah*</note>. From the Names and the verses of the **Priestly Blessing** <note>Numbers 6:24-26</note>, using the substitution cipher of "Chalpa"t Binatam," there are two more names of 22. One ascends to Rabbi Nehunya... and the rest belong to the secret of the Orchard <note><term>Pardes</term>: the four levels of Torah interpretation or the heavenly realm</note> as noted at the end of the chapter.

### Chapter 15

Regarding the secret of the **Cherubim** <note>celestial beings</note>, we have general principles from the words of our Master Saadia Gaon <note>original: הרס"ג; a 10th-century philosopher and scholar</note>, according to our limited understanding. There is the secret of "Descent," which is the end of the connection... a hint to the "Golden Altar"... there are 18 "Living Creatures" within it. Sometimes the "Jubilee" <note>Binah</note> ascends and is glorified with the Divine Presence <note><term>Shekhinah</term></note>, and the Shekhinah descends and is glorified through the lower name. This is the secret of "The Lord by wisdom founded the earth" <note>Proverbs 3:19</note>. This is explained in the Gate of Names. 

The intention of the name *Yud-Vav-Dalet* <note>the letter *Yud* spelled out</note> is because it is the way of the male to cover the right and left... this is the secret of the Kingdom ascending. Therefore, Kindness <note>Chesed</note> turns toward Wisdom, and the Kingdom through the way of Strength <note>Gevurah</note> turns toward Understanding. **YUD:** Know that this structure is the male *Vav-He* over the female, and the female *He-Yud* over the male. When the female dominates... the *He-Yud* which is Judgment dominates the *Vav-He* which is Mercy. **YHVH:** This is the Torah of Judgment... as mentioned above... the *He* is Understanding, the *Vav* is the six extremities and the Written Torah. This is the secret of the "Tzaddik" <note>The Righteous One/Yesod</note> which is the "Living" name when flow is drawn to it from Wisdom. It descends to the Kingdom... but it is possible for Judgment to exist entirely... for there the light shows its forms...

<column-break/>

...his companions. Each one is included in the ten, and in those three, all ten are included. All of them are no more than ten. There are six forms [of the name] in the **Teli** <note><term>Teli</term>: the "Dragon" or celestial axis mentioned in *Sefer Yetzirah*</note>, twelve in the **Sphere** <note><term>Galgal</term>: the zodiac or cycle of the year</note>, and twelve in the **Heart**. Blessed is He! For it has been explained regarding the Sefirot that they are only ten, but their combinations are without number. All of them are completed in the Heart, which begins with the four letters of the Name, and their completion is thirty-two, which are the **Thirty-Two Paths of Wisdom**. 

There is "High above the high" <note>Ecclesiastes 5:7</note>, for half of the four-letter Name is in Greatness <note>Chesed</note> and half is in Strength <note>Gevurah</note>, and the collective is in the center <note>Tiferet</note>. Corresponding to them below, half is in Victory <note>Netzach</note> and half is in Splendor <note>Hod</note>, and the collective is in Foundation <note>Yesod</note>. Thus we find "The Lord and His 32 branches are above Him," and "The Lord and His 32 branches are below." Those above them are the **Seven Days of Creation**: Kindness, Strength, Beauty, Victory, Splendor, Foundation, and Understanding (which is called the "Week" and is the Sabbath day). However, the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note> does not complete the count to eight because she is the "Heart" <note>original: חל"ב (milk), but here likely a wordplay on Lev (Heart)</note>. Therefore it says, "The profit of the earth is in all" <note>Ecclesiastes 5:8</note>; she brings into existence the Hidden Kingdom in its source above. 

When Beauty <note>Tiferet</note> shines, it is from that source and in 그 high existence, in the secret of "The apple of the eye." Then the "diminishment of the moon" <note>the symbol of Malchut's exile or smaller state</note> will be filled, and she will radiate her light to all the world through the merit of their deeds. She then becomes a **Throne for Beauty**. She is a precious stone, with colors of blue-violet and sapphire, originating from the spring of Wisdom.

### In the Tikkunim

They said: Small and great living creatures are eight. These are "Aharonah" <note>a variation of the name</note>, and of them it is said, "Then he shall sing." When the Holy One, blessed be He, is with His Divine Presence, they are in the "Eight of Life." These are the creatures that are "sometimes silent, sometimes speaking" <note>Chashmal</note>, and they all beat their wings in song. The song within them has four faces for every side, making them square. This is what is written: "And every one had four faces" <note>Ezekiel 1:6</note>. There are eight through which Moses and David offered praise. For this reason, an instrument of eight strings was established, and praise was given below with eight, as it is said: "For the Leader, on the Sheminith" <note>Psalm 6:1; *Sheminith* means 'the eighth'</note>. There are eight letters for each, and they all add up to 72. Eleven are holy, and eight of those make 64. Eight for each side adds up to 72 <note>referring to the 72-letter Name of God</note>.

Behold, they explained in the *Sefer HaBahir* <note>an early Kabbalistic text</note> the **three states of the Kingdom**:
1. In her existence below as a **Firmament**.
2. In her equality with Beauty, in the secret of the "Two Great Luminaries."
3. As a **Throne** in the state of Wisdom, for she is the Throne for the Higher Glory.
He brought proof from the verse, "And they saw the God of Israel" <note>Exodus 24:10</note>... this refers to the Kingdom when it is attached to Beauty. It is beneath Victory and Splendor, which are the "feet." "As it were a paved work of sapphire stone" refers to the aspect of Wisdom, and "as the very heaven" refers to the equality with Beauty. Concerning the Divine Presence, it is also said "in the appearance of a sapphire stone," for there she is hidden and covered in the state of Wisdom, as explained in the Zohar.

### In the Book of Formation

We learned: The **Teli** <note>the Dragon/Axis</note> in the universe is like a king on his throne; the **Sphere** in the year is like a king in the province; the **Heart** in the soul is like a king in war. 
Behold, the **Teli** is the ruler over the heavenly signs, for all the spheres are overseen by it in a single glance. The **Sphere** of the sun, whose cycle awakens those who sleep... it organizes the needs of the year like a king in a province. On this secret, Samuel of Ramah used to circuit between Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah, returning to Ramah where his home was; for he included both sides, equal to Moses and Aaron. The **Heart** is within all the powers of the soul like a king in war, who takes the lead. There he sets for it a statute and an ordinance for all the forces of nature...

-># Slice of the Pomegranate: Gate 22 — The Gathering of the Nectar of Pomegranates<-

The pious one said: "Your wonders and Your thoughts are toward us" <note>original: "נפלאותיך ומחשבותיך אלינו"; Psalm 40:6</note> in the secret of the Torah which preceded the world. The glory of the Place <note><term>Ha-Makom</term>: a Rabbinic title for God, suggesting He is the 'place' of the world</note> arose in pure thought. He calculated **MAH** <note>original: "מ"ה"; the numerical value (Gematria) is 45</note> which is the numerical equivalent of **Adam** <note>Man</note>. It is written as a virtue: "What is man that You are mindful of him?" <note>Psalm 8:5</note>. **And he** is indeed the end of the thought and its specific purpose, which was intended at the beginning of the deed. This is the Divine service: to cleave to Him, may He be blessed. For one immediately enters into the Torah and the commandments with a perfected perspective, as in the Garden of Eden, "to work it and to keep it" <note>Genesis 2:15</note>, so that one does not distract their mind from it. Or, "as you walk," the Godly power shall lead you to eternal life. Even after the sin, when death was decreed upon us—and even the most righteous among us were not saved from the "counsel of the serpent" <note>a reference to the few biblical figures who supposedly died only because of the original sin of the serpent, not their own faults</note>—"when you lie down, it shall watch over you," and when you awaken for the resurrection of the dead, "it shall converse with you." Regarding the generation of our master [David], who exerted himself in this service all his days, it is written: "And David made a name" <note>2 Samuel 8:13</note>. This is the "end of the deed." Its permutation is "Asah Mah" <note>original: "עשה מ"ה"; 'Made 45'</note>, which is the numerical value of **Man** (Adam), a likeness like the appearance of a man upon the likeness of the Throne.

### Chapter 2: Rectification of the Chariot
This is the "awakening from below" that rises from the deeds of the righteous to adorn the **Shekhinah** <note>the Divine Presence, personified as feminine</note>, who was previously hiding in the "Bird's Nest" <note>a Zoharist term for the hidden place where the Messiah and the Shekhinah dwell</note> to awaken the 550 [powers]. From there, the light returns to follow the righteous, to dwell in glory with them and to be crowned by the spirituality of their deeds. Through this, the Shekhinah receives an additional flow of abundance from above, as previously mentioned. Thus, the soul of the righteous person becomes the source of all blessings; for this reason, it was said to Abraham, "And you shall be a blessing." **And this rectification** is completed in two ways: either by the soul of the righteous being emanated from those aspects that he chooses as his portion from the Chariot, or by being very diligent and rewarded with the "reward of a commandment is a commandment" <note>Pirkei Avot 4:2</note>, to illuminate a limb of the Divine structure through his good deeds. This continues until his entire body becomes like **white glass** <note>original: "כזכוכית לבנה"; a metaphor for a body so purified it becomes a transparent vessel for divine light</note> after being purified of every taint of transgression or improper thought. For the Divine Presence does not dwell in a flawed place, as the *Tikkunim* <note>Tikkuney Zohar</note> expounded on the verse: "Whosoever has a blemish shall not approach." They said: "Fortunate is he who completes his soul so that the Name **YHWH** may dwell within him," making himself a throne for Him. Fortunate is the mouth that connects the Holy One, Blessed be He, with His Shekhinah, which is the "Torah of the Lord." So too it is written: "Evil shall not dwell with you"—meaning there shall be no bed-mate who does evil. Of Jacob, it was first said that he was a "simple man" <note>Genesis 25:27</note>, which in its plain sense means pure of any blemish, and afterward, he became a "Chariot" for the **Tiferet** <note><term>Tiferet</term>: the Sefirah of Beauty/Harmony, often associated with the 'Holy One'</note>, "dwelling in tents." **And with this**, the soul of every righteous person is indebted to the light flowed into the Shekhinah, beyond what was implanted in her previously. "Happy is the man who follows Him" to illuminate within her an additional flow from above. This is the secret of the "Chariot" in every place. Because of the "Father of them all," it says, "And God went up from upon Abraham" <note>Genesis 17:22</note>, which is a title for the Shekhinah. There are levels in this: one of them is what David, King of Israel, merited, becoming a Chariot to the light revealed in the **Kingdom** (Malchut) from its own side, in that "he gave no sleep to his eyes" so that the "Glory" might sing to Him and not be silent. He says, "O God, do not be silent," and the entire Psalm revolves around this axis—to cut down the gluttons so that sin does not cause the "Guardian of Israel" to sleep.

**And our Rabbis** said that all his days he never sank into deep sleep, but only "the sleep of a horse" <note>Talmudic expression for a very light sleep</note>, meaning the measure of the deep sleep that fell upon [man]. The rider [of the horse] fell because of the counsel of the serpent, but David did not sleep more than that measure. This is what he meant by saying...

...in these details, this will not be pleasant in the Name. For the revealed world and the "garments of intentions" <note>meditative focuses</note> shall not be of all [heights?], instead of all the revealed things and the impression of the vessels that receive His seal.

### Chapter 2: To Understand
The matter of the hints of the **Appellations** <note>original: "כנויים"; titles used for God that are not the primary names</note> which are attributed to the Sefirot. Know that there are 18 orders of powers and appellations. All that the ancient sages intended was to hide this wisdom. Every sage would bring up for himself hidden intentions to partially conceal his wisdom within them. Therefore, if it appears so, how much more so [is it true] that we have yet another part that we have revealed in the smallest of small amounts, like a bit from the world of Appellations. For we have relied upon ourselves for a bit of understanding regarding the three types of knowledge of the Ten Sefirot. Likewise, every good deed hints at the Sefirot. And behold, what is this "by a miracle" according to the words of the hints? Will he not bow to us with a hint? We speak of a "lack of the appellation" or a "lack of the language of this matter." The Sefirot enter into many different aspects, and for every single aspect, there is a name and an appellation. That which is indicated by this appellation will not be indicated by that appellation. The same applies to the **Kingdom** (Malchut), and from there, the Sefirah of **Kindness** (Chesed) surrounds it. Behold, it was explained above in the preceding matter that the appellation of the Sefirot moves between "horse" and every other thing and its substitute. Everything follows this: the Attribute branches out, intended for an aspect according to the reality of its reception from one of the Higher Sefirot, to act according to the will of the Emanator. This is according to the actions drawn from it, depending on the matter, the time, and the place. Now, when the Kingdom receives from **Foundation** (Yesod), it is rectified into two aspects in the Kingdom, which receives ten aspects in the Foundation which influences it. As the Foundation influences, it will influence a part of everything it received from Wisdom, Understanding, etc. Thus, from there, what it influences from its own essence is eight; what it influences from that which it received from the higher ones is three. Thus, the aspect in the Kingdom changes according to the power of the influence and the influencer. So it goes for all the Sefirot. From here, there is an image... <note>the text here uses dense abbreviations like "כ"ק" and "חל"ה" which refer to specific Kabbalistic configurations of the Sephirot</note> ...The intention is that it begins in the aspect of "Nectar" (Asis). This is why it says the aspects were softened. Every aspect has its own appellation and reception according to the orders of the conductor. From the hints and secrets of the aspects, the Appellations descended. Every aspect and every appellation is a hint to an aspect unto itself. What this indicates, that will not indicate. This is the matter of the Appellations: the voice of the spreading of the branches of the Sefirot. Just as the "Torah of the Lord" <note>original: "תורת ה'"</note> is inclusive of the Sefirah, and the "Torah of the Name" is a Sefirah, every name is taken from the ten Sefirot. These are names that are established in the places that spread within them—in the branches that spread from the body of the Tree, and these branch out and spread further into small branches. Also, the hints of the Appellations are more specific than the actual Names, according to how the Appellations are "clothing" for those Names located in those places. And the Names located in those places are "clothing" for the **Havayot** <note>permutations of the name YHWH</note>, and the Havayah is a clothing for the Name of 72 [letters] of the Essence. All of them are like the Tree: whose leaves cover its eye, and its cracks cover its eye, and its branches and twigs cover its root. So is the matter above. This is what was explained in the *Tikkunim* many times: that it mentions different names in the Appellations, and the intention is toward these aspects. Now, look at the "Nectar" (Asis) in an inner way, according to the face of the aspects.

### Chapter 3: And Likewise
The matter of the hint that exists in the intention of the Kingdom, like different vessels and different parts of actions. All of them will be hinted at by one of the Sefirot. There will be no redundant or additional words, for this hints at one aspect included in the second Sefirah, and that hints at another aspect that was hidden... to return everything together... and to return again... for your need.

-># Gate Twenty-Two: The Appellations<-

## Chapter 1: Explaining the matter of the Names and the beginning of associating Appellations with the Holy One, Blessed be He — "From the beginning of the composition *Wings of the Dove*"
<margin>The Section for page 89</margin>
Regarding the characteristics, attributes, and actions of the emanated and produced souls and their laws: Since He, may He be blessed, is neither a body nor a power within a body, no physical accidents occur within Him, nor do the Divine emanations <note>Sefirot</note> change, Heaven forbid. From His perspective, He hovers within the world like a drop. Know that everything in the Torah attributed to the One Above is not written by way of metaphor or mere imagination. Rather, these terms refer to hidden, supreme intentions that are beyond investigation, end, or measure. A portion of the Torah's words are expressed in the "language of man" <note>original: "לשון בני אדם"</note> only to "settle the ear" <note>a Talmudic idiom meaning to make a concept understandable to human intellect</note> with what it is capable of hearing. Beyond this, there are seven rectifications of the Names and titles based on their purpose, followed by compound names and the Appellations which are divided according to the power that flows and spreads through them. The function of these Appellations is the power of the Actor working through them, for all essences are seen only as tools in the hand of the Architect. 

It seems to me that the Holy Tongue <note>Hebrew</note> did not begin by chance or by human convention, as is the case with the languages of other nations. Heaven forbid! The intention was to instill wisdom, for the Creator decreed in His wisdom and fixed in the mouth of man the various parts of wisdom and their characteristics. From the beginning, these emerged through sounds and movements, which then became defined and established. Know that as our Sages of blessed memory said: when the Holy One, Blessed be He, created the first man, Adam, he was a holy and pure body. The Holy One handed over to him the hidden treasures and the keys to the Torah. He placed the Holy Tongue—holy living forces—into his mouth as a vessel of Kindness. A pure light, like a spark, spread around him, meaning seventy branches of expansion that extend into the boundaries of the system like a wheel, reaching the "Rows of Kindness" of the Sanctuary. This is the portion of the Holy One: seventy living forces for seventy ministers for seventy languages. But He chose us and gave us speech in the Holy Tongue. His agreement regarding the names is that the tongue is called "tongue" and the mouth is called "mouth" to indicate the attributes that began their action. Immediately, they establish the power. Even when associated with physical things—as if a man were to grasp the "statutes" or the "beard" <note>referring to the *Idra* or Kabbalistic descriptions of Divine "features"</note>—the power is actually in the Higher Force that receives that sound. Therefore, as the Sages said: "Gracious words are a honeycomb" <note>Proverbs 16:24</note>. This applies to all limbs and all physical Appellations. It would be a grave error to think these names are physical; rather, they are like the essence of Wisdom or Understanding. When they are revealed further and spread toward Understanding <note><term>Binah</term></note>, which is like a mother carrying a child in her womb, she is called "Mother." Sometimes they are ready to unite and are called "Groom" and "Bride," or "Man" and "Woman." There are many reasons for these Appellations, and according to the resulting actions, they are included and hidden. One must listen well to this.

<column-break/>

## Chapter 1: He who merits will discern in these rectifications the greatness of our first Father, the creation
of the hands of the Holy One, Blessed be He. There is no end to the height of his soul, which was clothed in a holy body shining with the radiance of the Divine Presence <note><term>Shekhinah</term></note>, until the skin of his heel dimmed the orb of the sun. God handed him the keys to the Torah and the treasures of wisdom fixed in the Holy Tongue, which the Master of All later bequeathed to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Through this language, He gazed and created the world in its beauty and stature, and He formed man with the characteristics of his limbs, making him a "Throne of Glory" for all the upper channels. Every single limb is named after the spiritual powers that shine within it. Regarding this it is said: "He who plants the ear, shall He not hear?" <note>Psalm 94:9</note>. For the supreme power from which the lower ear was formed understands words to know if they are worthy of being received. From this spiritual source, the angels are described as having eyes, ears, feet, and wings.

**In general**, the Sages said that the entire Torah is comprised of the Names of the Holy One, Blessed be He. They asked: What is the meaning of the verse, "The Ark of God, which is called by the Name, the Name of the Lord of Hosts who sits between the Cherubim"? <note>2 Samuel 6:2</note>. This teaches that the Tetragrammaton, all His names, and all His Appellations are placed in the Ark. They made no distinction between the commandment "I am the Lord your God" and a mundane genealogical verse like "And Timna was a concubine to Eliphaz, son of Esau" <note>Genesis 36:12</note>. With this, there is no room to believe that the naming of things in the Holy Tongue refers essentially to physical sensations which were then "borrowed" to describe the High One. **Rather**, in the entire Written and Oral Torah, He did not leave any created thing, small or big, that cannot be examined. Without doubt, the primary meaning of these terms refers to the supreme spiritual beings, for whom the letters of the Torah were the intended dwelling and the source of their existence. However, through association and duality, hints of these names appear in the lower worlds. Only the perspective is switched for us; it is inverted for eyes of flesh. As it is written at the beginning of the discourse: "From my flesh I shall see God" <note>Job 19:26</note>. This is the reasoning of Nahmanides <note>original: "הרמב"ן ז"ל"</note> regarding the upper beings: that the Torah was not given to the ministering angels. Yet both perspectives fit together to complete the Divine intention for the "people saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation." It is written: "There is none like God, O Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your help" <note>Deuteronomy 33:26</note>. Our rabbis said: "There is none like God"—but who is like God? The pleasant and upright among you.

**However**, the master key to the intention of this Gate is the principle established among the Sages: "The end of the deed was first in the thought." Indeed, the beginning of thought is the head and source of all blessings. The acronym for "Rides the Heavens" <note>original: "רוכב שמים"; R-S</note> and the phrase "to your help" are explained in the words of the King...

...through the excellence of their deeds and from the quarry of their souls. **Chapter 3 in the Book of Illumination** <note><term>Sefer HaBahir</term>: one of the earliest and most influential Kabbalistic texts</note> states:
Rabbi Meir said: What is the meaning of that which is written, "And God said, Let there be light, and there was light" <note>Genesis 1:3</note>, and it does not say, "and it was so"? This teaches that this Light was exceedingly great, and no creature was able to gaze upon it. The Holy One, Blessed be He, hid it for the righteous in the World to Come. It is the "measure of all clarity," and it is the power of the precious stone called ***Soharet*** <note>a biblical term for a type of marble or stone, often interpreted in Kabbalah as a surrounding or encompassing light</note> and *Dar*. And what is this "measure of *Dar*"? It teaches that the Holy One, Blessed be He, took one part out of a thousand from a hidden corner and built from it a beautiful and adorned precious stone, and included within it all the commandments. Thus far the quote.

He explains that "Let there be light" refers to the bringing into being of the **Second Light**, which is the attribute of **Sovereignty** <note><term>Malchut</term>: the final Sefirah, representing the Divine Presence in the physical world</note>, which is second to **Wisdom** <note><term>Chokhmah</term></note>. And the **First Light** was exceedingly great, within the secret of the "Line of Kindness" <note><term>Chesed</term></note>, which Wisdom ascends over, above **Understanding** <note><term>Binah</term></note> as well—and this is the meaning of "exceedingly." And no creature was able to gaze upon it, for the intention of its spreading forth was to make known His mighty acts to the children of men.

<column-break/>

And there is a limit to His measure of **Beauty** <note><term>Tiferet</term>: the central Sefirah of harmony</note>, and it is evident there that the Holy One, Blessed be He, desired to utilize Sovereignty—that is, to create a "Chariot" <note>a vehicle or earthly representative</note> for Sovereignty. This was because she required more repair than all other attributes, since "her feet go down to death" <note>Proverbs 5:5; a reference to the Sefirah of Malchut's proximity to the "Husks" or forces of impurity</note>. To bring her back, Abraham seized her with Kindness until he became a Chariot for Kindness; and Isaac adorned her with Might <note><term>Gevurah</term></note> until he became a Chariot for Might.

Likewise, Jacob adorned her with the Torah, and desired to cling to her in all his affairs, as we find when he "went out from Beer-sheba" <note>Genesis 28:10</note>—which represents Understanding—and went to the "Chariot"—which is Sovereignty. Similarly, he "encountered the place" <note>Genesis 28:11</note> of the Divine Presence <note>the Shekhinah</note>. It was only intended for him to be a Chariot for Beauty, for Abraham and Isaac are the "two faces"—this is Kindness and this is Judgment—and there was a need for Peace to be between them for the repair of the world. Through "good deeds," one inclines the Chariot toward Kindness; and so the difficulties in this matter are seen.
