->### THE GATE<-

And yet, due to the fewness of those who attain it, it is not grasped. By this we also learned that the emanations were unable to draw from its flow due to its subtlety. The Holy One, Blessed be He, hid this **Second Light** for the righteous in the World to Come. The **Righteous** <note>Tzaddikim</note> are Beauty and **Foundation** <note><term>Yesod</term>: the Sefirah that channels energy into Malchut</note>, as it is written: "For the Lord is righteous, He loves righteous deeds" <note>Psalm 11:7</note>, and "The righteous is the foundation of the world" <note>Proverbs 10:25</note>.

They draw nourishment from Wisdom through Understanding in the aspect called "the World to Come," which is the inner dimension that is not revealed. From there, Wisdom is unified, as they said in the Zohar, portion *Yitro*: "He [the Infinite] desired to cover Himself, and He made for Himself a Palace <note><term>Hechal</term>: often referring to Binah</note> to hide within. That Palace He brought forth from Himself... and He honored it with precious garments. He opened fifty gates within it... and that Tracing <note>the Reshimu, or remnant of the Infinite light</note> was hidden within it. Once it was hidden and entered inside, it was filled with light." Thus far.

Indeed, the **World to Come** is also a title for **Understanding**, the "river that never ceases," which flows and comes to provide influence below. And **Wisdom** is the "measure of every stone" in the world, in which all things were limited. In the aspect of the "Beginning" <note>the first point of creation</note>, all beings and the future encompasses to be formed in the world are within Understanding. Therefore, they said in the *Tikunim*: "A shield and a buckler <note>original: *Tzannah ve-Soharet*</note> is His truth" <note>Psalm 91:4</note>. *Tzannah* is the Lower Shekhinah <note>Malchut</note>, and *Soharet* is the Upper Shekhinah <note>Binah</note>.

However, this refers to the **Middle Column** <note>the central axis of the Sefirot</note>. It said that there was "power in the stone to weigh it"—this refers to the letter *Yod* <note>the smallest Hebrew letter, representing the point of Wisdom</note> in the aspect of Wisdom unified in Understanding. This is the "Precious Stone," the "shining point" within the Palace... which is called *Soharet*, a term for "encompassing," for she includes and surrounds the World of Construction <note>the six Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</note> in which the circle of all beings exists.

(And he asked: What is *Dar*? For from it "Let there be light" is explained. He interpreted that *Dar* is the existence of the "Side" <note>referring to the rib/side taken from Adam</note> taken from this *Soharet*. She is one of the aspects of the "Thousands" <note>referring to the letter Aleph, which also means a thousand</note>, which are Wisdom and Understanding—the Torah that preceded the world. In the construction, in their inclusion of ten times ten times ten... until the "Thousand," which is the end of the sphere. He indicated the existence of the Side in the aspect of the two thousand years themselves before the construction was revealed. And from it, He built the "living beings" of the letter *He*... a construction for the precious stone, the existence of the letter *Yod*.

She is "beautiful" from the side of the flow of **Beauty** (*Tiferet*). For Sovereignty is the letter *He* [5] and Beauty is the letter *Vav* [6], which numerically equals 11 <note>original: *A-H*</note>. Its permutation is *H-A*, indicating that she is adorned by that flow in three colors... these are the three *Vavs* in "Your Thousands" <note>referring to the Name of God</note>. He said: "and all the commandments were included in her"—the right and the left, "to do" and "not to do," which are dependent on the Ten Sefirot. Since Sovereignty includes all ten, she therefore includes their branches as well. It was necessary to introduce this to explain the "Chariots" that will follow.)

## Chapter 4: And it is brought...

...there, that Abraham came and requested that this precious stone be given to him, but He did not wish it. Instead, he took his attribute of **Might**, which is **Fear**, as it is written: "by the Fear of his father Isaac" <note>Genesis 31:42</note>. Jacob came and desired it, but it was not given to him. He [God] said: Since Abraham is above and Isaac is below him, you shall be the **Middle** and take all three of them. And what is this "Middle"? It is **Peace**, as it is written: "You give Truth to Jacob" <note>Micah 7:20</note>. **Truth** and **Peace** are one... and this is what is written: "And I will feed you the heritage of Jacob your father" <note>Isaiah 58:14</note>, which is a complete heritage—namely Fear, Kindness, Truth, and Peace.

**He said** that out of the Holy One's love to complete this attribute [Sovereignty], which requires more repair than any other because "her feet go down to death," He requested of Abraham to leave the domain of the "Husks" <note><term>Kelipot</term></note> by saying to him: "Go forth from your land... to the land that I will show you" <note>Genesis 12:1</note>. This "land" is Sovereignty, to adorn her. Even though the essence of his soul's radiance was from the side of Kindness—and therefore it said shortly after that Kindness was his attribute—it is possible to illuminate any of the attributes as He wishes. For every soul is comprised of all ten. He was able to influence Sovereignty from his own existence in the secret of Kindness specifically, just as our master David did, who called himself "pious" <note>Hebrew: *Chasid*, from *Chesed*</note>... as it is written: "the sure mercies [Kindness] of David."

The verse testifies that Abraham did not [initially] desire her, even though in truth he stems from her... rather, he merited through his deeds and "went on his journeys" to this land. **Isaac came**, of whom it is written "visitation" and "deposits," which are like "Remembrances." The emanation of his soul was from Sovereignty within Foundation. Therefore, it was said of him, "to Sarah a son" from the side of the Female <note>the Nukva/Sovereignty</note>. She was his Chariot before the Binding (*Akedah*), for because of this, he poured out his soul unto death. But the secret of the Resurrection of the Dead prevailed through the Name *Y-H-W*, the secret of the "Living of the Worlds," and revived him. Then he requested a higher power, even though this attribute had already been given to him... and it was said to him after the Binding: "Sojourn in this land." He merited and was crowned in his place in the secret of the "Line of the Living of the Worlds," leaning to the left alongside Abraham who held his right. Therefore they said of the Chosen One <note>Jacob</note> in another place:

# Pomegranate Juice &emsp; Gate 22: The Appellations &emsp; Slice of the Pomegranate
## Page 100

For the purpose, according to what His wisdom, may He be blessed, saw fit. And this is what I have written: that all the cords <note>referring to physical limbs/tendons</note> of the person are intended to align with the spiritual forces and upper powers. All the cords of a person are meant to envision and look upon the branches of the upper roots. The King <note>God</note> shall be the throne, and the daughter <note>the Shechinah</note> shall be for the sake of the Chariot <note><term>Merkavah</term>: a vehicle or throne for Divine energy</note> for one of the essences of the Sefirot.

To understand the matter of the Chariot: Know that any person who purifies himself from all sin and is meticulous in the fulfillment of the commandments, especially in his character traits, and pursues righteousness and clings to what is good—he becomes a Chariot for the ten Sefirot. This was the intention of the creation of souls. Similarly, when a person purifies his external limbs, he becomes a dwelling and a Chariot for that specific Sefirah to which his heart is directed. For it is impossible for the Divine Presence <note><term>Shechinah</term></note> to rest upon him unless he is pure.

The matter is that he must purify his entire body from blemish, and afterwards be meticulous in a specific matter and perform commandments and righteousness within it. Then he will be a throne and a Chariot for that specific Sefirah. However, if his soul is not empty of sin, the Shechinah will not dwell there, even though the soul of a person is naturally prepared for union with the Sefirot. He makes himself a Chariot for a different Sefirah through his leaning toward certain traits and attributes. For even though the physical limbs are empty of God, and the Sefirot of the world are filled by Him, when a person strives below through a specific commandment or a certain quality from the Sefirot, he makes himself a Chariot for it.

Even if his soul is currently associated with another Sefirah, he can overcome his nature toward any Sefirah he intends to reach below. By doing so, he draws down its influence upon himself, and it becomes included and received in his soul. The matter of the Chariot is this: when a man holds onto a specific commandment, the glory of the light from the appointed Sefirah—which is spiritual—spreads over him. When he adds to his purity, the Shechinah pursues him to dwell within him and to receive from that light which flows from above upon him, until the Shechinah is clothed within the soul of that righteous person. Then his soul becomes a palace and a resting place for the Shechinah.

When the Shechinah is clothed in the soul of the righteous person, it receives the light of the upper Sefirah. This light is clothed in the Shechinah because of its attachment to the soul of the righteous person, until the soul of the righteous person becomes a palace for the Shechinah and a Chariot for the upper Sefirah. And when that Sefirah is unified with the soul of the righteous person, it pours forth influence and blessings, performing its actions through that righteous man. His leaning and desire then cause the influence to flow from that Sefirah to all the lower and upper worlds. For even the angels do not receive the influence of that Sefirah except through the mediation of the soul of the righteous person.

This is the meaning of the verse regarding Abraham, "and you shall be a blessing" <note>Genesis 12:2</note>, meaning the source of blessings, because he was a conduit for the flow of the influence—namely, he was the Chariot for **Kindness** <note><term>Chesed</term>: the Sefirah of expansive love and benevolence</note>. Likewise, the other Patriarchs were each a Chariot for their specific attribute: Abraham for Kindness (*Chesed*), Isaac for **Might** <note><term>Gevurah</term>: the Sefirah of judgment and restraint</note>, and Jacob for **Beauty** <note><term>Tiferet</term>: the Sefirah of harmony and balance</note>. Moses, the master of all prophets, was the Chariot for *Tiferet* through the secret of **Knowledge** <note><term>Da'at</term></note>, and in his prophecy, he unified the Shechinah and the Higher Understanding. Joseph was for **Foundation** <note><term>Yesod</term>: the Sefirah of connection and procreation</note>, and even though he was alone, he was the Chariot for *Yesod*, which brings the flow from *Tiferet* to **Sovereignty** <note><term>Malchut</term></note>. Through this, he merited and provided food for the entire world during the years of famine. Therefore, Israel must purify themselves and their desires, and thus they will be worthy to engage in Torah and commandments.

**As for** what the Sages said about the Patriarchs being the Chariot, it is understood by what we shall first state: that our father Abraham, peace be upon him, became a Chariot for the "Thread of Kindness" drawn over *Malchut* in the secret of "the right hand brings near," for he brought all people in the world closer to the service of Heaven. Isaac was a Chariot for the second thread, influenced by *Gevurah* (Might), for he stretched out his neck upon the altar. It is said in the Zohar that he informed all inhabitants of the world that there is Law and there is a Judge; with the "left hand that pushes away" all who seek dishonest gain. Through his attribute, wealth and money are influenced into the world, as it is written: "And Isaac sowed in that land" and it is written, "for you are much stronger than we" <note>Genesis 26:12-16</note>. All this is in addition to the repair of the "Embrace" shared by Abraham and Isaac in the secret of the two arms, as mentioned before.

**But** the level of *Yesod* is greater than them, for they are the preparation for union, but *Yesod* assists in that there is actual substance for the two aspects of unity—that of *Tiferet* and *Malchut* in their existence. This was given to Moses and to Jacob, and Joseph became a "best man" <note>intermediary</note> for both, as it is written: "These are the generations of Jacob: Joseph" <note>Genesis 37:2</note> and "And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him" <note>Exodus 13:19</note>. Behold, Jacob became a Chariot for the light revealed in *Malchut* from the side of *Tiferet*, which pours into it two types of influence: one through the chain of the structure of all other attributes, and another where he actually unites with her in the secret of "Torah study is equal to them all," for his Torah was his craft. He spent fourteen years in the house of Eber, and even at night, he did not sleep due to his constant occupation with the Torah.

**And great** is the honor of our teacher Moses, peace be upon him, who became a Chariot for the light revealed in the inner part of *Malchut*—the "King's daughter," the secret of the "Side," the bride of Moses—from the secret of *Da'at* (Knowledge) which is in *Tiferet*. With this hidden union, he became a "best man" above to unify the "Father and Mother" <note><term>Abba v'Imma</term>: the higher Sefirot of Wisdom and Understanding</note>. This is part of the wonders he performed in the occupation of the Torah and its interpretation for the six hundred thousand. He merited to bring down the Manna and all the signs and wonders.

**There is**, however, the level of Enoch <note><term>Chanokh</term></note> below them all, who was a "cobbler of shoes." His intention was to connect **Metatron** <note>the highest angel, associated with Enoch</note>, the secret of the "shoe" with all its aspects, to *Malchut*. With every stitch he made with the awl, he would utter a blessing for the sake of the High, to cause influence to flow from above upon *Malchut*. Therefore, he merited in his lifetime to become the Chariot for the Prince of the Presence <note>Metatron</note>.

This is the key to all that will come in the words of our Rabbis regarding the attribution of any Chariot to any of the holy ones—each man according to the work they do. They draw down additional influence to the "Woman of Valor" <note>Malchut/Shechinah</note> who leads the world, from that specific aspect which they merited

# Slice of the Pomegranate &emsp; Gate 22: The Appellations &emsp; Pomegranate Juice
## Page 65

...through the skill of their actions and the intent of their souls.

In the third chapter of *The Book of Illumination* <note>original: "Sefer HaBahir," one of the earliest Kabbalistic works</note>, Rabbi Meir asked: Why is it written, "And God said, let there be light, and there was light" <note>Genesis 1:3</note>, rather than saying "and it was so"? This teaches us that this original light was so immense that no created being could look upon it. Therefore, the Holy One, blessed be He, hid it for the righteous in the Future to Come. This light is the "measure of all merchandise in the world" <note>A play on the word "Soharet," which means both a type of marble/stone and "merchandise" or "trade"</note>; it is the power of the precious stone called *Soharet*. 

Rabbi Isaac then asked: What is the "measure of *Dar*" <note>referring to the "Dar and Soharet" stones in Esther 1:6</note>? It teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, took one facet out of two thousand and built from it a beautiful, adorned precious stone, incorporating all the commandments within it. Thus far the quote.

**Explanation:** "Let there be light" refers to the "Living Beings" <note>the <term>Chayot</term>, a high order of angels</note> of the second light, which is *Malchut* (Sovereignty), as she is second to *Chochmah* (Wisdom). The "First Light" was exceedingly great, belonging to the secret of the "Line of Kindness" <note><term>Chesed</term></note>, where Wisdom rises above Understanding <note><term>Binah</term></note>—this is the meaning of "exceedingly." No creature can look upon it directly. However, through the merit of its "spreading out" <note>the process of emanation</note>, it became possible to make His mighty acts known to the children of men.

<column-break/>

The sage <note>likely referring to a previous commentator or section</note> explained in the book *Sataq-Keh* <note>possibly a shorthand reference to a specific manuscript or section</note> that the Patriarchs "fixed" the soul of *Malchut*. This means they "clothed" and softened her, because *Malchut* requires more correction <note><term>Tikun</term></note> than the other Divine Attributes. This is because "her feet descend to death" <note>a reference to Proverbs 5:5, interpreted here to mean that *Malchut*, being the lowest Sefirah, borders the realm of "husks" or negativity</note>. 

Therefore, Abraham adorned her with the "jewelry" of the Seven-fold Chariot of Kindness (*Chesed*), and Isaac adorned her with Might (*Gevurah*), until he became a "Chariot" for that attribute. Likewise, Jacob adorned her with the Torah and merited Truth/Justice in all his affairs, specifically regarding the Divine Presence (<term>Shechinah</term>). Jacob "cooked" the Seven <note>referring to the seven lower Sefirot</note> which was Understanding (*Binah*), and he went to the "well" which was *Malchut*. He "encountered the place" of the Shechinah. Abraham and Isaac represented two opposites—Kindness and Judgment—and there was a need for Peace <note><term>Shalom</term></note> between them for the world to be sustained. Through good deeds, one becomes a Chariot for Kindness, drawing from the source of *Malchut*.

---

## The Gate

Yet, due to the limited capacity of those who receive it, this light is not fully grasped. This also teaches us that the "Living Beings" <note>the angels</note> could not draw from its flow because of its extreme refinement. Therefore, the Holy One, blessed be He, hid this "Second Light" for the righteous in the Future to Come.

**The Righteous** <note><term>Tzaddikim</term></note> refers to the Sefirot of *Tiferet* (Beauty) and *Yesod* (Foundation), as it is written: "For the Lord is righteous, He loves righteous deeds," and "The righteous is the foundation of the world." They draw their sustenance from Wisdom (*Chochmah*) through Understanding (*Binah*), in the aspect called the "Future to Come." This is the hidden inner realm where Wisdom is concealed. 

As they said in the *Zohar* (Section Yitro): "That impression <note><term>Reshimu</term></note> sought to cover itself; it made for itself a palace in which to hide. That palace emerged from it and spread with great and mighty expansion to every side. It honored it with precious garments and opened for it fifty gates. Within the innermost part, that impression was hidden and concealed. Once it was hidden within and entered the interior, it was filled with light." Thus far the quote. 

Indeed, the "World to Come" is also an appellation for *Binah*, the "river that never ceases," which flows and brings abundance to the lower realms. 

(Wisdom is the "measure of all merchandise in the world" because in the beginning, all the existences and encompassments that were destined to be formed in the world were limited and contained within *Binah*. Thus it is said in the *Tikunim*: "A shield and a buckler is His truth." The "Shield" is the Lower Shechinah (*Malchut*) and the "Buckler" <note>the *Soharet* stone/surrounding trade</note> is the Upper Shechinah (*Binah*). "His Truth" is the Middle Pillar <note><term>Tiferet</term></note>.) 

It says that the "Power of the Stone" was used to weigh the letter *Yod* <note>the smallest Hebrew letter, representing the point of Wisdom</note> in the aspect of Wisdom as it unites with Understanding. This is the secret of the word *Ch-C-M-H* <note>Wisdom</note>—it is a "Precious Stone," a shining point within the Palace. The term *Soharet* implies a "circle" or "encompassing" <note>from the Hebrew root meaning to go around</note>, because it includes and surrounds the "World of Construction" <note>the lower seven Sefirot</note>.

(He asked: what is the meaning of *Dar*? From this, "Let there be light" will be explained. *Dar* represents the existence of the "rib" taken from the brilliance of the *Soharet*. This is one facet out of the "two thousand" <note>Wisdom and Understanding, which preceded the world by 2000 years</note>. God built from her a construction for the Precious Stone, the existence of the *Yod*. She is "beautiful" because of the flow of *Tiferet*. *Malchut* is the letter *He* and *Tiferet* is the letter *Vav*, totaling 11, which relates to the name *Eheyeh*. She is adorned by that flow in three colors, represented by the three *Vavs* in the letter *He*. Therefore they said: "All the commandments are included in her"—right and left, "do" and "do not," which depend on the Ten Sefirot. Since *Malchut* is composed of all ten, she includes all their branches. This was necessary to explain before the discussion of the "Chariots" which follows.)

## Chapter 4: And it is Found

There <note>in the *Bahir*</note> it says: Abraham came and asked that this precious stone be given to him, but He did not want to; instead, he took his own portion, as it is said, "Kindness (*Chesed*) to Abraham." Isaac came and asked for power; they gave him this measure but he did not want it, and instead he merited and took the attribute of Might (*Gevurah*), which is "Fear," as it is written "by the Fear of his father Isaac." Jacob came and wanted it, but they did not give it to him. He said: "Since Abraham is above and Isaac is below, you shall be in the middle and take all three." 

What is the "Middle"? It is the secret of Peace. But is it not written, "You give Truth to Jacob"? Truth and Peace are one and the same, as the verse says: "Words of peace and truth." This is why it is written: "I will feed you the heritage of Jacob your father," which is a complete heritage—Fear, Kindness, Truth, and Peace.

**He said:** Because of the Holy One's love, He sought to complete this attribute <note>*Malchut*</note> which requires more correction than any other—since "her feet descend to death"—He asked Abraham to leave the domain of the "husks" <note><term>Kelipot</term></note> by saying, "Go forth from your land... to the land that I will show you." This "Land" is specifically *Malchut*, which he was to adorn. Even though his soul's radiance was from the side of Kindness (*Chesed*), a soul can illuminate any attribute it wishes, for every soul is composed of all ten Sefirot. He could have influenced *Malchut* from his own essence. 

Indeed, our master David called himself "pious/kind" <note>original: <term>Chasid</term></note> through the secret of "the sure mercies of David." Abraham, however, merited through his actions and his "journeys" to this Land to establish its leadership. 

**Isaac came**, of whom it is written "visitation" and "remembrances" <note>terms associated with *Malchut* and *Yesod*</note>. The emanation of his soul was from *Malchut* within *Yesod*. Therefore, it was said of him "a son for Sarah," in the secret of the Feminine. She was his "Chariot" before the Binding <note>the <term>Akedah</term></note>, for he poured out his soul unto death, until the "Dew of Resurrection" prevailed through the secret of the Name of the "Living of the Worlds" and revived him. Then he sought a higher power... even after the Binding, it was said to him, "Dwell in this land." He merited to be crowned in his place in the secret of the "Life of the Worlds," leaning to the left alongside Abraham who held the right. Therefore, the *Bahir* says elsewhere: "And through the merit..."

# Pomegranate Juice &emsp; &emsp; &emsp; Gate 22: The Appellations &emsp; &emsp; &emsp; Slice of the Pomegranate

For the purpose and according to what His wisdom, blessed be He, decreed, and as explained in the resting place within it: the human vessel serves as palaces and garments for the spirituality and higher powers within it. To the stranger, His kindnesses are visions, and the branches of specific matters are linked. The flow of this connection exists through the power and wisdom of Kindness <note>original: "Chesed"</note> to incline the Chariot <note>original: "Merkabah" — a term referring to a physical vehicle or "throne" for Divine energy</note> toward the eight essences of the <term>Sefirot</term> <note>Divine emanations or attributes through which God interacts with the world</note>.

To understand the matter of the Chariot, know that any person who purifies themselves from all sin and is exceptionally meticulous in a specific commandment, pursuing it and clinging to it, becomes a "Chariot." This is just as the Sefirot, whose conduct is explained as acting as a power over specific details. Likewise, when one purifies each of their limbs and strengthens their focus, they become a power, a base, and a Chariot for that specific Sefirah to which that matter alludes. 

One should not wonder if a person happens to sin with one of their limbs and is thus removed from being such a Chariot for that Sefirah; God forbid <note>original: "Chas ve-chalila"</note> that such a lack should cause a deficiency in the Torah's requirement of him. The matter is that one should purify their entire body from every blemish, and afterward, be meticulous regarding any deficiency and occupy themselves with commandments and acts of charity. In this way, they will become a power and a Chariot for the specific Sefirah designated for that act. 

Specifically, if it happens that one stays awake during the rest of the night, God forbid that this should be a deficiency for that Sefirah. The desire is that the aspect of the "Word" should be like frankincense, not a deficiency in the Sefirot one is occupied with. A Chariot for a companion Sefirah is established through one's specific aspect, despite deficiencies or stumbles, for it is desired that the higher aspects and the Sefirot—each of which is comprised of ten sub-Sefirot—should be complete. 

A person should pray that when they perform a strong and holy act in one of the Sefirot, they should become a Chariot for it. It is desired that their wisdom be whole through that Sefirah, and they should turn to recognize their specific aspect. The Chariot exists in its totality, and the prayer in its specific aspect aims for it to be established in Heaven. The intention in the Chariot is that when one holds fast to three of the visions, a opening of light is granted to them from the Sefirah where the spiritual face dwells. When one strengthens their appointment, the Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah"</note> adds to them to compensate for any deficiency and to cling to them, in order to receive from that flowing freedom. This continues upward until the Divine Presence clothes itself in the soul of that righteous person <note>original: "Tzadik"</note>, becoming like a palace and a house of rest for the Divine Presence. 

When the Divine Presence clothes itself in the soul of the righteous person, the light of the higher Sefirah is revealed and clothed within the Divine Presence through the visions that cling to the soul of the righteous person. Regarding the secret of Understanding <note>original: "Binah"</note>, the soul of the righteous person becomes a palace for Understanding and a Chariot for the higher Sefirah. When the Sefirah is unified with the soul of the righteous person, the appearance of the flow, its blessings, and its actions occur through that righteous person. Their intention and focus should be toward the abundance flowing from that Sefirah to all the lower worlds. 

Even the angels do not receive from the flow of that Sefirah except through the mediation of the soul of the righteous person. This is the secret of what is written regarding "Blessing," meaning the source of blessings—a "pool" <note>original: "Berachah," punning on "Berechah" (pool/reservoir)</note> for the abundance of the flow. This means that one becomes a Chariot for Kindness <note>original: "Chesed"</note>. Similarly, other figures were Chariots, each for their specific attribute: Abraham for Kindness, Isaac for Might <note>original: "Gevurah"</note>, and Jacob for Beauty <note>original: "Tiferet"</note> in the secret of Enoch. Moses was for Beauty through the secret of Knowledge <note>original: "Da'at"</note>. 

Through his intention, he was distinguished in the Scripture. Joseph was for the Foundation <note>original: "Yesod"</note> because he guarded himself and adorned the holy covenant <note>referring to sexual purity and the sign of the covenant</note>, thus meriting to be a Chariot for the Foundation, which is the conduit for the flow from Beauty to Sovereignty <note>original: "Malchut"</note>. Because of this, he merited to sustain the world, following the principle of "Desire" and the generation of Sovereignty. Therefore, the "daughter of the house" <note>referring to the soul or the Shekhinah</note> rose to occupy herself with Torah and commandments.

### Chapter 4
It is explained in the *Book of Illumination* <note>original: "Sefer HaBahir"</note> that Kindness <note>Abraham</note> merited and refined his attribute of Kindness, and Isaac merited and refined his attribute of Might, and Jacob—

<column-break/>

—without the wicked or iniquities; they are the "cords of the year." "And I have not forgotten Your Torah" <note>Psalm 119:176</note>, for until midnight David would occupy himself with Torah. From then on, he engaged in songs and praises to "adorn" the Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note>, so that she would be radiant and prepared to receive an additional flow. However, the full necessity of the flow was not drawn down in his days because he shed much blood and fought the wars of the Lord. Therefore, he called himself "poor and needy." It was subsequently drawn down in the days of Solomon, to whom the Lord gave rest on every side, with neither adversary nor evil occurrence.

**Indeed**, Joseph the Righteous merited to be called by the name of the "Righteous One of the World," for he became a Chariot to the light revealed in Sovereignty from the side of the Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, his understanding being directed toward the Divine Union. He merited this because he guarded his covenant in holiness, and from there he sustained the world.

### And what
the Sages said regarding the Patriarchs of the world being "the Chariot" is understood by what they are called. Our Father Abraham, peace be upon him, became a Chariot for the "Thread of Kindness" which is drawn over Sovereignty in the secret of "the right hand brings near," for he brought all inhabitants of the world closer to the service of Heaven. Isaac was a Chariot for the second thread, which is influenced by Might <note>Gevurah</note>, for he "stretched out his neck upon the altar." 

They said in the *Zohar* that he would inform all the inhabitants of the world that there is Law and there is a Judge. With the "left hand pushing away," he rejected all unjust gain, rescuing the oppressed. Through his attribute, wealth and money flow to the world, as it is written: "And Isaac sowed in that land" <note>Genesis 26:12</note> and "for you have become much stronger than us" <note>Genesis 26:16</note>. All this is in addition to the refinement of the "Embrace" shared by Abraham and Isaac in the secret of the "Arms," as previously mentioned.

### But
from what assisted, there is substance for two aspects of Unity: that of Beauty <note>Tiferet</note> and Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note> in their hidden and revealed existence. This was entrusted to Moses and to Jacob. Joseph became a "best man" <note>original: "Shuvin" — an intermediary or wedding attendant</note> for both of them, as it is written: "These are the chronicles of Jacob: Joseph..." <note>Genesis 37:2</note> and "And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him" <note>Exodus 13:19</note>. 

Behold, Jacob became a Chariot for the light revealed in Sovereignty from the side of Beauty, which pours into it two kinds of flow: one through the chain of the structure of all other attributes, and another where he actually unites with her in the secret of "the study of Torah is equal to them all." For his Torah was his primary occupation; he was hidden in the House of Eber for fourteen years, and even at night he did not sleep, to continue his persistent study of the Torah.

### And great
is the honor of our teacher Moses, peace be upon him, who became a Chariot for the light revealed in the innermost part of Sovereignty—the "King's daughter," the secret of the "Side" <note>referring to the creation of Eve from Adam's side</note> in its freshness. Moses came from the secret of Knowledge <note>Da'at</note> within Beauty. With this hidden union, he became a "best man" above to unify the "Father and Mother" <note>the higher Sefirot of Chochmah and Binah</note>. This is part of the wonders he performed through his engagement with the Torah, interpreting it for the six hundred thousand souls. He merited to bring down the Manna and all the signs and wonders.

### There is,
however, the level of Enoch, which is below them all. He was a "sewer of shoes" <note>a famous Kabbalistic metaphor</note>. His will was to connect <term>Metatron</term>—the secret of the shoe with all its aspects—to Sovereignty. With every stitch he made with the awl, he would utter a blessing for the "Higher Need," to draw flow from above onto Sovereignty. Therefore, he merited in his lifetime to be a Chariot for the Prince of the Face <note>the high angel Metatron</note>. 

This is the key to all that will follow in the words of our Rabbis regarding the attribution of any Chariot to any of the holy ones—each person and the work they do. It should be understood that they draw an additional flow to the "Woman of Valor" <note>Malchut</note> who leads the world, from that specific aspect they merited.

# Pomegranate Juice &emsp; &emsp; &emsp; Gate 22: The Appellations &emsp; &emsp; &emsp; Slice of the Pomegranate
### 65

<margin>
He stretched a line and took the measure for Beauty <note>original: "Tiferet"</note>. He explained there that the Holy One, Blessed be He, desired that they rectify the Kingdom <note>original: "Malchut"</note>, meaning they should create a Chariot <note>original: "Merkabah"</note> for the Kingdom. This is because she requires more rectification than the other attributes, since "her feet go down to death" <note>A phrase from Proverbs 5:5, used here to suggest that the attribute of Malchut descends into the lower realms and requires human effort to elevate it</note>. He explains that she was small in Kindness <note>Chesed</note> until he made a Chariot for the "Little One" in the Torah, and for the Priest for Justice... just as with the matter of the Eighth. Similarly, Jacob... in the Torah... as in the matter of the Eighth, sent from the Crown <note>Keter</note>... Understanding <note>Binah</note>, and he went as a Chariot for the Kingdom. Likewise, he encountered the place of the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note>... to be a Chariot for Beauty, for she is its companion. And Isaac, there are two opposites: this is Kindness and this is Judgment <note>Din</note>. It was necessary for there to be peace between them for the rectification of the world through the soul, so that through good deeds they would become a Chariot for Kindness... such as the Tablets.
</margin>

...through the excellence of their deeds and from the quarry of their souls. **Section 3** in the *Book of Brilliance* <note>original: "Sefer HaBahir," a foundational 12th-century Kabbalistic text</note>:
Rabbi Meir said: What is the meaning of that which is written, "And God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light" (Genesis 1:3), and it does not say, "and it was so"? This teaches that this light was very great, and no creature could look upon it. The Holy One, Blessed be He, hid it for the righteous in the future to come. It is the attribute of all the "merchandise" <note>original: "sechorah," a play on words in the Bahir linking trade/merchandise with the surrounding light</note> in the world, and it is the power of the precious stone called *Zoharet* <note>Brilliant</note>. And what is the attribute of *Der* <note>A term from Esther 1:6 often translated as mother-of-pearl or white marble</note>? It teaches that the Holy One took a spark from a thousandth of its brilliance and built from it a beautiful and adorned precious stone, and included within it all the commandments. Thus far the quote.

**Explanation:** "Let there be light" refers to the existence of the "Second Light," which is the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note>, for she is second to Wisdom <note>Chochmah</note>. The "First Light" was very great, in the secret of the line of Kindness <note>Chesed</note>, which Wisdom ascends over, above Understanding <note>Binah</note> as well. This is the meaning of "very [great]," and no creature could look upon it. The intent of its expansion was to "make known to the sons of man His mighty acts," yet due to the scarcity of those who can perceive it, it is not attained. He also intended to teach us that the lower entities could not draw from its flow because of its extreme subtlety; therefore, the Holy One, Blessed be He, hid this second light for the righteous in the future to come.

**The Righteous** <note>original: "Tzaddikim"</note>: These are the attributes of Beauty and Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, as it is written: "For the Lord is righteous, He loves righteous deeds," and "The righteous is the foundation of the world." They draw from Wisdom through Understanding, in the aspect called the "Future to Come" <note>Olam Ha-Ba</note>. This refers to her innermost part which is not revealed, where Wisdom is unified. As they said in the *Zohar* in the portion of *Yitro*: "That impression sought to cover itself, and it made for itself a palace to hide within. That palace emerged from itself and appeared great and vast to every side. He honored it with precious garments and opened for it fifty gates. Inside, that impression was hidden and concealed. Once it was concealed and redeemed within, it was filled with light." Thus far the quote. Indeed, the "World to Come" is also a name for Understanding <note>Binah</note>, which is a flow that never ceases, continuing to provide influence below.

**And Wisdom** is the attribute of all "merchandise" <note>original: "sechorah"</note> in the world, for within it all future existences and circuits to be formed in the world were limited at the beginning. This is Understanding. Therefore, they said in the *Tikkunim* <note>The Tikkunei HaZohar</note>: "'A shield and a buckler <note>original: "socherah"</note> is His truth'—'Shield' is the Lower Presence <note>the Shekhinah/Malchut</note>, and 'Buckler' is the Higher Presence <note>Binah</note>. 'His Truth' is the Middle Pillar <note>Tiferet</note>." He said that there was power in the stone to weigh with it—this is the secret of the number 208 <note>the numerical value of the word "Der"</note> in the aspect of Wisdom that unites with Understanding. This is the "power" in the secret of "Power of What" <note>original: "Koach Mah," a play on words relating the numerical value of Power (28) and the Divine Name (45)</note>. It is a precious stone shining within the Palace, from the expression "a precious day passing," called *Socheret* <note>Buckler/Surrounder</note>, a term for "surrounding," as it includes and surrounds the World of Construction, which contains the circuit of all existences.

**And he asked:** What is *Der*? For through it, "Let there be light" is explained. The explanation is that *Der* is the reality of the "rib" taken from the brilliance of the *Socheret*. It is one of the two thousand aspects which are Wisdom and Understanding—the Torah that preceded the World of Construction in their inclusion from ten and ten of tens until the "thousand," which is the end of the sphere. Similarly, for both of them, it indicated the existence of the "rib" in the aspect of the two thousand years themselves before the Construction was revealed. He built from it the "Living Being" of the letter *He* <note>ה</note>, which is the construction for the precious stone, the reality of the letter *Yod* <note>י</note>. She is beautiful from the side of the flow of Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>. Since Kingdom <note>Malchut</note> is 50 and Beauty is 6, the numerical value is 56, the permutation of which is "the Mountain" <note>H-A</note>. This indicates that she is adorned with that flow in the three colors of the rainbow, which are the colors found in the letter *A*. Therefore, he said, "all the commandments are included in her," right and left, positive and negative, which depend on the Ten Sefirot. Since the Kingdom is included of ten, she therefore includes their branches as well. It was necessary to preface this to explain the "Chariots" that follow.

-> The Gate <-

### Chapter 4: And it is brought
there: Abraham came and asked to be given this precious stone, but He did not want to; rather, he took his own attribute, as it is said, "Kindness <note>Chesed</note> to Abraham." Isaac came and asked for power; they gave him this attribute, but he did not want it, and instead took the attribute of Strength <note>Gevurah</note>, which is Fear, as it is written, "By the Fear of his father, Isaac." Jacob came and wanted it, but it was not given to him. He said: Since Abraham and Isaac are beneath you, you shall be the middle one and take all three. What is "middle"? It means Peace. But is it not written, "You will give Truth to Jacob"? Truth and Peace are one, as it says, "words of peace and truth," and "if only there be peace and truth in my days." And this is what is written, "I will feed you the heritage of Jacob your father," which is a complete heritage: Fear, Kindness, Truth, and Peace.

**He says** that out of the love of the Holy One, Blessed be He, to complete this attribute <note>Malchut</note> which requires more rectification than any other—because "her feet go down to death"—He requested of Abraham that he leave the domain of the "husks" <note>original: "Kelipot," forces of impurity</note> by saying to him, "Go forth from your land... to the land that I will show you." This "Land" is the special one, the Kingdom, to adorn her. Even though the primary sparkle of his soul was from the side of Kindness <note>Chesed</note>—as he said nearby that Kindness was his attribute—it is possible to illuminate any attribute one desires, for every soul is comprised of all ten. He was able to influence the Kingdom from his own essence in the secret of Kindness, just as our master David did, who called himself "pious/kind" <note>chasid</note> in the secret of "the sure mercies <note>chasdei</note> of David," and it is written "and Your kindness they shall sing." The verse testifies that Abraham did not want it, though in truth he is still associated with it, as will be explained. Rather, he merited through his deeds and "went on his journeys" toward this Land, "journeying toward the South" <note>associated with Chesed</note>. Isaac **came**, of whom it is written "visitation" and "deposits," which are like "remembrances," for the emanation of his soul was from the Kingdom within Foundation. Therefore, it was said regarding him, "and to Sarah a son," from the side of the Female. She was his Chariot before the Binding <note>the Akedah</note>, for that reason he "poured out his soul unto death." However, the [light] of the Resurrection of the Dead overcame him through the name *Y-H-W* in its fullness, the secret of the "Life of the Worlds," and revived him. Then he sought higher power, even though this attribute had already been granted and it was said to "dwell" in them after the Binding—"dwell <note>gur</note> in this land." He merited and was crowned in his place in the secret of the "Living End of the Worlds," taking to the left along with Abraham who held the right. Therefore, they said in the *Bahir* in another place...

<summary>This page discusses the Kabbalistic interpretation of the "precious stone" (the attribute of Malchut) and how the Patriarchs—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—interact with it. It explains that while the attribute of Kingdom requires human rectification, the Patriarchs ultimately embody Kindness, Strength, and Beauty to support it.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the discussion of how human limbs and the Patriarchs serve as a "Chariot" (Merkabah) for the Divine Sefirot, specifically focusing on the purification of the body and the specific roles of Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph, Moses, and Enoch in anchoring Divine light in the world.</meta>

# Pomegranate Juice &emsp; &emsp; &emsp; Gate 22: The Appellations &emsp; &emsp; &emsp; Slice of the Pomegranate

...for the necessity according to what His wisdom, may He be blessed, decreed. With what has been explained, we find that all the limbs of a person's parts are palaces and garments for the spiritualities and supernal powers. Indeed, all of a man's limbs are likenesses, reflections, and branches of the supernal roots. From the perspective of this connection, it is within the power and preparation of a man to incline the Chariot <term>Merkabah; a vehicle or vessel for Divine energy</term> toward one of the branches of the Sefirot <term>the ten creative attributes of God</term> and to prepare the matter of the Chariot. Know that every man who purifies himself from all sin and sanctifies himself through the commandments exceedingly, and pursues and clings to the holy mystery, becomes—heaven forbid the opposite—a Chariot for the Sefirot to which that specific commandment alludes.

Similarly, when he purifies one specific limb from its fellows, that limb itself will be a foundation and a Chariot for that Sefirah which flows toward it, whether for good or for its opposite. The explanation is that if he purifies one of his limbs, it becomes a Chariot for that Sefirah. Therefore, you find the saying regarding Phinehas, that in his zeal to purify, he established the foundation <note>original: "Yesod"</note> of the void of the Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah"</note> from the seed of forbidden mixtures <note>original: "Kila'im"</note>. The matter is that one should purify his whole body from blemish and sin, and sanctify himself limb by limb so that he performs commandments and acts of righteousness with them. Then he will be a throne and a Chariot for that Sefirah designated for it, especially if he calls upon its names... and from that Sefirah... so that it lives in those hours. For everything, one must unify from the Sefirot the Diadem <note>original: "Atara," another name for Malchut</note> as a Chariot for another Sefirah through his intention <note>original: "Kavannah"</note>, which he shall direct and attach.

And even though the Sefirot are emanated from God, and each Sefirah is comprised of all ten, when a man exerts himself in a deed of a commandment regarding one of the Sefirot, he becomes a Chariot for it. Even though, from its perspective, it is comprised of other Sefirot, since he prevails over his own nature for its sake, it will be integrated and revealed in his character until it is called by his name.

The concept of the "Chariot" is this: when a man holds fast to humility and the commandments, a pipe <term>Tzinor; a channel of Divine flow</term> opens upon him from the Sefirah to which that law alludes. Through the intention of that pipe, the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note> pursues him to cling to him in order to receive from that flowing light, elevating him until the Divine Presence clothes itself in the soul of that righteous person <term>Tzaddik</term>. He assists through his intention in the sacrifice and slaughter for the "Machine" <note>an archaic term for the Divine system</note>. When the Divine Presence clothes itself in the soul of that Tzaddik, the light of that upper Sefirah is revealed, clothed within the Divine Presence in the "outer" part which clings to the soul of the Tzaddik. The end of the matter is that the soul of that Tzaddik becomes a palace for the Divine Presence and a Chariot for the upper Sefirah.

When that Sefirah is unified in the soul of the Tzaddik, it flows with abundance <note>original: "Shefa"</note> and its blessings, performing its actions through that Tzaddik. His character becomes a source for the abundance flowing from that Sefirah to all the lower and upper worlds. For even the angels do not receive from the abundance of that Sefirah except through the mediation of the soul of the Tzaddik. This is the meaning of "they shall be blessed" and "you shall be a blessing," meaning a source of blessings, and that they should merit the blessing of the abundance—that is, to be a Chariot for the luminary.

So too, the other Patriarchs were each a Chariot for his specific attribute: Abraham for Kindness <note>Chesed</note>, Isaac for Strength <note>Gevurah</note>, Jacob for Beauty <note>Tiferet</note> as is known. Enoch's kindness was toward Beauty in the mystery of Knowledge <note>Da'at</note>, and his prophecy was specialized between Hearing and Understanding <note>Binah</note>. Joseph was for the Foundation <note>Yesod</note> because he guarded himself and sanctified the "Holy Covenant" <note>a reference to sexual purity</note>, meriting to be a Chariot for the Foundation, which is the end of the transition of the flow from Beauty to the Kingdom. Because of this, he merited to sustain the world in the years of famine. And David was for the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note>, as he struggled with his life <note>literally "cheeks"</note>, and therefore rose before the night to engage in Torah and commandments.

### Chapter 4

It is explained in the *Book of Brilliance* <note>original: "Sefer HaBahir"</note> that Kindness merited and took his attribute of Kindness, and Isaac merited and took his attribute of Strength, and Jacob...

<column-break/>

...without the wicked ones surrounding me; they are the "bonds of sleep." Nevertheless, "I have not forgotten Your Torah" <note>referencing Psalm 119</note>, for until midnight he was engaged in Torah, and from then on in songs and praises to adorn the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note>, so that she would be radiant and sweet to receive an additional flow. However, the full necessity of the flow was not drawn down in his days because he shed much blood and fought the wars of the Lord. Therefore, he called himself "Radiant," for there was no adversary or evil occurrence.

**Indeed**, Joseph the Righteous merited to be called by the name of the "Righteous One of the World," for he became a Chariot for the light revealed in the Kingdom from the side of the Foundation <note>Yesod</note> which leads to the Union <note>Zivug</note>. He merited this because he guarded his covenant in holiness, and from there he would nourish the world.

**As for** what the Sages said about the Patriarchs being "The Chariot," it will be understood by what we preface: that Abraham, peace be upon him, became a Chariot for the "Thread of Kindness" drawn over the Kingdom in the mystery of "the right hand brings near." For the Lord brings all who come into the world near to the service of Heaven. Isaac was a Chariot for the "Second Thread" influenced in her from Strength <note>Gevurah</note>, as he "stretched out his neck upon the altar." They said in the *Zohar* that he would inform all who come into the world that there is Judgment and there is a Judge in the underworld for every greedy person, and he would save the oppressed. From this attribute, wealth and sustenance are flowed to the world—"your blessing"—and "Isaac sowed in that land," and it is written, "for you have become much stronger than us." All of this is in addition to the rectification of the "Embrace" shared by Abraham and Isaac in the mystery of the Arms, as mentioned previously.

**However**, the status of the Foundation <note>Yesod</note> is greater than theirs, for they are the preparation for the Union, but it [the Foundation] assists because it has substance for two aspects of the Unity. That which belongs to Beauty <note>Tiferet</note> and Kingdom <note>Malchut</note> in their hidden and revealed existence was equally handed over to Moses, and this was for Jacob. Joseph became a "best man" <note>shoshbin</note> for both of them, as it is written: "These are the generations of Jacob: Joseph," and "Moses took the bones of Joseph with him." Behold, Jacob became a Chariot for the light revealed in the Kingdom from the side of Beauty, which pours into her two kinds of flow: one in the chain of the "Building" <note>the structure of the Sefirot</note> through all the other attributes, and furthermore, he actually unites with her in the mystery of "Torah study is equal to them all," for his Torah was his faith. He stayed in the House of Eber for fourteen years, and even at night he did not lie down due to the constancy of his engagement in Torah.

**And great** is the honor of Moses our Teacher, who became a Chariot for the light revealed in the inner part of the Kingdom—the "King's daughter," the mystery of the "Side," the "Bride of Moses" from the mystery of Knowledge <note>Da'at</note> that is in Beauty. With this hidden Union, he became a "best man" above for the rest, like a father and mother. This is part of how he "did wonders" and "all the signs and portents."

**There is**, however, the level of Enoch <note>original: "Hanokh"</note> below them all, who was a "sewer of shoes." His will was to connect Metatron <term>an archangel often associated with Enoch</term>—the mystery of the "shoe" with all its aspects—to the Kingdom. With every stitch that he pricked with the awl, he was grafting for a "higher need," to draw flow from above upon the Kingdom. Therefore, he merited in his lifetime to be a Chariot for the "Prince of the Face" <term>Sar HaPanim, a title for Metatron</term>. This is a key to all that will come in the words of our Rabbis regarding the attribution of any Chariot to whichever of the holy ones, "each man from his work which they do." It should be understood that they are drawing down an additional flow to the "Woman of Valor" <note>referencing Malchut</note> who leads the world from that aspect which they merited through their skill.

It details the specific spiritual roles of Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph, Moses, and Enoch in the celestial hierarchy.</summary>

# Pomegranate Juice &emsp; &emsp; &emsp; Gate 22: The Appellations &emsp; &emsp; &emsp; Slice of the Pomegranate

...to one of the sides and one of the Divine attributes. For example, Abraham is the "Man of **Kindness**" <term>Chesed</term>; Isaac is girded with **Strength** <term>Gevurah; associated with judgment and restraint</term>; and Jacob with **Beauty** <term>Tiferet; the central attribute balancing kindness and strength</term>. Moses is associated with **Victory** <term>Netzach</term>, Aaron with **Splendor** <term>Hod</term>, Joseph with the **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, and likewise Solomon. In the aspect of **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> lies the secret of the priesthood. Moses is also linked to the "Hidden Knowledge" <term>Da'at</term> within the attribute of **Beauty**, representing the inner dimensions and secrets of the Torah. Joseph, Boaz, and Palti son of Laish are all rooted in the **Foundation** <term>Yesod; the attribute linked to sexual purity and the funneling of divine energy</term>, and likewise Solomon. Solomon also has an affinity with the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term> in its outward expression, which is included within the **Foundation**, and many such examples exist. "And four they are in every kingdom," etc., referring to the majority of the righteous kings.

However, the specific individuals designated as the "Foundations of every generation" across the totality of the Divine attributes are: Adam, Noah, and Shem, who correspond to **Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge** <term>Chokhmah, Binah, and Da'at</term>; Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who correspond to **Kindness, Strength, and Beauty** <term>Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet</term>; and Moses, Aaron, Phinehas, and David, who correspond to **Victory, Splendor, Foundation, and Sovereignty** <term>Netzach, Hod, Yesod, and Malkhut</term>. Some count Joshua for **Sovereignty** <term>Malkhut</term>, the "face of the moon," to complete the Divine Chariots upon their entry into the Land of Israel. Nevertheless, the "Four" are among the seven "Fathers" who struck the covenant. All ten are the roots of the souls for the "Complete Man" <note>Adam Ha-Shalem; the primordial spiritual archetype of humanity</note> within the inclusion of the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term>, the "Mother of all living," as we mentioned in the first Gate, with God’s help.

### Gate Twenty-Three: Explaining the Values of the Appellations — The Letter Aleph

<columns>2</columns>

**Chapter 1: Aleph-Bet** The **Crown** <term>Keter</term> and **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> and their living forces indicate this regarding the name **Father** <note>original: "Ab" (Aleph-Bet)</note>.

<margin>**Father (AB)**</margin> This refers to **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>. Furthermore, the acronym for "Father of Mercies" <note>original: "Av Ha-Rachamim"</note> stems from it, as it flows into the **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> of mercy. **Wisdom** is the progenitor and "Father" of all existence. From **Wisdom**, the source of the "all" flows into the **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. The term **Father** (AB) is taken because **Wisdom** is the father to **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, which is included with it. It is also the "Father" to **Sovereignty** <term>Malkhut</term>, which is also called "Wisdom" in the secret of "The Lord by Wisdom founded the earth" <note>Proverbs 3:19</note>. When the flow is divided, it is called "Father" to **Wisdom**; here the judgment is thin/refined in the secret of its flow into the statute and its foundation. **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> is also called **Father** through mercy, for he is the father of the "Congregations" and is merciful through the secret of the "Mercy of the Crown" <term>Rachamei Keter</term>. When **Beauty** has mercy on **Sovereignty** via the secret of the Crown’s mercy, he is called "Father of Mercies." This name is sometimes attributed to the **Crown** <term>Keter</term> or **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, as it acts like a father in the Great Mercies stemming from the Crown. There is also an interpretation of **Father** (AB) as a "branch" or "root" of the expansion of the Divine Emanation <term>Atzilut</term>. **Beauty** is the Father, and the "branches" are those that spread from his "brain" into the **Foundation**—meaning the influence of the Foundation.

<margin>**Will (ABH)**</margin> This refers to the "ascent of the Will," and the Will resides in the **Crown** <term>Keter</term>; thus it is the influence of the Supernal Crown.

<margin>**Lost (ABD)**</margin> Like the **Crown**, "ABD" <note>original: "Abad," meaning lost or destroyed</note> refers to the withdrawal of the Divine flow.

<margin>**Gleanings (ABChT)**</margin> This refers to "gathering" <note>original: "Leket"</note>. Gathering is like the sustenance provided by **Sovereignty** <term>Malkhut</term>, meaning the influence of the "sustenance" of the Divine Presence, and all are one.

<margin>**Mourning (ABL)**</margin> This refers to the withdrawal of the Divine flow and the strengthening of the "Power of Judgment" <term>Gevurat Ha-Din</term> within holiness. It occurs when the holiness is "lowered" to cut off the external forces. This is the secret of the withdrawal of the Divine Presence and the dominance of Judgment.

<margin>**Mighty (ABI)**</margin> This is **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, his strength and the "Vision of Jacob," as in the "Mighty One of Israel" <note>original: "Abir Yisrael"</note>. He is called this in the secret of his emanation to tip the scales of Judgment toward Mercy.

<column-break/>

<margin>**Stone (ABN)**</margin> Apart from the secret of the "Inner Light" hinted at in the word, it is known that the "Male" principle is **Wisdom** and **Sovereignty** is the "Foundation" <note>original: "Yesod"</note>. Therefore, the entire Supernal Building is supported by her, in the secret of "Upon one stone are seven eyes" <note>Zechariah 3:9</note>.

<margin>**Father/Son (A-B)**</margin> The word **Stone** <note>original: "A-B-N", often read by Kabbalists as "Ab" (Father) and "Ben" (Son)</note> refers to the Crown and Wisdom of the righteous. She is called "Stone" (ABN) because of her relationship as a daughter from two sides: first, her standing from the side of **Judgment** and the merit of the righteous; second, her birth and nursing from **Mercy**, ascending to the **Crown**. She requires "purity" to ascend. This is the secret of "Afflictions of Love" that chastise the righteous so they are worthy of being "sweetened" <note>the process of turning Judgment into Mercy</note>. It also hints at all boundaries.

<margin>**Stone (ABN)**</margin> When she dwells in her house, she is called "Stone" (ABN) in the womb. She is called "the Mercy of the Lord in Righteousness." This refers to **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>, as explained in the Gate of Victories. Sometimes she is the "Head of the Corner" <note>Psalm 118:22</note> when she ascends to the **Crown**. She is the strength and power of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, and thus called the "Stone of Israel." Sometimes she is the crown of her husband.

<margin>**Limb/Wing (ABR)**</term> This is **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> through whom the flow is funneled. Commentators explain that she influences and shepherds Israel below. Furthermore, she is called "Stone" because **Beauty** refines all the flocks for her. Secondly, it refers to the **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> (Joseph) for the upper beings. Because she receives all actions, she is called "Stone."

<margin>**Dewdrop (AGL)**</margin> This is the **Sapphire** <term>Sefirah</term> that receives all colors from above, whether for good or otherwise. In the *Tikkunim*, it is explained that she is called this because she resembles **Wisdom**, which is called "Sapphire." Both **Wisdom** and **Sovereignty** share the numerical value of fifty <note>original: "Nun"</note>. From the side of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, she is called a "Complete Stone." This is what Rabbi Akiva meant when he said to his students: "When you reach the stones of pure marble, do not say 'Water, water!'" <note>A famous warning from the Talmud regarding the dangers of mystical ascent</note>. This refers to the two "waters"—the Foundation and Sovereignty—which, in the form of the letter Yod, fill Wisdom. From there, she is called "Stone" (ABN) because of the shape of the Yod.

<meta>This page continues the discussion from Gate 22 regarding how the Patriarchs (Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob) serve as a "Chariot"—a physical vehicle or manifestation—for the Divine Attributes (Sefirot). It specifically explores how their lives and actions mirrored the qualities of Kindness, Dread, and Beauty.</meta>

# Gate 22: The Appellations &emsp; &emsp; &emsp; Slice of the Pomegranate
### Page 1

<margin>
**A.** "Then with fire and with fire" <note>original: *az be-esh u-ve-asha*</note> refers to the waters, as in "Your right hand, O Lord, is glorious in power" (Exodus 15:6). Behold, the Altar is the secret of **Kingship** <term>Malchut; the final Sefirah, associated with the physical world and the feminine principle</term>. The Altar is also linked to **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. The "two arrangements of wood" on the Altar represent **Greatness** <term>Gedulah/Chesed</term> and **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>. The Altar itself is **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> above the wood. Isaac was "bound" above the wood because this Altar followed the secret of the Altar in the Eternal House <note>The Temple in Jerusalem</note>. The Sage [Rabbi Moshe Cordovero], may his memory be a blessing, explained in his book *Or Yakar* (The Precious Light) that the Altar is **Kingship** and **Foundation**. The "two small lambs" represent **Victory** and **Splendor** <term>Netzach and Hod</term>. The "surrounding ledge" is **Beauty**. The "west side" is **Strength**. The "four corners" represent **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>, which also includes the three higher attributes. The "large lamb" refers to the Wisdom and Beauty that dwell above **Greatness** and **Strength**. Isaac was bound upon the wood-pile, which represents **Dread** <term>Pachad; another name for the attribute of Strength/Judgment</term>, his specific divine attribute.
</margin>

By the merit of Abraham, who was worthy of the attribute of **Kindness**, Isaac was worthy of the attribute of **Dread**. This attribute stood by him after he offered his neck upon the Altar and they were integrated into one.

**Victory** and **Splendor**: We have learned that these are typically associated with the boughs of a fig tree (which belongs to **Victory**) and a nut tree (which belongs to **Splendor**). Regarding **Beauty**, the essence of the "Western Arrangement" <note>of the Altar fires</note> is the oil-wood.

Isaac "laughed" <note>a play on the name Yitzchak, meaning "he will laugh"</note> over them all. It is more accurate to explain that this Altar also followed the secret of the Altar in the Eternal House. The Sage, may his memory be a blessing, explained in the book *Or Yakar* that the Altar is **Kingship** and **Foundation**, as implied by the "two small lambs" being **Victory** and **Splendor**. The "surrounding ledge" is **Beauty**, the "west" is **Strength**, and the "four corners" are **Kindness**, also including the three higher attributes. The "large lamb" is in the Wisdom and Beauty that dwell above **Greatness** and **Strength**. Isaac was bound upon the wood-pile, which is **Dread**, his actual attribute.

**Jacob** arrived, and the emanation of his soul is from **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> in its lower aspect. The sign for this is "all the seed of truth" <note>Jeremiah 2:21</note>, referring to **Kingship, Foundation, and Beauty**. Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob are as explained in the Zohar (Portion: *Lech Lecha*). Jacob desired this attribute, and his actions prove it: "Jacob went out from Beer-sheva" <note>Genesis 28:10</note>—this refers to the Sefirah of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>—"and went toward Haran," which refers to **Kingship**, as explained in the Zohar. "He encountered the place"—this is the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term>. He said, "And this stone, which I have set up as a monument, shall be God’s house" (Genesis 28:22). He worked for Rachel, and Jacob’s name also hints at **Kingship** (the "Heel" <note>original: *Ekev*</note> and the letter *Yod*). He was not given this status until he married Leah—the secret of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>—and he became the "Chariot" for **Beauty**, which is the "fire of the children" <note>the central balancing force</note>. He is the "Righteous One" between two sisters <note>Leah and Rachel, representing the upper and lower Sefirot</term>, and then he was called "Israel," following the secret of the letter *Yod* within the Divine Name, situated between the two letters *Vav* of the Tetragrammaton. He includes three aspects, as previously mentioned.

**Truth**: **Beauty** is the secret of **Truth**, the "Middle Pillar" which is the line of Mercy in its own color. However, in terms of **Peace**, it completes **Kindness** and **Dread**. There are two designations for this: First, that **Truth** <term>Emet</term> includes three aspects: the essence of Truth itself, and the other letters of the word. Since **Peace** is hinted at in the shape of the letter *Aleph*, the remaining letters are *Tav* and *Mem* (forming the word *Tam*, "perfect" or "complete"), which hint at **Kingship**, as it is said, "A perfect man (*ish tam*), the husband of the Matron" <note>referring to the union of the Sefirot</note>. With this, "Truth" is consistent with what the author of *Me'orat Zuot* <note>a Kabbalistic work</note> precisely noted: "The Patriarchs are the Chariot." This does not mean each one is a complete chariot alone, but rather through their union, the three of them became a "firm throne" for the Divine Emanation.

## Chapter 5: He further said:

Therefore, it says: "The stone the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone" (Psalm 118:22). Why did they reject it? Is it not said, "Because Abraham obeyed My voice and kept My charge (*mishmarti*), My commandments..." (Genesis 26:5)? The attribute of **Kindness** said: "All the days Abraham was in the world, I did not need to do my work, for Abraham stood there in my place and kept my charge." And what is "my work"? It is that I justify the world. Even if they are found guilty, I grant them merit and further return them and bring it into their hearts to do the will of their Creator. Abraham did all of this, as it is written: "He planted an *Eshel* <note>an orchard or inn</note> in Beer-sheva and called there on the name of the Lord, God of the world" (Genesis 21:33). He provided food and water to all who came into the world, granting them merit and speaking to their hearts: "Whom are you worshipping? Worship the Lord, God of heaven and earth." He would lecture to them until they repented. How do we know he even granted merit to the guilty? As it is said: "And the Lord said: Shall I hide from Abraham what I am doing... and Abraham shall surely become..." (Genesis 18:17). Rather, God told him so that he would know and seek mercy for them and grant them merit. Is it possible God did not know he could only be saved through his merit? "One who comes to purify himself is assisted; one who comes to defile himself, they open the door for him." What does "they open for him" mean? It refers to those who always open for my commandments, my statutes, and my laws. Abraham said: "Since I do not desire it [the attribute of Judgment], I will keep its commandments." And what are "my laws"? Even the rulings and dialectical arguments <note>original: *pilpulim*</note> preserved Above—he knew them and fulfilled them. And what is meant by "From there is the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel" (Genesis 49:24)? It means from there the Stone of Israel is nourished. And what is "from there"? It refers to **Superior Justice**. And what is that? It is the Great Hidden Light, the "precious stone" <note>original: *socheret*</note> that was built beneath it, called "Friend" <note>original: *Re'a*; numerical value 72</note>.

**He said** that King David, peace be upon him, showed that the Patriarchs of the world "rejected" his attribute <note>Kingship/Judgment</note> when he saw that it was impossible to perfect its Divine Influence except over a long period of time, when the Lord grants rest to the people of the world by silencing the enemy. David held onto it when he saw its ascent to the "chief cornerstone." We also learned that Jacob desired it, for he did not fear the "terror of the night." 

He asked: Why do you say they rejected it? Is it not said of Abraham, "and he kept my charge," which is **Kingship**, including all the commandments as mentioned at the start of the essay? He replied: What is "my charge"? It is not the earthly portions which are matters of **Kingship**, but rather matters of **Kindness**. For Abraham our Father, peace be upon him, took hold of his "charge"—the **Kindness** within **Kingship**. From there, he became a "Chariot" for the Light of **Greatness** <term>Chesed</term> itself which is drawn down there. He did this by completing its three aspects: granting merit to the world by its downward influence; justifying them through its very essence; and having the secret of the "extended right hand" to receive those who repent, based on its reception from **Repentance** <term>Binah</term>, which is the source of souls. This is why it says "to do the will of their Creator." 

These three aspects in Abraham are: 
1. Providing bread and water (his aspect of influence). 
2. Lecturing to them until they repented (his aspect of initial reception). 
3. Justifying the guilty (his middle aspect). 

The latter was placed last because he did not succeed in justifying the people of Sodom. Therefore, the Holy One, blessed be He, wanted to grant him merit by having him seek mercy for them, joining his good intention to the deed.

**Since** I did not desire to be a "Chariot" for the abundance that adorns itself from its own essence, I will "keep its commandments" and draw down **Kindness** into it, as mentioned before. The "rulings and arguments" preserved Above refer to the innovations that the Sages of every generation will produce in the future, even "the mixing of cooked foods" <note>laws of *eruv tavshilin*</note>. Regarding the verse "By the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, from there is the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel"—the "Mighty One of Jacob" is the strong and hard **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> from which the "Stone and Son" <note>following the Aramaic translation</note> were nourished. For if so, Jacob would be a Chariot for **Kingship**, nourished by **Foundation**. Therefore, he explained "from there" as being from **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, which is **Superior Justice**, while **Kingship** is **Lower Justice**. **Understanding** is the Palace in which the Primordial Light was hidden; when it is hidden there, it is called *Socheret* (precious stone). Thus, **Beauty** is the letters *Yod* and *Vav* within the borders influenced by the Hidden Wisdom in **Understanding**, and Jacob and his sons are the "Chariot" for them.

The summary of the matter: It is possible for the righteous to be a Chariot for the Divine Attributes through the drawing down of their souls, their actions in this world, and their inclinations...

It explains how Abraham's hospitality and advocacy for the guilty were physical manifestations of the Divine attribute of Chesed.</summary>
