->### Assis Rimmonim: Gate 23, Values of Appellations<-

The **Shekhinah** <term>the Divine Presence, associated with the Sefirah of Malchut</term> which, through the [angelic] "Wings," they are clothed in her.
<margin>Also the order [of the angels]... regarding the "Crowns": the order of the twenty-five.</margin>
In the **Higher Foundation** <term>Yesod; the ninth Sefirah, the channel of connection</term>, His "Good Name" is to do good when seeing the **Candelabra** <note>the Menorah</note>.
In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet; the central Sefirah of harmony</term>, it is like a body from which hands and feet spread out; so too in **Beauty**, there is the spreading of hands and the mystery of the feet (the order of the twenty-five). Everything that is purified in the body is as one, and just as in a single body the limbs are drawn to the preceding limbs, so in the purified **Beauty** is the measure in **Foundation**. And just as there is a womb above the spring, so in **Beauty** there is [the attribute of] compassion above **Foundation**. And just as the body has the power of writing, here in **Beauty** it is as we have explained in the *Zohar*.
**Decree/Separator** <note>original: *Gorah*; related to cutting or defining boundaries</note>: It is good in **Beauty** when He decrees and separates below between the **Husks** <term>Kliphoth; the forces of impurity</term>. "Selah, may He have mercy on us" <note>a liturgical-style plea</note>. It is called the "End of the Rest" and it decides between the Holy right and left.
**Coal** <note>Hebrew: *Gachelet*</note>: When it is in a state of inflammation through **Strength** <term>Gevurah; the Sefirah of judgment</term>, and likewise in **Kingship** <term>Malchut; the final Sefirah</term> when she receives light from Him. The secret of the "Flame" is the **Foundation** that brings the light, and the secret of the "Coal" [is Malchut]; for just as the letter *Lamed* in the word contains eight "wings" and all the joints are tied to it when the flame is bound to the coal, so is the binding of **Kingship** to **Foundation**, all in the secret of the "Strongest of the Strong." And remember to mention it.
**Sifted Lime** <note>original: *Gir Hanaphah*; refers to chalk or lime used in building</note>: In **Kingship** when the **Foundation** is joined with her.
**Gehinnom** <note>Purgatory or Hell</note>: In **Strength** from the side of harsh judgment. It is called *N* <note>the letter Nun</note>, a language of depth, for the sea is deep, meaning it is subtle and profound.
**Valley** <note>Hebrew: *Gai*</note>: A term used for **Kingship** when she is received between the [Sefirotic] lines... the secret of the "Valley" is a language of depth, similar to the "Groan of the Bed."
**Wave/Heap** <note>Hebrew: *Gal*</note>: When resting in **Kingship** within the hidden spark, in the secret of the "Thirty-Nine [Lights]" as mentioned.
**Wheels of the Chariot**: In **Victory** and **Splendor** <term>Netzach and Hod; the seventh and eighth Sefirot</term> according to the words of Rabbi Moshe <note>Rabbi Moses Cordovero</note>.
**Waves** <note>Hebrew: *Galim*</note>: In **Kingship** when she receives and flows; the secret of the "S" <note>the letter Samekh</note> of the Structure. Likewise in **Understanding** <term>Binah; the third Sefirah</term>, for those surrounding it are the Sefirot of the Structure.
**Approach/Clash** <note>Hebrew: *Gash*</note>: The secret of "He approached the war." These are the ten Sefirot and the secret of the powers of judgment that clash in **Kingship** due to the totality of the "Higher Waves," which are the seven Sefirot of the Structure.
**Camel/Weaned** <note>Hebrew: *Gamal*</note>: Its sign is for Rachel...
**Acts of Kindness** <note>Hebrew: *Gemilat Chasadim*</note>: In **Kingship** from the side of **Kindness** <term>Chesed; the fourth Sefirah</term>.
**Garden** <note>Hebrew: *Gan*</note>: In **Understanding**, and likewise in **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah; the second Sefirah</term> and **Understanding**. **Understanding** is a "Garden for plantings" that were within the wombs, and **Kingship** is a garden for the lower plantings, etc. It is the "Bright Lily." Everything in it is grace, including the lower grace. Likewise, we include it in the three Sefirot of the Structure and all thirty of its days—meaning for the Union—and they contain the "Spring of Eight." **Understanding** is the [higher] Garden, and **Kingship** is the lower garden. There is a source of pleasure for us, the secret of the "Spring" in **Kingship**, which is a garden for the **Foundation**.
**Vine** <note>Hebrew: *Gefen*</note>: In **Kingship**, and she nurses from **Understanding** in the secret of "Wine that gladdens" in **Victory**. The secret of the "Degenerate Vine" and "Thorns" refers to the **Husks**.
**Stranger/Sojourner** <note>Hebrew: *Ger*</note>: In **Beauty** when He descends from His place and clothes Himself in the external layers through the **Husks**.

### Chapter 4: Dalet [ד]

**Speech** <note>Hebrew: *Dibur*</note>: In **Kingship** when she ascends to the higher Sefirot. Speech specifies the "Voice," for the Voice is simple [undifferentiated] and Speech divides it into articulations and "hands" with all the higher attributes through **Kingship**. The essence of speech is "small" from the side of **Strength**. Likewise, in the bareness of **Kingship**, it is "one thing upon another," and that is the **Foundation**, for... the **Foundation** is the value of the Sefirot. Furthermore, **Kingship** is called "Words" <note>Hebrew: *Devarim*</note> because of the specification of her joints and responses, as each one is called a "thing" <note>Hebrew: *Davar*</note>.
**Honey** <note>Hebrew: *Devash*</note>: In **Kingship** from the side of **Strength**, yet it is sweet; therefore we do not find it in the "New."
**Two Faces** <note>Hebrew: *Du-Partzufin*</note>: **Beauty** and **Kingship** as one in their state of existence within **Understanding**, like the "Emanations in the World."
**Generation/Dwelling** <note>Hebrew: *Dor*</note>: In **Foundation** when it is unified with the previous generations, **Beauty** and **Kingship**, as explained in the portion of *Vayikra*. It is from the side of **Strength**, for their union is through arousal...

<column-break/>

<margin>The numerical value [of David] equals the Name of God [Y-H-V-H] with the word itself. **David** in Beauty from the side of the 156 surrounding it.</margin>
All the attributes for **Beauty** shall ascend to the base, and when they ascend to the **Crown** <term>Keter; the highest Sefirah</term>, they ascend to the secret of Rachel. Likewise, all these levels roll into pure obligations in the "River of All." There are eighteen [powers] in **Understanding**, as is the custom... for **Understanding** is "Liberty" <note>Hebrew: *Deror*</note> for all... and **Kingship** is in the secret of the "Living" that sweetens the "Thorns."
**Judgment** <note>Hebrew: *Din*</note>: In **Understanding**, and because she is hidden within the hidden judgment, she is also the life of the "World to Come."
**Judge** <note>Hebrew: *Dayan*</note>: According to some, in **Strength**; according to Rabbi Moshe, in **Beauty** from the side of **Kingship**, for **Kingship** is judgment in its connection. One might say the "Judge of Kingship" refers to the laws.
**Image** <note>Hebrew: *Dyokan*</note>: The judgment of... **Kingship** is the "Hand" of **Beauty**.
**Page/Leaf** <note>Hebrew: *Daf*</note>: In the **Foundation** which includes the 22 letters of writing... and when it is clothed in **Strength**, the gap is decided and it is called "Page." **Kingship** is called "Poor" <note>Hebrew: *Dach*</note>...
**Poor** <note>Hebrew: *Dal*</note>: From the **Righteous One** <note>Yesod</note> when **Kingship**... nurses from him. She is also "Poor" in relation to **Beauty**, which is "Rich" and strong, and thus **Kingship** is called "Dalah" <note>the poor one/the hanging one</note>.
**Blood** <note>Hebrew: *Dam*</note>: In **Kingship** when she nurses from the side of judgment. The secret of the "Closing" indicates **Understanding**, for she is closed and the flow from her is minimal. Therefore **Kingship**... and for this reason, Blood indicates judgment.
**Twilight** <note>Hebrew: *Dimdumei Chamah*</note>: In **Kingship**, and her light is in **Beauty**. It is called "Warmth" as in a deep and hidden world. Know that for this reason... **Foundation** is like it.
**Likeness/Imagination** <note>Hebrew: *Dimyon*</note>: In **Kingship**, through which all matters seen by the prophets are revealed... according to the secret of "Grace." According to Rabbi Moshe... as explained.
**Image/Form** <note>Hebrew: *Demut*</note>: The "Form of Man" is **Kingship**, as mentioned in the *Tikkunim*...
**Tears** <note>Hebrew: *Dema'ot*</note>: Two tears... drop into the Great Sea... and they are Judgment. They are in **Strength**, and the secret of them is in **Strength** and **Kingship**. When spread into the "Holy Judgment," it is the Great One who bestows mercy upon the poor... which is **Understanding**. His eyes are the center... and the judgment is received.
**Knowledge** <note>Hebrew: *Da'at*</note>: Our meaning is the "Balance" that looks... **Beauty** and **Foundation** are the ones, for **Beauty** couples between **Wisdom** and **Understanding**... and the **Foundation** includes the Seven Lower Sefirot and **Kingship**.
**Dwelling** <note>Hebrew: *Dar*</note>: Our meaning is a "Dwelling" for **Beauty**. The secret of the "Breasts" [Dahd]... He dwells within their impurity. There is also the meaning of "Persecution" in **Kingship**, for her constellation always draws good and evil from the side of **Strength**. According to Rabbi Joseph, *Dar* is a language of "Liberty" <note>Deror</note> and strength in **Understanding**.
**South** <note>Hebrew: *Darom*</note>: The secret of the right side in **Beauty**... in relation to **Understanding**.
**Path** <note>Hebrew: *Derech*</note>: In **Beauty** as it adds to **Kingship**... and the totality of the "Paths" that are sweetened from **Kingship** to **Kingship** because of **Understanding**.

### Chapter 5: He [ה]

When it is at the end of a word, it hints at the world of **Kingship**. Every letter *He* that comes in a word is a secret of a known action... in **Kingship**. And at a time when the action is an "Opening," the letter *He*... acts as a "Form of Life," hinting at **Understanding**. Every "Definite He" [the prefix *Ha-*] is an opening in the "Womb"... a secret of the "Source of Lives" in **Understanding**. In **Kingship**, it is because of the way the feminine connects... and also so that the external forces do not know, for **Understanding** is called "The Concealed" <note>original: *Kasla*</note>, a lock against the **Husks**.

->### Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: Values of Appellations<-
->**Sigil: Shin (ש)**<-

**Abundance** and the **Merits** of the **Supreme Loving-kindness** <term>Chesed; the fourth Sefirah</term>: **Son** <note>Hebrew: *Ben*</note> in **Loving-kindness**, and likewise the mystery of **World** <note>Hebrew: *Olam*</note> has the same numerical value as **Loving-kindness** <note>Both sum to 72 in Gematria</note>. **Firstborn** <note>Hebrew: *Bechor*</note> is in **Crown** <term>Keter; the highest Sefirah</term>, for it is the firstborn of all emanated beings, as is known. In the [Zohar's] commentary on the Commandments and the literal meaning of the Torah, the "voice of the firstborn son" includes the "extremities" <term>the lower six Sefirot</term>. Some explain **The Firstborn** as the **Foundation of Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>, and **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> is called "firstborn" from the side of Wisdom, for it is the crowned one. In terms of Wisdom, it is called "firstborn" to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. As it is written: "My firstborn, my son" <note>Exodus 4:22</note>. **Kingdom** is called "firstborn" from the side of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, which are the five [measures of] Loving-kindness. And "merit" in the state of death is called "merit" <note>Hebrew: *Zechut*</note> as explained in the *Tikunim* <note>Tikunei HaZohar</note>. There are names and secrets regarding the **Husks** <term>Kliphoth; forces of impurity</term>, of which it is said: "And over their deaths you shall tread."

**Son** <note>Hebrew: *Ben*</note> without qualification refers to **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>. He is also called "Son of **Foundation**" <term>Yesod</term>, meaning the "Son" of the letters *Yud-Samekh-Vav-Dalet* <note>Spelling out the name of the Sefirah Yesod</note>. Furthermore, he is called **Son of Freemen** <note>Hebrew: *Ben Chorin*</note> because he draws sustenance from the "Crown of Freemen," which are **Understanding** and **Wisdom**. He is also called **Son of Suckling** <note>Hebrew: *Ben Yanik*</note> from **Understanding** in the mystery of the Jubilee. He is also called **Son of Delight** <note>Hebrew: *Ben Chefetz*</note> for he draws the "Supreme Oil" that flows from the "Well of Understanding" through **Wisdom** onto **Understanding**. He is called **Son of the House** <note>Hebrew: *Ben Bayit*</note> because **Beauty** is the "Son" of **Understanding**, which was the "House" for **Wisdom**. For this reason, the entry of the five [measures of] Loving-kindness is the "Chariot" for the soul. Some explain the entry of the **Son** and **Daughter** <note>Beauty and Kingdom</note> as occurring together as one. One who prays for the "Daughter" <term>Malchut/Shekhinah</term> must pray for the "Son" first. This ascends to the **Supreme Constellation** <term>Mazal; the flow from the highest Sefirot</term>.

**Children of Israel** are the **Loving-kindness** <term>Chesed</term> within **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, drawing sustenance from it. **Daughters of Jerusalem** are the "Daughters of the Righteous" who receive the flow from the "Supreme Jerusalem," which is the **Shekhinah** <term>Divine Presence</term>. She is called by this name because the Shekhinah stands over them. **Boaz** is in **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> because it draws from the "Breasts" <note>Hebrew: *Shadayim*</note>, and the explanation of "Bo Az" <note>In him is strength</note> refers to the intensities of Judgment; through this arousal, the Union occurs. **Pure** <note>Hebrew: *Bar*</note> refers to the flowing liquid, similar to the language of a *Baraita* <note>an "external" teaching</note>, meaning it is "outside." 

**Blessing** <note>Hebrew: *Barekh*</note>, according to Rabbi Joseph [Gikatilla], is in **Loving-kindness**, and its reason is the "Water of Loving-kindness." According to the *Zohar*, it implies that through **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>, the waters are congealed and descend below; this is the power of **Loving-kindness** sweetening the **Strength**, like "fire flashing amidst the hail." **Blessed** <note>Hebrew: *Baruch*</note> is in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, as explained in the *Zohar*: "Blessed is the attribute of Understanding," for it is the "Supreme Understanding." It is the dwelling place of the "Secret of Life," which provides nourishment and fruit to all worlds. It is called **Blessing** in **Understanding** because it is the source of connection, and it flows into **Foundation**. We also hear in the *Tikunim* that "Blessed" includes all ten Sefirot. **Iron** <note>Hebrew: *Barzel*</note> is in **Kingdom** and **Beauty** from the side of Judgment. **Bolts** <note>Hebrew: *Berichim*</note> are in the six directions <term>the six Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</term>, and they are called "Bolts" because **Beauty** is the **Middle Bolt** that shoots from one end of the heavens to the other. **Health** <note>Hebrew: *Beriyuta*</note> is in **Kingdom** when it is born from Judgment and Strength. **Covenant** <note>Hebrew: *Berit*</note> is in **Kingdom**, **Beauty**, and **Foundation**. There is the "Covenant of the Tongue" in **Understanding**, and the "Covenant of the Flesh" in **Foundation**. When **Kingdom** is bound between **Foundation** and **Understanding**, it is also called "Covenant." This is the mystery of circumcision: the "uncovering" refers to **Foundation** and the "folding back" refers to **Kingdom**. **Foundation** is also called the **Covenant of Peace**, as it completes the connection between **Beauty** and **Kingdom**. **Pool** <note>Hebrew: *Berekhah*</note> refers to the collection of the flow, located in **Kingdom** and **Understanding**. **Kingdom** is the "Lower Source of Blessing" through **Foundation**, and **Crown** is the "Upper Source of Blessing" through the "Spring," which is **Wisdom**. **Blessing** refers to the planting of the flow in **Kingdom** and **Understanding**, as in the verse: "The blessing of the Lord makes one rich."

<column-break/>

**Sigil: Bet (ב)**

**Lightning** <note>Hebrew: *Barak*</note> is in **Foundation** or the **Shekhinah**. Sometimes it is in **Crown** from the side of the "Living Creature" <term>Chayah</term>. **Flesh** <note>Hebrew: *Basar*</note> is in **Kingdom**, and sometimes in **Beauty**, as in "and He closed the flesh under it" <note>Genesis 2:21</note>, meaning the birth of **Kingdom** from **Beauty**. **Daughter** <note>Hebrew: *Bat*</note> is **Kingdom**. She is called "Daughter of **Wisdom**" in the aspect of the letter *Yud*, and "Daughter of **Understanding**" in the aspect of the "Five Extremities" <term>the five Sefirot from Chesed to Hod</term>. In the forces of impurity, she is called "The King's Daughter" within the "House of Wisdom," which is called "King." She is called **Bat Kol** <note>literally "Daughter of a Voice," or a Divine Echo</note> when **Beauty** <term>the "Voice"</term> is close to **Understanding** and receives from her. She is called "Daughter of a Pair" because she is the mate of **Beauty**. She is called "Daughter of Spheres" because she is the daughter of the ten spheres <term>Sefirot</term> included in her. She is called **Bathsheba** <note>"Daughter of Seven"</note> because she includes the seven Sefirot. She is called "Daughter of Shaddai" when she sucks from the "Breasts" of **Loving-kindness**. 

## Chapter 3: Redemption

**Redemption** <note>Hebrew: *Geulah*</note> is in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> based on the mystery of "the redemption shall be his" <note>Leviticus 25:31</note>. It is also in **Foundation**. The male aspect of **Understanding** is called **Redeemer** <note>Hebrew: *Goel*</note>, as is **Kingdom** from the side of **Foundation**. **Excellence/Pride** <note>Hebrew: *Gaon*</note> is in **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, referring to the heights of the flow passing through it. It is also found in the "Excellence of Jacob" <term>Tiferet</term>. **Haughtiness** <note>Hebrew: *Ga’avat*</note> in the "garments" <term>external layers</term> of the Divine. **High** <note>Hebrew: *Gavoh*</note> is in **Crown** <term>Keter</term> because He is high above all. Sometimes it refers to other Sefirot, as in "for one high above the high watches" <note>Ecclesiastes 5:7</note>. **Border/Boundary** <note>Hebrew: *Gevul*</note> is in **Kingdom**, which is the boundary for the "external forces" to reach and no further. It is the end of the Emanation from the side of **Understanding** and **Wisdom**, though from the side of the Infinite <term>Ein Sof</term>, it extends without end. 

**Strength/Might** <note>Hebrew: *Gevurah*</note> is in **Loving-kindness** <term>Chesed</term> [specifically] "Isaac's Laughter," and also in **Understanding** which includes all strengths, and in **Kingdom** as explained in the *Tikunim*. **Lady/Mistress** <note>Hebrew: *Gevirah*</note> is in the **Shekhinah**, for she is the mistress of Strength. **Crystals/Gems** <note>Hebrew: *Gevish*</note> are in **Understanding** and **Kingdom**. **Kingdom** is the "Crystal" over all lower creatures, and **Understanding** is over the whole building [of the Sefirot]. **Roof** <note>Hebrew: *Gag*</note> is the covering in **Crown**, which is the roof over all the emanations. **Gad** is in **Kingdom** and **Foundation**. In the *Zohar*, it implies **Understanding** and **Kingdom** <note>the letters Gimel and Dalet</note>. In the *Tikunim*, it includes the Right and Left sides: **Understanding** leaning to the right and **Kingdom** to the left. 

**Greatness** <note>Hebrew: *Gedolah*</note> is in **Loving-kindness** <term>Chesed</term>, for all Sefirot and powers grow through it. Without this Sefirah, the "prosecutors" <note>accusing angels</note> would prevail. It is written "The young lions roar for prey" <note>Psalms 104:21</note>—the "lions" are the external forces that suckle from the flow of **Loving-kindness**. **Body** <note>Hebrew: *Geviyah*</note> is in **Beauty**, and according to Rabbi Moses [Cordovero], it is in **Foundation**. **Skull** <note>Hebrew: *Gulgalt*</note> refers to the mystery of the "Skull" of **Crown** <term>Keter</term>, which contains the "white light" and the "brains." It is above all the Sefirot, just as the physical skull is above the body. **Sphere/Wheel** <note>Hebrew: *Galgal*</note> is an appellation for the...

**Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah; the second Sefirah</term> is also called **The Strength of "What"** <note>original: "Koach Ma"; a wordplay on the Hebrew letters of Chokhmah</note>. The secret of its name is as it connects with the six extremities <term>the lower six Sefirot</term>, which are balanced. It is also the secret of **Bread** <note>original: "Lechem"</note>. This is Wisdom in the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term> as explained in the section "Koach" <note>Strength</note>. Likewise, in the **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, it is balanced.
**To Whiten** <note>original: "Le-laben"</note>: The **White** refers to the cloak with the [Breastplate] plate, and therefore it is a term for a covering. Further on, this is explained in the Torah portion *Beshalach*.
**Gold** <note>original: "Zahav"</note>: Refers to **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> and **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>, as is known.
**Olive** <note>original: "Zayit"</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. It is already known that Understanding contains the oil. There is also a mention in the *Faithful Shepherd* <term>Raya Mehemna; a section of the Zohar</term> that in Understanding, the letter *Yod* is within it, and in the "House" <note>the letter Bet</note> the *Yod* is captive, named for the phrase "He founded and I dwelt."
**Habitation** <note>original: "Zevul"</note>: Refers to **Beauty and Kingdom** <note>original abbreviation: "T"M", referring to Tiferet and Malchut</note> in the measure of the voices. It is built and includes everything from the Right side. It is a built morning, and it possesses the "Reception" of all that is included within it. Everything comes from the Right, and the "Morning" is not separate in name on its own. It is not called "Everything" <note>original: "Ha-Kol"</note> except when it is awakened in union with Understanding. Furthermore, it is guarded and has the power of the Ruler from the Right side. Nevertheless, it does not rise to a name of its own but only as included in the Female <term>the Sefirah of Malchut</term>. It is called **The All** <note>original: "Ha-Kol"</note> because **Loving-kindness** <term>Chesed</term> is clarified in the portion *Yitro* and in the *Faithful Shepherd*.
**Remembrance** <note>original: "Zechura"</note>: Refers to the **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> in which there is remembering. This is a term for **Incense** <note>original: "Ketoret"</note> in the power of the male principle. With the Foundation, it is the secret of being "bound" and "smoke" <note>wordplay on the root K-T-R</note>, which is everything. There is also a descent toward evil from all the prevented things, as in "And He remembered that they were but flesh."
**Merit** <note>original: "Zechut"</note>: Refers to **Loving-kindness** <term>Chesed</term> in the [path of] Straightness in the *Tikunim* <note>Tikunei HaZohar</note>. However, according to the author of *The Guide* <note>likely referring to a specific Kabbalistic guide or Maimonides in a different context</note>, it refers to **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>. This is also implied in the whispers in the *Palaces of Solomon* regarding the Palace and Strength. It is called "The All," and it is the secret of the letter *Heh* in the portion *Shemot*. The reason is that the "Amalekites" in this Palace open a restoration through Merit. Forever, He is the Loving-kindness, and the words of the song are good in Wisdom.
**Small Face** <note>original: "Ze'ir Anpin"; the "Microprosopus" or the central cluster of Sefirot</note>: According to Rabbi Moshe <note>likely Moshe Cordovero</note>, it refers to **Beauty and Kingdom** <term>Tiferet and Malchut</term>. For us, it refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. It implies that it stems from Wisdom and Understanding, and so it seems to me.
**Cry** <note>original: "Ze'akah"</note>: Refers to **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>. As it says: "And their heart cried out to the Lord," and there is no "heart" but Understanding, as the heart understands.
**Standing Upright** <note>original: "Zekifah"</note>: Refers to **Beauty and Kingdom** <term>Tiferet and Malchut</term>, since all who are bent over are returned and straightened by the letter *Heh*, which is Tiferet and Malchut.
**Elder** <note>original: "Zaken"</note>: Refers to the **Crown** <term>Keter</term>. In the plural, "Elders" alludes to **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term> which includes all the Sefirot.
**Radiance** <note>original: "Zerach"</note>: Rabbi Moshe explains this refers to **Beauty and Kingdom** <term>Tiferet and Malchut</term>, for its light shines upon the City of David <term>Malchut</term>, spread out in the secret of the moon's adornment.
**Everlasting Arms** <note>original: "Ziro'ot Olam"</note>: Refers to the triad of **Loving-kindness, Strength, and Beauty** <term>Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet</term>, which are the arms and the body <note>the body is Tiferet</note>.
**This** <note>original: "Zot"</note>: Refers to **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>. The world... <unclear>illegible</unclear> in **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. First, to investigate.
**Olives** <note>original: "Zeitim"</note>: Refers to the **Long Face** <term>Arich Anpin; the external aspect of Keter</term> in the upper "shaving." It also refers to the **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> from the side of Loving-kindness (the right side), where the flow of "the good oil" passes through the Foundation to the Kingdom, as is clarified.

### Chapter 8: H-B-U-Sh <note>Entries for the letter Het (ח)</note>

**Rope** <note>original: "Chevel"; also means "lot" or "measure"</note>: Its matter is "reception." It refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> which receives the "ornaments" <note>or "disturbances"</note> and the powers of Judgment. Sometimes it cuts off all the wicked. Through it, "Jacob is the lot [rope] of His inheritance" in the secret of his "Voice," which is the rope of his portion.
**Wrecker** <note>original: "Chovel"</note>: In the section... <unclear>illegible</unclear> he is a wrecker and a destroyer who consumes.

**Rose** <note>original: "Chavatzelet"</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> when it nurses from Understanding. Then it writes a "good scent" like the rose that grows by the waters, as clarified in the portion *Emor*.
**Festival of all Festivals** <note>original: "Chag kol ha-Chagim"</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> when she connects to **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> from the side of Loving-kindness of the Sefirot. In every festival, she is in a Sefirah unique to it. For example, on Passover, she is unified with the Knowledge of Loving-kindness. At the time of the Torah [Shavuot], she is unified with her "beloved" in Wisdom and in the *Faithful Shepherd*...

**New** <note>original: "Chadash"</note>: Its matter is "Holy." This refers to the **Moon** <term>Malchut</term> always.
**Eve** <note>original: "Chavah"</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> who is the "Mother of all living" for the lower beings.
**Seer** <note>original: "Chozeh"</note>: Refers to **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> who bestows the vision and prophecy to the Kingdom through the prophets. Furthermore, "Seer" <note>Chozeh</note> has the numerical value of the [Divine] Name.

**Nose** <note>original: "Chotem"</note>: According to Rabbi Moshe, it is in **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>. **Blue Link** <note>original: "Hulyat de-Takhilta"</note>: Every link is made of three pools. It refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> as it connects to the six [extremities] in the secret of the three colors of the pupil, which are the three Patriarchs.
**Heat of the Day** <note>original: "Chom ha-Yom"</note>: In the secret of **Loving-kindness** <term>Chesed</term>. It is possible it comes from the "small bit of holiness" explained in the portion *Vayikra*.

<meta>This page continues the alphabetical dictionary of symbolic terms (the Appellations) within the Kabbalistic system. It completes the entry for "Mountain" and moves into terms starting with the letters Zayin (ז) and He (ה). # Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations

28: **Mountain** <note>original: "Har"</note>: Simply stated, this refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut; the tenth and final Sefirah</term>. The reason is that just as a mountain is open and free to all, so too is the Kingdom open to the "descent of the Sabbath," <note>The indwelling presence of God on the day of rest</note> providing a grasp for the converts who come to take refuge under the wings of the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term>.
Another reason is that just as a mountain contains many plantings, so too the Kingdom includes all the lower powers. There are **Mountains of Spices**, which are the nine extremities <note>the nine Sefirot above Kingdom</note> that spread toward their corresponding sides. There are also **Mount Horeb**, **Mount Sinai**, **Mount Zebul**, and others.
**Mount Moriah** refers to **Foundation** <term>Yesod; the ninth Sefirah</term>, where the **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> within **Beauty** <term>Tiferet; the sixth Sefirah</term> unites with the first three Sefirot, which are represented by the letters *Yod* and *He*. Even the **Crown** <term>Keter; the highest Sefirah</term> is called a "Unification" as mentioned in the Zohar.
There is the **Holy Mountain**, which refers to Kingdom when it receives from Wisdom, which is the "Place of Holiness." **Mount Zion** refers to Kingdom when Foundation unites with it, representing the perfection of the form within it; the indwelling presence is called "Zion."
There is **Mount Gerizim**, where the blessing resides, and **Mount Ebal**, where judgment resides; these are within Kingdom on the sides of **Loving-kindness** <term>Chesed</term> and **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>.
**The Good Mountain** is Foundation within Kingdom from the side of Holy Kindness. **Mount Abarim** is within Foundation and also within Beauty, as explained in the Zohar.
**The Mountains of Zion** are **Victory** <term>Netzach</term> and **Splendor** <term>Hod</term> surrounding Foundation (which is Zion), and they overflow into it.
There are **Mountains of Silver**, **Mountains of [Slast?]**, **The Rocks of Sapan**, **Mount Esau**, and **Mount Seir**; these refer to the **Husks** <term>Kelipot; the forces of imbalance or evil</term>. Beauty within Kingdom, from the side of the inclusion of Strength within the aspect of Kindness, is prepared in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, as mentioned in many places in the Zohar and the *Tikunim* <note>The Tikunei HaZohar</note>.

### Chapter 6: The letters Qof, Vav, Yod, etc.
This refers to the "Sichlas" <note>likely a mystical name or permutation</note> writing of "Pomegranates" in Beauty, even though the Torah itself is hinted at in Kingdom.
It indicates the crowning of Beauty and Kingdom, since the name *Yod-He*—the secret of the Court—is within Beauty and Kingdom. The *Vav* is Beauty, and the term **Difficult** <note>original: "Kasheh"</note> refers to Kingdom. Even though "Difficult" points to the numerical value of 13, they have already absorbed these words as a general rule from the Strength of Kingdom. Therefore, the Name points to Kingdom and indicates Judgment mixed with Mercy; the sign for this is the end of the verse.
Or, perhaps "Difficult" is Beauty, while the Name and Kingdom are in the secret of her Husband, for they are damaged in the Zohar. Wisdom unites with the "Eye of the Lord," and the reception rises within the Name. Therefore, the main secret here is Beauty, which is "difficult" without Kingdom, but with the addition of the *Yod* from above, it indicates the masculine aspect over the reception, as if the "Assembly of Israel" <term>Knesset Yisrael; a name for Malchut</term> is mentioned. The letter *He* indicates the Foundation of Beauty and Kingdom, but not like the Name that indicates the union of Beauty, Kingdom, and Crown, which is like "Koh" <note>The word for 'Thus' or the number 25</note> and adds to them.
**And there was a Lemon... Rebuke** <note>original: "Vayehi Limon Ga'ar"</note>: This refers to Strength in the aspect of Fear. Likewise, **Our Cloud** <note>original: "Avinu"</note> emerges from the side of Judgment.
**And he lodged** <note>original: "Veyalin"</note>: This is in Kingdom. It is explained in the *Faithful Shepherd* <note>Raya Mehemna</note> that he enters in the evening and leaves in the morning. This means that at night, she gathers the Mercy into the storehouses and nurses from the side of Judgment, giving permission to the Husks to spread through the world to punish the wicked. He "leaves in the morning" because in the morning, Mercy prevails, and the rectifications go to the Mountains of Silver, where reward is written for those who do His will. See the *Pardes* <note>Cordovero's Orchard of Pomegranates</note>, which elaborates on this chapter further.
**Meeting** <note>original: "Va'ad"</note>: A term for a "House of Meeting," referring to **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, as explained in the section on Genesis. There, the "Meeting" and the "Gathering" include all the Sefirot.
**[Sh"m?]**: Among the lower beings, I have received that these are "Wheat," and they are the ones who consume the Husks. The Judgment alone rises above, as explained in the secret of the spirits.

### Chapter 7: The Letter He (ה)
**This** <note>original: "Zot"</note>: This is in Kingdom. The reason is that it contains the five "Kindnesses," as explained earlier in its entry. From the side of the nursing of the seven Sefirot upon it, it possesses the addition of goodness received from the seven lower Sefirot.
**Habitation** <note>original: "Zevul"</note>: From the language of "connection" <note>original: "Chibur"</note>. It is explained in the *Faithful Shepherd* in the book *Saph-Saph* that it says, "This time my husband will be joined to me." <note>Genesis 29:34</note> The intention is to hint at the portion of Understanding and her son, for the sons are from Kindness upon Foundation. In the case of Leah's daughter, who is Kingdom, it says "this time he will be joined to me," hinting at the Foundation of Wisdom and Understanding. To Him, it hints at

<meta>catchword: To Him, it hints at</meta>

<column-break/>

the Husks. The matter of the large letter *Qof* and the small letter *He* is explained in the Zohar: the large *He* hints at Kingdom when she receives from Foundation; she is "large" to indicate her fullness when filled with the overflow. The small *He* hints at the diminishing and lack of the Moon <term>a symbol for Malchut</term>, as she nurses from Judgment for all thirty days. This is just as in the reception of the Name, the *Dalet* becomes a *He*, and so on.
**Breath** <note>original: "Hevel"</note>: Ecclesiastes spoke of "Seven Breaths" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:2, often translated as "vanity of vanities"</note>, and these correspond to the seven Sefirot. This is the language of the "breath of the mouth," as explained there. There is a breath and a "protection" in Kingdom that descends to cling to Beauty in the secret of Unification. There is an "ascending breath," which is in Understanding, which tends to cling to Wisdom.
**Haggadah** <note>Telling/Narrative</note>: This is in Wisdom, as explained in the secret of the spirits, and also in Kingdom when it is supported by her as the "Mistress of the Narrative," receiving its nursing from the overflow of Wisdom.
**Footstool** <term>Hadom</term>: This is in Kingdom, for the prophets lean upon it. It is like a stool where the six Sefirot rest; a footstool and a place of rest for all of them.
**The Blood** <note>original: "Ha-Dam"</note>: In the strengths and Kingdom, and from the reception of the [Likeness?]. It is explained that "The Blood" <note>Hebrew: H-D-M</note>—the letter *He* and "Dam"—is green <note>Mystical color associations often differ from physical ones</note>. From this side, the "greenish" aspect of the living creature emerges. Also, blood is bitter from the side of Judgment and from the side of the awakening of Wisdom.
**Splendor** <term>Hadar</term>: This is in Beauty, as explained in the *Tikunim*. There is also a "taken splendor" in the Crown <term>Keter</term> and the "Splendor that is a garment" for Beauty.
**He** <note>original: "Hu"</note>: This refers to the hidden aspect, the essence, and the concealment. It is a connection. It is also in Understanding in relation to the "World of Building," in the secret of the Jubilee <note>The 50th year, associated with Binah</note>, which is hidden in the aspects of the elevation of its fullness in the secret of the *Yod* in Wisdom, as explained in this chapter.
**[Vil'ah?]**: And the existence of the "S"V-H" like the "S" of escape is in Kingdom. It hints at the "flow of springs," and the "S" within it is like Kindness, as explained in the works of [Rabbi Moshe?]. It is also in Beauty and indicates the inclusion of male and female. Its inclusion sends the transformations of Kindness and Kingdom, etc. And the arrangement: *He* is Kingdom (female), *Vav* is Beauty (male), *He* is the Supernal Crown, including all, and it indicates a man including both male and female.
**Glory** <term>Hod</term>: The glory of the Glory of Strength, which clothes itself to receive in the external realms.
**[Hovah]** <note>Being/Occurring</note>: In the verse "Disaster [Hovah] shall come upon disaster," it indicates Judgment in Understanding, Beauty, and Kingdom, in order to mention the Husks and to strike them.
**Alas** <note>original: "Hoy"</note>: This refers to the withdrawal and the preciousness of existence that is narrowed by the screen of the "living" <term>Chai</term>. This is Beauty, and it is the Name of [Yod-He-Vav-He] with the *Vav* and Kindness withdrawn. It then ascends to Understanding, where it is in the aspect of "Difficulty" <note>original: "K-V-Y"</note>. For there, the overflow of Kingdom to the Foundation is not present, and there is a withdrawal between the *Yod* and the *Vav*. For the *Yod* of "Living" is in the revealed Foundation. When the overflow is withdrawn in the "House of the Soul" for all, in the secret of the "Sources," they depend on Understanding. Its sign is "Repentance" <term>Teshuvah</term>, for Repentance is close to being received from the Name.
**She** <note>original: "Hi"</note>: In Kingdom, as in her hidden relationship with the "Pleasure" of Wisdom. There is also "She" and "Our Shell," as mentioned in the Zohar in the portion of *Chukat*.
**Palace** <term>Heikhal</term>: In general, every single Sefirah is called a "Palace" for the Sefirah above it. Specifically, it is in Crown, which is a palace for the [32 paths of Wisdom] and the [50 gates of Understanding] in the secret of the "Sealings." And in Understanding, which is a palace for Wisdom. And Beauty, which is established within it and revealed from the Palace and enters the [Circle], which is the Palace that is Kingdom. Kingdom is also a palace for Beauty. Also, the word *Adonai* <note>Lord</note> has the same numerical value as *Heikhal* <note>Palace</note>.
**Halakha** <note>Law/Walking</note>: This is in Kingdom. There is "Halakha from Moses [at Sinai]," and the intention is the "Crowned Bride" in the secret of the Measures, for she rises and passes through the *Tikunim*. And in the *Faithful Shepherd*, it is associated with the [Holy One], who was a traveler from the side of Strength. There is also "Halakha in Many," from the side of the three Patriarchs who are called "Many." In the *Tikunim*, it implies that Kingdom is called "Halakha" when she is in the Crown and goes to be unified with her husband.
**Hallel** <note>Praise</note>: This is in Kingdom. A "Complete Hallel" is in the secret of the full moon, while its sign is "incomplete" in the secret of the diminished moon.
**Hallelujah**: Its meaning is a "beating" that ascends from Kingdom to Beauty. The order of its letters is *He-Yod* and *Vav-He*. Its inclusion is that she is received into Beauty, which is *Yod*, and includes the Name and Understanding, from which she receives; this is the letter *He*.
**Hineni** <note>Here I am</note>: In Kingdom, in the aspect of responsiveness. It indicates Judgment and its revelation, and it is discussed in this chapter.

<summary>This page defines various mystical terms starting with the letters Har (Mountain), Zayin, and He, mapping them to the Sefirotic tree. It explains how physical and biblical concepts like "mountains," "blood," and "palaces" represent the flow of divine energy and the relationship between attributes like Mercy and Judgment.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the alphabetical dictionary of symbolic terms (the Appellations) within the Kabbalistic system, focusing on terms beginning with the letters Yod (י) and Tet (ט). The previous page concluded the entry for "Mountain." This section explores how physical concepts like "hand," "wine," and "river" represent specific divine emanations or Sefirot.</meta>

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations

**The Uplifted Hand** <note>original: "Yad HaRamah"</note>: This is the influence that flows from **Understanding** <term>Binah; the third Sefirah</term> toward **Beauty** <term>Tiferet; the sixth Sefirah</term>, as explained in the Zohar. It also refers to the "hands" of a dream, which are **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> and **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term> emerging from Beauty. 
**Knowledge** <note>original: "Yeda"</note>: This relates to the vowel point *Segol* and its rectification via Beauty and **Foundation** <term>Yesod; the ninth Sefirah</term>. It describes the one who harms or receives from Understanding.
**Let there be** <note>original: "Yehi"</note>: Refers to Beauty. Similarly, regarding the luminaries, "Let there be light" refers to the Foundation of the written Torah. 
**Jubilee** <note>original: "Yovel"</note>: Refers to Understanding, which includes the number fifty, representing the "Fifty Gates of Understanding" when it clings to the fiftieth gate through **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>.
**Day** <note>original: "Yom"</note>: Refers to Beauty when it is bound to the Right <note>Kindness</note> and the Left <note>Strength</note>. It is also called the "Day of Isaac." In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut; the tenth Sefirah</term>, it is called "Day" until the midday point. In Foundation and Understanding, it is also called "Day." The "Second Day" refers to Knowledge, meaning it is revealed and known. When Kingdom is "a crown upon the head of her husband," she is also called "Day." There is also a "Double Day" in Understanding when Beauty is revealed within it and illuminates it.
**By Day** <note>original: "Yomam"</note>: Refers to Kindness, as it is the first of all the lower days <note>the seven lower Sefirot</note> and illuminates them. 
**Dove** <note>original: "Yonah"</note>: Refers to Kingdom when it unites with the "Body," which is Beauty. However, there is also a "Dove" that acts as a fountain of Wisdom, and this refers to the Sefirah of Wisdom, as explained in the *Tikunim* <note>The Tikunei HaZohar, a classic Kabbalistic text</note>.
**Joseph** <note>original: "Yosef"</note>: Refers to Foundation, which is the "chariot" for this Sefirah. It also refers to the phrase "the house of his father."
**Counselor** <note>original: "Yoetz"</note>: Refers to Understanding, in the sense that it is the "thought" behind every prayer.
**Creator** <note>original: "Yotzer"</note>: Refers to **Mercy** <term>Rachamim</term> or Foundation, which forms all the powers that emanate into Kingdom. Some say it refers to the **Crown** <term>Keter</term>, based on the Sages' saying that "all was made with Wisdom" but was initially conceived in Mercy.
**Appendage of the Liver** <note>original: "Yoteret HaKaved"</note>: Refers to the female aspect of the "Shells" <term>Kelipot; the forces of impurity</term>. Just as there is male and female in holiness, so too in the "Other Side." The liver is the male, and the appendage is the female.
**Unification** <note>original: "Yichud"</note>: Refers to Beauty, which unifies everything.
**Wine** <note>original: "Yayin"</note>: Refers to Strength <term>Gevurah</term>. It is associated with judgment. There is also **Preserved Wine** <note>original: "Yayin Meshumar"</note> kept in its grapes since the six days of creation. This refers to the wine of Understanding, which flows into the six days of building <note>the six Sefirot from Kindness to Foundation</note>. It is called "preserved" because it is guarded from any mixture of harsh judgment. 
**Sea of Wine** <note>original: "Yam Yayin"</note>: Refers to Understanding when it unites or when it extends toward Foundation.
**Jachin** <note>original: "Yakin"</note>: Refers to Understanding, for in that place, it draws a "thread of kindness" toward the Crown. It also refers to Kindness when it spreads over the lower Kingdom. Solomon called the Temple pillar "Jachin" because it was destined to prepare the seat of the Kingdom.
**Children** <note>original: "Yeladim"</note>: Refers to Understanding and the secret of the Cherubim.
**Wailing** <note>original: "Yelalah"</note>: Refers to Kingdom from the side of judgment and the "Shells" which rouse weeping.
**Sea** <note>original: "Yam"</note>: Refers to Understanding when it illuminates the fifty gates. There is a distinction between the "Sea of Reeds" and the "Sea of Wisdom." The term "Who" <note>Hebrew: Mi</note> refers to Understanding when it is hidden within Wisdom and does not yet flow outward, whereas "Sea" refers to it when it is revealed.

<column-break/>

...fillets, and your cheeks, in this manner within the Palaces.
**Their Fillets are Silver** <note>original: "Chishukieihem"</note>: This refers to those who bind one to another through the "silver" of Kindness. They are the "sweetness of the House," the pillars upon which the House rests, which are **Endurance** <term>Netzach</term> and **Splendor** <term>Hod</term>.
**Groom** <note>original: "Chatan"</note>: Refers to Beauty when it unites with its bride, the Kingdom, and they are adorned with the crowns of the Mother <note>Understanding</note>.

# Chapter 9: The Letter Tet
-> In Kingdom, in her hidden partitions <-
-> In the wall of the womb, which is Kingdom in its partitions <-

**The Letter Tet**: Lacks a king because of the "Shells." It relates to Foundation and sometimes to the "vow" as explained in the *Tikunim*.
**Ring** <note>original: "Taba'at"</note>: Refers to Wisdom within the partitions of the Kingdom included within it.
**Purity** <note>original: "Tohorah"</note>: The essence of Kindness and the child of Strength. Even though purity is found in Kindness, it is the secret of refining Strength into Kindness.
**Good** <note>original: "Tov"</note>: Means "pleasantness." It refers to Kindness, Beauty, and Foundation, for they draw forth Kindness.
**A Good Day**: Refers to Kingdom from the side of Kindness. There is also "Spiritual Good," which is the influence of Wisdom into Kingdom via Beauty and Foundation.
**Spleen** <note>original: "Techol"</note>: Refers to Lilith <note>a demonic figure in the Kelipot</note>.
**Grinders** <note>original: "Tachonot"</note>: Refers to Endurance and Splendor. It is the secret of the "right-side grinding" in the secret of Kindness. However, the "left-side grinding" is from the side of Strength, which grinds things down into dust.
**Dew** <note>original: "Tal"</note>: Numerically equals 39 <note>T-L = 9+30</note>, representing the names of God that flow into Kingdom. It is the influence that descends from the "Ancient of Days" <term>Atik Yomin; the highest aspect of the Divine</term> to the Head, and from there it provides life to the souls of the righteous and to all lower beings.
**Prayer Shawl** <note>original: "Tallit"</note>: Refers to Endurance and Splendor. It is used to "enwrap" the light. It can also refer to Understanding when it enwraps the light of Wisdom. In the words of the Masters, it refers to Beauty and the garment of Kindness.
**Basket** <note>original: "Tene"</note>: Refers to Kingdom, the "Final He" of the Divine Name, which receives the "First Fruits," which are the letters of the Divine Name.
**Drop** <note>original: "Tipah"</note>: Refers to Kingdom, Foundation, and Understanding, specifically the "Drop of Foundation" as explained in the *Tikunim*.
**Pure Drop**: This is the "Oil" of the letter *Yod*, which contains three points, representing the flow from the highest source.

# Chapter 10: The Letter Yod
-> From the language of "Light," referring to Foundation and the River <-
-> From the language of "Illumination"; there is a difference between "River" <note>Ye'or</note> and "Stream" <note>Nahar</note> <-

When it flows into Strength, it is called a **River** <note>original: "Ye'or"</note>. It refers to the phrase "and all the rivers shall flow to it." It also refers to Beauty.
**Jabbok** <note>The river Jabbok, original: "Yabbok"</note>: An acronym for Kindness, Strength, and Beauty <note>Y-B-K: Yichud (Unification), Bracha (Blessing), Kedushah (Holiness)</note>. Foundation in Beauty represents Unification, Kindness represents Blessing, and Strength represents Holiness. It represents the three Patriarchs and the three columns of the Sefirotic tree.
**Dry Land** <note>original: "Yabbashah"</note>: Refers to Kingdom when the upper influence is withheld and she is dried and burnt by the "beasts of judgment," until Beauty flows into her and she becomes "The Dry Land" that reveals the influence of the Earth.
**Hand** <note>original: "Yad"</note>: Refers to the five fingers, which are the five Sefirot. There are two "Hands": the **Right Hand** is Understanding when it leans toward Kindness (even though Understanding is on the Left, it acts as the "Right" in relation to the Kingdom), and the **Left Hand** when it leans toward Judgment.
There are other "Hands," such as the **Strong Hand** <note>Yad HaChazakah</note>, which is the influence of Understanding upon Strength, and the **Great Hand** <note>Yad HaGedolah</note>, which is the influence of Understanding upon Kindness.

<summary>This page provides a Kabbalistic dictionary for terms beginning with the letters Yod and Tet, explaining how concepts like "Wine," "Dew," and "Hand" symbolize the interactions and flows between the Sefirot (Divine attributes), particularly focusing on the roles of Understanding (Binah) and Kingdom (Malchut).</summary>

<meta>This page continues the alphabetical dictionary of symbolic terms (the Appellations) within the Kabbalistic system, focusing on terms beginning with the letter Chet (ח). It continues the work of Rabbi Moshe Cordovero as abridged in "Asis Rimmonim."</meta>

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 53: The Meanings of the Appellations

For all the Sefirot, their secret is the "voice heard," etc. And in the *Tikkunim* <term>Tikkunei Zohar; a seminal Kabbalistic text</term>, they are "crowned"... 
In the *Tikkunim*: **Walls** <note>original: "Chomot"</note> according to the words of Rabbi Moshe in the manuscript, which are found in some of the appellations more specifically, such as when referring to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut; the tenth Sefirah</term>. 
**Sun** <note>original: "Chamah"</note>: Refers to the "windows" <note>original: "Chalonot"</note> of the Kingdom. It was also precisely noted as the language of "the rainbow" <note>original: "Keshet"</note>, as in "sin crouches at the door." In the *Tikkunim*, it implies that when they clothe themselves in the "shells" <term>Kelipot; the forces of impurity</term>, like the shell of the rainbow, the shell itself is identified with the number sixty-nine.
**Sin** <note>original: "Chatat"</note>: Mentioned in the Lamentations, and it refers to Kingdom. In the *Ra’aya Mehemna* <term>a specific section of the Zohar</term>, it implies the secret of the Serpent within the shells—specifically the male aspect of the shell, while the "corrupt sin" refers to the female demon Lilith.
**Life of** <note>original: "Chayei"</note>: Refers to **Foundation** <term>Yesod; the ninth Sefirah</term>... when Kingdom receives vitality from the higher realms, she is called "Life," and when she bestows vitality to the worlds below, she is called "Life of the Worlds." Rabbi Moshe explains that this refers to the power that provides life to the created beings. Even the "shells" are sometimes called "life of the worlds" in the sense that they sustain the lower realms that depend on them.
**Living Being** <note>original: "Chayah"</note>: There is a "supreme living being" above the firmament representing the bestowing power. There is also a "living being" under the "King of Israel," and a "living being" within Kingdom, following the secret of the letter *Aleph* above, *Yod* below, and *Vav* in the middle. At the end of the process, she receives the "Source of Life" for all Sefirot. Kingdom is also called "Living" because it derives from **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah; the second Sefirah</term>, following the secret of the "living Wisdom."
**Freedom** <note>original: "Cherut"</note>: In the hidden names, it refers to **Understanding** <term>Binah; the third Sefirah</term>, for it is known that freedom is the law of Understanding.
**Life of the King** <note>original: "Chayei HaMelekh"</note>: Wisdom and Understanding together are called "Life," as they bestow upon the "King," which is **Beauty** <term>Tiferet; the sixth Sefirah</term>. Wisdom is also called "Life" because it bestows life upon the entire world, which is Understanding. Furthermore, Understanding is called "Life of the World" because it bestows life to all worlds beneath it.
**Life** <note>original: "Chayim"</note>: All the first five Sefirot <note>from Keter to Gevurah</note> are called "Life" as they provide vitality to everything beneath them.
**Statute** <note>original: "Chok"</note>: According to Rabbi Moshe, this refers to the "lower writing," which is the end. Likewise, the letter *Chet* represents the end, which is the essence of Wisdom.
**My Strength** <note>original: "Cheili"</note>: This refers to the flow toward Wisdom and Understanding, following the secret of the letter *Yod* as explained in the *Tikkunim*.
**Freedom** <note>original: "Cherut"</note>: This is Understanding, from which freedom and redemption emerge for the world.
**His Vitality** <note>original: "Chayuto"</note>: Refers to the lower powers, as explained in the Torah portion *Pekudei*.
**Wisdom** <note>original: "Chokhmah"</note>: Explained previously in the section on specific Names. It is called the "beginning of Wisdom" as it flows through thirty-two paths to Understanding and Kingdom (which are called "God"). It is also called the "Living Wisdom." 
**Milk** <note>original: "Chalav"</note>: This is white, representing **Kindness** <term>Chesed; the fourth Sefirah</term> according to Rabbi Moshe. Others explain it as the flow from Wisdom to Understanding, where it becomes "milk" to nourish the "children" <note>the lower Sefirot</note>.
**Loaf** <note>original: "Challah"</note>: Refers to Kingdom along with the three Patriarchs <note>Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, representing Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet</note>.
**Dream** <note>original: "Chalom"</note>: Refers to Kingdom when she ascends and holds the sixty higher voices. It can also refer to the "clothed" flow of prophecy, as explained in *Ra’aya Mehemna*.
**Window** <note>original: "Chalon"</note>: In the "tent" that is the "inn" for Understanding. It is also interpreted as Beauty in the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>, receiving

<meta>catchword: flow</meta>

<column-break/>

the flow that generates within her, as explained in the *Tikkunim*.
**Fifth** <note>original: "Chamish"</note>: Refers to the letters *Yod-He* in Wisdom, or more correctly, the foundation of **Strength** <term>Gevurah; the fifth Sefirah</term>.
**Loins** <note>original: "Chalatzayim"</note>: Refers to the "repairing" of Beauty and Kingdom, which are called the "loins" of the higher body.
**Five** <note>original: "Chamesh"</note>: Refers to the Sefirah of Strength, representing the five types of judgment. It is also related to the "beautiful eyes" mentioned in scripture.
**Precious Things** <note>original: "Chamudot"</note>: Refers to the days of "Greatness" <term>Chesed</term> in their entirety, representing desire and longing, prepared for the righteous.
**Five** <note>original: "Chamesha"</note>: Refers to Beauty, as it is the fifth Sefirah <note>when counting from Chesed</note>. Also refers to Kingdom in the secret of the letter *He* in the *Tikkunim*.
**Gracious** <note>original: "Chanun"</note>: According to Rabbi Moshe, this refers to the **Crown** <term>Keter; the highest Sefirah</term>.
**Kindness** <note>original: "Chesed"</note>: Refers to the Sefirah of Greatness, the "Right Hand." The *Book of Creation* explains it is called "Grace" because acts of kindness shine even through the face of Judgment. It is also called the "World of Kindness," hinting at the Crown or Understanding. "The Kindnesses of David" refers to Foundation.
**Pious** <note>original: "Chasid"</note>: Refers to the Crown, as mentioned in the *Tikkunim*.
**Stork** <note>original: "Chasidah"</note>: Refers to Understanding, because she "does kindness" <note>a pun on the Hebrew word for stork, 'Chasidah'</note> for her children. It can also refer to Kingdom when she is being nourished by Kindness.
**Desire** <note>original: "Chefetz"</note>: Refers to Wisdom when it receives from the Highest, according to Rabbi Moshe. According to the *Tikkunim*, it refers to Kingdom.
**My Desire** <note>original: "Cheftzi"</note>: Refers to Understanding, often described through the imagery of "fruits."
**Midnight** <note>original: "Chatzot Layla"</note>: Refers to Kingdom when she is nourished by both Judgment and Mercy. From the side of Strength, she is called "Night" <note>when judgments are aroused</note>, and from the side of Kindness, she is called "Midnight."
**Half** <note>original: "Chatzi"</note>: Any "split" thing refers to Kingdom. It can also refer to Beauty, which stands halfway between Understanding and Kingdom.
**My Gravel** <note>original: "Chatzatzi"</note>: Refers to Foundation, specifically the "arrows" <note>the flow</note> that it shoots into Kingdom.
**Silver Trumpets** <note>original: "Chatzitzrot Kesef"</note>: Refers to the side of Kindness and the "blasts" of Strength, through which the "children" <note>souls</note> are aroused.
**Statute** <note>original: "Chok"</note>: Refers to Foundation, for it is the "statute" through which all flows pass. Kingdom is also called "the engraved statute."
**Investigation** <note>original: "Cheker"</note>: Refers to Kingdom, as she "investigates" or reflects the light of Beauty.
**Sword** <note>original: "Cherev"</note>: Refers to the "consuming fire" of Kingdom when she acts through the power of Strength. It can also refer to the "Sword of the Lord" which has many symbolic "edges."
**Passion** <note>original: "Cheshek"</note>: Refers to the Crown due to its intense hiddenness and longing. It also refers to Strength and Kingdom when they are drawn together.
**Electrum** <note>original: "Chashmalah"</note>: Refers to Kingdom in her state of preciousness. According to Rabbi Moshe, it relates to the "hidden garden."

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations

...a hint to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut; the tenth Sefirah</term> in its lower aspect of "Lordship," and therefore "Blessed be the Name" is whispered below <note>A reference to the practice of whispering the second line of the Shema prayer</note>. 
And the rectification is found in the word **Throne** <note>original: "Kisse" (כסא)</note> and its permutations. 
Inside it, it indicates **Beauty** <term>Tiferet; the sixth Sefirah</term> who sits upon the Throne. There are "small vessels" and "small letters" <note>The Hebrew letters written in a smaller script in the Torah scroll</term> 
in Kingdom when she receives and is bound to the five "small letters" in the secret of the "five cups of wine." 

**Wall** <note>original: "Kotel"</note>: In Beauty when it is unified with Kingdom 
through the Righteous One <term>the Sefirah of Yesod</term>. It is the numerical value of "the Name" <note>likely the Tetragrammaton</note> plus the 32 paths of Wisdom, hinting at Beauty. This "Wall" is 
where the faces of Kingdom are revealed with the Righteous One <note>Yesod</note> in every place. 

**Basin** <note>original: "Kiyor"</note>: In **Victory** <term>Netzach</term> and **Splendor** <term>Hod</term>, and it is the "Basin and its stand." It is entirely here, and its power is as it is written: "of copper and of gold," 
as is known. 

**Power** <note>original: "Koach"</note>: In **Understanding** <term>Binah; the third Sefirah</term> which spreads out to Kingdom, and from her it is received 
and prevails. It also refers to **Crown** <term>Keter; the highest Sefirah</term>, and it is called "the Power of my Lord" as in the portion of *Shelach Lecha* <note>Numbers 14:17</note>. The word "all" <note>original: "Kol"</note> in its foundation 
is a pure source containing the 50 Gates of Understanding. 

**Bride** <note>original: "Kallah"</note>: In Kingdom when she receives 
the seven blessings and the 50 Gates of Understanding and Foundation. This is the secret of the word "Kallah" <note>Kaph-Lamed-Heh</note>, for the letter Kaph-Lamed <note>numerical value 50</note> is the foundation 
of all 50 gates, and the letter Heh is the secret of Kingdom. Therefore, the Bride includes 
ten Sefirot, meaning "all" <note>Kaph-Lamed</note> which is the 50 gates that are the 10 Sefirot <note>each containing ten</note>, and the Heh is Kingdom. 
The blessing of the "living" <note>Chai</note> that is appropriate refers to the secret of the "vessel of the Bride" 
which is in the secret of Understanding, from which the blessings flow, as explained in the book of *Terumah*. 
And in all these matters, it is 
the King of Kindness in his greatness, the "daughter of a king" for her husband, and in all these names 
it is as explained in the *Pekudin*. 

**Kidneys** <note>original: "Kelyot"</note>: In Victory, Splendor, and Foundation. They receive from above 
by way of Understanding. As the verse says: "Who put wisdom in the inward parts <note>original: "Tuchot"</note>?" and the explanation is that "Who" <note>original: "Mi"</note> refers 
to Understanding, who provides her influence and wisdom to the "inward parts" <note>the kidneys</note>. For this reason they are called *Kelyot* <note>Kidneys</note>, 
meaning "KL" <note>Kaph-Lamed = 50</note> a hint to Understanding, which are the 50 Gates of Understanding, and the suffix "Yot" refers to her character. There is 
a distinction between "inward parts" and "kidneys," for the "inward parts" refer to the essence of the world, from the language of "plastering," while "kidneys" 
refer to the completion after the influence has been received. 

**Lyre** <note>original: "Kinnor"</note>: In Kingdom, because 
she is comprised of ten, and this lyre that David played was made of "twenty-six" and "ten" <note>A Gematria reference</note>. The "twenty-six" refers to Beauty 
in the secret of the Tetragrammaton, and "ten" is Kingdom. For every musician, etc., and it is built upon the secret of 
the assembly. 

**Wing** <note>original: "Kanaf"</note>: In Kingdom, and with every tip of the letter Heh to give life. It also refers to the abundance of 
influence to the last ones <note>the lower worlds</note> as a "pocket," and the existence of the addition, for it happens only little by little. 

**Wings** <note>original: "Knafayim"</note>: 
Their eyes are in the secret of the beauty of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, of blessed memory. The "two wings" belong to the Throne, and the "six 
wings" are the six directions <note>the six Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</note>. This is the secret of the unification of the name *ADNY* with *YHVH*. 
Likewise, the "Wing" is the name for the wings of the eye, which is the inclusion of the three Patriarchs <note>Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, representing Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet</note>, and the wing 
is what covers them. 

**Throne** <note>original: "Kisse"</note>: The "Throne of Mercy" is Beauty, and the "Throne of 
Glory" is the Shekhinah <term>the Divine Presence/Kingdom</term>, for the Shekhinah is called "Glory." Or Beauty is 
a "Throne" for the Higher Wisdom, and the "Throne" is in Kingdom because she is a throne for Beauty. 
Similarly, the "Throne of Judgment" is in Kingdom. In every place where you find "Throne," sometimes it refers to the Throne 
and sometimes to the One who sits upon the Throne, each according to its place. However, simply "Throne" 
usually refers to Kingdom. And if Kingdom is not there, then the place of the Throne is called the "Throne of Glory," 
in the secret of the garment, as explained in the Gate of *Arvei Nachal*. 

**Throne (abbreviated)** <note>original: "Kes" (כס)</note>: In Kingdom 
when she is clothed and rises to the Crown. 

**Silver** <note>original: "Kesef"</note>: **Kindness** <term>Chesed; the fourth Sefirah</term>. And also "the silver is for the stone" <note>a reference to the Temple building</note>. And also 
Understanding is called "the house of silver," which is in the place of the secret of the 50 gates. Silver 
is in the secret of the Kingdom as explained in the book of *Me'irat Einayim*, and also in Crown. And also "the money" <note>original: "Kesef"</note>—this is considered 
to be in **Might** <term>Gevurah; the fifth Sefirah</term>. 

**Young Lions** <note>original: "Kefirim"</note>: According to the words of Rabbi Moshe, it is the Shekhinah who carries their sins 
on behalf of Israel. But according to the Zohar in the portion of *Vayishlach*, it refers to the "other side" <term>Sitra Achra; the realm of evil</term>. And also 
"Kefirim" refers to the language of "doubling" <note>original: "Kefulim"</note> of the waters. 

**Cover** <note>original: "Kapporet"</note>: In Foundation which surrounds and covers over 
Kingdom. 

**Branches/Palms** <note>original: "Kapot"</note>: "Palm branches" <note>of the Lulav</note> refer to Foundation. The explanation of "Kapot" <note>hands/palms</note> is that they gather the incense 

<column-break/>

above and below and unify Beauty and Kingdom. 

**Cherubim** <note>original: "Keruvim"</note>: In Beauty and Kingdom. 
And their wings are as the "Wing" that covers the Mercy Seat <note>the Kapporet</note>, which is the Righteous One <note>Yesod</note>. He is 
the Covenant which is covered and hidden. And sometimes they are Victory and Splendor. This is also explained 
in the *Tikkunim*. Or perhaps they are the Angels and Seraphim who are the "Cherubim" below 
Kingdom. 

**Excision** <note>original: "Karet"</note>: In Kingdom, in the aspect of the "shell" <term>Kelipah</term> that severs the influence, 
cutting it into pieces, God forbid. 

**Kneeling** <note>original: "Kri'ah"</note>: According to Rabbi Moshe, it is in **Soul** <term>Nefesh</term> 
and **Spirit** <term>Ruach</term>. According to the Zohar, it is in Foundation, as they said: "Everyone who kneels, kneels at the word 'Blessed'" <note>original: "Baruch"</note>, 
which is Crown. 

**Writing** <note>original: "Ktivah"</note>: Like "Sealing" <note>original: "Chatimah"</note>. See the entry for "Seal" <note>original: "Chotam"</note>. 
**Written**: In Wisdom, which is the revelation and the cascading of Greatness and Might. 
The choices are "written." 

**Script** <note>original: "Ktiv"</note>: In the secret of the Sefirah that bestows 
and plants the holy seed into Kingdom. 

**Palms/Hands** <note>original: "Kappayim"</note>: Beauty hangs upon the heads of the arms, 
in the secret of Kindness and Might, as is known. Shekhinah is the "Right Hand" and Kingdom is the "Left Hand" 
in the secret of Judgment. 

**Crown** <note>original: "Keter"</note>: In the first Sefirah, which is the Head and Crown 
to the rest of the Sefirot. It is also found in the lower aspect that is received, which is the aspect of the "Point" 
in the secret of the ending, in every place.

### Chapter 12: Leah

**Leah**: In Understanding <note>Binah</note> when she is perceived as spreading out into the three aspects 
that emerge from her. Thus, Leah gave birth to six sons <note>representing the six Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</note> 
and one daughter <note>Kingdom</note>. 

**Heart** <note>original: "Lev"</note>: In Understanding, the foundation of the source, like the heart to the whole body. 
It indicates the inclusion of the 32 <note>numerical value of Lev (LB)</note> paths of Wisdom. It is also in Kingdom 
when she receives the 32 paths from Wisdom by way of Understanding. 

**Lebanon** <note>original: "Levanon"</note>: In Wisdom <term>Chokhmah; the second Sefirah</term>. 
Also in the secret of the "Whiteness of the Sapphire," as mentioned in the *Tikkunim*. There is "Male Lebanon" <note>Wisdom</note> and there is "Female Lebanon" 
which is the "Whiteness of the Sapphire" <note>Kingdom</note>. This will be explained in the *Tikkunim*. There is also the "Palace of the Holy of Holies" 
which is called the "Whiteness of the Sapphire." But in Kingdom, it is called the "Pavement of the Whiteness 
of the Sapphire," as explained in the *Tikkunim*. 

**Frankincense** <note>original: "Levonah"</note>: In Wisdom, as it is included there. 
The reason is that just as frankincense has no scent until it is crushed, but its essence is soft when received 
from its source, so too Kingdom has no light of her own, only what she receives from Beauty. 
"Whiteness in secret" is in the secret of simple Mercy, for the Sefirah shines as it is written. 
For the intention, see the entry for "Lebanon" in the portion of *Vayikra*. 

**Flame** <note>original: "Lahav"</note>: In Kingdom, from the side 
of Might. There is also a "Flame" among the destructive angels, from which the fire of Gehenna is born. 

**Blaze** <note>original: "Lehavah"</note>: 
It turns about in Kingdom in the aspect of the forces of Judgment that cascade down. 
Sometimes they appear as men and sometimes as women, as is explained 
in the *Tikkunim*. In the Zohar, regarding the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil, "Good" is explained there 
as purity, and "Evil" as impurity. Similarly, in another place, the "Flame" is purity, 
which turns sometimes downward and sometimes toward the light of Mercy and Judgment. 

**To Him** <note>original: "Lo" (לו)</note>: In Beauty, which is the letter Vav <note>numerical value 6</note>, when it connects to the "Flying Tower" <note>Understanding</note>, which is the letter Lamed <note>numerical value 30</note>. 

**Tablets** <note>original: "Luchot"</note>: The Assembly <note>Kingdom</note>. The secret is that they are placed in the Ark, 
which is Kingdom, through the Foundation in Beauty 
which is the Torah. It is possible that the "Writing" is in Beauty and Kingdom, and the "Tablets" themselves 
are in Victory and Splendor. 

**Levi**: In Might. Also in Beauty in the secret of Knowledge <term>Da'at</term> which rules 
and unifies between Wisdom and Understanding, as explained in the portion of *Shelach Lecha* and *Vayishlach*. 

**Leviathan**: 
Foundation. It receives in the secret of Knowledge. Foundation unifies Beauty and Kingdom below. 

**Palm Branch** <note>original: "Lulav"</note>: In Foundation, in the secret of the "Straight Line" that rises to the Infinite. 

**Bread** <note>original: "Lechem"</note>: 
In Kingdom, because of the influence she receives from Understanding. However, her unification 
with Beauty is unified through the letter Vav <note>the numerical value of the Vav is 6, connecting to the word Lechem</note> for all the inhabitants of the world, and therefore she is called "Bread."
