<meta>This page continues Gate 23 of the "Juice of Pomegranates," which functions as a dictionary of symbolic "Appellations" for the Sefirot (the ten creative attributes of God). This section focuses on terms beginning with the letters Yod (י) and Kaph (כ). It clarifies how biblical names, objects, and concepts map onto the divine structure of the Sephirotic tree.</meta>

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations
### Page 257

<column-break/>

<margin>Yashar (Straight)</margin>
**Straight** <note>Hebrew: *Yashar*</note>: This refers to the space between them, and from it, apparently, comes the name **Israel** <note>A wordplay on *Yashar-El*, "Straight to God"</note>, which mediates toward the Tribe. It is possible this refers to the "Bond" <term>the connection between the Sephirot</term>, which is the name **God** <term>El</term> as explained in the Torah portion *Vayishlach*. **Straight** refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> when she connects to **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, specifically in **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> which is the "upright" path between the extremes and mediates between them all. This is the sense in the book of *Exodus* <note>original: "Pekudei"</note>, and according to the author of the *Kuzari*, it refers to **Beauty**.

<margin>Yeshivah (Sitting)</margin>
**Sitting** <note>Hebrew: *Yeshivah*</note>: Refers to an ascent into **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, by whose power all the "extremes" <term>the six lower Sefirot</term> "sit" or dwell within her. This is the secret of the "array of the House of Emanation," as explained in the *Faithful Shepherd* <note>A section of the Zohar</note>.

<margin>Yishenei (Sleepers)</margin>
**Sleepers of the dust** <note>Hebrew: *Yishenei afar*</note>: Refers to the merit through which one lives between two "dusts"—between **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> and **Kingdom** <term>Malkhut</term>. This is the meaning of "for dust you are and to dust you shall return": that which is emanated from Understanding and flows into Kingdom.

<margin>Yisrael (Israel)</margin>
**Israel**: Refers to **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> in its aspect of mediating between **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> and **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> through the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>. Its attribute toward **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> is the "God" <term>El</term> of Wisdom. The word *Yashar* (Straight) is also related to the language of "Song" <note>Hebrew: *Shir*</note> in Understanding, following the secret of the "Song of the Levites." It mediates the song to the power of "God" <term>El</term>. Because mediation only occurs through the secret of Knowledge, it is said that "Israel arose in [God's] thought." There is also an "Israel" that refers to the seven lower Sefirot, or specifically to **Foundation** or **Kingdom**, as explained in the *Tikunim* <note>The Tikunei Zohar</note>.

<margin>K"A Kavod (21 Honor)</margin>
**21 / Honor** <note>Hebrew: *K"A (21) / Kavod (Honor)*</note>: In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>. In the "Shells" <term>Kelipot; forces of evil</term>, it is "Honor." In **Kingdom**, it is when she enters **Wisdom** to be glorified by her "husband" <term>Tiferet</term> within her "canopy." Otherwise, she would be diminished. This relates to the 32 paths of Wisdom. Similarly, in the secret of the "World of the Throne" <note>the World of Beriah</note>, the essence of Honor comes from the side of Wisdom. It also refers to **Understanding**, where Wisdom is crowned. There is a distinction between **Honor** <term>Kavod</term> and **Heart** <term>Lev</term>; both refer to the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term> and the 32 paths. "Honor" is the 32 paths in Wisdom through Understanding, while "Heart" <note>Hebrew *Lamed-Bet*, numerical value 32</note> refers to the 32 paths in Kingdom.

<margin>Keves (Lamb)</margin>
**Lamb** <note>Hebrew: *Keves*</note>: In **Beauty**, which is "subjugated" <note>wordplay on *Kavash*, to conquer/subjugate</note> with Kingdom in exile by the power of "Wisdom" <term>Chokhmah</term>.

<margin>Kabir (Mighty)</margin>
**Mighty**: A term for power and strength; this is in **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term>.

<margin>Kevar (Already)</margin>
**Already** <note>Hebrew: *Kevar*</note>: Found in **Crown** <term>Keter</term>, **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, and **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> within **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>. For the letter *Kaph* is Keter, *Bet* is Binah, and *Resh* is the "Beginning" <term>Reshit</term> of Wisdom. The reason for this acronym is explained in the *Gate of the Mediator*.

<margin>Keveshim (Lambs)</margin>
**Lambs**: In **Beauty**. It is called a "Lamb" from the side of **Kindness**, as explained in the *Tikunim*. Its "bases" are the six Sefirot, and the lambs are from the side of Kindness, which cause the "Judgment" <term>Din</term> to be forgotten.

<margin>Kivshan (Furnace)</margin>
**Furnace**: Refers to the "proofs" from the side of **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term> that crown it and ignite it with the power of Judgment. This Judgment dwells "under the horns," in the secret of when she [Kingdom] was shamed with her husband. This "furnace" raises the flow to the lower worlds, and thus she is called a furnace.

<margin>Kad (Pitcher)</margin>
**Pitcher**: In **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, which corresponds to the 24 Books <note>of the Hebrew Bible</note> and the 24 letters of the "Blessed be the Name" <note>The second line of the Shema</note>. In **Kingdom**, it refers to the 24 courts. In the *Tikunim*, it hints at Kingdom from the side of Judgment, as explained in the portion *Vayishlach*. The secret of the number 25 <note>Hebrew: *Koh*</note> is to the right, from the side of Abraham, covering until "thus" <term>Koh</term>. There is also a 25 to the left, like the "Flame of the Heart." Corresponding to these are the 25 letters in the *Shema* prayer of morning and evening. Kingdom is called **Koh** (25) in the secret of the "25 Gates" from the right: 10 of Kindness, 6 of Victory, and 5 of Beauty <note>the math here follows specific Kabbalistic groupings</note>. Likewise 25 to the left. Kingdom is called "Koh" because she is comprised of 25 and 25, which equals 50, the "50 Gates of Understanding," as explained in the *Tikunim*.

<margin>Kohen (Priest)</margin>
**Priest**: The **High Priest** is **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, which is "great" and merciful to all the "Days of Creation." A "Priest" generally is from the side of **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>. An **Ordinary Priest** is the angel **Michael**, as explained in the *Gate of Emanation*.

<margin>Kova (Helmet)</margin>
**Helmet**: Spread over **Kingdom**, for she is a "Helmet and a Crown" on the head of Salvation from the side of **Greatness** <term>Gedulah/Chesed</term>, as it is written: "as a helmet."

<margin>Kos (Cup)</margin>
**Cup** of Blessing...

<column-break/>

<margin>Yam (Sea)</margin>
**Sea**: **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> and **Kingdom** <term>Malkhut</term>. She is called the **Sea** when she receives from the "Lower Wisdom." She is called the **End Sea** <note>The Red Sea; *Yam Suf*</note> because she is the "end" of the levels. She is called the **Salt Sea**, etc. There are two aspects: when nourishment is plentiful, it is "holy," but when judgment dominates, it is like how too much salt ruins the dish. But when it is minimal, it "sweetens" the judgment. She is also called the **Last Sea**. The Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term> is called the **Ancient Sea** to indicate the union of the **Crown** with **Wisdom** and **Understanding**. The Sefirot above are also called "Sea" in terms of the abundance of flow. She is called the **Blue Sea** <note>the color *Tekhelet*</note> and **Seas** because she is comprised of all the "Days" <term>the lower Sefirot</term>.

<margin>Yemei Olam (Days of Eternity)</margin>
**Days of Eternity / Days of Old**: These are the days while they are still "within" <term>hidden in the source</term>.

<margin>Yamim (Days)</margin>
**Days**: "Day One" is called **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>, "Day Two" is **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term>, etc. Day Three is **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, Day Four corresponds to **Victory** <term>Netzach</term>, Day Five to **Splendor** <term>Hod</term>, Day Six to **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, and all of them are "with her" in **Kingdom**. According to the *Tikunim*, Day Four is the "Moon" <note>Kingdom</note> and the Sabbath is shared between **Foundation** and **Kingdom**.

<margin>Yamin (Right)</margin>
**Right**: In **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>. All good things come from the "Right."

<margin>Yesod (Foundation)</margin>
**Foundation**: In **Kingdom**, it is the "Standing." It is called Foundation because it is the foundation of Kingdom. Spiritual things have their foundation above. Furthermore, in its aspect of nourishing the world, it is called "His Tree" and "The Children's Children," for he is the foundation of the worlds.

<margin>Yaakov (Jacob)</margin>
**Jacob**: In **Kingdom**, in her inner, holy aspect. When she ascends, she is "The Ascent of Jacob." It also hints at **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, which is the letter *Yod* and *Ekev* <note>a wordplay on the name Yaakov</note>, and the letter *Vav* which includes the seven "heights."

<margin>Yafeh (Beautiful)</margin>
**Beautiful of Branch**: In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, for it beautifies the branches. Likewise in **Foundation**, for whatever happened to Jacob <term>Tiferet</term> happened to Joseph <term>Yesod</term>, as explained in the *Zohar*.

<margin>Yafeh (Beautiful)</margin>
**Beautiful of Eyes**: According to some, this is **Joseph** in **Kindness**; to others, it is in **Wisdom**, for the eyes correspond to Wisdom. In Kingdom, it refers to the "Beautiful Eyes" of the Bride.

<margin>Yitzchak (Isaac)</margin>
**Isaac**: In **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term>, in the aspect that awakens toward Mercy; for "Isaac" implies **Laughter** <note>Hebrew: *Tzchok*</note> and rejoicing in the secret of the "Sweetening of Judgments."

<margin>Yakar (Precious)</margin>
**Precious** in His eyes: A term for **Light**. It refers to **Foundation** or **Beauty**.

<margin>Yirah (Fear)</margin>
**Fear / Awe**: In **Understanding** or **Severity**, for Severity is Fear, as it is said, "And God saw" <note>Hebrew: *Vayar*, related to *Yirah*</note>. **Foundation** flows into Severity which is called Fear, and **Kingdom** receives the attribute of Judgment from Severity.

<margin>Yarom (Exalted)</margin>
**Exalted**: In **Understanding**, for she is higher than all the Sefirot.

<margin>Yerushalayim (Jerusalem)</margin>
**Jerusalem**: In **Kingdom**, in her [holy] aspect.

<margin>Yareiach (Moon)</margin>
**Moon**: In **Kingdom**, specifically in her inner aspect. However, the term *Levanah* <term>the white moon</term> also refers to Kingdom.

<margin>Yeriyah (Curtain)</margin>
**Curtain**: In **Beauty**, in the aspect called "Heavens," which includes everything. It is written, "He stretches out the heavens like a curtain." It refers to the inclusion of the five "ends" <term>the lower Sefirot</term> and primarily concerns **Kingdom**, as explained in the *Zohar*.

<margin>Yarketei (Recesses)</margin>
**Recesses of the North**: By the power of **Kindness** in the lower aspect. From the side of **Severity**, it is called "North."

<margin>Yesh (Substance / There is)</margin>
**Substance** <note>Hebrew: *Yesh*</note>: In **Wisdom**, including **Understanding**. The hint is the letter *Yod* for Wisdom and *He* for Understanding, the root of the Tree. Together they comprise the "310 worlds" <note>The numerical value of *Yesh* (יש) is 310</note> promised to the righteous. From there, they flow to **Greatness** <term>Chesed</term> and **Severity**.

<margin>Yeshuah (Salvation)</margin>
**Salvation**: In **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>. It is hinted at in the verse "His right hand has saved Him."

<margin>Yeshurun (Jeshurun)</margin>
**Jeshurun**: In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> when it receives from the Right and the Left, in the secret of the "Two Rows" <note>Hebrew: *Shurot*</note> that it mediates and includes.

It focuses on the linguistic roots and numerical values (Gematria) that link biblical vocabulary to the Kabbalistic structure of the universe.</summary>
<keywords>Israel, Binah, Malkhut, Tiferet, Yesod, Gevurah, Sea, Fear of God, Jacob, Isaac, 310 worlds, 50 Gates of Understanding</keywords>

<meta>This page continues the "Gate of Appellations," a dictionary of symbolic names for the Sephirot. The previous page concluded the letter Yod and Kaph; this page begins the letter Mem (מ). It explores how physical descriptions—such as "Water," "Staff," and "King"—correspond to divine emanations.</meta>

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations
## The Letter Mem

<column-break/>

**Their appointed time** <note>Hebrew: *Mo'adam*</note>: **Wondrous** <note>Hebrew: *Mufla*</note> in **Crown** <term>Keter</term>, a term denoting hiddenness and wonder.

**Myrrh** <note>Hebrew: *Mor*</note>: In **Crown** <term>Keter</term>... a term of strength, to clarify and sing. Also in **Victory** <term>Netzach</term> as explained in the *Faithful Shepherd* <note>A section of the Zohar</note>.

**Savior** <note>Hebrew: *Moshia*</note>: In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> because it assists the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term>. When it is revealed and called such, it is the Foundation of **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>, where salvation resides through the power of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>.

**Ruler** <note>Hebrew: *Moshel*</note>: In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, the King of **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, as explained in the *Faithful Shepherd*.

**Death** <note>Hebrew: *Mavet*</note>: Refers to the *Klipah* <term>the "shell" or spiritual impurity</term> that stands in opposition [to holiness].

**Justifier** <note>Hebrew: *Mazkeh*</note>: Located in the brains... in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, while the "nesting" is in **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. Also, when Kingdom receives from **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term>, it is called "Mo-Ches" <note>likely an abbreviation or technical term for judgment</note>, but when it is sweetened by **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, it is called **Justifier** <note>Mazkeh, related to purity/merit</note>.

**Sustenance** <note>Hebrew: *Mazon*</note>: In **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>, as it flows sustenance downward, as described in the secrets of the Torah portion *Terumah*.

**Fortune** <note>Hebrew: *Mazal*</note>: In **Crown** <term>Keter</term>, in its aspect of governance—the "constellation" that flows downward.

**Psalm** <note>Hebrew: *Mizmor*</note>: In **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> and **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. It is possible it refers to Kingdom in its role of singing to **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> to fill its lack, as explained in the *Corrections of the Zohar*.

**East** <note>Hebrew: *Mizrach*</note>: In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, as explained in the Torah portions *Vayelech* and *Bamidbar*. It is also possibly in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, because the secret of Beauty—which is not small—emerges from **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> and **Understanding**.

**Vision** <note>Hebrew: *Machazeh*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> when she is a "clear mirror," and **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term> is revealed within her.

**Visions** <note>Hebrew: *Machazot*</note>: These are in **Victory** <term>Netzach</term> and **Splendor** <term>Hod</term>, which serve as the "visions" for **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, which is called the "House."

**Half-Shekel** <note>Hebrew: *Machatzit HaShekel*</note>: Its meaning is "the intermediary." It refers to the letter *Vav* [6] in the secret of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> and the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>, which sits between its secret and its existence. The "twenty gerahs" of the Shekel refer to the letter *Yod* above and *Yod* below <note>The letter Aleph is composed of two Yods and a Vav, totaling 26, the value of the Divine Name</note>. Similarly, in **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> when she ascends to Beauty, she is called the Half-Shekel.

**Peeled White** <note>Hebrew: *Machshof Lavan*</note>: In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> when it inclines toward **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>; its "whiteness" is revealed. Similarly in the **Ancient of Days** <term>Keter</term> when the white light is revealed.

**Thought** <note>Hebrew: *Machshavah*</note>: In **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>, and also in **Crown** <term>Keter</term> and **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. The reason is that Kingdom is called "Thought" relative to the lower worlds, as she is a "refined thought." In this sense, "Thought" can apply to the entire World of Emanation <term>Atzilut</term> because it is more refined [than what is below]. Similarly, **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> is "Thought" relative to the "Building" <term>the seven lower Sephirot</term>, which are the "action" and "revelation" of Understanding. Furthermore, Understanding reveals what is in Wisdom; therefore, Understanding is called "Pure Thought" and Wisdom "Refined Thought," while the Crown is the most refined of both.

**Staff/Incline** <note>Hebrew: *Matteh*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, because she "extends" and "inclines." **Beauty** and **Kingdom** are also considered this when unified. **Staff** is also in **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> and **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> in the secret of "leaning," as it sometimes inclines toward **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>. There is also a "Staff of Thirty" in **Understanding**, and the word *Matteh* [Staff] can be read as *Mat-Heh* <note>meaning 59, representing the gates</note>... it is called such due to its inclination toward Judgment.

**Target/Guard** <note>Hebrew: *Mattarah*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, referring to guarding, as in the secret of the "pupil of the eye."

**Matron** <note>Hebrew: *Matrona*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, and also in **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> as mentioned by our teacher.

**Metatron**: According to the commentators on the *Paths*, he is the transformed Enoch. He is the "Master of the World" below. Sometimes this name refers to the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term> when she "clothes" herself in this angel, as hinted in the verse "for My Name is within him."

**Who** <note>Hebrew: *Mi*</note>: In **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>. Because of its hidden nature, it is called by the language of a question: "Who is He?" It is also called *Mi* because of the six "extremes" <term>the lower Sefirot</term> together with the Jubilee <note>Binah</note>, which equals fifty—the numerical value of *Mi* (Mem=40, Yod=10).

**Water** <note>Hebrew: *Mayim*</note>: In **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>. There are "Upper Waters" in the secret of the letter *Heh*... and "Lower Waters" in the secret of the letter *Yod*. There are "Many Waters" in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> which are a river that does not...
<meta>catchword: cease</meta>

<column-break/>

...cease. As explained in the Torah portion *Vayishlach*: "And he inclined to me rest" <note>Genesis 49:15</note> comes from the flow of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, as explained by the elder Rabbi Yeiva. The "power of the Priests" is in Understanding... a flow of pure water that never ceases. According to Rabbi Isaac, "Pure Water" is one thing, but "Plonim" and "Zonim" waters are found in the *Klipot* <term>impure shells</term>.

**Circumcision/Word** <note>Hebrew: *Milah*</note>: In **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>.

**Birth of Prophecy**: In the secret of "mixed wine" and its arousal to intoxicate the *Klipah*.

**Established Place** <note>Hebrew: *Makhon*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> because she is the "nest" for all the *Klipot* <term>to be regulated</term>. Also **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> is the "Established Place" for the fifty [gates] of **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> that descend to the "seven sons" <term>the lower Sefirot</term>.

**Covering** <note>Hebrew: *Mikhseh*</note>: In **Crown** <term>Keter</term>, which is wondrous and covered.

**Double** <note>Hebrew: *Makhpelah*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> because she is "doubled" in her aspects... also in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>.

**Deciders** <note>Hebrew: *Makhri'im*</note>: **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> and **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>.

**Golden Tablet** <note>Hebrew: *Mikhtam*</note>: **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> and **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>... as explained in *Ra'aya Mehemna*.

**Full** <note>Hebrew: *Maleh*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>... filled with the flow of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>.

**Angel** <note>Hebrew: *Malakh*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> when she performs a mission via **Metatron** or **Sandalphon**. She is called "the Angel of Y-H-W" <note>Hebrew: *Malakh Hashem*</note> when she acts for the Ancient One... but she is not called "Angel" except when she is active.

**Craft/Work** <note>Hebrew: *Melakhah*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> in her aspect of enacting the upper powers below. She is the one who "finishes the building" and is the "ornament of the building."

**Kingship** <note>Hebrew: *Melukhah*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> when unified with **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, who ascends to reign.

**Inn/Lodging** <note>Hebrew: *Malon*</note>: In **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> where **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> and **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> are unified. It is called an "Inn" or "Lodging" because they stay there only temporarily [during union].

**Salt** <note>Hebrew: *Melach*</note>: In **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, which sweetens the bitterness of the judgment of **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, which is called the "Salt Sea."

**King** <note>Hebrew: *Melekh*</note>: Generally, every Sephirah can be called "King." However, when the Zohar says "King" without qualification, it usually refers to **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> as it stands over **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. Similarly, all of Israel are "sons of Kings." There is also the "King of Peace" <note>Shalom</note>... which the Zohar in *Terumah* identifies as **Beauty** or **Foundation**. Elsewhere, "King of Peace" refers to **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> or **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>... or even the **Crown** <term>Keter</term>... There is a "Great King," a "Holy King," and a "King of Judgment." These are in **Understanding** from the side of Greatness and Severity... **Beauty** is called "Holy King" from the side of Kindness.

**King of Kings of Kings**: The King of [Kings] is **Crown** <term>Keter</term>, ruling over the kings of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, who in turn rule over the world <term>the lower six Sefirot</term>. "Peaceful King" refers to the Crown within Understanding. **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> is also called "Perfect King" when unified with Beauty.

It emphasizes the transitions between high conceptual states (like Crown and Understanding) and their manifestations in the lower realms of Kingdom and action.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the alphabetical lexicon of divine "Appellations" (nicknames or symbolic terms) used in Kabbalistic literature to describe the ten Sephirot—the emanations of God’s light. This section focuses on terms beginning with the letters Mem (מ) and Lamed (ל).</meta>

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations

->**The Letter Mem**<-

**God of Hosts** <note>Hebrew: *Elohim Tzevaot*</note>: According to the *Tikunim* <note>The *Tikunei Zohar*, a classic Kabbalistic text</note>, and generally, this refers to **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term>. 

**Source** <note>Hebrew: *Mabua*</note>: Refers to **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, for it is the point from which the "letters" of **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> flow out toward the "windows" <note>symbolic openings for divine light</note>. It also appears in **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> as the "Straight Line" in the windows.

**Tower** <note>Hebrew: *Migdal*</note>: Refers to **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> and **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. Just as a tower indicates a high place of judgment and protection, **Understanding** is high above all judgments, and **Kingdom** is the "womb" for all created beings. The "Floating Tower in the Air" <note>A paradoxical Talmudic image</note> refers to **Understanding** which "soars" and is revealed within **Beauty**, which is called "Air." The **Crown** <term>Keter</term> is also called a "Floating Tower" because it appears through **Wisdom** and **Understanding**.

**Shield** <note>Hebrew: *Magen*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> in its aspect of protecting and providing for the fifty gates. It is associated with the four Archangels: Michael, Gabriel, Nuriel, and Uriel. It is also found in **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, as explained in the Torah portion *Shemot*.

**Strife** <note>Hebrew: *Madon*</note>: Refers to the flow of "Harsh Judgment" that spreads from **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term> downward through the Sephirot to fuel accusations, or its opposite when sweetened.

**Mad/Madin**: Refers to a "multitude of judgment" found in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>.

**Knowledge** <note>Hebrew: *Mada*</note>: Found in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> from the perspective of the Sephira of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>. It represents a state that is neither entirely white (mercy) nor entirely red (judgment).

**Measure of Day** <note>Hebrew: *Midat Yom*</note>: Found in **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, following the secret of the twelve boundaries and the twelve hours of the day. 

**Measure of Night** <note>Hebrew: *Midat Layla*</note>: Found in **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, following the twelve boundaries and twelve hours of the night.

**Measure of Harsh Judgment**: Found in **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term>. 
**Measure of Soft Judgment**: Found in **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, which acts as the "lower court" for the world.

**What is His name and what is His son’s name** <note>Proverbs 30:4</note>: This is a code. "What" <note>Hebrew: *Mah*, which equals 45</note> is **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>, and "His Name" is **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>. The name of God (Y-H-V-H) when spelled out with the letter *Aleph* <note>YOD-He-AV-He</note> equals 45 (*Mah*). This name sustains the world and is the secret of the "Son" (Tiferet) as it relates to the "Mother" (Understanding). Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai explains in the *Tikunim* that this name allows us to "know" how **Beauty** interacts with **Kingdom** to govern the world.

**Brain** <note>Hebrew: *Moach*</note>: Found in **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>. However, in the context of the "Skull," it refers to the inner part of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>. Generally, every Sephira can be called "Brain" in relation to the Sephira below it.

**Pole/Staff** <note>Hebrew: *Mot*</note>: Found in **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> and **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>.

**Additional** <note>Hebrew: *Musaf*</note>: Found in **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, representing the extra light that spreads through the union of **Beauty** and **Kingdom**.

**Foundations of the Earth**: Found in **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> and **Righteousness** <term>Tzedek/Kingdom</term>.

**Appointed Time** <note>Hebrew: *Moed*</note>: Found in **Foundation**, **Kindness**, and **Severity**. This corresponds to "Morning" for Abraham (Kindness) and "Evening" for Isaac (Severity). In the *Tikunim*, the six "ends" <note>the six emotional Sephirot</note> are called the "Appointed Times of the Lord."

<column-break/>

**Showbread** <note>Hebrew: *Lechem Panim*</note>: Found in **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, representing the flow from the "Upper Faces" to the "Lower Faces" through the secret of the Tetragrammaton (Y-H-V-H).

**Lat** <note>Hebrew for "Lizard" or a curse, but here used numerically for 39</note>: Refers to **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term> within **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. It relates to the "strap" used for the thirty-nine lashes.

**L-Y** <note>To/For God</note>: **Severity** when it clings to **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>.

**Night**: Found in **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. There is a distinction between **Layil** <note>Masculine form of night</note> and **Layla** <note>Feminine form</note>. **Layil** refers to the state before the divine union (from the start of the night until midnight). From midnight onwards, when **Kingdom** unites with **Beauty** in a state of mercy, it is called **Layla** (with the added letter *He* at the end).

**Leviathan**: Refers to the **Crown** <note>Atarah</note> of the Foundation. It is "eaten by its husband" <note>a metaphor for spiritual integration</note>. It also hints at the three "lines" of the divine structure: Kindness, Judgment, and Mercy.

**Lioness** <note>Hebrew: *Lishah*</note>: Found in **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> when it is nourished by the side of **Severity**. It indicates a lack of flow, as a lioness "seizes prey."

**L-K** <note>To you / 50</note>: Found in the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term>, representing the fifty gates.

**Tongue** <note>Hebrew: *Lashon*</note>: Found in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> and **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. Just as a tongue brings out hidden thoughts from the heart, **Understanding** brings out hidden things into the "fifty paths," and **Foundation** pours out the flow. The "Tongue of the Learned" refers to **Foundation** receiving from **Victory** and **Splendor**, which are the "lips."

**To Dwell** <note>Hebrew: *Lashabat*</note>: Found in **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term>, relating to the dwelling of the "seventy members of the Sanhedrin" <note>the high court</note> to clarify judgment.

### Chapter 13: Me'od (Very/Power)

**Yivaled** <note>Will be born</note>: Refers to **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> in the Torah portion *Lech Lecha*.

**Very/Power** <note>Hebrew: *Me'od*</note>: Found in **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> and **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, representing the "Great Light" and the "Small Light." It also relates to **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> as the source of the light for the "Brain" and the "Moon" <note>Kingdom</note>.

**Food** <note>Hebrew: *Ma'achal*</note>: Refers to the "Sustenance" <term>Mazon</term> that is prepared as Manna. It is the flow from **Foundation** to **Kingdom**.

**Curse/Lights** <note>Hebrew: *Me'erot*</note>: When spelled without the letter *Vav*, it refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>...

<meta>This page continues the alphabetical lexicon of divine "Appellations" (symbolic names or nicknames) for the ten Sefirot—the emanations through which the Infinite manifests. This section concludes the letter Mem (מ) and begins the letter Nun (נ).</meta>

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations

<columns>
**Offering** <note>Hebrew: *Minchah*</note> and **The Sound of the Crowds Heard**, for it is **Sweet** to them: "Sweet" refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> from the side of **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term>, following the secret of "bitter at its start and sweet at its end." **The Giving of the Torah** <note>Hebrew: *Matan Torah*</note>: according to Rabbi Moshe <note>Moses Cordovero</note>, this is in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, but according to the *Zohar*, it is in **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, because through the writing of the Torah for **Kingdom**, **Foundation** provides for it within **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>. **A Good Gift** <note>Hebrew: *Matana Tovah*</note>: in **Kingdom** when she is clothed in the three Patriarchs <note>Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, representing Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet</note>; it also follows the secret of the three colors of the eye. **A Good Tongue** <note>Hebrew: *Lashon Tovah*</note> and **The Tongue and the Goodness Associated with It** <note>original: "Lashon ve-ha-tov lah chavrut"</note>: this elevates the status to **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>. **Loins** <note>Hebrew: *Motnayim*</note>: in **Understanding** and **Foundation** when the union is in **Beauty** and **Kingdom** on the side of **Severity**. The "Loins" are slightly below **Splendor** <term>Hod</term> and slightly above **Soul** <term>Nefesh</term>. Thus Rabbi Moshe (of blessed memory) chose the verse "from your loins they shall go out" <note>Genesis 35:11</note> etc.

### Chapter 14: Faithful <note>Terms starting with the letter Nun</note>

**Faithful** <note>Hebrew: *Ne'eman*</note>: in **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, as it bestows the flow of vitality from **Beauty** to **Kingdom** and does not withhold the flow. **Beautiful** <note>Hebrew: *Na'eh*</note>: in **Kingdom** when she is adorned with her ornaments—this attribute is associated with **Lovingkindness** <term>Chesed</term>, meaning "C" for Kingdom, "L" for Beauty, etc. <note>original: "k' Malchut l's Tiferet"</note>. **Prophecy** <note>Hebrew: *Nevuah*</note>: in **Kingdom** when she receives influence from **Victory** <term>Netzach*</term> and **Splendor** <term>Hod</term>, which are the "Prophets." **Prophets of Truth** <note>Hebrew: *Nevie'ei Emet*</note>: in **Victory** and **Splendor** when they receive from **Beauty**, which is called "Truth," following the secret of their illumination. **South** <note>Hebrew: *Negev*</note>: in **Lovingkindness**. Regarding **Severity**, it is a part of **Understanding** totaling seven, for it had the power of the waters of **Lovingkindness**. Since the Sefirot are mirrored in one another, **Severity** acts on the side of **Lovingkindness** in a great and harsh way to balance its nature; therefore, the boundaries of **Lovingkindness** leaning toward **Severity** are in the "South." **Melody** <note>Hebrew: *Niggun*</note>: in **Understanding** from the side of **Severity**; this is the secret of the Levite who would play music, for music stems from the secret of **Severity** toward the side of **Understanding**. **Affliction** <note>Hebrew: *Nega*</note>: in the **Shell** <term>Klipah</term> <note>the external forces of impurity</note>. **Nobles of the Peoples** <note>Hebrew: *Nedivei Amim*</note>: these are in the triad of **Lovingkindness, Severity, and Beauty**. In **Lovingkindness**, they bestow and give to the poor, and "the poor" refers to Righteousness and Charity <note>symbolizing Malchut</term>. **Vow** <note>Hebrew: *Neder*</note>: in **Understanding**. See Rabbi Moshe regarding the term "Dwelling" <note>Hebrew: *Dirah*</note>, which follows the path of restoration; it is also related to the language of "Release" and "Freedom." Therefore, a vow to God regarding a non-obligatory matter alludes to **Understanding** and its freedom, as expressed in the words of Rabbi Moshe (of blessed memory). **River** <note>Hebrew: *Nahat*</note>: Generally, each of the seven Sefirot is called a "River" from the side of **Lovingkindness**. Specifically, it refers to **Understanding** and **Foundation**, and sometimes to **Beauty**. The **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term> is called a "River that flows and goes out" <note>original: "nahar de-nagid ve-nafik"</note>... likewise **Foundation** is sometimes called "River that flows and goes out." **Beauty** is called a "Male River" <note>Hebrew: *Nahat Dichura*</note> from the side of **Severity**, and its inner meaning refers to the abundance of the waters of **Lovingkindness**. It is also called "River in Eden" <note>original: "Nahar be-K"R"</note> by the influence of the Higher Triad upon it. **Wanderer** <note>Hebrew: *Nod*</note>: called thus in the Shell... in the secret of the male aspect... from the side of **Severity** in the secret of palaces, and the illness from the side of **Lovingkindness** in the secret of its whiteness. **Brightness** <note>Hebrew: *Nogah*</note>: in **Understanding** from the side of **Lovingkindness**. Also, the Shell of **Nogah** is named against the **Lovingkindness** in **Kingdom** during its restoration. **Abode** <note>Hebrew: *Naveh*</note>: in **Kingdom**, following the secret of a "cup" for **Beauty**. **Flowing Waters** <note>Hebrew: *Nozelim*</note>: in **Understanding**, the bestowing of flow from the Higher Triad through the seven Sefirot—namely Lovingkindness, Severity, Beauty, Victory, Splendor, Foundation, and the "Body and Covenant"—from the Understanding of all bestowers toward **Kingdom**. **Pleasantness** <note>Hebrew: *No'am*</note>: this is the flow and the brightness that descends from **Understanding** from the side of the **Crown** <term>Keter</term> to **Kingdom** through the Sefirot, as explained in the *Zohar*: "And all the Lovingkindness of the worlds... all its goodness, all its preciousness, all its light... is called Pleasantness." **Preserver** <note>Hebrew: *Notzer*</note>: in the secret of **Understanding** and **Beauty**, according to Rabbi Moshe. **Awesome** <note>Hebrew: *Nora*</note>: in **Beauty** from the side of **Severity**, as explained in the Torah portion *Yitro* on the verse "And Jethro heard" regarding the standing at God's presence, for it is "Awesome." For **Lovingkindness** is "Great" and **Severity** is "Awesome"...

<column-break/>

the perfection of the "House," and it is called "Awesome." There is no fear except in **Lovingkindness** and the perfection of the face, as it is written: "Fear the Lord, you His holy ones, for there is no want to those who fear Him" <note>Psalms 34:10</note>. **Bearer of Iniquity** <note>Hebrew: *Noseh Avon*</note>: in **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. The reason is that iniquity damages as far as the Foundation; therefore, it must be inclined and [forgiven] from there. **Noah/Rest** <note>Hebrew: *Noach*</note>: in **Foundation** when it rests in **Kingdom**, following the secret of **Beauty**; it is the language of "Resting" and "Satiation" because through satiation, there is a pause for **Kingdom**. **Savor** <note>Hebrew: *Nichoach*</note>: in **Foundation**. Flow descending from **Understanding** to **Lovingkindness** and then to **Severity** to extinguish the fire of **Severity**. **Stream** <note>Hebrew: *Nachal*</note>: Generally, each of the seven Sefirot is called a "Stream," for the **Understanding** is the "Great Sea" and upon it is written "and she shall be divided into seven streams." Specifically, it is in **Beauty**, and the meaning is that the foundation of **Understanding** and the gathering [of light] is called **Beauty**, the "Ancient Stream" <note>Hebrew: *Nachal Kedumim*</note>, for there the ancient ones are gathered. Particularly, the union of the **Crown** with the Sefirot is a "Stream like a Stream of Delights" <note>Hebrew: *Nachal Ma'adanim*</note> because the essence of delight is there. There is a distinction: a "Stream" <term>Nachal</term> refers to the future, but a "River" <term>Nahar</term> never ceases. Between stream and stream, **Beauty** is born. **Foundation** is also called a "Stream" as mentioned in the *Tikunim*. **Heritage without Boundaries** <note>Hebrew: *Nachalah beli Metzarim*</note>: in **Understanding**, for behind and above it there are no boundaries; and in **Beauty** when it rises to **Understanding**; and in **Foundation**, namely the flow of **Beauty**, as explained in the *Book of Formation* <term>Sefer Yetzirah</term>. **String of the Lyre** <note>Hebrew: *Nima shel Kinnor*</note>: in **Foundation**. The "Lyre" is **Kingdom**, and the "Strings" are the Sefirot that are prepared in **Foundation** through their bestowal, and through them the melody of the lyre is played. Sometimes there are seven strings and sometimes ten. **Banner** <note>Hebrew: *Nes*</note>: in **Foundation** when it is elevated above **Victory** and **Splendor** and serves as a banner over them. **Shoe** <note>Hebrew: *Na'al*</note>: **Metatron** <note>the prince of the angels</note> when he covers and clothes the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term>. **Youth** <note>Hebrew: *Na'ar*</note>: **Metatron** when he receives influence from **Understanding**; he is called a "Youth" because he provides for all the worlds. Sometimes the **Divine Presence** is called a "Youth" <note>Hebrew: *Na'ar* or *Na'arah*</note>—she is a *Na'ar* before she receives from the male, and a *Na'arah* after she has received. Sometimes **Foundation** is called a "Youth." **Princes/Eunuchs** <note>Hebrew: *Nis/Sarisim*</note>: Plural form. These are the camps and the legions in the secret of the **Divine Presence** below; they are appointed over her. Sometimes they are in **Victory** and **Splendor** when the flow is upon them. **Soul** <note>Hebrew: *Nefesh*</note>: in **Kingdom**. She is called a "Living Soul" <note>Hebrew: *Nefesh Chayah*</note>. From the side of the crowns, she receives from **Understanding** and **Beauty**. She is called the "Extra Soul" <note>Hebrew: *Nefesh Yeteirah*</note> on the Sabbath day when she is exalted. She is also called "The Soul of David." **Stationed** <note>Hebrew: *Nitzav*</note>: indicates the unity of the flow in **Foundation** and above in **Beauty**. It also refers to the language of "Building," as explained in the portion *Vayigash*. **Victory** <note>Hebrew: *Netzach*</note>: refers to the seventh attribute. **Blossoms** <note>Hebrew: *Nitzanim*</note>: in the triad of **Victory, Splendor, and Foundation** <term>NeHeY</term> at the beginning of their ascent in "Thought," as explained in the portion *Bereshit*. **Vengeance of the Covenant** <note>Hebrew: *Nekam Berit*</note>: in **Kingdom**, named so because it exacts vengeance and bestows the Holy Covenant that influences from the Upper Seventh. **Lamp of the Lord** <note>Hebrew: *Ner Hashem*</note>: in **Kingdom**, for she is a lamp that receives the upper light. When she is merit-worthy of light, she is called a "Lamp"; when she receives the secret, she is called "Lamp of the Lord," and likewise "Lamp of Commandment" <term>Ner Mitzvah</term>. The "Lamp" represents the revelation of the Name. She is composed of three lights: Red, White, and Green, corresponding to the three Patriarchs. **Kingdom** is the container, **Beauty** is the wick, and the oil is the flow of **Wisdom**. **Spikenard** <note>Hebrew: *Nerd*</note>: in **Foundation**, following the secret in the *Zohar*, portion *Emor*. **Exalted** <note>Hebrew: *Nassa*</note>: in **Understanding**, **Foundation**, **Crown**, and **Beauty**.
<sig>L 03</sig>  in **Beauty** <note>catchword</note>
</columns>

<summary>This page defines Kabbalistic appellations starting with the letters Mem and Nun, linking terms like "Faithful," "River," "Soul," and "Lamp" to specific Sefirot (divine emanations). It emphasizes the symbolic roles of Foundation (Yesod) as a bestower and Kingdom (Malchut) as a recipient or "Lamp" for divine light.</summary>

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations

**The Place where the Supreme Oil is Found**: This refers to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut: the tenth and final emanation, representing the physical world and divine sovereignty</term> in its aspect as the "tenth," which is the "Kingdom of the King." It includes all the actions of the upper worlds. When it is unified with its desires in **Beauty** <term>Tiferet: the central emanation, often associated with the masculine principle or the "King"</term>, it is called the **Kingdom of Heaven** <note>Hebrew: *Malchut Shamayim*</note>, as **Beauty** is known by the name "Heaven." When everything above it is fulfilled through **Beauty**, it is called the **Kingdom of the Heavens** <note>original: *Malchut Shamayim*</note>, named for the "oil poured out upon its maidens." It is also called the **Kingdom of the House of David**, named for the four and twenty-eight "times" <note>Ecclesiastes 3:1-8 lists 28 "times," often mapped to the moon's cycle</note>, which corresponds to the number of the kings of the House of David. **Melchizedek** <note>literally "King of Righteousness"</note>: refers to **Kingdom**, as stated in the *Zohar*. **Before the Lord** <note>Hebrew: *Milifnei Hashem*</note>: "I shall prepare my soul," which is "inner" to **Beauty**, as seen in the Torah portion *Terumah*. **A Kingdom of Priests**: refers to **Kingdom** and **Beauty** when the higher levels are unified within it through the power of **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> which flows through the Priests, as mentioned in section 56. **Rest** <note>Hebrew: *Menuchah*</note>: according to Rabbi Moshe <note>Moses Cordovero</note>, this refers to **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> because it is the end of the "descent of the lodgers" <note>the flow of divine energy</note> that comes down to **Foundation** and **Kingdom**. However, it is also called **Rest** in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, for there all things "rest" in the secret of the Jubilee year <note>the 50th year when slaves were freed and land rested</note>.

**Candelabra** <note>Hebrew: *Menorah*</note>: refers to **Kingdom**, which receives from the ten lamps upon it <note>representing the Sefirot</note> as explained in the *Tikunim*. Sometimes it refers to the angel **Metatron** <note>the supreme archangel and "Prince of the World"</note> because he is appointed over the leadership of time. This flow is sometimes attributed to **Foundation** alone, or to **Beauty**. **Offering** <note>Hebrew: *Minchah*</note>: refers to **Kingdom** when she is situated between the "two arms" <note>Kindness and Severity</note> as explained in the collected teachings. **Number** <note>Hebrew: *Mispar*</note>: refers to **Kingdom**, for within her the supreme powers are revealed, counted, and made manifest. **Dwelling Place** <note>Hebrew: *Ma'onah*</note>: refers to **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> and **Kindness**. That is, when **Kindness** receives and spreads out, it is called "the dwelling place of the God of old," and **Kindness** is poured out upon the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah: the feminine aspect of God dwelling on Earth</term>. **Spring** <note>Hebrew: *Ma'ayan*</note>: refers to **Understanding**, which is the "spring of gardens." It is also called this because of **Wisdom** and **Crown** <term>Keter</term> which are the "source of water." In the aspect of the "Fifty Gates of Mercy," they are the "blessings of the spring." Specifically, **Crown** is the point where the water emerges, **Wisdom** is the pipe that collects the water, and **Understanding** is the flow of the water. Likewise, **Kingdom** is called a **Spring**: **Beauty** is the source of the water, **Foundation** is the pipe that gathers it, and **Kingdom** is the spring into which the waters enter. **Springs of Salvation**: refers to **Understanding** and **Wisdom**. "Salvation" specifically refers to **Foundation**—meaning they flow into **Kindness**, and also into **Victory** <term>Netzach</term> and **Splendor** <term>Hod</term> when they receive from **Kindness**. **Above the Heavens**: refers to **Understanding**, which is "above" **Kindness** and **Severity**, which are themselves above "Heaven" (**Beauty**), as explained in the portion *Vayikra*. **Depths**: refers to **Wisdom**, and according to Rabbi Moshe, to both **Wisdom** and **Understanding**.

**West** <note>Hebrew: *Ma'arav*</note>: refers to **Kingdom**, where the "Sun" (**Beauty**) "sets" <note>a pun on the word *Ma'arav* (West) and *Erev* (Evening/Mixing)</note>. Because of this, there is a "mixture" <note>Hebrew: *Erev*</note> of husks <note>Klipot: forces of impurity</note> within it, for they are mixed together at all times. **Array** <note>Hebrew: *Ma'arakhah*</note>: refers to **Understanding**, which is the "array of all existences." **Kingdom** is also called this, as she manages and "arrays" the fruits that are sent out, as is **Beauty**, as explained in the collected teachings. **Action** <note>Hebrew: *Ma'aseh*</note>: refers to **Understanding**, for within her the thoughts are revealed through her power. Indeed, "action" is the revelation of thought. **The Work of the Chariot** <note>Hebrew: *Ma'aseh Merkavah*</note>: refers to **Metatron**. The word "Chariot" <note>Hebrew: *Rechev*</note> implies that which acts as a vehicle for **Kingdom**. The "Work of the Chariot" also refers to the spiritual Worlds of Action, or when the Ten Sefirot act as a chariot for **Wisdom**, which is called "In the beginning" <note>Genesis 1:1</note>. **Tithe** <note>Hebrew: *Ma'aser*</note>: refers to **Kingdom**, as she is the tithe and the "tenth" of the existences. **A Tithe of the Tithe**: refers to **Kingdom** when unified with **Kindness** and **Severity** in the secret of the Priest and the Levite. The "Tithe" refers to the masculine Levite (the secret of **Severity**), and "from the Tithe" refers to the Priest (the thread of **Kindness**), as known from the *Tikunim* on the portion *Lech Lecha*. **The Keys of Enoch**: in **Kingdom**, in the secret of the Name of 8 to 4 <note>referring to divine name permutations</note>, as explained by Rabbi Mordechai Dato <note>the author of this abridgment</note>. In **Wisdom** and **Knowledge**, for there is the entrance to the hidden parts of the Sefirot. **Monument** <note>Hebrew: *Matzevah*</note>: refers to **Kingdom** when it unifies with **Beauty**. **Commandment** <note>Hebrew: *Mitzvah*</note>: also refers to **Kingdom** when she is in a state of protection without the "mixture of leaven" <note>referring to Passover matzah</note>, before she enters the union with the higher levels. In that state, she is a pillar and **Kindness**. From this comes "Wealth" <note>Osher</note> as opposed to the **Candelabra**, in the secret of "from the soul" and the meditation of Isaac. Therefore, one does not fulfill the obligation through it <note>matzah</note> unless the essence of the commandment is directed toward...

<column-break/>

**Kindness**, for the measure of wealth indicates the completion of her sustenance, as explained in the portions *Vayechi* and *Tikunim*. **Commandment** <note>Hebrew: *Mitzvah*</note>: refers to **Kingdom** when you are unified with her husband <note>Beauty</note>. This occurs when the letters *Vav* and *He* are added to her. Furthermore, in the word *Mitzvah*, the "Name of 30" is revealed, for the letters *Mem-Tzadi* [numerical value 130] are replaced [by Atbash cipher] with *Yod-He* [numerical value 15, doubled] <note>This is a complex gematria relating the word Mitzvah to the Tetragrammaton YHVH</note>. Furthermore, there is "Rest" in **Beauty** and **Foundation**, for they are the foundation of the Commandment, which is **Kingdom**, as explained in the *Tikunim*. **The Depths of the Sea**: a hint to the totality of the "Husks" <term>Klipot: the shells or forces of evil</term> that exist "under the sea," which is **Kingdom**. **Ritual Bath/Hope** <note>Hebrew: *Mikveh*</note>: refers to **Beauty**, as it is written: "The Hope of Israel is the Lord." It also refers to **Foundation** and **Kingdom**, for in her are gathered all the waters of the flow from **Beauty**, as explained in the collected teachings. **Place** <note>Hebrew: *Makom*</note>: refers to **Beauty**, because it is the "clearing place" of the Six Directions <note>the six Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</note> which are called "The World." Also, the numerical value of "Place" <note>186</note> is found in the "Squared Name" in **Metatron**: how? 10 times 10 is 100; 5 times 5 is 25; 6 times 6 is 36; 5 times 5 is 25. The total is 186, the value of **Place**. According to Rabbi Moshe, this is the appointment over the World of the **Crown**, which is the "Place of the place of the world." **Source** <note>Hebrew: *Makor*</note>: refers to **Crown**, **Wisdom**, and **Understanding**, as previously explained. It also refers to **Kingdom** as she nurses from the mountain; the "Source" sustains that which flows below and is called the "Source of Living Waters," as explained in the *Tikunim*. **The Staff of Almond/White**: refers to **Beauty**, for the "Staff" is shaped like the letter *Vav*. It is "White" <note>Lavan</note> because it draws from **Foundation** and **Kindness**, which is a white line. From there comes the name "Lebanon" <note>Lavan/White</note>... **Raging Staffs**: refer to **Judgment** <term>Din</term>, which are staffs of punishment for future generations. **King's Acquisition**: refers to **Kingdom**, for there is profit without end, as in the portion *Lech Lecha*. **Holy Convocations**: refer to **Victory**, **Splendor**, and **Foundation** <note>Netzach, Hod, Yesod</note> when they nurse from **Wisdom**, which is called "Holy." **Mirror/Vision** <note>Hebrew: *Mareh*</note>: refers to **Understanding** and **Kingdom**. Just as a mirror shows all things, so **Understanding** shows the "spark" of all the hidden Sefirot within her, and **Kingdom** reflects all the Sefirot. **The Vision of the Legions**: refers to **Victory** and **Splendor** when they flow into **Foundation**, which is called "Lord of Legions" <note>Hashem Tzva'ot</note>. **Gall/Bitterness** <note>Hebrew: *Marah*</note>: refers to the "Husk" and the "Blessing of the Angel of Death." **Chariot** <note>Hebrew: *Merkavah*</note>: according to Rabbi Moshe, the "Upper Chariot" is **Victory, Splendor, and Foundation**, while the "Lower Chariot" is **Crown, Wisdom, and Understanding**. However, according to the *Tikunim*, the Upper Chariot is **Kindness, Severity, and Beauty**, and the Lower Chariot is **Victory, Splendor, Foundation, and Kingdom**. Also, **Kingdom** becomes an "Upper Chariot" when she is filled, and a "Lower Chariot" when she is the vehicle for the other Sefirot. Furthermore, the *Tikunim* state that **Kingdom** is the Chariot when she clothes herself in the celestial "Living Creatures" <note>Chayot</note>. **Moses**: is the Chariot for **Beauty** in the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>. **Settings of Gold**: refer to **Victory** and **Foundation**, for there the power of **Severity** <note>associated with gold</note> is born. **The Joy of the Whole Earth**: refers to **Beauty**, which is joy for all; to **Foundation**; and to the "Horn" which is **Kingdom**. **Pledge** <note>Hebrew: *Mashkon*</note>: refers to **Kingdom**, who is the "pledge" for Israel, for through the Torah (**Beauty**), God is among them. **Maskil** <note>one who contemplates/enlightens</note>: a name used between **Wisdom** and **Understanding**. It is **Foundation** which enlightens the secret that is **Kingdom**. Regarding the "darkening" of the flow of **Understanding** into **Wisdom**... **Understanding** is called this when it ascends through the "Bird of Wisdom" and dips into the light... which is Abraham through the power of **Wisdom**, which is called "Intellect" <note>Sekhel</note>. **The Repayer of Recompense**: refers to **Severity**, according to the attribute of punishment within it, which knows how to repay each person according to their deeds. **Tabernacle** <note>Hebrew: *Mishkan*</note>: refers to **Understanding** and **Kingdom**. **Understanding** is the "Upper Tabernacle" and **Kingdom** is the "Lower Tabernacle." Of them it is said: "A dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob." Also, **Kingdom** is called the "Tabernacle of Testimony," for within her the "Testimony" is established—that is, **Foundation** and **Beauty**. **Mishnah/Second**: refers to **Kingdom**, for she is "second" to the King (**Beauty**). He is the letter *Vav* and she is the second... a portion for the Levite. **Lintel**: refers to **Foundation**, as the "gateway" for that which ascends...

<summary>This page concludes the Kabbalistic dictionary for the letter Mem, defining terms like "Place," "Source," and "Tabernacle" as metaphors for the Sefirot, notably using gematria to explain why the word "Place" (Makom) represents the Divine Name.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the alphabetical index of the letter Ayin (ע), defining the symbolic "Appellations" or nicknames used in Kabbalistic literature to describe the ten Sefirot (Divine Emanations).</meta>

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 27: The Meanings of the Appellations

Because sometimes a doubt <note>Hebrew: *Sefika*</note> is resolved from all the worlds, and this world is poured out upon the cessation—a window, like the "window" that is before us. **World** <note>Hebrew: *Olam*</note>: The "World of Sustenance" <note>Hebrew: *Olam ha-Kiyum*</note> refers to **Understanding** <term>Binah: the third emanation, the Divine Mother</term> when it receives from **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah: the second emanation, the primordial flash of intuition</term> which is called "Sustenance." Some call **Wisdom** the **Hidden World** <note>Hebrew: *Olam ha-Ne'elam*</note> because within it, the essences of the "edges" <note>the six emotional attributes</term> are extremely subtle and hidden. **Depth** <note>Hebrew: *Omek*</note>: In general, all the Sefirot are called "Depths," for even though they are called "Wisdom," they intend toward a great gathering... they are deep and sealed. **Sheaf** <note>Hebrew: *Omer*</note>: Refers to **Understanding**, from the language of a "sheaf" <note>a measure of grain</note> that stands and binds the fifty [gates of] mercies, as explained in the *Tikunim* <note>Tikunei Zohar: a classic Kabbalistic text</note>. **Bird** <note>Hebrew: *Of*</note>: Refers to **Foundation** <term>Yesod: the ninth emanation, the channel of procreation and flow</term> which hovers and moves toward **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>; similarly, it refers to **Metatron** <note>the supreme archangel in Jewish mysticism</note> who hovers and moves within **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, as explained in the *Tikunim*. **Fawn** <note>Hebrew: *Ofer*</note>: Refers to **Beauty** when it is refined from the higher vessels of **Lovingkindness** <term>Chesed</term> and **Might** <term>Gevurah</term> and mentions the power of Judgment. **Maker of the Bride** <note>Hebrew: *Oseh Chalah*</note>: Refers to **Beauty** from the side of **Crown** <term>Keter: the highest, most transcendent emanation</term>, which is called "Bride." **Strength** <note>Hebrew: *Oz*</note>: Refers to **Might** from the side of Judgment. **Diadem** <note>Hebrew: *Atarah*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** when she ascends to the **Crown** via the "House of Feasts," and **Kingdom** is the "Diadem upon the exalted head." **Eye** <note>Hebrew: *Ayin*</note>: Collectively, this refers to the qualities of some Sefirot that are in **Kingdom**. For instance: the "depths of the eyes" where all are open and included... and in the eye itself, like the three colors of the eye: white, green, [and red]. The "Pupil" <note>Hebrew: *Bat Ayin*</note> is **Kingdom**, as explained in the *Ra'aya Meheimna*. There is also an "Eye that has no eyelids," which is the "Open Eye" <note>Hebrew: *Eina Pekicha*</note> found in the **Crown**, as explained in the *Tikunim*.

**Gloom** <note>Hebrew: *Iftah*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** from the side of **Might**. **City** <note>Hebrew: *Ir*</note>: Refers to **Understanding** and **Kingdom**, for **Understanding** is the "Upper City"—the Jerusalem above—and **Kingdom** is the "City of David"—the Jerusalem below. **Mixture/Boundary** <note>Hebrew: *Eruv*</note>: Refers to **Beauty**, which mixes between the "two houses" <note>the upper and lower realms</note>, and through which one carries from house to house; these houses are **Understanding** and **Kingdom**. **Upon** <note>Hebrew: *Al*</note>: The letter *Koph* <note>the Hebrew letter ק</note> refers to the three mercies that are "upon" **Beauty**, which is the letter *Yod* <note>י</note>. **Upon the Heavens**: Refers to **Lovingkindness** and **Might**, which are "upon" **Beauty**, which is called "Heaven." **Cause of Causes** <note>Hebrew: *Alat ha-Alot*</note>: Refers to the **Crown**, and the "Cause of all Causes" refers to the **Infinite** <term>Ein Sof: God as He is in Himself, beyond all description</term>. **Upon all Waters**: Refers to **Understanding**, which is above the entire structure [of the Sefirot]. **Pillar of Fire**: Refers to **Kingdom** from the side of **Might** in the secret of the Night. **Pillar of Cloud**: Refers to **Kingdom** from the side of **Lovingkindness** in the secret of the Day. **Pure Wool** <note>Hebrew: *Amer Naki*</note>: Refers to **Lovingkindness**, specifically when the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note> belongs to it. **Grapes** <note>Hebrew: *Anavim*</note>: These are the "edges" <note>the lower attributes</note>. They are white when they represent **Lovingkindness** and mercies from the side of **Might**, and black from the side of the intensity of Judgment. Plain "grapes" refers to **Kingdom**. **Delight** <note>Hebrew: *Oneg*</note>: A collective term for **Understanding**, **Beauty**, and **Kingdom**... it implies the delight of the Garden, which is **Kingdom**. This is suggested in the *Tikunim*. **Playfulness** <note>Hebrew: *Sha'ashuim*</note> refers to the collective of **Beauty** and **Kingdom** within **Understanding**. **Humility** <note>Hebrew: *Anavah*</note>: Refers to **Beauty** in the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>. **Poor** <note>Hebrew: *Ani*</note>: Refers to **Foundation** and **Kingdom**, because she has nothing of her own <note>the moon/Kingdom has no light of its own, only what it reflects</note>, and her actions are such that she receives her flow from **Beauty**. **Cloud** <note>Hebrew: *Anan*</note>: Refers to **Lovingkindness** as it is included in **Kingdom**. **Branch of a Thick Tree** <note>Hebrew: *Anaf Etz Avot*</note>: These are the three "Patriarchs" <note>the qualities of Kindness, Might, and Beauty</note> included in **Beauty**... indicating unity. **Dust/Earth** <note>Hebrew: *Afar*</note>: Refers to **Understanding**, but its essence is in **Kingdom**, specifically from the side of the forces of Judgment within **Kingdom** in her lower aspect. **Tree of Life** <note>Hebrew: *Etz ha-Chayim*</note>: Refers to **Beauty**, which is the tree that gives birth generally and draws life from **Wisdom**. **Tree of Knowledge** <note>Hebrew: *Etz ha-Da'at*</note>: Refers to **Foundation**, which is the tree of perceptions... in which the colors of the Sefirot appear. **Fruit Tree**: Refers to **Kingdom**, which is the tree where the "fruits of the souls" are nurtured.

<column-break/>

**Knowledge of Good and Evil**: This refers to the mundane realm within **Kingdom**... but **Kingdom** is the tree that unifies with the Higher Knowledge, while beneath it is "Good and Evil"—"Good" being Metatron and "Evil" being Samael <note>the primary demonic figure in Kabbalah</note>. There is a "Good Tree" and a "Tree of the Serpent." The "Good Tree" is **Beauty**, which is planted forever in permanence. **Sorrow** <note>Hebrew: *Etzev*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** from the side of the spreading of the "husks" <term>Kelipot: the shells of evil or impurity</term>. **Counsel** <note>Hebrew: *Etzah*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom**, for the "Council" <note>the other Sefirot</note> take counsel with **Kingdom** and bestow flow into her. **Acacia Wood** <note>Hebrew: *Atzei Shittim*</note>: According to Rabbi Moshe <note>Cordovero</note>, this refers to the two "columns" that stand and sustain the building. **Essence/Bone** <note>Hebrew: *Etzem*</note>: White bone hints at Mercy and **Lovingkindness**. Plain "flesh" hints at Judgment, but in [divine] mercy, it hints at Compassion. **Ascent of the Heavens**: Refers to **Kingdom** when she receives from **Beauty** (which is called "Heaven"). Similarly, the second palace of the Divine Presence is called the **Ascent of the Heavens**.

**Assembly/Stoppage** <note>Hebrew: *Atzeret*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** when the flow stops because the sins of humanity make them unworthy of that flow. **Heel** <note>Hebrew: *Ekev*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom**; just as the heel is the end of the body, so the Divine Presence is the end of the levels of Emanation. **Binding** <note>Hebrew: *Akidah*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** from the side of **Might**, in the secret of the "Binding of Judgment." **Root** <note>Hebrew: *Ikar*</note>: Refers to **Foundation**, which is the essence, secret, and root of the world. **Barren Woman** <note>Hebrew: *Akarat*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom**, for Rachel was a "barren woman" <note>Hebrew: *Akarat ha-Bayit*</note> until the Lord remembered her from the heavens. **Evening** <note>Hebrew: *Erev*</note>: Refers to the internal forces of Judgment. **Plains/Willows** <note>Hebrew: *Aravot*</note>: Refers to **Beauty** and **Foundation**. Just as **Beauty** is called *Aravot* because within it the forces of Kindness and Might are "mixed" <note>Hebrew: *mit'arvim*</note>, so too in **Foundation** these forces are mixed. **Willows of the Brook** <note>Hebrew: *Arvei Nachal*</note>: This refers to the side of **Might** as it manifests through **Beauty**. **Evening Prayer** <note>Hebrew: *Aravit*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom**. **Garden Bed** <note>Hebrew: *Aruga*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom**, which is a garden, and the "Bed of Spices" in which the orders of the Torah are planted. **Thick Darkness** <note>Hebrew: *Arafel*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom** when she is refined from the side of **Might** through **Beauty**. **Bed/Cradle** <note>Hebrew: *Eres*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom**... she is included of ten <note>Hebrew: *Eser*</note>. **Herb/Grass** <note>Hebrew: *Esev*</note>: Refers to **Beauty**. **Fruit-bearing** <note>Hebrew: *Oseh Peri*</note>: Refers to **Beauty**, which bears the "fruit of the souls" for **Kingdom**, though the primary "making" is in the **Crown**. **Smoke of the Altar-Pile** <note>Hebrew: *Ashan*</note>: Refers to **Beauty** which ascends upward through **Understanding** to **Wisdom**; through it, **Wisdom** and **Understanding** are unified, and flow and blessing descend to the world. **Smoke** also refers to the secret of the intensity of Judgment from the side of **Might**. **Rich** <note>Hebrew: *Ashir*</note>: Refers to **Beauty**... being refined by **Understanding**. **Ten/Tenth/Tithe** <note>Hebrew: *Eser/Asor/Esron*</note>: All refer to **Kingdom** when she is collectively comprised of all ten Sefirot. **Time** <note>Hebrew: *Et*</note>: Refers to **Kingdom**... there are twenty-eight "times"—fourteen for good and fourteen for evil. Thus it is said: "Let him not come at all times" <note>Leviticus 16:2</note>. **Ancient One** <note>Hebrew: *Atika*</note>: Refers to the **Infinite**, the **Crown**, or sometimes **Understanding**, all depending on the context. **Entreaty** <note>Hebrew: *Atar*</note>: Refers to when prayer reaches the **Supreme Crown**... from the language of "digging/boring through" <note>Hebrew: *Chatirah*</note>.

# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations
<note>Hebrew title: Asis Rimmonim, Sha'ar 23: Erchei ha-Kinnuyim. This is a condensed version of Rabbi Moshe Cordovero’s Pardes Rimmonim.</note>

**Sciatic Nerve** <note>Hebrew: *Nasheh*</note> and so on. Therefore, it appears to be **Understanding** <term>Binah: the third emanation, associated with the Divine Mother</term>, as our Sages of blessed memory said on the verse "And the Lord God built" <note>Genesis 2:22; the word 'built' (*vayiven*) shares a root with *Binah*</note>. In the Zohar, this refers to Understanding, which is situated above **Strength** <term>Gevurah: the fifth emanation, representing judgment and restraint</term>. **Kiss** <note>Hebrew: *Neshikah*</note>: The cleaving of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet: the sixth emanation, the central balance</term> and **Kingdom** <term>Malchut: the tenth emanation, the feminine presence of God</term>, spirit to spirit in the secret of union. **Extra Soul** <note>Hebrew: *Neshamah Yeterah*</note>: Rooted in **Understanding**, for generally, "Soul" <note>Neshamah</note> is in Understanding. However, in the "Faithful Shepherd" <note>Ra'aya Mehemna, a later layer of the Zohar</note>, it is heard as part of **Crown** <term>Keter: the highest, most transcendent emanation</term>. From Understanding to Crown, it is "Understanding" in partnership with the external aspect, while "Crown" is the aspect of the Foundation of the Crown in the "extra" staff below. **Eagle** <note>Hebrew: *Nesher*</note>: A voice in **Kingdom**, whose aspect is above all of **Beauty**—that is, the "Voice of the Cedars." You also find it referring to **Crown** with a change, for even though it is below on the earth, its place is in the heavens among the plantings of the "Nut Garden." In the Zohar, there is an aspect of this Sefirah that is in **Understanding**, namely "the great eagle with large wings," of which it is said, "As an eagle stirs up its nest." In the "wings of its mouth" are the secrets of the various Sefirot. **Paths** <note>Hebrew: *Netivot*</note>: These are in **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah: the second emanation, the flash of intuition</term>, corresponding to the thirty-two paths of Wisdom. The paths are hidden in Wisdom, and by them, our way is clarified through the "Eagle of the Paths."

->Chapter 15: Grandfather<-
<note>Hebrew: Saba. This refers to the "Ancient" or "Old" aspect of the Divine manifestations.</note>

**Grandfather** <note>Hebrew: *Saba*</note>: Attached to **Wisdom**, namely the Primordial World in **Crown**, which is the "Great Old Man." Similarly, **Grandmother of Grandmothers** is in **Understanding**, referring to the concealment of Understanding within the Crown and Understanding. She is in the "pipe" <note>kaneh</note> relative to Wisdom, which is the Male, as mentioned in the section on Noah. **Cause of Causes** <note>Hebrew: *Sibat ha-Sibot*</note> is in **Crown**, and the **Cause of all Causes** is in the **Infinite** <term>Ein Sof: the Godhead prior to any emanation</term>. **Treasure** <note>Hebrew: *Segulah*</note>: **Kingdom**, in the secret of her nourishment from the "Segol" vowel point, which represents the three Patriarchs. She is the treasure of **Beauty**, and all good flow is added to her, as mentioned in the section on Terumah. **Order of Times**: **Beauty** and **Kingdom**, which are "Primordial" in their lineage, the measure of day and the measure of night. **Secret of the Sukkah**: In **Understanding** and **Kingdom**, in the secret of the binding of **Beauty** and **Kingdom**. The word *Sukkah* <note>numerical value 91</note> is a shorthand for the union of the names of God <note>YHWH (26) + ADNY (65) = 91</note>. It is the secret of attachment and joining, entering the bridal canopy <note>Chuppah</note> and being hidden in **Understanding**, in the secret of the "six ends of the worlds." When it is "raised up," it is heard in **Understanding**, in the aspect of the "Seah-measure" that surrounds the "Horse" <note>Sus</note>, which is **Beauty**. **End of all Speech** <note>Hebrew: *Sof kol lashon*</note>: The "End" and "Limit" are in **Foundation** <term>Yesod: the ninth emanation, the channel of flow</term>, for though **Kingdom** is the end of the Emanation, the law of "End" belongs to Foundation, for from him the garment descends below to the very end of the Emanation. **Merchandise** <note>Hebrew: *Sacharat*</note>: In **Wisdom**, according to its intention in **Understanding**, for through her all creatures of the world come, and from her the "merchandise" goes out. It also implies a "circuit" <note>Sivuv</note> that surrounds the whole market within Understanding. **Moon** <note>Aramaic: *Sihara*</note>: In **Kingdom**, by power of **Beauty** which receives and descends like the moon. **Assistance** <note>Aramaic: *Siyata*</note>: In **Wisdom**. **Adhesion/Blemish** <note>Hebrew: *Sirkha*</note>: In the **Shells** <term>Kelipah: the forces of imbalance or "evil"</term> that mimic the holy Tablets, attempting to draw strength and nourishment to rise toward **Beauty** by destroying the goodness of Israel. **Basket** <note>Hebrew: *Sal*</note>: According to the commentators, this is **Kingdom**, which is the receptacle for all of the Emanation. **Selah**: According to the Faithful Shepherd, it is in **Kingdom**, but according to the Zohar, it is a voice in **Understanding** when she is unified with **Wisdom**, as explained in the section on Vayakhel. **Forgiveness** <note>Hebrew: *Selichah*</note>: According to Rabbi Moshe <note>Cordovero</note>, it is in **Beauty**, in the secret of the mercies within it. Some say it is in **Crown** during the time of Yom Kippur. **Ladder** <note>Hebrew: *Sulam*</note>: In the secret of **Beauty**, and its width extends from the lower extremities until **Understanding**, and its base is in the world of **Kingdom**, as mentioned in the section on Vayigash. **Rock** <note>Hebrew: *Sela*</note>: In **Kingdom**, in the aspect where she is the "Bride of the Lord." There is also a "Rock" in **Understanding**, and it is the strength that stops the Kingdom. **Fine Flour** <note>Hebrew: *Solet*</note>: In **Kingdom**, for she is pure, bright, and refined to ascend upward to be bound between the "Arms" <note>Chesed and Gevurah</note>, kneaded for good through the **Righteous One** <term>Tzaddik: a title for Yesod</term>. **Sandal**: In **Metatron** <note>the prince of the world and supreme angel</note>, acting as a "sandal" for **Beauty**

<column-break/>

when looking at him as he ascends the levels, for he is Metatron. Heaven forbid one should call him the actual **Foundation**, for he is only "opposite" it. **Great Sanhedrin**: In **Understanding**, and revealed in **Beauty**, for the Sanhedrin consists of seventy branches in Beauty, which are the seven Sefirot <note>the lower seven</note> each comprised of ten, making seventy. This is the secret of the "Voice" above them, and the collective is seventy like the Sanhedrin. The **Small Sanhedrin** is in **Kingdom**. **Horse** <note>Hebrew: *Sus*</note>: In **Kingdom**, like a "Crown" relative to its level. **Great Feast**: In **Understanding**; the **Small Feast** is in **Kingdom**. **Storm** <note>Hebrew: *Sa'arah*</note>: In the force of Inner Judgment, or a "gracious" force of Inner Judgment. Some say the force of judgment is in the "Gracious One." **Counting of the Omer**: In **Kingdom**, wherein the "Brains" <note>Moachin/Intellectual flow</note> of seven days—which are seven weeks, totaling forty-nine days—are drawn.

->Book, Scribe, Story<-
<note>Hebrew: Sefer, Sopher, Sippur. The three terms from Sefer Yetzirah used to describe creation.</note>

Wherein **Understanding** receives the "appeasement" from **Wisdom** and supplies it to **Foundation**, and there they come into being in the aspect of the **Crown** opposite it in three ways through giving: this is "Book, Scribe, and Story." Some say the **Torah Scroll** is **Beauty**, including the Written and Oral Law. Rabbi Akiva considered it a commandment to learn from the Creator. It is written below that "The Book of the Kingdom" <note>Sefer ha-Malchut</note> is where all the powers of **Strength** <note>Gevurah</note> begin.

->Chapter 16: Ayin-Bet (72)<-
<note>Referring to the mystical Name of God consisting of 72 names.</note>

In the secret of the word "Therefore" <note>Lakhen</note> which has the numerical value of **72**. Wisdom is the power of "The seventy-two engraved in it," and the windows are the secret of seventy-two. **Servant** <note>Hebrew: *Eved*</note>: In **Kingdom**, for the "Generation of the Earth" is called a servant, as explained in the section on Kedoshim. According to the *Tikunim*, any language of "servitude" refers to **Metatron**. **Service of the Levites**: In **Understanding**, in the secret of the "Bull of the Levites." **Kingdom** is also called the "Service of the Levites" because she bestows grace. **Circle** <note>Hebrew: *Agulah*</note>: In **Understanding**, which is the "Daughter of 28" <note>Koach/Power</note> of Insight, and she is included in the aspect of the "Grasp" in Understanding. **Witness/Until** <note>Hebrew: *Ad*</note>: In **Kingdom**, for she is the end of the Emanation, and upon her is the "Hallelujah." Also in **Foundation**, for two reasons: the thirty gates of Understanding are the "Hallelujahs" before Foundation, and the fifty gates of Understanding are the Male World, for from Foundation and above is the "Male World," and below is the "Female World," as explained in the section on Hamor. **Congregation** <note>Hebrew: *Edah*</note>: In **Kingdom**, for there is the "Meeting House" <note>Beit Va'ad</note>. **Testimony of our Father**: This is the "Union" <note>Zivug</note> that occurs through **Beauty** and **Foundation**. Beauty unifies and joins **Wisdom** and **Understanding** in the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at: the quasi-Sefirah of integration</term>, and Foundation unifies and joins **Beauty** and **Kingdom**. **Eden**: In **Crown** essentially, for "No eye has seen it." It is also in **Understanding**, for Understanding is the beginning of the "Gardens." It is attributed to the Crown, and in Understanding relative to the "Six Ends," they take pleasure <note>tit'aden</note> in the Crown. So too, the Sefirot "take charge" and suck from above, and they are called "Eden," for they take pleasure from the power of the Upper Dwelling. **Pleasure** <note>Hebrew: *Ednah*</note>: In **Kingdom** when she receives from the aspect of the "Upper Pleasure" <note>Eden</note>. **Passing Over Transgression**: According to Rabbi Moshe, this is in **Beauty**, which "passes over transgression" by the power of the Mercies within it. Some say "Passing over the Appointed" is in **Foundation**, in the secret of "Covering over transgression." This is the "Book of Mercies" in the Crown. **Ascent/Burnt Offering** <note>Hebrew: *Olah*</note>: In **Kingdom** when she ascends level after level with **Beauty** to **Understanding**, which is the "House of her Mother." **World** <note>Hebrew: *Olam*</note>: In general, any of the ten Sefirot can be called a "World." **Kingdom** is called the "Lower World," and **Foundation** is called the "Lower World" because it is the "Foundation of the World." It is also called the "Middle World" because it is between **Beauty** and **Kingdom**. **Beauty** is called the "Male World," for it is the "Master of the World's Wisdom."
