# Juice of Pomegranates | Gate 23: The Meanings of the Appellations | 77
->31<-
<meta>catchword: Chapter</meta>

**Metatron** <note>The highest archangel in Kabbalistic tradition, often serving as the heavenly mediator</note>: He is found in **Kingdom** <term>Malchut: the tenth and final emanation, representing the physical world and the feminine Presence of God</term>, and within him, he is called **Atonement** <note>Hebrew: *Kippur*</note> and **Fortune** <note>Hebrew: *Mazzal*</note>. **Bundle of Life** <note>Hebrew: *Tzeror ha-Chayyim*; see 1 Samuel 25:29</note>: This refers to **Understanding** <term>Binah: the third emanation, the Divine Mother</term>, **Beauty** <term>Tiferet: the sixth emanation, the central trunk of the Sefirotic tree</term>, and **Kingdom**. The explanation is that a "bundle" is never less than three components. Thus, it is in Kingdom by way of the influence of Beauty which it receives from Understanding. In the Torah portion *Vayikra* <note>Leviticus</note>, it is called "The one who hears the voice" in Kingdom, from the perspective of what she receives from the three Patriarchs <note>Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, representing Mercy, Strength, and Beauty</note> through Beauty. Furthermore, Beauty is called the **Bundle of Light**, meaning a bundle in which the abundance of the spark is gathered from the three [higher attributes] of **Mercy** <term>Chesed: the fourth emanation</term>, and therefore it is called "leaning toward Mercy." **Tower** <note>Hebrew: *Tzerichah*</note>: In Kingdom, when she receives from the side of Beauty and the side of **Strength** <term>Gevurah: the fifth emanation, representing judgment</term> within it, and lacks the "Pool of Mercy" <note>Hebrew: *Berechah*, a play on 'blessing' (*Berachah*)</note>, for Beauty does not bestow any blessing upon her when she draws from the side of Judgment. But when she receives from Beauty itself, her "tower" is required <note>or "she is called *Tzerichah*"</note> because she receives from the side of Mercy.

### Chapter 19: Reception in Kingdom from the perspective of Foundation
Meaning that through the hand of **Foundation** <term>Yesod: the ninth emanation, the channel of procreation and connection</term>, she [Kingdom] couples with Understanding and Beauty, and she receives the Names from above. **Holy** <note>Hebrew: *Kadosh*</note>: This is **Crown** <term>Keter: the highest, most transcendent emanation</term> when spelled *K-D-SH* without the letter *Vav*. When Beauty rises into the "Glory of Knowledge" <term>Da'at: the quasi-emanation of bridge-building intellect</term>, it is spelled *K-D-V-SH* with a *Vav*. There is also "Holy" in Beauty when holiness is drawn down to it from the Crown. Likewise, "Holy" is in Foundation when it receives from the "Choice Holy Oil." This occurs through Beauty. When the holiness enters from Beauty into Foundation and Kingdom, it is called **Holiness** <note>Hebrew: *Kedushah*</note>, meaning the "Holiness of God." **Primordial** <note>Hebrew: *Kedem*</note>: In the Crown, for it is prior to all the Sefirot. **Accuser** <note>Hebrew: *Katnur*</note>: This implies it is in Kingdom and Understanding; meaning that it "preceded" <note>Hebrew: *Katmah*</note> the voice and movement toward revelation, and Understanding is the "preceding" and movement above; thus it is also called "Day." **Sanctity** <note>Hebrew: *Kodesh*</note>: In Understanding. From there and above, it is called the **Holy of Holies**, meaning the Crown is "Holy" and Understanding is "of Holies." **Line** <note>Hebrew: *Kav*</note>: Below [the letters] *Yod* and *Tav*, it is called a "Line" because it ascends upward, pierces through, and descends to the very bottom—the secret of simplicity. It is called **Measuring Line** in the secret of the inner spirituality that gives measure to all existences. It is called the **Green Line** that surrounds the world, which consists of the fifty gates in the secret of Knowledge, spreading within the "doubt," and its color is green. Some Sefirot consider Understanding to be the Green Line, though it is implied elsewhere in the Zohar that the "pierced shell" <note>external forces of evil</note> is also called the Green Line. **Voice** <note>Hebrew: *Kol*</note>: There is a "Voice of Dreams" from the side of Beauty. There is an "Inner Voice" that is not heard, which is Understanding. In the secret of the "Evil One"—that is, Beauty—there is an "Internal Voice," which is in Kingdom when she is hidden from her Master. She is then the "Great Voice" and the "Voice of a Dream." It is called "in the ear" to hint at Beauty, which includes seven voices. Furthermore, Beauty is called the **Voice of the Shofar** <note>Ram's horn</note>, like the sound of a blast that rises to thought and ascends through Understanding, which is the Shofar. There are twenty-two [letters] of the "Voice to make a word heard" and the "Voice that does not make a word known," which refers to the aspect called "Day." When it acts within the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: another name for Kingdom</term>, it becomes the "Voice that does not make a word known." When she unites with the Sefirot of the "Building" <note>the lower six Sefirot</note>, she is the "Voice that makes a word heard," a voice that becomes revealed. There is also the "Voice of the Fine Judge," meaning the Voice is Beauty uniting with the "Fine Judgment" which is Kingdom. There is also the **Voice of the Turtledove**, which is the voice of Beauty belonging to the "turtledove" of Kingdom. **Seven Voices**: These are the six Sefirot of the Building. **Leniency** <note>Hebrew: *Kulla*</note>: In Kingdom from the side of Mercy. **Stature** <note>Hebrew: *Koma*</note>: In Beauty and the **Righteous One** <note>Yesod</note> when they are received above in Understanding, and it descends to the "small" [level] until the Sefirah of Kingdom in the secret of the "Arranged Stature." **Rising** <note>Hebrew: *Kumin*</note>: In the secret of the letter *Yod*, opening with the twenty-two Sefirot... Understanding... **End** <note>Hebrew: *Ketz*</note>: In Foundation, which is called the "End of Days." Its "End" is specifically in the Heavens, divided as written: "For all that is in the Heavens and the Earth" <note>1 Chronicles 29:11</note>, which the Targum translates as "that which takes hold of the Heavens and the Earth." **Difficulty** <note>Hebrew: *Kushya*</note>: In Kingdom from the side of Judgment. **Knot** <note>Hebrew: *Kesher*</note>: In the "shell" <note>Kelippah</note> and its name... and the voice of the connection... And there is Beauty, the "Knot of Ethics" toward Strength. **Incense** <note>Hebrew: *Ketoret*</note>: In Understanding, a binding. And the secret is in Kingdom when she is bound within it through Beauty, and likewise in Beauty, which is the matter

<column-break/>

toward the "West"... they shall unite and be bound from Wisdom and Understanding as explained above. **Lament** <note>Hebrew: *Kina*</note>: Its root is in the "shells" <note>forces of impurity</note>, but there is a "Good Lament" that causes the "crushing of hearts" for the righteous. **Enduring** <note>Hebrew: *Kayyam*</note>: In Beauty during its ascent to Understanding, which pours "Endurance" upon it. **Pen** <note>Hebrew: *Kulmus*</note>: In Beauty, in the secret of the letter *Yod*. **Sling** <note>Hebrew: *Kela*</note>: There is an "Upper Sling" and a "Lower Sling." The Upper Sling is in the Crown, and the Lower is "the sling of a stone" and so on, which is the destruction of the "shells." For this reason, the young men... "and God shall sling the souls of your enemies" <note>1 Samuel 25:29</note>. There is the "sling" in the fruits of the Sefirot... and the secret is the letter *Qof*. When related to Understanding and this [Kingdom], it is called a "Sling," which is the "beginning of the scale" that ascends with Wisdom. **Nests** <note>Hebrew: *Kanim*</note>: Which are the building of the "Seat of the Mighty," and it is in Metatron, who is a "Nest." Also in Understanding and Kingdom, which is a "Nest" for the six Sefirot... And there is the Nest for the "deficiencies," and it is in the general Building. Metatron is called the "Nest of a Bird" <note>Hebrew: *Kan Tzippor*</note>... for the Kingdom, which is called "Bird." **Reed/Measure** <note>Hebrew: *Kaneh*</note>: The Name of the Mothers <note>the higher three Sefirot</note> and the Name of the Sefirot. There are sixty degrees to the Upper Crown, Understanding... it is the secret of the letter *Qof* bound to Knowledge <note>Da'at</note>, through which Wisdom and Understanding unite. In its striking, it is the Voice that is comprised of fire, wind, and water... There is a "Reed" in the "shell," called "the beast of the reeds." **End of the Right Hand** <note>Hebrew: *Ketz ha-Yamin*</note>: In Foundation and Metatron... And there is the "End of All Flesh" in the "shell," which is the nest and end of all flesh. **Jumping the Road** <note>Hebrew: *Kefitzat ha-Derech*</note>: In Kingdom, for she "jumps" to unite with Beauty, her husband, as explained in the *Tikunim* <note>Tikunei ha-Zohar</note>. **Relatives** <note>Hebrew: *Kerevim*</note>: Creatures... they are the "Holy Creatures" <note>Chayot ha-Kodesh</note> who are "close" to the internal [realms]. Therefore they are called "Relatives." Those outside are "far." **Sacrifice** <note>Hebrew: *Korban*</note>: In Kingdom, where all the Sefirot unite. Furthermore, she couples with Beauty and draws near, and the *Chayot* [Creatures] of the name *Y-H-V-H* are called "Great," therefore it is called a "Sacrifice." **Close** <note>Hebrew: *Karov*</note>: In Foundation, which is a "close neighbor" to Kingdom. **Horn of Power** <note>Hebrew: *Keren ha-Gevurah*</note>: In Kingdom. Its explanation: the "Power" <note>Hebrew: *Koach*</note> of the Horn, which is Beauty... in the "Small Births." In the secret of "He shall clothe me," which is the aspect of the "Spark of Mercy of the Creatures" as explained in the *Tikunim*. **Four Corners** <note>Hebrew: *Karnot Arba*</note>: In Kingdom, which relate to the four sections of the Tefillin <note>phylacteries</note>, which are the four names of *Y-H-V-H*. Furthermore, they unite thirty names of *Y-H-V-H* and thirty of *A-D-N-Y*... Wisdom and Understanding... Beauty and Kingdom, as explained in the *Tikunim*. There is also the "City of the Great King," which is Understanding in Kingdom... receiving the "Blows" called "Great King"... as explained in the portion *Vayakhel*. **Horn** <note>Hebrew: *Keren*</note>: There is a "Horn" [meaning] "And he shall take a horn." This is in Beauty, for Beauty is a "Horn," and the "Aroma" is the Shekhinah. There is a "Horn" [meaning] "the corner of the corners," which is in Kingdom, for she is the "Corner" and "Angle" for the boards of the Tabernacle, as explained in the portion *Lech Lecha*. Likewise in Foundation, and likewise in **Victory** <term>Netzach: the seventh emanation</term> and **Splendor** <term>Hod: the eighth emanation</term>, and they are called "Horns." From the side of Understanding come the "Straps of the Tefillin." **Ankles** <note>Hebrew: *Karsulim*</note>: In the [lower] Sefirot. They are considered "Thighs" relative to Beauty, which is the "Body." They are the Thighs, but relative to Foundation, which is lower... they are called "Ankles." They are unique only in this aspect, which is to protect the Thighs. **Her Ground**: The Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term>. **Ground** <note>Hebrew: *Karka*</note>: In Kingdom, for in her all aspects are "planted." **Knot/Connection** <note>Hebrew: *Kesher*</note>: In Beauty when it is connected to the three Patriarchs in the secret of Blessing. Likewise in Foundation when it is connected to the three "Children," for from above are Patriarchs and below are Children. Likewise in Kingdom, for she is the "Knot of All" in the secret of the letter *Qof*... Also in Understanding, because she is a "Good Knot" that joins Mercy with the seven lower [Sefirot]. **Bow** <note>Hebrew: *Keshet*, i.e., Rainbow</note>: In Foundation, which is the "Covenant of the Bow." Through it, union occurs. The matter of the Bow is like the matter of the Knot.

<meta>This page continues the alphabetical index of symbolic names (appellations) for the Sefirot, moving through the letter Pe (פ) and beginning the letter Tsadi (צ). It maintains the structure of defining how physical or scriptural terms map onto the Divine emanations.</meta>

# Chapter 17: Excellence in Understanding, which is above Beauty, and Strength, Might, and Wisdom; and from there its vitality, etc., is acquired:

**Mouth** <note>Hebrew: *Peh* (פה)</note>: The opening of the mouth—meaning when the tongue opens the lips and the air between the lips—is called "Mouth." This corresponds to **Kingdom** <term>Malchut: the tenth Sefirah</term> from the aspect of **Foundation** <term>Yesod: the ninth Sefirah</term>, which is called by the Divine Name *Y-H-V-H* <note>The Tetragrammaton</note> that numerically equals "Mouth" <note>Both sum to 85 in Gematria</note>. The lips correspond to **Victory** and **Splendor** <term>Netzach and Hod: the seventh and eighth Sefirot</term>, and the tongue is Foundation, which unites the Mouth with the throat. The throat corresponds to **Beauty** <term>Tiferet: the sixth Sefirah</term>, where the windpipe is located, as explained in its entry under the letter *Qof*. Above this, the "Opening of the Mouth" is in **Understanding** <term>Binah: the third Sefirah</term>. The openings are in **Greatness** and **Strength** <term>Chesed and Gevurah</term>, the tongue is Beauty within Understanding (corresponding to **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>), and the throat is in **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah: the second Sefirah</term>. There is also a "Mouth" in the world of Foundation within Kingdom, called *P-H* with the addition of the letter *He*, which is known to indicate Mercy. It is called the "Mouth of Strength" <note>original: *Pi ha-Gevurah*</note> when it receives from Strength. **Remembers/Visits** <note>Hebrew: *Poked*</note>: Refers to Strength, as it acts through the leadership of the six directions. **Dread** <note>Hebrew: *Pachad*</note>: In Strength, when it is clothed in harsh judgment. **Firstborn/Opening of the Womb** <note>Hebrew: *Peter Rechem*</note>: In Kingdom, which is the opening of the womb. This originates in Understanding, where the "repair" within her flows vitality; their reward is like the "tester of kidneys." **Wonder** <note>Hebrew: *Pele*</note>: In **Crown** <term>Keter: the highest Sefirah</term> and likewise in Wisdom, to indicate their exalted status. It is also in Beauty when it rises through Knowledge to the Crown; ultimately, it always refers to the Crown. **Streams** <note>Hebrew: *Palgei*</note>: In Understanding according to the words of Rabbi Moshe <note>Moses Cordovero</note>; but according to our view, they are in Kingdom, which is a pool full of water, as mentioned in the "Kabbalah of Solomon" and earlier in this book.

**Inside and Outside**: In Beauty. Their secret is the "fillings" <note>The spelled-out names of the letters</note> in Kingdom: Grace and Holiness are within them, and the union of the fillings is Splendor. Likewise, "The Face of the Lord" is in Beauty, and "With all your heart" is in Kingdom. So too are they in the other Sefirot: "Face" in Strength, and the "Face of the Moon" in Victory and Splendor. **Ceased/Verse** <note>Hebrew: *Pasak/Pasuk*</note>: In Kingdom from the side of Beauty, as it is written "besides the judgment." When the hidden Name is unified with it, it is called the "Verse of the Bride." **Charge** <note>Hebrew: *Pekudah*</note>: In Kingdom, which is the charge of Beauty through the flow of goodness. **Orders/Precepts** <note>Hebrew: *Pekudim*</note>: In Victory and Splendor, from which the "visitation" comes to Kingdom. **Red Heifer**: In Understanding from the side of Strength, and it is known from the foundation of Mercy. It is also in Kingdom, but in Understanding it is the secret of *influence*, while in Kingdom it is the secret of *reception*. **Detail** <note>Hebrew: *Perat*</note>: In Beauty; through the Crown it is called "General," but compared to Splendor, Judgment, and Pomegranates, Beauty is the "Detail" through which things are specified in the Garden. Kingdom is the "General" that includes everything in the secret of sustenance. **Fruit of the Tree**: In Kingdom, called "Fruit of the Majestic Tree" in the secret of taking the Lulav <note>The palm frond used on Sukkot</note>, which involves the thirty-six countenances. Beauty is called "Majesty" <note>Hebrew: *Hadar*</note>, and she is the "Majesty of the Face." **Uncovering** <note>Hebrew: *Periah*</note>: In Foundation. There is a distinction between Circumcision and Uncovering: Circumcision removes the foreskin from the world, while Uncovering brings the foreskin closer to the holy [covenant].

**Curtain** <note>Hebrew: *Parokhet*</note>: In Kingdom, which is a curtain and a screen between the secular/profane and all the sweet things. **Provider** <note>Hebrew: *Parnas*</note>: In Understanding and Kingdom, for they provide for all the upper and lower levels. **Extended**: Like Mercy. So I heard in the *Tikunim* regarding the verse "Your right hand is extended." **Opening** <note>Hebrew: *Petach*</note>: In Kingdom, in which there is the entrance to all corners. She is the "Lower Opening" and is called the "Opening of the Eyes," as all eyes look toward her. There is also an "Opening of the World," which is Foundation, for it is the openings of the world of Building. It is called "Openings" in the plural because within it are the path of the Right (Mercy) and the path of the Left (Strength). Every opening is both open and closed, etc.

# Chapter 18: Host <note>Hebrew: *Tzaba*</note> in Victory and Splendor; through Foundation it is called "Lord of Hosts" <note>Hebrew: *Tzabaot*</note>. This is found in Victory... for the essence of Victory is Foundation, and from this, "Laws" are named, as is known regarding Wisdom in the *Tikunim*.

**Deer/Splendor** <note>Hebrew: *Tzvi*</note>: In Foundation when it rests in Kingdom, when Kingdom is "The Righteous One" <note>Hebrew: *Tzadket*</note>... and likewise in Beauty during its nullification in Pharaoh...

<column-break/>

->Meanings of the Appellations<-

...in Mercy; and likewise Kingdom is called the "Glory" <note>Hebrew: *Pe'er*</note> of all. **Righteous** <note>Hebrew: *Tzaddik*</note>: As mentioned... the wrapping of Charity <note>Hebrew: *Tzedakah*</note> with Justice <note>Hebrew: *Tzedek*</note> and the letter *Yod*. The resting place of Justice is Foundation, which becomes "Righteous." In the portion *Emor*, it is explained that Foundation and Kingdom are called "Righteous Ones" in the plural, since she prepared this covenant—one is Circumcision and the other is Uncovering. The "Righteous One" is only called so when joined with Kingdom. And all of Strength in the filling of the dowry... in the verse "For as..." and Justice was weighed... and in the *Book of Mercy* it is stated that Beauty is called "Righteous" and Kingdom is called "Justice." There is an "Upper Justice" in Understanding, and likewise Victory in Understanding, for Charity is Mercy, and therefore it is in Understanding. In the *Chariot* of the portion *Acharei Mot*, it implies it is in Beauty, and Kingdom is called "Charity" in the *Book of the Teacher* regarding the "Point," which according to its secret was crowned in Sarah. Thus it is heard that there were six places in Beauty. **Neck** <note>Hebrew: *Tzavar*</note>: In Victory and Splendor of Beauty... and Strength. The reason is that one must also be careful in Understanding. **Rock** <note>Hebrew: *Tzur*</note>: Some associate it with Foundation, but it is in Understanding, which "forms" <note>Hebrew: *Yotzeret*</note> all existences. Some associate it with Strength, as it represents hard judgment. Some associate it with the "Cliff" <note>Hebrew: *Sela*</note>, which is in Kingdom, from which the waters emerged; regarding her it is said, "He opened the rock and water flowed out." **World's Need**: In Kingdom, for the primary leadership of this attribute is for the sake of the lower world.

**Form** <note>Hebrew: *Tzurah*</note> and Male: via the letters *L-M* in Beauty, for Foundation is called "Form." **Radiance/Splendors** <note>Hebrew: *Tzachtzachot*</note>: In the hidden sources within the Crown and in Understanding. The reason is that the power of the repair of all Sefirot and from her emerged the splendors in beauty for all the Names... in Beauty, as mentioned in the portion *Toldot Yitzchak*. **Zion**: In Foundation and also in Kingdom. In purity, there is the Sabbath and the secret... she clings to two virtues. To seal the innermost point, Foundation is called the "Point of Zion." **Headplate/Flower** <note>Hebrew: *Tzitz*</note>: In Understanding. It exists to atone for the sin of the "Face," so that the covenant of her power replaces the face of the salt, which are written as "Opening." Therefore, "Holy to the Lord" was written upon it, for it is Holiness... and for piety. Therefore it is in Beauty, meaning a shield hovering over the opening via the Crown... for Mercy. **Fringes** <note>Hebrew: *Tzitzit*</note>: In Kingdom in her measurements. One who approaches the "Kingdom of the Sea" reaches the ultimate goal, as described in the commentaries. **Pot's Broth/Hinge**: In Kingdom, which is like a pot in which all existences are cooked. It needs spices to sweeten it... and therefore it needs to be nurtured first from the builders to Foundation... to the pot... and her servants are sent to her. Therefore, we unify her with the phrase "Blessed be the Name [of His glorious Kingdom forever]," etc. **Evening Shadows**: Branches of harsh judgment, as explained in the portion *Chayei Sarah*. **Shadow of Death** <note>Hebrew: *Tzalmavet*</note>: Within the "Shell" <term>Kelipah: the forces of evil or impurity</term>. It is the male that rules over the female called "Death" and the "death of Goliath." **Rib/Side** <note>Hebrew: *Tzela*</note>: In Kingdom, in the aspect of the "entry" that is in the establishment of the Upper World. There is also the "Side of the Tabernacle," which is in Beauty, which is a rock for Kingdom... as described in the *Tikunim*. **Wool**: White, like Mercy according to Rabbi Moshe. Therefore... in the Crown... white... "the hair of his head like pure wool." It is known that the "Hair of Mercy" is in the Crown, just as the Crown is the secret of the Soul. **Channels/Pipes** <note>Hebrew: *Tzinorot*</note>: The esophagus in Wisdom and Understanding... they empty into the union... and this aspect... Wisdom... for all the Right, like the verse... Wisdom within the Crown... **Cry** <note>Hebrew: *Tzea'kah*</note>: In Understanding, and its power is to overturn Judgment. Because of this, the lower beings are judged by it, as mentioned in the portion *Shemot*. **North** <note>Hebrew: *Tzafon*</note>: In Strength, in the secret of Judgment. Sometimes for good, like "Hidden Goodness"... Mercy in the Crown, etc. **Bird** <note>Hebrew: *Tzippor*</note>: In Kingdom, against the "Countenances"—meaning when she covers Beauty and they nurture from Metatron.

# Asis Rimmonim: Gate 23, Values of Appellations
<note>Hebrew: עסיס רמונים (Nectar of Pomegranates) is a summary of the Pardes Rimmonim, the primary encyclopedic work of Cordoverian Kabbalah.</note>

...and the **Cavity of Wisdom**, which follows the order of the *Tikkunim* <note>original: "כתיקוני'" - referring to the Tikkuney Zohar</note>. **Leaven** <note>original: "שאור" (Se'or)</note> in the congregation.
**Relative** <note>original: "שאר" (She'ar), meaning kinsman or flesh</note> in terms of gluttony, from the perspective of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet: the sixth Sefirah</term> clothing itself there to learn **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>.
**Oath** <note>original: "שבועה" (Shevuah)</note>: This concept is derived from the word "seventh" <note>Hebrew: שביעית (Shevi'it)</note>, as it is comprised of the seven extremities <note>the seven lower Sefirot</note> and **Foundation** <term>Yesod: the ninth Sefirah</term> acting within **Understanding** <term>Binah: the third Sefirah</term>. These include Foundation and **Kingdom** <term>Malchut: the tenth Sefirah</term>, for all the Sefirot are only called "oaths" from the perspective of Foundation, as explained in the Zohar. The oath resides in Kingdom when it ascends to Foundation; therefore, the Oath is the "Recitation of the Shema" <note>The central Jewish prayer</note> which corresponds to the Foundation, known as *K-Y* <note>The letters Kof and Yod, Gematria 110</note>, receiving the secret from the depths of Understanding.
**Seven Commandments**: Generally, all the seven Sefirot of the "Building" <note>the lower seven Sefirot</note> are called "Seven." Their fear is a single support, and Understanding is included with them. Therefore, they are called **Seven Sabbaths**, as they are included in the number fifty <note>original: "ח"י" is likely a typo for "נ" (50)</note> through the secret of the Jubilee years.
**Seven**: Within Beauty, specifically in the unification of **Lovingkindness** and **Strength** <term>Chesed and Gevurah</term>, as explained in the portion *Lachazor*.
**Seven Days**: In Understanding, which includes the seven lower "days" <note>the lower Sefirot</note>. There are seven lower days below just as there are seven upper days above, as explained in the portion *Vayikan*.
**Lattice** <note>original: "שובכת" (Shovakhat)</note> which is upon the capital: Meaning the pillars *Jachin* and *Boaz* <note>The pillars of the Temple</note>. They are the "wings," and the deaths of the columns are Lovingkindness and Strength. Upon them is the **Shekhinah** <note>The Divine Presence</note>, which serves as the covering and is Understanding.
**Sabbath**: In Kingdom. The reason it is called Sabbath <note>Hebrew: שבת (Shabbat)</note> is interpreted as *Bat* <note>Daughter/Kingdom</note> which is Kingdom, and the letter *Shin* <note>ש</note> includes the three Patriarchs <note>Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet</note> in **Victory** and **Lovingkindness** <note>Netzach and Chesed</note>. For the three Patriarchs are the "House" <note>Hebrew: בית (Bayit)</note> and the end. This is "Night," therefore the sign is *L-Y* <note>possibly meaning "to me"</note> Sabbath. Consequently, one is liable for stoning <note>for desecrating the Sabbath</note>. The "void of the Sabbath" is through Foundation, through the secret of the "seventh" as explained above in its entry. The **Day of Sabbath** is Beauty. When they unite together, they ascend to Understanding. Therefore, Understanding is called the "Cause of the Greatnesses" of the **Three Sabbaths**, meaning: Sabbath of Kingdom, Beauty, and Understanding, as heard in the Zohar.
**Field** <note>original: "שדה" (Sadeh)</note>: Generally refers to Kingdom. Similarly, **Field of Apples** refers to Kingdom. The interpretation of "Field" <note>original: "סיש"</note> relates to the light of Lovingkindness, dreams, and living creatures. The essence of this appellation is in Beauty, and the interpretation is that it includes the fifty gates of the "Apple." Similarly, "The Dream of Joseph" and "Beauty." The interpretation is a "Field of Inquiry" that includes the "Apples." Kingdom is called "Field of Apples" because it is the orchard where all the Apples—which are the Loves <note>the Sefirot of emotion</note>—pour their influence into it.
There is also a **Sprouting Field**, which refers to Kingdom when it is in a state of poverty. And there is a **Protected Field**, and in the book *Pasak*, a "Burning Field" that raises sparks.
**Spine of the Palm Branch** <note>original: "שדרת הלולב" (Shidrat ha-Lulav)</note>: Refers to Foundation. The **Palm Branch** <note>Lulav</note> itself refers to Foundation and Beauty, which are inclusive of Foundation and Strength, through the secret of the leaves on the right and left. And in the movement of the spine of the Lulav, there is the secret of the number eighteen <note>original: "ח"י"</note>, referring to Foundation and Beauty, as in the portion *Lavor*.
**Lamb** <note>original: "שה" (Seh)</note>: In Lovingkindness, because it is a "perfect lamb," just as "perfect life."
**Officer** <note>original: "שוטר" (Shoter)</note>: In Beauty from the side of Kingdom. The reason is that the "Judge" <note>original: "השופט"</note> is Strength, and his decree is carried out by the Officer. When punishment is required, he lashes. Similarly, in Beauty, there is judgment via the "Pure Strap," which is Kingdom, called "the Strap." Therefore, Beauty is called an Officer.
**Table** <note>original: "שולחן" (Shulchan)</note>: In Beauty. From the perspective of Foundation, it is called "High," and everything is prepared upon it and flows into it.
**Table**: In Kingdom from the side of Strength, through the secret of "The table is in the north" <note>The North symbolizes Strength/Gevurah</note>.
**Ruler** <note>original: "שולט" (Sholet)</note>: In Beauty from the side of Foundation, for the ruler governs the body of the King. Therefore, in the context of Beauty, he rules in his lower aspect toward the Foundation, which is the secret of "Ruling over the water" and "The voice of the ruler."
**Conversation** <note>original: "שיחה" (Sichah)</note>: In Kingdom, for it is a drop that is part of prayer.
**Judge** <note>original: "שופט" (Shofet)</note>: All Sefirot are called "Judges" from the side of Understanding, through the secret of the spreading of Judgment.
**Shofar**: Generally Beauty. **Great Shofar** is Understanding, for in it is the "Great Jubilee" which returns everything to its source.
**Legs** <note>original: "שוקים" (Shokim)</note>: Victory and Splendor <term>Netzach and Hod</term>, for Beauty, which is the "Body," leans upon them.
**Ox** <note>original: "שור" (Shor)</note>: In Strength. In the *Tikkunim*, it implies Beauty from the side of Strength. Furthermore, it implies the offering brought by Adam—a "Horned Ox"—referring to Kingdom and the horn of the right side...

<column-break/>

...is Foundation.
**Lily** <note>original: "שושן" (Shoshan)</note>: There is a Sefirah which is Understanding; therefore, it is in the "Wing," and there are six petals... and it will be in Splendor <term>Hod</term>.
**Rose** <note>original: "שושנה" (Shoshanah)</note>: Comprised of red and white, Judgment and Mercy. It refers to Kingdom. It also shares 13 petals, and in Kingdom, there are 13 "scales of the beard" <note>referring to the 13 Attributes of Mercy</note> when it is a kingdom from 13 "eyes," as explained in the portion *Bereshit*. According to the *Tikkunim*, the "Roses" are two: the Upper and Lower Seventh <note>Understanding and Kingdom</note>.
**Black** <note>original: "שחור" (Shachor)</note>: Interpreted by Rabbi Moshe <note>likely Cordovero</note> of blessed memory: these are the 20 levels of morning and evening. "Morning" of Lovingkindness... and "Evening" in Victory, which is a darkened light compared to Lovingkindness. "Evening" precedes the morning that turns into Lovingkindness, diminishing from above.
**Skies** <note>original: "שחקים" (Shachakim)</note>: Victory and Splendor, for they "grind" <note>A pun on the root sh-ch-q</note> manna for the righteous, who receive the flow of Beauty and transmit it to the Righteous One <note>Foundation</note>.
**Accusation** <note>original: "שטנה" (Sitnah)</note>: According to Rabbi Moshe <note>Cordovero</note>, this is only "Void," and therefore salt is compared to the *Kelipah* <note>Shell/Husk: forces of evil</note>.
**Old Age** <note>original: "שיבה" (Seivah)</note>: In **Crown** <term>Keter: the highest Sefirah</term>, through the secret of the whiteness within it.
**Bush/Meditation** <note>original: "שיח" (Siach)</note>: In Foundation. The interpretation is that it receives speech from Understanding and gives birth to the offspring... in the presence of Lovingkindness, Judgment, and Mercy... as explained in the *Tikkunim*.
**Acacia** <note>original: "שיטה" (Shitah)</note>: In Kingdom, from the side of the "spreading" <note>pshitut</note> of Lovingkindness.
**Song** <note>original: "שיר" (Shir)</note>: In **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>. Interpretation: The "Prince" <note>Sar</note> of the letter *Yod*. **Poetry** <note>original: "שירה" (Shirah)</note> is in Kingdom. Interpretation: The letters *Shin-Resh-Yod-He*. And the Commandments are the "Song" and "Soul" for the nations.
**Forgetfulness** <note>original: "שכחה" (Shikhah)</note>: In the *Kelipah*, for there is no "Remembrance" there. However, there is a "Weighty Forgetfulness" of evil, as explained in its entry.
**Shekhinah** <note>The Divine Presence</note>: There is an **Upper Shekhinah** and a **Lower Shekhinah**. The Upper Shekhinah is Understanding, which dwells <note>mashkenet</note> the two upper ones <note>Crown and Wisdom</note> upon the seven of the Building. Also, the five extremities dwell in it through the secret of their ascent. The Lower Shekhinah is Kingdom, which dwells among the multitudes below. Also, the five extremities dwell in it through the secret of their descent. Understanding is also called Shekhinah when it is written as a "cloud" for Strength.
**Intellect** <note>original: "שכל" (Sekhel)</note>: In Foundation. Every expression of "intelligence" <note>haskalah</note> comes from the side of Understanding.
**Near Neighbor** <note>original: "שכן קרוב" (Shakhen Karov)</note>: In Foundation, in the sense that it "dwells" upon Kingdom.
**Snow** <note>original: "שלג" (Sheleg)</note>: Interpreted by Rabbi Moshe as "Pure" in Beauty. It is under the Throne of Glory, pure in Understanding.
**Flame** <note>original: "שלהבת" (Shalhevet)</note>: In Beauty, for the "Coals" are Wisdom, through the secret of the *Yod-He-Vav-He*. The addition of the "Light" is Beauty, through the secret of the five extremities that spread out... the writing of "Coals" and "Flame" is when they are clothed in the emanation of Strength, to awaken Wisdom from its portion, as in the beginning of the portion *Vayikra*.
**Peace** <note>original: "שלום" (Shalom)</note>: In Beauty and Foundation, because they mediate between Lovingkindness and Judgment. Furthermore, when Understanding clothes itself in Judgment... Beauty receives the 32 Paths from Wisdom and influences Understanding... Foundation receives the 32 Paths and influences... as discussed in the *Tikkunim*.
**Complete** <note>original: "שלם" (Shalem)</note>: In Kingdom, the aspect that clarifies the "Void" into a "Complete" place.
**Peace Offerings** <note>original: "שלמים" (Shelamim)</note>: In Kingdom, which takes from the pillar *Jachin*... because they would cast a "complete" remembrance... and could not tip the scales, as explained in the portion *Vayikra*.
**Name** <note>original: "שם" (Shem)</note>: In Kingdom. In "small gematria" it equals seven, as it is included in ten. Similarly, in Understanding, it is 50 gates...
There is a "Name" that refers to "Everything." Generally, every single Sefirah is called a "Name," to say that there is a level above it, for nothing is hidden from Him. The "World of Speech" is called "Name" for the emanations. Specifically, it is in Understanding, which is the "Name" for Wisdom. Similarly, it is in Kingdom, which is the "Name" for Beauty (which is the name *Y-H-V-H*), and the interpretation of "Palace" <note>Hekhal</note> is my Lord <note>Adonai</note>.
**Left** <note>original: "שמאל" (Smol)</note>: Understanding, Strength, and Splendor, according to their levels.
**Observe** <note>original: "שמור" (Shamor)</note>: In Kingdom from the side of Strength. For "Remember" <note>Zakhor</note> and "Observe" <note>Shamor</note> are Beauty and Kingdom... "Remember" is the male and "Observe" is the female. The reason is that "Remember" applies to the general rule of "doing," as it is written "So that you may remember and do."

# Nectar of Pomegranates: Gate 23, Values of Appellations
<note>Hebrew: עסיס רמונים (Asis Rimmonim). This work serves as an accessible summary of the primary Kabbalistic system of Rabbi Moshe Cordovero.</note>

### Chapter 4: The Letter Resh
<note>The source text says "Chapter 4: Seeing," but the entries follow the alphabetical order of the letter Resh (ר).</note>

It appears in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> and **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>. It is weighed like milk and called "Spirit."
**Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>: because the "living being" <note>original: "החייה" (Ha-Chayah)</note> is to live within it. It is more hidden to indicate Wisdom. This is mentioned in the *Tikkunim* <note>The Tikkuney Zohar, a central Kabbalistic text</note>.
**Head** <note>original: "ראש" (Rosh)</note>: Refers to **Crown** <term>Keter</term>, Wisdom, and Kindness. Crown is the head of Wisdom, which shines forth. It is also called the **White Head** <note>original: "ראש הלבן" (Rosh ha-Lavan)</note> in the mystery of whiteness that whitens the sins of Israel. Kindness is called the "Head of Gold," which is the head of the "daughter-in-law" <note>original: "לב"כ" - likely an abbreviation for the Bride/Malchut</note> who are the laws. There is also the **Head of the Nazirite**, which is in **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term> in the mystery of the aspects that stand with **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. There is the **Head of All**, which is in Beauty, the "Head of the Skull" called "Male."
**Showbread** <note>original: "לחמי פנים" (Lachmei Panim)</note>: This is in Kingdom, called "Voice" and "Star." **Endurance** <term>Netzach</term> and **Splendor** <term>Hod</term> are also called Showbread, as explained in the *Tikkunim*.
**Beginning** <note>original: "ראשית" (Reshit)</note>: In Wisdom, which is the beginning of revelation. Similarly, Kingdom is called "Beginning" in the aspect of the "Point" <note>original: "הי"ל" - likely the Primordial Point</note> within it. In the *Tikkunim*, it is stated that it was the beginning of all the Crowns.
**Great/Many** <note>original: "רב" (Rav)</note>: Any expression of "Rav" stems from Wisdom, from which the flow is drawn to become "Great," as understood in the *Tikkunim*. There is **Abounding in Kindness** <note>original: "רב חסד" (Rav Chesed)</note> in Kindness, and **Great in Power** in the aspect of Kindness and **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term> together. There is **Great Goodness**, which is in the "Arm" <note>The flow of Tiferet</note> of the flow of Understanding that pours into **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. Furthermore, it is like the **Euphrates River**, which are the levels in Beauty, the "Tree of Life," as mentioned in the portion of *Bereshit* <note>Genesis</note>.
**Descend** <note>original: "רד" (Rad)</note>: Kindness, within the realm of holiness.
**Square/Fourth** <note>original: "רביע" (Revi'a)</note>: In Understanding. This refers to the four-sided letter *Shin* <note>Found on the head-tefillin</note> upon the "Backs" <note>The outer aspects of the Sefirot</note>.
**Many** <note>original: "רבים" (Rabbim)</note>: In the Patriarchs <note>The Sefirot Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet</note> in the mystery of their blending. This means they beat against one another before the upper deciding factor unifies them. Since "Many" is no less than three, it resides in the three Patriarchs.
**Quadrant/Mating** <note>original: "רובע" (Rova)</note>: In Foundation. This is an expression of "mating" <note>Hebrew: רביעה (Revi'ah)</note>. There is a "Quadrant" in the Beauty of Kingdom, for then Kingdom is in the mystery of the "Fourth" to the Queen. This is because it was the "Bed of Solomon," an expression of mating in Foundation (see portion *Balak*).
**The Fourth H** <note>original: "רביעית ה'"</note>: This is in Kingdom, which is the fourth letter of the Name *Y-H-W-H*. She is the fourth to the three Patriarchs, who are the "Feet of the Queen," and she is the Fourth Foot. She is called "Fourth" because she has not yet been unified with him, as explained in Chapter 17.
**Rebecca** <note>original: "רבקה" (Rivkah)</note>: In Kingdom, from the side of the "adornment" <note>original: "המתופר"</note> at the time of the mystery of Understanding.
**Feet** <note>original: "רגלים" (Reglayim)</note>: The feet of Kingdom in the mystery of her lowest aspect that clarifies the "husks" <term>Kelipot: forces of impurity</term>, as in "I washed my feet." Also refers to the "Movers" <note>Angels</note> who are also called "Feet," being beneath the Throne of Glory <note>original: "הכ"כ" - הכיסא הכבוד</note>, as explained in portion *Lech Lecha*.
**Gutters/Troughs** <note>original: "רהטים" (Rehatim)</note>: In Endurance, Splendor, and Foundation. They are within the Throne of Glory, as stated in the *Tikkunim*.
**Abundance (of Grain and Wine)**: In Foundation, when it flows between Beauty and Kingdom. There is also **Abundance of Wisdom**, which is in the Crown, as explained in the *Tikkunim*.
**Spirit** <note>original: "רוח" (Ruach)</note>: In Beauty when it acts as the decider between Kindness and Water <note>Chesed</note>. It is called the **North Wind** when it receives from Severity, and the **South Wind** or **Cool Wind** in the aspect of Kindness, in the mystery of the "Waters of Kindness." There is the **Holy Spirit** <note>original: "רוח הקודש" (Ruach ha-Kodesh)</note>, which is Kingdom when she receives from Wisdom (called "Holy"). The mystery is that the Holy Spirit is below the Glory. It is also called a **Great Wind** from the side of Kindness, and a **Strong Wind** from the side of Severity. The **Spirit of the Lord** is Foundation in Beauty. There is the **Spirit of God** in Understanding, because it is the "Soul of Understanding" (called *Elohim*). Similarly, it is in Beauty as the soul for Kingdom.
**Width**: The Foundation of Kingdom, as explained in the *Ra'aya Meheimna*.
**Rider of the Heavens**: In Understanding, which "rides" upon Beauty. Because Fire and Water are called "Heavens," she rides upon him.
**Merchant** <note>original: "רוכל" (Rokhel)</note>: In Foundation, where all types of flow are gathered like a merchant's powders.
**Height** <note>original: "רום" (Rum)</note>: In Understanding or Crown, in the mystery of Beauty, according to the commentators.
<meta>catchword: From (מן)</meta>

<column-break/>

There is also **Spirit of the Heavens**, which is in Understanding, as explained in the *Tikkunim*.
**Spear** <note>original: "רומח" (Romach)</note>: In Beauty. When it leans toward the side of Kindness, it is the 248 <note>Numerical value of "Spear" (Romach) is 248</note> positive commandments. With the six [directions] of Beauty, it is the Spear, and the hand that holds it is Kingdom, in the mystery of the "Pipe" <note>The channel of flow</note>.
**Shepherd among the Lilies**: In Beauty, which "pastures" the houses of lilies. There are two "Kophs" <note>The Hebrew letter ק</note> there, in the mystery of the nourishment from Understanding to Understanding.
**Broad Places/Streets** <note>original: "רחובות" (Rehovot)</note>: In Understanding, in the "Heavens" in her expansion over the "Backs." These are the "Streets of the streams of water."
**Merciful** <note>original: "רחום" (Rachum)</note>: In Kindness, for He has mercy on the creatures, and kindness and forgiveness come from there. It is possible it is in Kindness from the side of Beauty, which is the "Master of Mercy." Thus, "Merciful" equals 248 <note>The numerical value of Rachum (רחום) is 248</note> as explained above regarding the "Spear."
**Distant**: In Wisdom, due to its hidden nature. Also Beauty, when it withdraws upward, is called "Very Distant" from Kingdom, as explained in portion *Vayikra*.
**Rachel**: In Kingdom, in her aspect of unifying with Beauty (Jacob).
**Mercy** <term>Rachamim</term>: In Beauty, which is the "Line of Mercy."
**The Lord's Strife** <note>original: "ריב ה'" (Riv Hashem)</note>: In Kingdom, as she "contends" with her husband (Beauty) over the destruction of the Temple. Also in Understanding, which contends over the destruction of the Foundation.
**Scent/Aroma** <note>original: "ריח" (Reiach)</note>: In Kingdom, when she is in the mystery of the sacrifices and incense. She ascends through the levels via Severity (where the "nose" <note>anger/breath</note> is) up to Wisdom, and from there to the Infinite <term>Ein Sof</term>. She is then received by her Beloved in the mystery of the Foundation of Wisdom and Understanding, which is **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>. Through it, the flow of Wisdom is awakened in the "Visitations" of the lines of Understanding. Understanding then clothes itself in Mercy, and through this, the world is blessed—this is the "Pleasing Aroma."
**Empty** <note>original: "ריקם" (Reikam)</note>: In Beauty. This refers to the Name when it is in "Blackness," containing only the testimony of the letter *Yod*, the mystery of Wisdom.
**Tender/Soft**: In Crown, Understanding, and Beauty. Primarily in Understanding, because it is "tender and thin," being the "Greenness" of her crown; she is the "Nursing Mother."
**Pomegranates** <note>original: "רמונים" (Rimmonim)</note>: In Understanding, as explained in the *Tikkunim*.
**Song/Joy** <note>original: "רנה" (Rinah)</note>: In Foundation during the time of rest: "Sing, O righteous ones." It is also in Understanding from the side of Severity, in the mystery of Song.
**Friends/Companions** <note>original: "רעים" (Re'im)</note>: Explained in the *Tikkunim* as Endurance and Splendor, because they are "Friends" in their action. In the Zohar, it implies they are in Understanding and Wisdom, or Kindness and Severity, which are called "Friends."
**Thunders**: The Foundation that is within Understanding.
**Quake/Noise** <note>original: "רעש" (Ra'ash)</note>: In Kingdom, which is shaken by the "Living Beings of Dust," for she was created from dust. She clothes herself in the strength of Severity and quakes the "Kingdom of Wickedness" to destroy it. There is also a "Quake" from the side of the husks.
**Will/Desire** <note>original: "רצון" (Ratson)</note>: In the Crown, for it reconciles and gives "Good Will" to all the Sefirot. When the Sefirot suckle from it, they are clothed in Will.
**Firmament** <note>original: "רקיע" (Raki'a)</note>: Generally, all Sefirot are called "Firmaments." Specifically, Understanding, Beauty, and Foundation. Understanding is the firmament "above the heads of the Living Beings." Beauty is called "Firmament" in the mystery of the Name *R-K-Y-A*. Foundation is the firmament "above the heads of the Living Beings" of Kingdom. Sometimes Kingdom is also called "Firmament" above the heads of the lower Living Beings.
**Domain/Authority** <note>original: "רשות" (Reshut)</note>: In Understanding. When she unifies with Beauty, she is called a "Private Domain." There is also a "Public Domain," which refers to the Cherubim, which are "Many," or the 70 Nations. But the "Individual of the World" is One and Unique.

### Chapter 21: The Letter Shin
**Lioness** <note>original: "לביא" (Lavi)</note>: In Foundation from the side of Judgment. Even Kindness clothes itself in Judgment and becomes a Lioness, and therefore it roars <note>Hebrew: שואג (Sho'eg)</note>.
**Question/Request** <note>original: "שאלה" (She'elah)</note>: In Kingdom, from the side of Kindness and Wisdom. A request should be made gently. Therefore, God said to Solomon, "Ask what I shall give you."

# 79 Nectar of Pomegranates: Gate 23, Values of Appellations 79

**Testimony** <note>original: "תעודה" (Te'udah)</note>: Found in **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> when it flows into **Metatron** <note>The supreme angel and celestial scribe</note>, and likewise in **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> when she receives from Understanding, as mentioned in the portion of *Lachor* <note>Referring to a section of the Zohar</note>.
**Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>: This is the second Sefirah <note>counting in a specific sub-configuration</note> that spreads to all sides and includes all colors. It is glorified by the agreement of the tongue <note>original: "הסכמת לשון"</note>. Perhaps Kingdom is called this when she receives from him and learns to be called thus.
**Apples** <note>original: "תפוחים" (Tappuchim)</note>: According to the mystery of the colors—redness, whiteness, Judgment, and Mercy. They are only called "apples" in the mystery of when **Kindness** <term>Hesed</term> clothes **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>, and likewise in Beauty when it includes the three Patriarchs <note>Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, representing Hesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet</note>.
**Prayer** <note>original: "תפלה" (Tefillah)</note>: Through Kingdom, for in her the souls are prepared. All prayer originates from the side of Kingdom; it is through her that it is bound above and draws Kindness from the Patriarchs.
**Hope / Line** <note>original: "תקות" (Tikvat)</note>: Refers to the "scarlet thread" in Kingdom. Perhaps this follows the mystery of Judgment that arouses desire, as in the mystery of "your lips are like a thread of scarlet" <note>Song of Songs 4:3</note>. This desire is located in the lips, as mentioned in the portion of *Vayechi*.
**Teki'ah** <note>The long, straight blast of the Shofar</note>: Found in Beauty from the side of Kindness.
**Teru'ah** <note>The broken, staccato blast of the Shofar</note>: Found in Kingdom from the side of Judgment, and also in Beauty from the side of the inclusion of Kingdom within it.
**Mighty** <note>original: "תקיף" (Takif)</note>: Refers to Strength, as implied by the verse "Your right hand, O Lord, is glorious in power" <note>Exodus 15:6</note>.
**Offering** <note>original: "תרומה" (Terumah)</note>: In Kingdom. The "Great Offering" <note>Terumah Gedolah</note> is from the side of Kindness, and the "Tithe Offering" <note>Terumah Ma'aser</note> is from the side of Strength, which separates the tithe and writes it for the Levite to include the Israelite.
**Seals / Coins** <note>original: "תיוין" (Tivin)</note>: These are judgments in the *Ra'aya Mehemna* <note>The "Faithful Shepherd," a section of the Zohar</note>. They are the rectifications of the Teru'ah-Teki'ah-Teru'ah blasts... <note>The text here enters a complex gematria and permutation involving the letters of the word Torah and names of God</note>. It also hints at the Written Torah given at 70 days, which is the meaning of **Torah**.
**Tarshish**: Refers to the two "plates," which are the three joints of the right arm (**Kindness**) and the left arm (**Fear/Strength**).
**Repentance / Return** <note>original: "תשובה" (Teshuvah)</note>: Rooted primarily in Understanding, for in her is the "return" of all living beings and souls. She is the Jubilee <note>the 50th year</note> and the source of all rectifications to bestow and receive repentance, as explained in the portion of *Vayikra*. Likewise in Kingdom: when Kingdom lacks, she sucks from Judgment to bestow upon the creatures, and the world is judged. But when Mercy spreads over her, she produces her holy fruits, and then she is called "Repentance." The word *Tashuv-He* <note>תשו"ב ה</note> means the [letter] *He* <note>representing Kingdom</note> shall return to her place. Any language of "return" in Kingdom is from the side of Understanding, which is the Jubilee, and in Kingdom, there is the realization of that return.

<column-break/>

The Oral Torah <note>original: "תורה שבעל פה"</note> which explains the Written Torah; it is in the "Lower Understanding" <note>a name for Kingdom</note> where all the secrets of the upper realms are revealed.
**Boundary** <note>original: "תחום" (Techum)</note>: An area in Kingdom. Her boundary is five thousand cubits, which are the days of the week... <note>This refers to the laws of the Sabbath boundary</note>.
**Supplication** <note>original: "תחנה" (Techinah)</note>: In Kingdom, hinting at the time of drawing down "grace" <note>Chen</note> and the "nursing" that performs Kindness.
**Ark** <note>original: "תיבה" (Teivah)</note>: Found in Kingdom and in Understanding, as explained in the *Tikkunim*.
**Integrity / Simplicity** <note>original: "תימות" (Temimut)</note>: Found in Beauty, according to the words of Rabbi Joseph. It appears to be in Beauty in the mystery of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>, which is the "three upper leaves."
**Rectification / Silence** <note>original: "תיקון" (Tikkun)</note>: A language of silence <note>original: "שתיקה" (Shetikah)</note>, which is in Kingdom. From the side of the **Crown** <term>Keter</term> there is the "silence of the word." Rectifications in Kingdom are from the side of the Crown, meaning she is sweetened with her husband <note>Tiferet</note> through the Crown, in the mystery of "Why, O Lord, do You stand afar?" <note>Psalm 10:1</note>.
**Blue** <note>original: "תכלת" (Tekhelet)</note>: Like the sea. There is a sea in Kingdom and in the "Lower Understanding." It resembles the lower sea and indicates the strength of Judgment.
**Mound** <note>original: "תל" (Tel)</note>: In **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, for all ascend to it to receive flow and sustenance from it.
**Snow** <note>original: "תלג" (Telag - Aramaic for Sheleg)</note>: According to Rabbi Moshe, this may be the mystery of the "white dew," as explained in its entry.
**Hidden** <note>original: "תל" (Tamon - here spelled תל)</note>: In Kingdom, with the inclusion of the upper holy levels within her.
**Image** <note>original: "תמונה" (Temunah)</note>: In Kingdom and in Understanding, for through them, that which is above them is revealed. Regarding what is written, "For you saw no image" <note>Deut 4:15</note>, that refers to Understanding, whose images are hidden. But "the image of the Lord he shall behold" <note>Num 12:8</note> refers to Kingdom, which is the "image of the Lord" and the scroll of the image.
**Exchange** <note>original: "תמורה" (Temurah)</note>: In Kingdom when she transforms into Metatron.
**Perfect / Whole** <note>original: "תמים" (Tamim)</note>: In Kingdom in the inclusion of her holy aspects. Also in Foundation, because through it these aspects are unified. The *Ra'aya Mehemna* implies Kingdom is called "Perfect" from the side of Kindness.
**Her Image** <note>original: "תמונתה" (Temunata)</note>: Like "Image," meaning the "movement of the [letter] He" <note>original: "תנועת ה"</note>.
**Continual** <note>original: "תמיד" (Tamid)</note>: In Foundation from the side of Kindness; a name for the conduit... It also applies to Beauty and Kingdom.
**Conditions / Tannaim** <note>original: "תנאים" (Tenaim)</note>: Found in the *Tikkunim* and the Zohar, referring to the Sages of the Mishnah.
**Earlobe** <note>original: "תנוך" (Tanukh)</note>: In Beauty. Hinted at by the ear, the eye, and the nose, which are the three aspects of the head; these are rooted in Metatron.
**Tekoa**: In Kingdom from the side of Judgment.
**Shields** <note>original: "תריסין" (Terisin)</note>: The Great Prophets, who are like great shields and many in number, receiving the flow from Understanding, which is their Crown.

### Gate Twenty-Four: Explaining the Matters of the Palaces

---

Every palace is approached, and there shall be no gap or faulty thing within it. Inside it shall be a veil <note>Parokhet</note> to divide between the Holy and the Holy of Holies.

**The First Palace** is named for the two lights within it... each light is approached by the light of the "Sapphire Pavement" <note>original: "ספיר" (Sapir)</note>. It is on the right and is male. When the Holy One, Blessed be He, gathers the souls into the Palace of the Holy of Holies, then the light prevails over the female aspect <note>original: "נוקבא" (Nukva)</note> and the male arouses the female who was first a "knowing" aspect. Then the souls become male... <note>The text describes the spiritual procreation and unification of souls in the celestial palaces</note>. These two lights, male and female, unite into three unified "children" who praise the Eternal. When these two lights unite, the "Sapphire Brick" sucks from them a single light... and she sits upon seven wheels <term>Ofanim</term>. From this aspect, a single firmament spreads out.

<column-break/>

Know that above in the realms there are seven Palaces, and seven below, corresponding to one another. The first palace to us is called:
1. **The Palace of the Sapphire Pavement** <note>original: "לבנת הספיר" (Livnat Ha-Sapir)</note>.
2. **The Palace of the Essence of Heaven** <note>original: "עצם השמים" (Etzem Ha-Shamayim)</note>.
3. **The Palace of Brilliance** <note>original: "נוגה" (Nogah)</note>.
4. **The Palace of Merit** <note>original: "זכות" (Zakhut)</note>.
5. **The Palace of Love** <note>original: "אהבה" (Ahavah)</note>.
6. **The Palace of Will** <note>original: "רצון" (Ratson)</note>.
7. **The Palace of the Holy of Holies** <note>original: "קדש קדשים" (Kodesh Kodashim)</note>.

The details of the structure and names of these palaces are explained in the Zohar, portion of *Pekudei*. In general, these palaces are spiritual heavens and include within them types of angels called *Ofanim* <note>"Wheels"</note>, who are appointed over service and action, and over the guidance and flow to the lower world. Every single palace is unified and included [in the one above it]. So too are the camps of angels who dwell with us... until all the palaces are unified and included together in the Palace of the Holy of Holies. This Palace of the Holy of Holies is more [elevated] in the world...

# 79 Nectar of Pomegranates: Gate 23, Values of Appellations 79

**Peace** and etc., and **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> is "good," and therefore he is remembered for good.
**Shoot** <note>original: "יחור" (Yichur)</note>: As explained in the *Tikunim* <note>The Tikunei Zohar</note>. **Lying Lip**: Found in the **Husk** <term>Klipah</term> <note>The realm of spiritual impurity or "shells"</note>, as explained in the portion of *Toldot*.
**Jacob's Sackcloth**: In the Husks and their void. **And all the Holy Ones**: **Lie** is every tongue.
**Gazing**: From the side of **Judgment** <term>Gevurah</term>. **The Holy Shekel**: In **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, as is known. **Lowliness**: Before the 360 surrounds of the "Shay" <note>The number 310, often representing divine reward</note>... flow to the flames... and seven against the types of preparation.
**Prince of the World**: Refers to the staff in Kingdom, but its essence is in **Metatron** <note>The supreme archangel</note>; thus he is called **Prince of the Face**... 20 sons in the mystery of the **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>, 20 names of the Lord and Wisdom.
**Sarah**: In Kingdom, in the mystery that she is always joined to Abraham <note>who represents Kindness/Hesed</note>.
**Sharon**: Like a garden; since the Sharon is a place of connection, so too is **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> the source of all flow, watering the Garden <note>Kingdom</term>.
**Princes**: In the "Kallu" <note>likely an abbreviation or unclear term</note>, for they are princes over all the Husks, as explained in the portion of *Behaalotecha*.
**Seraph**: In Kingdom when she is ignited among the Seraphim.
**Seraphim**: In Understanding; this is when they draw sustenance from that **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term> and are included in one another; there was a name in the wings of each one.
**Shash-kor** <note>A cryptic term, possibly "Six-cold"</note>: In Kingdom when she is comprised of the six extremities <note>the six Sefirot from Hesed to Yesod</note>. So too **Shihor** in the mystery of His own glory, for every 5 is included in 10... and 30 aspects.
**Joy** <note>original: "ששון" (Sasson)</note>: In Foundation when it is from the six extremities to 10; and Understanding and Insight are "Joy and Gladness," as explained in the portion of *Balak*.
**Six Days**: In **Kindness** <term>Hesed</term> and **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, because they are comprised of the six extremities.

### Chapter 22: Desire in Kingdom
When her Presence <term>Shekhinah</term> receives all the prayers and brings them above, providing for each one its **Desire**.
**Twins**: In the **Crown** <term>Keter</term> for they are "two halves of a body," and likewise in Beauty which is from below and decides between the extremities.

**Produce** <note>original: "תבואה" (Tevu'ah)</note>: In Kingdom, as explained in the portion of *Vayeshev*.
**Insight** <term>Tevunah</term>: In Understanding itself when it flows and gives birth to a "son" and a "daughter" <note>Beauty and Kingdom</note>. Likewise, Isaac in Kingdom from the side of the higher triad. There is a distinction between Understanding <term>Binah</term> and Insight <term>Tevunah</term>: for "Binah" indicates the essence of Understanding, while "Tevunah" is through Beauty in the mystery of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>. It is also explained as the "Son of YaK" <note>referring to the divine name Yah</note>. Because the main essence is in Beauty within Understanding, she is called by the name Understanding.
**Chaos** <note>original: "תהו" (Tohu)</note>: Something which cannot be grasped and which astounds people; it resides in Understanding and also in the Husk of "Wine" to indicate concealment.
**Praise** <term>Tehillah</term>: In the Crown, and from there the flow goes to Wisdom and Understanding, and they are called "Praises." Kingdom is also called "Praise" in the mystery of the heart and the "living" <note>Chai/18</note>, for their end is in their beginning. They are only called Praises when they are included in Kingdom, being the ten types of Hallelujahs.
**Within**: In Beauty, because it is in the middle between the "N" <note>likely Netzach/Victory</note> and between Wisdom and Understanding in the mystery of Knowledge. There is a "Within" and "Commotion" that exist in the Husks.

**Tosefta** <note>original: "תוספתא" (Addition/Supplement)</note>: In Kingdom from the side of Foundation, which is called "The Adder."
**Scarlet Worm**: In Kingdom, for "all her household is clothed in scarlet." There is also a "worm and maggot" which exist in the Husk.
**Dove and the Voice of the Dove**: In Kingdom as long as she has not received the Male. When she receives the Male, she is called **Torah** <note>The Law/Teaching</note>, as explained in the Gate of Awe.
**Torah**: There is a "Holy Torah" indicating Wisdom, and it is "illuminated" in Kindness. Beauty, as is known, is the "Written Torah" as it gathers all Kindness. This is the "Torah of Kindness on her tongue." In the Zohar, it is in Kingdom as the "Written Torah" regarding all Strength in its ascent to be unified. So our Sages said, "We heard it from the mouth of the Strength" <note>The Almighty</note>. When she unifies with the other powers, they are also called Written Torah. From the side of Kindness and the "Positive Commandments," it is called Torah. The **Oral Torah** is in Kingdom, indicating things that are world-like in the arrangement for the lower realms... and it is written "A scroll of the worlds" which is sworn to Beauty... and Kingdom is the "Scroll of the worlds" in Beauty. Therefore it is called Torah from the language of...

<column-break/>

...and he is the King of the Right, and Beauty covers him. Therefore he is "Remembered for good" <note>ML"T</note> to raise up, since the gate is open for "The Adder." He is the King of Strength, and Kingdom covers below; therefore Kingdom is called a **Lyre** <note>original: "כנור" (Kinnor)</note> from the side of Strength.

**Joy** <note>original: "שמחה" (Simchah)</note>: In Understanding, and from her, all life is vitalized. It also exists in Kingdom when she is refined... In Joy there are seven Sefirot which are "seven years."

**Heaven** <note>original: "שמים" (Shamayim)</note>: In Beauty when it is balanced between Kindness and Judgment, between "Fire" <note>Esh</note> and "Water" <note>Mayim</note>—hence *Sha-mayim*. Kingdom is the "Heaven of Heavens" to Beauty.

**Eighth**: From Strength into Kingdom. The "Eighth" is the King of Yearning and is called "Kat" <note>perhaps a measure or small group</note>, comprised of Kindness and Strength. It is called "Ten," for Kindness would ascend to the Crown... and Judgment does not go into exile from its place. There is also an "Eighth" in Foundation, which is eighth from top to bottom and bottom to top. Understanding is also called "the Eighth," as implied in the Zohar.

**Hearing**: In Strength and the Kingdom within it. Sometimes Hearing is for Mercy when the intent is toward all Kindness.

**Oil**: In the inner part of Understanding. There is "Oil of Joy" which is the flow of flow to Kingdom. It can also mean "Greatness" <note>Gedulah</note> and is Foundation. There is "Oil for anointing" and it is Kindness when received. Beauty, which is the "Great Source," contains the inner part of the anointing. It is called "Holy Anointing Oil" in the Crown when received. When the King of Strength is included with him, the "Anointing" is Kindness and the "Holy" is Strength, for they are the Holiness. It is called Oil like the flow of Foundation which gathers the flow and pours it into Kingdom. It is called "Olive Oil" because the flow of the "Path" <note>Shibul</note> flows to all; "Olive" is Kindness. However, the essence of the flow is the flow of the Presence <term>Shekhinah</term>... and "Oil" is in Kindness... for the Holy Name is there. Every "Oil" belongs to the flow of the Right and the King of Wisdom, as explained in the portion of *Vayikra*.

**Shema** <note>The "Hear O Israel" prayer</note>: In Kingdom and in Understanding, the repair of the flow within her. The name of the Lord is doubled... "Hearing" <note>Shemi'ah</note> is for the Female, "Hear" <note>Shema</note> is for the Male, which is Beauty.

**Shema'ta** <note>Legal tradition/hearing</note>: In Kingdom from the side of Strength in the Foundation of Understanding, which are "Hearing," as explained above and in the *Tikunim*.

**Sun**: In Beauty, which governs the measure of the day and its dwelling. Likewise in Foundation. There is a "Sun and Shield" in the *Tikunim*, and over them is the Moon, adding Wisdom.

**Year**: For every path, all the Sefirot receive... and the King of Beauty, who includes twelve months, twelve powers... Beauty receives the "Year" of the King who includes... its essence is in Kingdom and it is also called "Year." Likewise, the Presence is called the "Year of Release" <note>Shmitah</note>.

**Barley** <note>original: "שעורה" (Se'orah)</note>: In Kingdom from the side that she is measured <note>original: "משתערת"</note> by the measures she uses, and her attributes... and names and beings clothed in twenty...

**Gate** <note>original: "שער" (Sha'ar)</note>: In Kingdom, being an anagram of **Ten** <note>original: "עשר" (Eser)</note>, for she is comprised of ten. Also the translation of "Rock" is *Polka* in the Zohar. **Peace**: To the... **Gate of Heaven**: In Kingdom. In the Zohar, it implies it is in Foundation, which is the gate to Beauty (called Heaven), and all flow is funneled through it to Kingdom.

**Teeth**: In Kingdom... building for all the Sefirot... there are twenty... and there are those of the "Husk" that are praiseworthy... and they are in the Husks.

**Lips**: In the Husks, as explained in the *Tikunim*. **Lip**: "Open my lips" etc. in Kingdom. The "Lip of the Lord" is in Kingdom, for she is the "Lip" to Beauty in order.

# Nectar of Pomegranates: Gate 26, The Palaces

Roots of the four elements <term>Arba Yesodot: Fire, Air, Water, and Earth</term> are the offspring of the spiritual **Element of Water**. **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term> can [transform] into **Kindness** <term>Hesed</term>. **The Holy Spirit** is the **Element of Air**. **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> is the **Element of Earth**. There, they are refined.
The material and the higher, subtle elements—as they chain down and become denser, level after level, throughout the worlds—[descend] from the clearest clarity. Every descent leads toward density. The General Rule of these five levels follows the pattern of the **Sefirot** <note>The ten divine attributes</note>. For in the World of **Emanation** <term>Atzilut</term>, there are Sefirot, and all is Emanation. In the World of **Creation** <term>Beriah</term>, there are Sefirot, and all are of the nature of that level.

Consider a parable of a **silver merchant** <note>This metaphor explains how divine light remains the same "substance" but changes in quality or "purity" as it descends</note> who categorizes silver into four types: pure silver of the highest grade, silver that is pure but less so than the first, silver of fifty parts, and silver of thirty parts. He ensures that in each type there is no actual mixture resembling the other types. So too is the matter of the levels of the Sefirot: those of Emanation are more subtle than those in Creation; and those of Creation are more subtle than those in the World of **Formation** <term>Yetzirah</term>; and those of Formation are more subtle than those in the World of **Action** <term>Assiyah</term>.

This is the "chaining down" <note>original: "Hishtalshelut"</note> of the four elements. When all the worlds and Sefirot are chained down, they are included within the **Palaces** <term>Heichalot</term>, the paths, and the **Husks** <term>Klipot</term> <note>The external layers of impurity</note>. The Husks descend into the firmaments and constellations. Added to these four elements is the "matter" which is before our eyes. It is known that Emanation is a "curtain" <note>original: "Parsah"</note> for Creation, Creation for Formation, and Formation for Action. Similarly, in the World of Action, there is a chain of Husks. Within these three [lower worlds], there are "windows" <note>channels of light</note> between the worlds and the holy angels. That which is hidden from the holy angels exists within the levels and Palaces of Formation.

The Palaces are situated between the higher and lower levels, between the Sefirot themselves, which are the essence of the **Infinite** <term>Ein Sof</term> spreading out and vivifying them. From this, we know that these four elements are the same four elements found in the firmaments, though they are celestial/spherical there. These elements in the firmaments are the very same elements found in the World of Formation, and so on up to the highest levels. However, because of their "chaining down," they have become thickened/dense. As they move further from their source, they lose their refinement and become revealed as matter.

According to this, there is nothing in the world upon which the spiritual Power does not spread. However, by the nature of the Light—according to the Will of the Divine Light—it acts as a "curtain" for the other lower levels. Thus, it is revealed, becomes dense, and spreads from level to level until there is nothing found in the World of Action <note>the physical world</note> that does not contain spirituality according to its height and its distance from its source. Behold, when the "matter" of the lower sources is elevated to the levels of proximity to the subtle light, everything within it returns to being pure matter, like that higher level.

This is the secret of the World of Action which burns with the strength of the Great Fire. Things standing in their place [in the lower world] do not return to that same state here in Action. But if they are brought close to [higher] Action, the more they are brought closer, the more they will return to their source. This is the matter of the **Animal Soul** <term>Nefesh HaBehemis</term>. For when the four elements are rectified and mixed through the seeds of their death, that matter is strengthened and the "Living Soul" is extracted from it. Because the elements were refined in their completion, a higher supernal light is bound to them. Then, what was previously under the angels appointed over the elements changes its level and returns to be considered as receiving from a higher flow and light. This is through the refined moisture of that lower matter.

As the Sages said: "There is no herb on earth that does not have an angel above it striking it and saying 'Grow!'" <note>original: "גדל" (Gadal). This famous Midrash from Genesis Rabbah explains that physical growth is triggered by spiritual "striking" or transmission of energy</note>. The meaning of "striking" refers to the transmission and cause of the Higher Light into the herb's constellation <note>Mazzal</note> via the angel, who acts like a pipe for the ascending light in the secret of the World of Formation and the World of the Angels. For this, the angel is necessary.

<column-break/>

And the end of the fifteen dwellings will be essential, hovering over the Palaces and separating between holiness and impurity. For they shall be partitions between the Holy and the Impure. Through them, the lower dwellings are directed. They exist by the direction of the world that spreads out to prosecute and punish with judgment those who are forced by the outcomes of the spiritual radiance included within the inner Palaces. But "around the wicked they walk" (Psalm 12:9)—they go around, surrounding and desiring the Curtain, but they shall not enter within.

### Chapter 9: The Palaces

There are fifteen "windows"—the windows of **Wisdom** <term>Hokhmah</term>. There are thirty reasons for these fifteen windows.
In the Palaces are associated the matters of the Angels, and in general, all their affairs are taken in the form explained in the portions of *Pekudei* and *Ezekiel*. Similarly, they are not associated—so to speak—with the **Throne of Glory**. It is explained in the portion of *Pekudei* that the **Husk** <term>Klipah</term> is close to the Outer Palace. It is known that this Husk surrounds the world of **Metatron** <note>The supreme archangel and "Prince of the World"</note>.
The World of Angels: These Palaces are in the World of Angels. They rectify lack... [The text here refers to various counts of Palaces, often totaling seven].
The levels of the angels are included in the name of Metatron and the "House of the Right." The "River of Fire" <term>Nahar di-Nur</term> are the branches of the Sefirot spreading from the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term>, may she be blessed, into the World of Formation. They are called the "Fires of the Stream." Therefore, they need the "Element of the Transformation of Names" through prayer, so that the branches may be united back to their sources.
Therefore, all the essences of the Palaces are associated with the "Pure Mirror" <note>original: "Me'or"</note> within each one. Because of the branches spreading into Metatron (who is called the "Youth"), the branches are called "Windows." These windows are the ten spiritual lights given to her from the King's House, from where the Higher Sefirot spread with the Shekhinah. There, within the "Youth," the Shekhinah is called a "Covenant."

As explained, the inner levels mentioned are Palaces and "Garments" for the branches spreading from the Sefirot. Know that:
The **Palace of the Sapphire Pavement** <note>original: "Livnat ha-Sapir"</note> is the Palace for the branch spreading from **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. The branch spreading from the Shekhinah is included with Foundation in this Palace. Also, in the Sapphire Palace are the three spirits included in the seven, etc., as described in the portion of *Pekudei* and *Vayakhel*.
The **Palace of the Essence of Heaven** <note>original: "Etzem ha-Shamayim"</note> is the Palace for the branch of the "Voice" <note>likely Tiferet</note>.
The **Palace of Brightness** <note>original: "Nogah"</note> is the Palace for the branch of "Providence."
The **Palace of Merit** <note>original: "Zekhut"</note> is the Palace for the branch of **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>.
The **Palace of Love** <note>original: "Ahavah"</note> is the Palace for the branch of **Kindness** <term>Hesed</term>.
The **Palace of Will** <note>original: "Ratzon"</note> is the Palace for the branch of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, for it is said of it that it is the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term> as explained in the Gate of the Palaces.
The **Palace of the Holy of Holies** <note>original: "Kodesh Kodashim"</note> is the Palace for the branches of the "Three Upper Sefirot" <term>Keter, Hokhmah, Binah</term>.
All seven branches spread out. Above, in the ten levels of angels included in the six mentioned Palaces, there is a "Foundation of Foundations" and a secret of Kindness. This corresponds to the Palaces in the Sefirot and their union with the Earth. For the Palaces are from the levels of Formation and the Angels, while the level of the "Names" <note>Divine Names</note> is higher.

### Chapter 10: To Understand

The order: One must know how all existing things are within... and are divided into specific places and boundaries. Therefore, it is impossible to equate everything. The matter is that above there shall be...
