# The Book of Pomegranates: Gate 24, The Palaces

They rectify all the prayers and all the engagements in the Torah every day, and they pray and pray, a seal of strength until the break of dawn. Then, when the day begins and they gather to the firmament called the **Book of Remembrance**, a furrowed row shines there like a brilliance among the appointees, the guardians, and the expansive regions on this side of this Palace.

### Chapter 2: The Palace
The second is called the **World of Assembly**. This Palace has one height and thirty dwellings called a "world," and it is called "to the interior" and it returns also to the first Palace. Its intention is to shine within it, and it is included with one light, the full [angel] called **Hadarki**. Both of them are integrated with the Gracious One who serves in the Dream which is in the lower Palace. Their lives shall be further integrated, and the colors of the heavens shall be mixed. For every color, it is called the "World of the Heavens," but this Palace is not [just] the Palace of Distance and Swiftness; this Palace is the **Palace of Purity**.

It is the location for the nurturing of the prophets <note>original: "yenikat hanevi'im" - the spiritual source from which prophets draw their visions</note>. Know the matter of the place of the prophets' nurturing in the book, for the book is nothing compared even to **Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him** <note>original: "MaRa'AK" - an abbreviation for Moshe Rabbeinu Alav HaShalom</note>. The distinction between the prophecy of Moses and the other prophets is this: Moses would prophesy from the **Palace of Will**, which is the sixth Palace, by means of the union of **Harmony** <term>Tiferet</term> and **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term> which are revealed in this Palace. His prophecy was from the **Luminous Mirror** <note>a clear, direct spiritual vision</note> and its brilliance, and he did not need to look between himself and the Palace to observe with the eyes of prophecy. Therefore, his vision was not in a "vision" or "riddles." Regarding this matter, this Palace is in the aspect of Harmony, which is the Luminous Mirror for all other prophets who prophesy from the third Palace, which is the **Palace of Intention**. For the general rule is founded upon Harmony and Kingdom—at the conclusion of Harmony upon Kingdom—and it appears in Kingdom as the **Non-Luminous Mirror** <note>a clouded or indirect spiritual vision</note>. In the level of the Holy Height in its "smallness" <note>a state of diminished divine light</note>, which is the foundation of this Palace—the World of the Heavens—it is at the conclusion of Kingdom over Harmony, and it does not shine more than [for] the rest of the prophets. There is a combination and a duality between the **Sefirah** <note>Divine attribute</note> and the Palaces, and between them. Therefore, they need light for their strength, just as they alone [overcome] the illness; for as the partitions increase, the walls and the heights increase.

### Chapter 3: The Palace
The third is called **Intention** <term>Kavanah</term>. This Palace is appointed over the dwellers of the Holy Palaces. Regarding the lack of the "limbs" <note>referring to spiritual structures</note> that we mentioned, there is no explanation of the edge of the color, and it is not revealed at all except through the activity of the other lights within it. Then, through this, its light, color, and goodness are revealed from among the other colors of the lights. This union is distinct and is called **A.Z.** <note>likely a divine name or abbreviation</note>. This light is called "Prepared" and is from the "Holy Lip" that descends and flows from **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>. Through it, the other lower Palaces enter and are integrated into this Palace, and from its paths, they enjoy the Good.

### Chapter 4: The Palace
The fourth is called the **Palace of Merit**. Within this Palace, all merits and iniquities are judged, as well as all reward and punishment for all who keep the Torah. This Palace has one cycle called "Merit," and after it, the Palace of Merit is named. It is called **A.L.** <note>a Divine Name associated with power</note>, and in it, all the people of the world are judged. These are the daily deeds, and this merit is established. These [lights of] merit and life are seventy lights, and they all stand in a sort of circle like the **Sanhedrin** <note>the supreme legal assembly of ancient Israel, consisting of 71 judges</note>. From the middle, two lights emerge that stand to witness over human beings through the observation of the **Two Eyes of God** which watch over all the earth, named **Orphi**, **Tagrisel**, **Devriaz**, **Palmichal**, **Epimon**, **Shepichal**, and **Bolel**. They are the ones who look into the eyes of human beings. By them, every merit, image, and form in the world and in the upper realms is made.

<column-break/>

These two lights are received in this [Palace] and they testify before the Seventy. They judge the innocent and the guilty for good or for evil. These merits stand in the middle, and a commander protects with **Kindness** <term>Hesed</term>. There are also seventy to the right and seventy to the left, and all of them are [judged] by the hand of God. They are integrated into the Great Light called **Merit**. Observe that according to him, there are seventy to the right in Kindness and seventy to the left in **Glory** <note>referring to Gevurah/Severity</note>. The essence of the judgment is through the seventy who are joined by **Harmony** <term>Tiferet</term>, which is the decider between them.

### Chapter 5: The Palace
The fifth is called the **Palace of Love**. Within it hangs the sustenance and the life force of the other Palaces that were established. In this Palace, there is one cycle composed of four colors: **red, white, black, and green**. It is called **Toli**. He is the one who carries the established dwellings, and all the upper and lower keys are in his hand. All the gates of the hidden treasures are handed over to these lights. All of them stand integrated within it six times every day and emerge from it. In the "Second" that is in it are all the treasures and secrets of the mystery in the Orchard of Love, for there is the secret of the cleaving of all who cleave. All the souls that are destined to enter bodies are given life there. This Palace is never empty of the pleasure that rules there. It receives all the additional souls from **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>... and concerning this they said: "The Son of David [the Messiah] will not come until all the souls in the 'Body' <note>a heavenly storehouse of souls</note> are exhausted."

### Chapter 6: The Palace
The sixth is called the **Palace of Will**. This is because within it occurs the "Time of Will" <term>Et Ratzon</term> for all, and there the prayer ascends. For within it is the unification of **Harmony** <term>Tiferet</term> and **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. Therefore, Moses was called to the "Time of Will." And what is in the "Kissing"? It is the **Kiss of the Sublime Name**. All the Palaces are strengthened by this Palace, and all sustain one another within one another and are integrated within this Palace through the unification of prayer in a blended life-force. For they are further divided in the "Orchard," as explained in the words of **Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, of blessed memory** <note>the traditional author of the Zohar</note>.

### Chapter 7: The Palace
The seventh is called the **Holy of Holies**. This Palace is supreme, ascending and sanctifying all the lights, blessed be He. No form or thing can be grasped within it. Inside this Palace, a **Curtain** <term>Parochet</term> is spread to divide between the Holy and the Holy of Holies. Inside the Curtain are two **Cherubim**. This Palace is the totality of the crowns <note>the Keter level</note> through the prayer of Israel to our Father. Within the Curtain, there inside the Holy of Holies, is the **Shekhinah** <note>the Divine Presence</note>. The beginning of the reception of the flow is from the "Supreme Beard" <note>the flow of mercy from the highest level of divinity</note>, which is the Greatness. This Palace receives the souls from Understanding—those souls destined to be sanctified in the color of the **Pious King**. Thus far, I have reached in my summary of the matter of the Palaces. The student will find everything at length in the **Holy Zohar** and in the **Holy Orchard** <note>referring to Cordovero's book, Pardes Rimonim</note>.

### Chapter 8: And in the Zohar
In the portion of *Terumah*, it says as follows: "There are six dwellings, which are level upon level, and all of them are dwellings for supreme angels, hosts upon hosts, and so it is below. All of them grasp one another to make everything one. There are six dwellings above, and this one that comes [is] a curtain of light for them. They all stand and look... these levels and others." This dwelling is a place nearby... These dwellings are places of life and rest, which are the "subtle ones" mentioned in the portion of *Pekudei*. Therefore, in the portion of *Pekudei*, they are called "Palaces" <term>Heichalot</term>, and in the portion of *Terumah*, they are called "Dwellings" <term>Medorin</term>. This is the matter we mentioned at the start... and so it is in the **Tikunim** [of the Zohar] where the six Palaces are mentioned.

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 24 — The Palaces

And this level of ascent and this rest shall be in the aforementioned place. It is found that the "pillars" of the **World of Action** <note>original: *Assiyah* — the lowest of the four spiritual worlds, representing the physical and near-physical realms</note> and the **Husks** <note>original: *Kelipot* — the shells of impurity or spiritual debris</note> are otherwise a danger, for they act as the wicked within the kingdom of the attribute of Judgment. These are the holy angels, for as the judges instruct, so the officers and the lower ranks of Action carry out. Therefore, as long as the righteous person stands within their soul, the "grace of Creation" from the **Kingdom** <note>original: *Malchut* — the final Sefirah or divine emanation</note> is upon them. They shall not be beneath that Kingdom or subject to the separation of the "branches of the spark," because the return of their soul will be higher than them. From the soul, the source of the **Divine flow** <note>original: *Shefa* — the spiritual energy or abundance that sustains the worlds</note> comes to them.

This continues until we reach the strength of the constellations and the natural laws, according to the law of the place itself and the paths of the Torah. From this, the scripture and the **Supernal Light** are divided. If you were to descend beneath the governance of the matters of the **World of Formation** <note>original: *Yetzirah* — the world of angels and emotions</note>, this would be the matter of what they say: that in the Palaces, they weigh, write, set aside the innocent, and convict the wicked. Because they are close to emotion and change, not all actions are identical. Through that "flame" <note>Moses's unique path</note>, the Light and the Supernal Providence depart from him and pass into the hands of the "Tablets" and the masters of the World of Formation. 

Even though the main part of the assembly is the **Divine Presence** <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note>, and everyone accompanies Her, one is not like the other in any respect. The quality that passes through the soul is such that every living being becomes thicker and coarser than that which is "above" it. For even though in the essence of the light, they are entirely equal, nonetheless, according to the "skin" of the recipient—through the distant World of Action—what one receives is through a second, thicker level. How much more so for one who receives it from within a murky and dark tenth level. 

So too is the matter of the angels at the end of the chain. The Supernal Light begins for them like a window over a table; when one looks into its hollow space, the light is diminished and distant. Because of this, the angels are called "portions of the cord," since the light spreads out into many sparks and "clothes" itself in each and every angel. Thus, the angel is like a vapor compared to the blackness of the recognition of the Blessed One. He clothes Himself in them, and they are like clouds. 

Consider the parable of a great fire burning inside a furnace that has narrow windows. The light passes through the windows and clothes itself in the opening and around the windows, giving life to the altar. There is no doubt that the sparks and the light are one in every sense; they do not divide into many sparks except from the perspective of the many windows. That spiritual "pipe" is within the hollow of the Palace, and its nurturing is through it. This is the reason for the foundation of the Palaces in the mystery of prayer: so that the sparks clothed within them may be ignited. This matter is not regarding the Palaces themselves—meaning the angels—but regarding the light that clothes itself within them. Through their existence, the matters of the flow and the light are upon them in the Palaces until the "dwellings" are ignited one by one. This is the power of the higher level—that the "soulic" angels are ignited by the Presence that spreads through them. From our level, this matter is understood: even though the Presence is not divided into parts, it is divided into parts relative to the body. Yet, our limbs are ignited as members of the soul in proportion to the spread of the soul in the body. So too, the angels are ignited by the light that spreads through their members—the angels being the "Supernal Members" of the spreading light. 

Thus, the level of the soul is defined as being higher for the **Righteous** than the level of the **Angel**. For the angel is a "body" made of simple elements that approach the flame and the light flowing upon them. The soul of the righteous is the story of the spreading light that clothes itself inside the angel.

<column-break/>

Thus we find the relationship of the angel to the soul is like the relationship of the body to the soul; eventually, it shall live. And this indicates:

### Chapter 12
Since I have written that the level of the **Righteous** <note>original: *Tzaddik*</note> is greater than the level of the **Angel**, one might doubt the status of **Enoch** and **Elijah**. Why are they mentioned as being at the level of angels? This would seem to be no advantage or benefit at all, for they would have descended from their level! They were at the level of the Righteous, which is higher and higher, yet now they were raised only to the category of Formation, which is the category of angels. 

One must say that the soul of Enoch ascended to the place of souls in the **Upper Garden of Eden**, along with all the other righteous. He lost nothing of his status. Rather, it was the Divine Will for him to act in the **Lower Garden of Eden**, just as all the spirits of the righteous stand there. It is not that they do not ascend further; rather, he merits to ascend and be part of the Inner Light, to be a blessing for the assembly of the flow that descends from the Presence, to transmit through his hand, and to distribute to all the other angels and all the other lower worlds. 

Furthermore, his physical body and his "elemental foundation" were turned into a "torch of fire," as it is written: "He was turned into spirits." This is not the case with other righteous people. For other righteous people, the soul is stripped from the body, and the physical matter is consumed in the dust, while their spirit clothes itself in another garment in the likeness of their body, enabling them to be protected in the Lower Garden of Eden. But with Enoch, his body and his spirit both turned spiritual; he ascended on high to become an eternal angel, while his soul ascended higher and higher to its place.

The reason Enoch reached this level is that he merited to be a "Supernal Throne" <note>original: *Kiseh Elyon*</note>. Therefore, by the start of the Sabbath—as written in the *Zohar on the Song of Songs*—he merited to inherit the place of **Adam the First Man** <note>original: *Adam HaRishon*</note>. For when the Holy One, Blessed be He, created Adam, the main intent of the Presence was for him to be the source of all the flow for the upper and lower beings, so that they would all be strengthened by him. All their intent was only to receive flow from him. Enoch, in his perfection, became a blessing before the Presence, becoming the source of flow for all. Just as he lived and removed death from himself, he removed death from all who inherit from him.

### Chapter 13
Regarding this matter, it is also said concerning **Elijah**. However, his case was not exactly like Enoch's. For with Enoch, his spirit and his physical body ascended together as one, as his body was turned into a torch of fire. But with Elijah, his spirit was stripped from his body and clothed in another garment and ascended on high, while his first body was hidden and concealed in the storm. He descends to perform missions by clothing himself in it. 

As I wrote in the portion of *Vayikach* <note>original: *Parashat Vayikach*</note> in the book *Mi Alah Shamayim* ("Who Has Ascended to Heaven"), the levels of Enoch and Elijah are greater than the other righteous. One might doubt why the merit of the world depends on this. It must be said that the level of the "White" <note>referring to a spiritual purity</note> is a "Chariot" <note>original: *Merkavah* — a vehicle for Divine manifestation</note> for the Presence. As I wrote regarding the Palaces, the level of the soul is greater than that of the angels. This is the level of the Chariot: the soul of the Righteous who lives merits to be a chariot and becomes a "Palace" for the Presence. Within that soul, the Presence clothes itself along with the matters of the **Sefirot** <note>the ten attributes of God</note>. That soul receives a blessing from the source of the cascading flow, and through that soul, all the angels and all the lower worlds send for and receive that flow.

It clarifies that Enoch and Elijah did not lose status by becoming angels; rather, they became unique "Chariots" or conduits for Divine energy, with Enoch specifically inheriting the cosmic role intended for Adam.</summary>

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 24 — The Palaces

From the passages of the overflowing light to all the resting places, and these are not accessible to every person. For the status of **Kindness** <note>original: *Chesed* — here referring to the soul of a righteous person characterized by the attribute of Mercy</note> is greater than the status of an **angel**. For even as matter, the soul prevails over them; all the parts of its physical matter are refined more and more, and a **Supernal Light** from above is added to it. It rises through the levels, adding a perfected holiness from the overflowing light, and it surpasses the angel. 

This is because the soul of kindness is comprised of **Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge** <note>original: *CHaBaD* — the three intellectual Sefirot</note>. This is because all things in the world descend from level to level; that is to say, they descend down to the Earth. He shall be elevated in the level of Kindness through the Holy One, Blessed be He, until He grants him merit this time through the Supernal Soul of Kindness, the aspects included in him. And this time, our Sages of blessed memory <note>original: *RaZaL*</note> will not return to eating meat, because he will have no closeness to the "Nest" <note>referring to the lower physical source</note>, on account of the evil of his deeds or the goodness of his days. For the vitality of the **beasts** comes from the side of holiness, and this will be for the light of the **Husk** <note>original: *Kelipah* — the shell of impurity</note>; the more the wicked and the narrow gain merit, they shall come from what was mentioned. A portion is to be exempted according to natural tendencies, etc., for Kindness can ascend by its nature to the level of Kindness in small matters. My spirit yearns for the element in the actions of superior things—like those who know how to refine silver and separate it from the tin. Refined silver is worthy for him to engage with, rather than making silver from tin. Because it is a more exalted and "opened" level, and with what has been explained: that the elements shall be and shall be received through **purity and holiness**, or through the **Husk and impurity**. For there are things from the "smallness of the Husk," and the light shining in them will be from the side of Holiness. ### Chapter 11
To understand well the matter of the angels with an explanation, and to expand upon the clarification: It has already been explained in the Gate of the "Order of Weakening" <note>original: *Seder ha-Challishut* — the process by which Divine light loses intensity as it descends</note> that the entire essence of the "Visions" was only to be moved by the essence of the "Lashings" for the sake of changing the attributes and actions which are never appropriate for Him in His simplicity. Our light is the "End of the Rigors"; because they are close to the Source, changes are not attributed to them. For it is necessary for the **Externalities** to be clothed in **Creation** <note>original: *Beriah* — the second highest world</note>. Just as the relationship of the "Governor" is to the "Visions," so is the relationship of the "Visions" to Creation. And since these levels still have a closeness to the Supernal Roots, and the changes multiplying within them have no end, Creation was not able to receive them until it was necessary for it to be clothed in **Formation** <note>original: *Yetzirah* — the third world, the realm of angels</note>. The relationship of Creation to Formation is like the relationship of the Visions to Creation. And since the essences of Formation are holy and pure, and the actions of reception and the "sacrifice of the two times" are close to the external and governed visions...

<column-break/>

...that which is wrapped by the specific **star** assigned to it. For the stars are in the **World of Action** <note>original: *Assiyah* — the physical and lowest spiritual world</note>, and they are ministers and servants to the "All" of Formation. Because of this, sometimes the growth of plants is attributed to an **angel** and sometimes to a **star**, and in all of it, one single intention arises. 

In this manner, the matter of the "Spread of the Holy One, Blessed be He" proceeds. For through Kindness, the four elements are repaired, and they are formed in the image of **Kindness** <note>Chesed</note>, by having the attributes formed in a manner more weighted toward compassion, with their intention focused on their closeness to the Supernal Light. See what was the source beneath the angels appointed over the World of Action. When the light is perfected from a more supernal flow and light through the angel appointed over the "nature of the power," the vitality of the light overflowing in it will be like a **living creature** <note>original: *Chayah*</note>; it will not have within it a spirit (*Ruach*) or a soul (*Neshama*). And upon the animal, there will be a **living soul** <note>original: *Nefesh HaChayut*</note>, and upon the "Livyah," it will have a soul, for this is the principle. For in the "Splendor of the Master of All," its elements will separate and the Supernal Light will be dismantled in the vitality from the edge of its choice. 

It shall not have a spirit or a soul that would ascend... for it was only in the vitality of the Splendor that flies in the air. For when it approaches the World of Action, it lives there by the light, and by the light of the Voice shall be its existence. But as it approaches the "back parts of the Palace," the light will fade from upon it due to its distance. All of its vitality will be diminished, like a bird caught above at the source. This is the meaning of the verse: *"the spirit of the beast that goes down downward to the earth,"* <note>Ecclesiastes 3:21</note> meaning it shall return to its primary foundation, the **element of Earth**, as with all the other parts of its elements. 

As Kindness lived at first, furthermore, its fate will be determined by necessity through the expulsion of the changing classes of the "Book of Descent," such as the signs in the chapter of the "Thirty Deaths." Spirit within spirit in **Victory** (*Netzach*), we have arranged ten things for it, etc. For there will not be within it a spirit and a soul, but merely a general vitality, like the vitality of a beast. And even if its fall is from a vitality more excellent than that of a beast, its end will be the character of its form—which is more refined than the movement of a beast and closer to the source of the Supernal Light—not that it possesses a spirit and a soul. 

And when it fades and is obscured, the matter will be a transformation of the parts of its soul and its elements into the natural attributes dispersed in the "Lashing." And the "dust" shall return to the "parts of the Rigor," licking the vision in the "Becomings of the Palaces," but not in the "Mountains of Separation." In this is the end of sorrow and the "Husk," for there will be no loss of spirit or soul in them, for they are the vitalities of the parts of the elements... through this will be the "Secret of the Voices." For through Kindness, the four elements will be repaired by the power of the "Ear of the Vision," and they will be formed in the image of Kindness by having the four elements formed in Kindness in an exalted form, like the glory of Kindness. It will approach the Supernal Light in vitality from light and from light to the "Secondary" and the **Husk** shall be from the levels, and it will be a "Exile." According to the power of the soul and the living creature, etc., in the final vitality, there shall be clothed in it **Spirit and Supernal Joy**. And because of this, for the sake of Kindness, they acted with kindness.

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 25: The Exchanges

In a precious and pure manner. And it is specifically assigned to the waste, etc. 
The way its own vitality works is that when the **Shell** <note>original: *Klipa* — the kabbalistic term for forces of impurity that "envelop" holiness like a husk</note> is revealed in its place, and its way of living is recognized, the Shells will suck from the "surplus" of the Supernal flow. ### Chapter 2: Regarding the Source
It is good to wonder further regarding the matter of the Shells: what is the source of their habitual existence? Do they evolve and descend from above? Every "effect" must be surrounded by its "cause"; if so, then every holy thing, every breath, and every pure flow that descends below would, God forbid, be damaged, as it would necessarily have to pass through the Shells. 

This relates to the mystery written in **Ezekiel** <note>referring to the vision of the Divine Chariot in Ezekiel 1</note> regarding the "living creature" <note>original: *Chayah*</note>. There is no thing surrounding it, not even one outer layer. For the "firmament" is raised above to receive from beneath the **Throne of Glory** <note>original: *Kisse HaKavod*</note>, and all matters descend from the heavens. The entire world ascends and descends through the "living force" <note>original: *Chayut*</note>. This is the secret of the verse: "And this is the gate of heaven." 

It is clear that there are places where the Shells are set apart on all sides. In the **Land of Israel** <note>original: *Eretz Yisrael*</note>, the Shell shall not rule, even if the "center of the House" is missing, as explained in the chapter on "Tikunim." There they answered that even though the center is certainly on the side of the Shell, God forbid, when holiness was destroyed, the Shell entered the Land of Israel. However, that Shell was a "thin shell" from the side of holiness, meant to protect and prevent the other Shells from spreading. 

As for what is written about the holy and pure ones who ascend and descend through the "living force," the writing is only considered "pure" outside the Land. This raises a difficulty for us regarding the **Generation of the Desert**: for the atmosphere of the Land of Israel went with them. If you do not say this, how could they eat "holy things"? Furthermore, in the portion of *Terumah*, regarding the Tabernacle, it is written that the **Divine Presence** <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note> was placed there. It was found that a "white cloud" and a screen were there to hide the building. The essence is that the *Shekhinah* passed through the Shells and created a gate and a way to ascend and descend. This "living force" went with them until they entered the Land of Israel, to its proper place, and there is the rest of holiness, for there is the "gate of heaven."

### Chapter 3: The Purpose of the Shells
After the structure of the Shells has been explained in order, one might ask: what is the benefit of the Shells? It must be said that they were necessary in order to punish those who fail and to turn the rebellious back. Those who merit will be elevated because of the **Evil Inclination** <note>original: *Yetzer HaRa*</note>. 

One might ask: If there were no Shells, there would be no evil. Know that the Shells were created by the "Universal Will" because Kindness and Strength <note>original: *Chasadim* and *Gevurot*</note needed to receive their nourishment and sustenance from the power of **Judgment** <note>original: *Din*</note>. If all were non-choosing angels, the world would not be ordered based on actions, for they would be forced in their deeds. 

Therefore, it was necessary for there to be a "Man of Choice," composed of the **Good Inclination** and the **Evil Inclination**. If he chooses the good, it is his will; if he tends toward the evil, he becomes defiled by it. Thus, his reward or punishment is according to his ways and the fruit of his deeds. The way to look at the "waste" <note>the Klipot</note> is that they serve 

<column-break/>

to break the wicked. This is explained in the Zohar, portion of *Terumah*. 

Furthermore, it can be said that the Evil Inclination was necessary because the actions of "Intellectual Mercy" are entrusted to man. Man had to be composed of Judgment and Mercy through the Evil Inclination and the Good Inclination, which evolves opposite the Shell. Through these two branches, man can affect the Supernal details above. 

As long as a man conducts himself in the ways of righteousness and integrity, the Shell serves as an aid and support to the Good Inclination. But when a man strengthens his Evil Inclination over the Good through the ways of wickedness, the Shell gains strength. Then the power of Judgment is awakened, and the Shell sucks from it. If Judgment overpowers Mercy, the attribute of Mercy turns into Judgment. 

Conversely, when a man strengthens his Good Inclination over the Evil, the power of the Shell is humbled, and Judgment is sweetened. Then the power of Mercy prevails until the attribute of Judgment turns into Mercy. Regarding this secret, it is said that the **Righteous** <note>original: *Tzadikim*</note> turn the Attribute of Judgment into the Attribute of Mercy, and the wicked do the opposite. This is the secret of the "branches" included in the soul of man, which he has the power to tilt to either side. 

Furthermore, the Shells surround holiness to create a "purposeful man." When a man sins, a gap is opened for the Shells. But he is meant to overcome the Evil Inclination so that the Shell is broken and humbled. Through this, he repairs what was damaged and purifies his existence. When the Shell is subdued, it returns to holiness, and the person enters into holiness as in the beginning, when everything was pure. In this way, the Good Inclination purifies and refines the Evil. As the sages said regarding the "Firstborn of a Donkey" <note>a reference to the laws of *Peter Chamor*—redeeming a mundane/unclean animal</note>, it is in man's power to repair and refine the Evil Inclination to return it to its source.

### Chapter 4: The Mimicry of the Shells
To understand the matter of the Shells well, one must know that the Shells exist before Holiness like **"an ape before a man"** <note>original: *K'kof bifnei adam* — a classic kabbalistic metaphor for how the forces of impurity mimic the structure of the divine realms</note> in their arrangements and actions. Just as all Holiness draws souls, flow, and nourishment for all that evolves from it, so too the Shell draws souls, flow, and nourishment for all creatures that evolve from it. This is the meaning of Holy and Shell, Pure and Impure. 

And just as Holiness is categorized into various orders—Mercy and Judgment, evolving into **Ten Sefirot** <note>the ten divine emanations</note> and levels, arranged in Seven Palaces, and revealed in three colors (White, Green, Red) as seen in the secret of the Rainbow—so too the Shells are tied in three knots: Impure White, Red, and Green. 

For there is an "Impure White," and likewise a "Red" that signifies excessive forbidden passion, and a "Green" associated with the "gallbladder" and the "bitter bile," which makes the face turn pale. These evolve and spread into Ten Sefirot of the "Other Side." 

The first of these is called **Tamuniah** <note>a name for a specific impure power</note>, whose intent is to confuse holiness, God forbid. Some read it as **Tachmuniah**, from the language of "consolation" <note>original: *Tanchumim*</note>, because she presents herself as a consolation to entice man—a "servant who would rule." 

The second is called **Aznitah**, from the language of "matter/concern" <note>original: *Inyan*</note>. The meaning is that she acts as a "separating screen" between Israel and their Father in Heaven...

### Chapter 15: Concerning the Nature of Angels

And after the nature of the angels' structure and their levels has been clarified, it remains for us to explain other necessary matters in this regard. For angels desire to change and clothe themselves in the air and elements of the World of Action <note>original: *Asiyah* — the lowest of the four kabbalistic worlds, representing the physical universe</note> and to appear to human beings. This is similar to what was explained to our master Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai (peace be upon him) in this work <note>referring to the Zohar</note>, in the portion of *Vayera*. It is written that the King <note>God</note> would not allow the angels to be "barefoot" <note>unclothed in physical matter</note> while in this world, within the human eye's perception. Therefore, they were forced to choose a physical composition and body, and to draw from the center of their gathering place according to the flow bestowed upon them from the "Source of Wealth," like Abraham—of whom it is written "and they ate" <note>Genesis 18:8</note>, as explained there in the Zohar.

They are sustained in the holy palaces; some draw from the aspect of **Severity** <note>original: *Gevurah* — the attribute of judgment and restraint</note>, and others draw from the **Beauty of the Tiferet**. It is not a simple matter, for there is a difference between "drawing nourishment" <note>original: *yenika*</note> and "being incorporated." As you have seen, the sustenance and food of the angels—meaning their existence—is from the flow of the Sefirot. However, their nourishment for the sake of performing actions comes from the "good qualities" according to the variation of the actions known to them. They act according to the functions of the Sefirot and are named after those Sefirot. For example, **Gabriel** is called "Power" <note>original: *Koach*</note> after the attribute of Severity (*Gevurah*); **Michael** after the attribute of Kindness (*Chesed*), and so on. The reason is that from the Sefirot, lights spread forth, and through that arousal, the actions are performed. The actual work of their action is the spreading and illumination of the angels. Therefore, they are named after the Sefirot and after the action of the Sefirot's vitality which enters each of them. 

Furthermore, we have a general rule regarding the numerical values: every angel whose name ends in **Lamed (30)** <note>original: *L*</note> draws its nourishment from the attribute of Kindness (*Chesed*). If it ends in **Yod-He (15)** <note>original: *Y-H*</note>, its nourishment is from the attribute of Beauty (*Tiferet*). If it ends in a plain **Nun (50)** <note>original: *N*</note>, its nourishment is from the attribute of Severity (*Gevurah*). There is support for this in the verses concerning numbers.

## Gate Twenty-Five: Explaining the Matters of the Shells

And there is another aspect... from which the "Human" <note>the archetype</note> descends into a more pure place. The reason explained is that he shall be sanctified through the blood of the **Shell** <note>original: *Klipa* — the "husk" of impurity</note>. It shall be clarified and established from it... things that are refined. It is not that they are like a human being, God forbid, but through the process of evolution and refinement, they are elevated and transformed... and from it, the waste <note>original: *pesolet*</note> is established. 

There is support for this in the Zohar, portion of *Terumah*, on the verse "Let there be light." It is written: five times "Light," then five times "Day," then five times "Firmament." These are three levels... and all are included in the Infinite. Since the birth of "Man" <note>the spiritual structure</note> begins with the refinement of light—as it is written, "Light is sown for the righteous"—afterward the light spreads and becomes like water, and then it congeals and becomes more material, in the mystery of the "Firmament," etc. After it was explained that the vitality of the "conceptions" and "refinements" is in the attribute of Severity (*Gevurah*), we must wonder how the Shells (*Klipot*) evolved from there through the levels of holiness to their place. The answer is that only the "Severities" (*Gevurot*) were explained as evolving from them...

<column-break/>

It is obvious that the "Male" aspect refers to the evolution of the flow that spreads to all worlds. As long as the **Shekhinah** <note>the Divine Presence</note> fills the Righteous One <note>original: *Tzadik* — the Sefirah of Yesod</note> and the aspect of the "Sign of the Earth," she will not clothe herself in **Metatron** <note>the highest angel, the "Prince of the Countenance"</note> in a way that he becomes the primary commander with a greater abundance than his level. Then it will be revealed... whether during his life or after his death. This is a high level... like the "Ancient Radiance." There are four aspects:
1. The smallest of all: the aspect of the angels. They are "Severities" for the spirits; the Supernal Light clothes itself in them. They are called the "Stones of the Chariot."
2. Greater than the first: the aspect of the Prophets. They are "Severities" and spirits of the Supernal Light from the attribute of Beauty (*Tiferet*) spreading within them, as this secret is revealed in the Zohar, portion of *Vayechi*.
3. The aspect of the Chariot of angels and the righteous: this is the aspect of **Metatron**.
4. The aspect of the "Garments": all those who are a chariot to the Sefirah in the aforementioned way...

### Chapter 14: Regarding Those Who Are Worthy and Unworthy

The general rule emerging from this is that there are times of "Grace" for man, and times of "Flaw," God forbid. There are matters that are included... and appear to human beings in many colors, according to the secret that was revealed to them. This is most hidden in the mystery of "Man," etc. One can hear this in the words of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai (of blessed memory)... because of the great addition of the holiness of the Supernal Vitality. So too is it clarified in the Zohar, portion of *Vayigash*: "All the life-forces of the world... from that place they emerge and go forth..."

### Chapter 1: How Impurity Emerges from Purity

After it was explained in the previous gate that everything that enters evolves from the foundations of the Supernal... the pure and the clean, we must wonder: from where did the Shells (*Klipot*) come, and how did the impure come from the pure? The answer is that the truth is that from Above, no evil thing descends. For Above, all matters are refined to the ultimate thinness, cleansed of all "clothing" and "composition," and emerge from the Supernal Light. Their descent follows the order of the levels, and from level to level, they are revealed, thickened, and become more material until the vitality of things is recognizable... like food and waste. 

From within the "inclusion," the waste <note>original: *pesolet*</note> is established. This is like the spreading of the branches; there remains "cloudy water." They evolved downward from level to level until they became thick and material, until the holiness was "clothed" within all the Shells, as explained in the portion of *Terumah*. 

This is also a parable of the "nourishment of grain." In a place where there is waste, when a person eats it, it is unavoidable that waste will be formed in his intestines. At the time the person eats, all that waste is for the purpose of the movement of the colors <note>meaning the metabolic process</note> from eating to digestion, and it must pass through the place of the waste.

-># Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 26: The Palaces of Exchanges<-

The aforementioned shall be general principles regarding the matters of these Palaces. The "Shells" <note>original: *Kliphot* — the spiritual layers of impurity that conceal divine light</note> and the Palaces are all one and the same thing. Corresponding to these seven Palaces, there are seven types of the Evil Inclination <note>original: *Yetzer HaRa*</note>, as explained here regarding the Palaces. Therefore, the Evil Inclination is called by seven different names. Corresponding to the seven cavities of these Palaces, the souls of the wicked descend—the lowest among them being the most cursed of the wicked. All the "good things" that come to them enter from within the aforementioned Gehenna <note>Purgatory/Hell</note>. May the Merciful One save every son of Israel from them and from their bread. See further in the Zohar, portion of *Pekudei*, and in this "Holy Orchard" <note>original: *Pardes HaKodesh* — referring to Rabbi Moshe Cordovero’s primary work, *Pardes Rimmonim*</note>, and you will see everything at length. You will also find it in the short pamphlet we have composed within this small work.

The flight of the Tablets mentioned in the *Book of Formation* <note>original: *Sefer Yetzirah* — one of the oldest extant books on Jewish mysticism</note>: the Tablets were like lightning. The spiritual essence of the letters within them supported the Tablets in the hands of Moses. Once the Tablets and their spiritual essences flew away, the Tablets became heavy in his hands; they fell and were broken. This is the secret of the burning of the Torah scroll of Rabbi Hanina ben Teradyon <note>A 2nd-century sage and martyr who was burned at the stake wrapped in a Torah scroll; he famously told his students he saw the parchment burning but the letters flying up to heaven</note>. It is also the secret of the two tears one makes upon seeing a Torah scroll that was burned—meaning, to return in this book to the spiritual essence of the letters. 

This is the secret of what our Sages, of blessed memory, taught: "And it was engraved upon them" <note>Exodus 32:16</note>. Anyone who erases the engravings of the King is like one who swears by Him in vain. Even when children go to school and point to the Torah with their fingers, the Holy One, Blessed be He, says: "And his foot..." <note>uncertain reference, likely regarding the physical contact with the sacred</note>. Do not read "and they tested" but "and they were born."

There is a distinction between the written letters and the "plantings of the mouth" <note>articulated speech</note>. The written ones are like a body, while the articulations in the mouth are their spiritual essence. This is the reason for what is written: "The Torah of the mouth." For the Written Torah is spirituality in a high place, and the mouth treads upon it to express it. This is why it is written in script. The Oral Torah <note>original: *Torah she-be'al peh*</note> is itself the "case" and the "flute" for it. 

The letters fixed in the mouth are like a body compared to the letters engraved upon the heart. Just as certain "cakes" <note>original: *levivot* — a play on *lev* (heart)</note> in the heart crown Him with wisdom, this matter is applied to each letter individually. However, when they are joined in the form of writing and words, the measure of their spirituality is according to the form of the word and the number of its letters. Afterward, a general spirituality that includes them all is added. This is not counted as forty-nine for each letter individually, but rather from their gathering, a beautiful action is formed that is greater than any letter alone. 

From this, the enlightened one will understand a word from among the words and behold the powers of the internal letters within it, and the additional movement of those powers—one power within another through various aspects. These powers are awakened in the Upper Stream to perform that specific action. Furthermore, a new understanding of spirituality will be formed from it, which will rise and bind itself to the Source until it hastens to perform its action with alacrity. This is the secret of the "Intention of the Names" and the "Intention of Prayer" <note>original: *Kavanat HaShemot* and *Kavanat HaTefillah* — meditative focuses used in Kabbalistic prayer</note. To understand this matter well, one must study Psalm 72 and Psalm 12, etc. Their shapes and forms are not equal in spirituality; they change according to their combination and the place they occupy. These are precious things to be interpreted according to the intent of the "Treasury." As it says: "Ten attributes..." <note>unclear reference</note>. In the writings of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, of blessed memory, we have expanded on this in many places. As explained: the essence is their spirituality and their "joints," and with what is written, the power of all time is called forth.

<column-break/>

And regarding the aforementioned Palaces, we have written about them in the Zohar, portion of *Pekudei*, and all that is added to them. They all have one window open to the lower dwelling. The holiness and the internal "Shells" descend through a small window like a pinhole. The lower one is wide, and from it they ascend and recognize the "magic" <note>original: *kessem*</note> of the laws of the night and the holy knot. They spread through the three dwellings of the wicked. When the holiness remains, it ascends and spreads until the "night vision," and during the night vision, they return and enter the aforementioned Female aspect and are tied below in their place so they cannot cause harm. It appears that the Palaces of Impurity are three Palaces and "garments" surrounding it, in the sign of impurity mentioned in the Gate of Holiness.

# Gate Twenty-Seven: Explaining the Secret of the Letters

## Chapter 1
Many people have thought that the Holy Letters are merely conventional <note>original: *haskamiyot* — arbitrary symbols agreed upon by humans for communication</note>, and that the Creator simply placed these structures as tools for connection in the "Tablets of the Book of Languages," based on a consensus established by a leader or by Moses our teacher through the advice of a prophetic spirit. According to this view, the essence of the letters would only be to reveal the intent of the speaker and to represent the will of the writer. If this were true, there would be no general benefit to this book. Heaven forbid that a person should think this! If one were to learn the words of this book with such a mindset, they would not be able to "atone" for their lack of power, though they might receive some reward for their labor.

However, the matter is not so! On the contrary, within the holy characters there is an inner essence, a spirituality, and an eternal life-force. This is explained in the Zohar, portion of *Behaalotecha*, which states that the Torah is divided into four parts:
1.  **The simple stories of the Torah:** Words as they are written. This is called the "Outer Garment," which contains what is hidden from us according to our ability. One who thinks the Torah is only its simple stories—meaning they learn only with a physical intellect—lacks the other parts.
2.  **The "Bodies" of the Torah:** This refers to the logical derivations of the Midrashim, which are like the "limbs" of the Torah.
3.  **The "Secrets" of the Torah:** The reception of the hidden mysteries of the Torah, such as the Zohar and similar works, which are the "Inner Spirit" of the Torah.
4.  **The Life-force and Spirituality:** The "Tablets of the Torah" which exist in the depth of goodness, through whose power one can choose worlds. This is called the "Soul of the Soul" <note>original: *Neshama l'Neshama*</note>. For if one knows their existence, the whole becomes clear. The intention here is the holy, internal, and spiritual essences.

## Chapter 2
And so, the letters relate to their internal essence. For every single letter and living being <note>original: *chayah*</note> has a broad choice to incline toward a specific spirituality, according to the power of the Supernal Action. Each one indicates a spiritual form and a glorious secret. This flows from the *Sefirah* <note>Divine emanation</note> and its essence, level by level, through the process of "Evolution" <note>original: *hishtalshelut* — the chain-like descent of divine light into matter</note> until it reaches that living force. The power of the letters is gathered and included in the spirituality of the Name. 

According to this, when a person mentions or expresses one of the letters in a book and contemplates the holy spiritual form, holy forms emerge from his mouth, ascending and binding themselves to the Essence. This applies not only to speaking them but also to their writing; the supernal spirituality rests upon them. This is the secret of "Reading the Torah Scroll." The letters *Tet* and *Samekh* in the Tablets stood by a miracle <note>According to tradition, the letters were engraved all the way through the stone; because *Tet* (in some scripts) and *Samekh* are closed shapes, their centers should have fallen out, but they miraculously stayed suspended</note>, for the spirituality sustained the miracle of the engraving.

-># Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 24: The Shells<-

[The Divine Presence] draws nourishment from the "foreign side" <note>original: *Nekhur* — referring to the realm of impurity</note> of impurity, from the surplus; and ultimately a small amount of good remains within it that is appropriate for the Shell <note>original: *Klipha* — the spiritual casing that conceals holiness</note>. The matter is thus: since the Kingdom <note>original: *Malkhut* — the lowest of the ten Sephirot</note> lacks the Understanding to awaken and prevent it, the Serpent then awakens and brings accusations against the good deeds performed in the world. The power of harsh Judgment is then awakened against the "educators" of Israel. If this Judgment were to flow directly into the Divine Presence <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note>, she would be drawing from the impurity within it. It would flow as "surplus," and the Serpent would be coiled around her heels to receive this bitter flow. For this is a power, and that is a power; the Divine Presence tastes the bitterness of this evil flow. This is the secret of "he cast it into her" <note>referring to the influence of the "other side"</note>. It is not that they have the power to cause the Serpent to rise and press upward toward the heights, God forbid, but rather that through its awakening, the bitterness of death is flowed upon her.

The name of this bitter flow is, God forbid, the secret of "impurity" <note>original: *Niddah* — ritual un-readiness</note>. Because the Divine Presence draws from it, she is confined, like a "hoof" <note>original: *Parsah* — a barrier</note>... until she is purified. The Shells never actually enter into the midst of Holiness; rather, they spread around it, always surrounding and striking at it from their apertures. They are like three colors and the secret of the three surrounding Shells, including all their branches, resembling the shells of a walnut. However, the order of the colors is reversed from that of Holiness. In Holiness, the "Green" is in the middle to mediate between Kindness and Judgment through Mercy. But in the Shell, which is entirely "eyes of envy" without peace, they desire to connect to it, but are cast outward. Therefore, the green color is on the outside, just as it is in the shells of a walnut.

These powers are called "Shells" because they encompass, surround, and cover the level of Holiness. They are like the "muddy abyss" and the "inner food" within it—the Foundation <note>original: *Yesod*</note> that is surrounded by the Shells covering it. They are like the three shells surrounding the brain <note>meaning the nut meat</note> of the walnut: the green shell, the white shell that hardens, and the thin skin between the hard shell and the food. Beneath these three shells, there is yet another shell that clings to the "brain" and clings to Holiness. The Zohar says that this one is the "Light" and is almost within Holiness; it is called the "Fourth" and is the intermediate state between Light and Impurity. However, one may rely on the fact that no "pig" <note>original: *chazir* — likely a metaphor for a specific type of impurity or "returning" spark</note> exists in the walnut between the thin shell and the brain. It is possible that sparks of "returning" light do not escape, covering it so that it is easily separated.

The secret of this shell is found in the "donkey" and "flesh," and its return is like the appearance of *Chashmal* <note>original: *Chashmal* — the "Glowing Amber" or "Electrum" seen in Ezekiel's vision</note>. This is the color. Because this fourth shell approaches Holiness most closely, the Zohar does not count it with the other three shells, nor is it numbered among them, for it is included within the ten levels of impurity we mentioned. Know that for the ten and thirty-three powers of impurity mentioned, there are names and nicknames for each one according to its matters and actions, as we have written in the *Tikkunim*, the *Zohar*, and other Kabbalistic books.

<column-break/>

The good that is written is to reveal every matter. The third is **Sisia-Satriel**, so named because she hides <note>original: *Satar*</note> the face of Mercy and destroys the holy building... The fourth is **Ne'at Belah**, who strikes at purity and weakens it, planting filth and consuming many souls; then we cry out for peace, "bitterly they weep." The fifth is **Nozeh**, meaning a branch of flame and dimness, burning with a flame of fire. The eighth is **Samael**, whose name shall be publicized as the accuser of Israel. The ninth is **Nizolia**, and by his power he draws from the side of purity... and when he draws from the side of impurity... like the form of "crooked serpents." The tenth is **Lilith**, who receives from all the Shells... corresponding to the twelve boundaries...

### Chapter 6
Know that no Shell or power of impurity exists except through grace. Their wings are from power and letters and proximity to Holiness. Not in the World of Emanation <note>original: *Atzilut*</note>, nor in the World of Creation <note>original: *Beriyah*</note>, but in the World of Formation <note>original: *Yetzirah*</note>—the world of **Metatron**—where "the wicked walk on every side." Wherever it is said that the Shells enter into Holiness or rule over it, the matter refers only to Metatron, who is the Palace for all these Sephirot. Sometimes the Tiferet <note>original: *Tiferet* — the Sephirah of Beauty/Harmony</note> is covered by him and hidden within him. For this reason, it is said that they enter the Sephirot, for touching the King’s garment is like touching the King himself.

Two apertures: one for seed and one for urine. So it is above in the "foreign" palace: the right is designated for the pure soul, and the left and middle are designated for the "surplus" formed in Judgment <note>original: *Gevurah*</note>, for there the "milk" <note>impurity/waste</note> is separated. When merit is found in the world, one can awaken the King through the "feminine waters" <note>original: *Mayin Nukvin* — the spiritual initiative from below</note> of the righteous that flow upward. Then she draws from the "foreign" [source] that flows with pure water and the secret of blessing. But when the sins of mankind increase, God forbid, then the Kingdom...

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 26: The Palaces of Exchanges

<column-break/>

**Chapter 1: Many** have thought that the holy letters are merely conventional, agreed-upon forms—drawn shapes and signs meant to represent spoken words. According to this view, the letters would have no intrinsic value beyond revealing the speaker's intent. <note>The author is refuting the idea that language is a human invention; he argues letters are divine entities.</note> Under such an assumption, one who gazes at the letters or toils to learn the words of a book would receive no spiritual reward for the labor itself, but only for the knowledge gained, like someone who learns the king's external decrees.

However, the matter is not so. Rather, within the holy letters, there is an inner vitality, a spirituality, and a life-force of the world, as explained in the book *Pardes* <note>Referring to *Pardes Rimmonim*, the primary work by Moses Cordovero</note>. By the "finger of God" <note>Exodus 31:18</note>, the Torah was written as four "Kings." <note>This refers to the four levels of interpretation: Peshat (literal), Remez (hinted), Derash (homiletical), and Sod (secret).</note> Even in the literal stories of the Torah, the words are like a body, while the spiritual intent is their soul. This is the reason for the "Written Torah" <note>The Pentateuch</note> and the "Oral Torah" <note>The Talmudic and Midrashic traditions</note>. The Written Torah exists as a high spirituality that requires a "garment" to be clothed in—this is the physical writing. However, the Oral Torah is even deeper and more hidden; it does not require that same physical garment, as it is a "story of things" <note>Oral transmission</note>.

There is a distinction between the letters as written and the movement of the lips during speech. The written letter is like a body, while the spoken movement is its soul. Therefore, one who learns the Torah in its literal sense must also learn it with its "garment"—the Oral Torah. For the Written Torah is spirituality in a high place, and it needs a "mouth" <note>A human interpreter</note> to manifest it. With God's help, I will elaborate on this during our study. When one reads from a book, the "body" of the letters is the ink, but the "soul" is the mystical secret of the Torah, like the *Zohar* and similar works. When letters join into a word, the spiritual measure of that word is determined by the number of its letters. Furthermore, through the musical notes <note>original: *Te'amim* — cantillation marks</note>, one can even "create worlds," as is known. Every single letter has its own power, but when joined in a holy word, a beautiful spiritual harmony emerges from that combination.

<column-break/>

The nature of these aforementioned "Palaces" <note>original: *Heikhalot* — spiritual realms or chambers</note> was explained in the *Zohar* (Portion of *Pekudei*). The Palaces of Impurity correspond to the seven Palaces of Holiness, acting as their dark reflection. Each has a section open to the lower dwelling, prepared for investigation. Against the seven holy palaces, there are seven types of "Evil Inclination" <note>original: *Yetzer Ha-Ra* — the human drive toward selfishness</note>. Just as the holy palaces are internal and surrounded by holiness, the external "Shells" <note>original: *Kliphot*</note> surround them. Therefore, the Evil Inclination is called by seven names. Corresponding to the seven holy chambers, there are seven dwellings in *Gehenna* <note>The purgatorial afterlife</note>. In the lowest of these, those who "cut the shoots" <note>A metaphor for heresy or damaging the divine unity</note> are judged.

From these, "thorns" are born that surround the holy inheritance <note>The people of Israel</note>. These forces extend into the three outer dwellings of holiness. All sins rely on these levels within *Gehenna*—may the Merciful One save us. These forces ascend and spread until they reach the "Queen of the Night" <note>original: *Malat Lailah* — likely a reference to Lilith</note>. However, they eventually return and sink back into their place so they cannot harm the community of Israel. See further in the *Zohar* (Portion of *Pekudei*) regarding this "female" entity. In the "Holy Orchard" (*Pardes*), this is all explained at length. It is shown that these Palaces of Impurity are merely "garments" that surround the internal holiness.

# Gate Twenty-Seven: Explaining the Secret of the Letters

**Chapter 2: Furthermore,** the letters relate in their form to their inner essence. All the powers of the letters are born from the movement of the "Levels" <note>referring to the Sephirot</note>. The shape of each letter is a physical representation of a spiritual force. When these letters are activated in the "Upper Orchard" <note>The divine realm</note>, they perform known spiritual actions. The writing of our physical hands is a reflection of the writing of the "Upper Scribe." For every letter, there is a specific action it arouses. When a person moves their lips in prayer or study, they draw down spirituality from the source. The breath of the person becomes a vessel for this divine light. This is the secret of "Returning the Names" <note>A Kabbalistic meditative technique</note> and the intention of prayer.

By understanding the "living vitality" <note>original: *Chayut*</note> within the letters, a person can connect their speech to the spiritual source. Though the physical lips move, the spiritual light remains unified in its source. When a person speaks with holy intent, the letters ascend and bond with their roots. Not only is the speech spiritual, but the very writing of the letters reflects divine attributes. This is the secret of the holiness of a Torah Scroll. Regarding the letters *Mem* and *Samekh* that were in the Tablets <note>referring to the Ten Commandments</note>, our Sages (may their memory be a blessing) taught that they stood by a miracle. <note>Since these letters are closed loops (ם and ס), if they were engraved all the way through the stone, the middle part should have fallen out. That they stayed in place is considered a miracle.</note> The essence is that their spirituality supported the physical matter. This is the secret of their vitality and their persistence.

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 24: The Shells

One errs in thinking that her intent is to destroy and lay waste to everything <note>original: "לכלות ולנוות כל דבר"</note>; rather, she hides the Face of Mercy and contradicts the Holy Building. Some call her *Saphriel*, and from her, the "Thorn of Peor" was made.

**The Fourth** is called *Keleh* <note>meaning "Extinction" or "Destruction"</note>, for she disguises herself in purity, yet covers, destroys, and consumes many souls. She is *Saphriel*, may his name be blotted out.

**The Fifth** is *Nochesh* <note>The Biter</note>, and the explanation of her name is the "Female of the Flame." Like a window pierced by a flame, God desires His creatures <note>original: "חפץ הק"בה בבריותיו"</note>, but she consumes all lower beings in a moment.

**The Sixth** is called *Hagrim*, which stirs up "closed miracles" <note>original: "נסים סגור"</note> between kings.

**The Seventh** is called *Erev* <note>Mixture/Evening</note>. When she receives from Holiness, it is "sweet" <note>Arat</note> to her, but then she casts it away and slaughters it. This is the cause of stumbling: it is sweet to a person at the start, but afterward, she casts the "poison of death" upon him.

**The Eighth** is *Kamal* <note>Samael</note>, and he is famous for being the "Accuser of Israel."

**The Ninth** is called *Gzuliel* <note>Robbery of God</note>. In her essence, she nursed from the Side of Holiness, and thus she is called by this name, meaning she robs the "nursing" from the side of purity. Then she has the permission to damage people in the future. When she nurses from the side of impurity at known times, she is also called *Ganziel*. She takes the form of a woman and is called *Lilith* <note>the primary female demonic figure in Kabbalah</note>. She receives from all the "Shells" and is called the "Woman of Harlotry." She is the mate of Samael. She has twelve "wings of death" corresponding to the twelve diagonal boundaries in the realm of Beauty <note>term: Tiferet (Beauty/Harmony)</note>.

<column-break/>

She nurses from the "Exchanged Violin" <note>original: "הכנור המוחלף"</note>, which comes from the surplus and the "Sweating Gold" that drips from the side of the Shell. The matter is this: since the Kingdom <note>term: Malchut (the Shekhinah)</note> has no power to awaken and sing on her own, the "Melodious Violin" <note>the spiritual force of praise</note> awakens and teaches an accusation regarding the sins committed in the world. This awakens the "Strong Judgment" against the enemies of Israel. Then, the Judgment leans toward the Divine Presence <note>term: Shekhinah</note>. This is the meaning of "nursing from the exchanged violin"—that which should have been an influence of surplus and joy instead becomes a "bitter influence." Then the "Serpent" <note>Samael</note> bites at her heels to receive that influence. Then the Shekhinah tastes the bitterness of this evil influence. This is the secret of the Exile: when the Shekhinah nurses from this, she is like a woman who is "separated" <note>ritually impure/Niddah</note>, so that her Husband cannot come to her until she is purified.

The "Shells" never actually enter into the Interior of Holiness; rather, they spread around the world from the side, surrounding it like a "Window." Our masters' secret regarding the <term>Kliphot (Shells)</term> is that they include all their branches in the likeness of a **walnut shell**. Just as in the order of layers, holiness is in the center to balance between Mercy and Judgment, in the "Shell" all are harsh, masters of strife, without peace. 

These garments are called "Shells" because they surround, encompass, and cover the level of Holiness, which is like the "Brain" <note>the inner marrow</note> and the inner whiteness. Just as there are three shells covering the brain of a walnut:
1.  **The Green Shell** (The outermost, bitter husk).
2.  **The White Shell** (Which becomes sweet).
3.  **The Hard Shell** (The barrier between the shell and the food).

Under these three shells, there is yet another shell that clings to the "Brain"—this is the one that clings to Holiness. The *Zohar* says this one is "Dark," yet it is nearly holy; it is the fourth shell, the <term>Nogah (Glow/Brightness)</term> that exists between the secret and the revealed. One might wonder why no "darkness" is seen in a walnut between the thin shell and the brain; this is because it is the "potential" that becomes "actual" only when the nut is cracked. This shell is the secret of the "Glow" <note>Ezekiel 1:4</note> that surrounds the divine. Because this shell is subtle and closest to Holiness, the *Zohar* mentions it alongside the other three shells, but it is sometimes counted with them because it is included in the "Seven Levels of Impurity" we mentioned.

Know that for these ten and thirty-three forces of impurity mentioned, there are names and titles for each one according to its matters and actions, as clarified in the *Tikunim*, the *Zohar*, and other books of the Kabbalists.

### Chapter 6: Know

->That they are for the Serpent, the Shell, the Assembly of Impurity, and their branches<-

The attachment of these forces to the world is external; they do not reside in the World of Creation <note>term: Beriah</note>, but rather in the World of Formation <note>term: Yetzirah</note>, which is the "World of Metatron." There, "the wicked walk on every side." Wherever it is said that the "Shells" enter holiness or rule over it, the meaning is only regarding **Metatron**, who is the "Palace" and "Garment" to the Divine Spheres <note>term: Sefirot</note>. Sometimes the Impure Shell clothes itself in him. For this reason, it is said they "enter the Sefirot," for the intent is the King's garment, which is treated as the King himself.

Similarly, what they said about the "Truth coming to the Brain"—this refers to the union of Samael and Lilith, hinting at the "Mother of all living" <note>Eve/Malchut</note>. These things are not to be taken literally. Rather, the intent is that in the "Foundation" <note>term: Yesod</note> there are two channels: one for the right side and one for Samael. Just as in the human body there are orifices for waste, so too above. The "Right Foundation" is designated for the influence of the "Clear Oil," while the "Left/Samael" side is designated for the surplus that accumulates at the "Navel." There, the "Silver and Gold" are the waste of the world. These forces can awaken against the "Living Righteous" <note>the Tzadikim</note>. When humanity's sins increase, Heaven forbid, then the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note>...

Therefore, these Palaces are one above the other, and all are essential, directed toward various types of destruction and harm. This is the secret of their existence. # Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 27: The Secret of the Letters

While they were still within Kindness <note>Chessed: the Sefirah of expansive love</note>, they were qualities that were not yet distinguished by the Infinite Light <note>original: "אור הסוף" – likely referring to the Ein Sof, the Boundless Divine</note>, which was simple and stripped of life-giving souls. For they were poured from the "navel" to the "navel," becoming more revealed and densified until they took shape as entities <note>original: "הוויות" – often mistranscribed as "חוליות" or "חיוליות"</note> of water. There is a great addition of the quality of Judgment <note>Gevurah</note> here, for water is the offspring of Kindness and Judgment. They were drawn further down to the triad of Kindness, Strength, and Beauty <note>original: "חג"ת" – the Sefirot of Chessed, Gevurah, and Tiferet</note>. In Beauty, they became more and more revealed until they were formed into the "firmament" above the screen of the formation of the child, like the appearance of the Milky Way. In these entities, the light is very thin. Through the process of descent, they become formed into circles of thin water, like a drop of seed, and in the firmament, they are covered and woven together. In this manner, the ten Sefirot <note>The ten divine emanations</note>—encompassing Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge <note>original: "חב"ד"</note>; Kindness, Strength, and Beauty <note>original: "חג"ת"</note>; and Endurance, Splendor, Foundation, and Sovereignty <note>original: "נהי"ם"</note>—revolve around the four "Personalities" <note>Partzufim: archetypal divine configurations</note>. In the secret of the Body and the Covenant, they prepared fifty gates, which are eight, and in their completion, they are five. Therefore, in the Act of Creation, "Light" is mentioned five times, "Water" five times, and "Firmament" five times. The Sefirot and the letters are all one matter. Therefore, in the general categories of these three manifestations—Light, Water, and Firmament—the letters are divided into five phonetic positions. Each word hints at a specific Sefirah:

*   **The Gutturals** <note>Letters spoken from the throat: א, ה, ח, ע</note> hint at Kindness <note>Chessed</note>, as they were more hidden.
*   **The Palatals** <note>Letters spoken from the palate: ג, י, כ, ק</note> hint at Judgment <note>Gevurah</note>, becoming slightly more revealed.
*   **The Linguals** <note>Letters spoken from the tongue: ד, ט, ל, נ, ת</note> hint at Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, being even more revealed.
*   **The Dentals** <note>Letters spoken from the teeth: ז, ס, ש, ר, צ</note> hint at Understanding <note>Binah</note>, as they are revealed even further.
*   **The Labials** <note>Letters spoken from the lips: ב, ו, מ, פ</note> hint at Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, being the most revealed.

Every word is made of letters, and the whole is more than its parts. Just as it is with the parts of the stars, so it is with the Sefirot: each one is more inclusive than the one above it. Behold, these letters shine from the source of their existence, which is Understanding <note>Binah</note>, for that is the beginning of their revelation. However, their essential existence and the dwelling of Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note> is through the "Thirty-Two Paths of Wisdom." The essence of the letters was formed in Understanding, but this formation is only a formation of light, as is known. For the letters in their physical shapes did not yet exist as "light" due to their extreme subtlety.

Philosophers categorize the letters into three sizes:
1.  **Large letters** represent Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note>.
2.  **Medium letters** represent Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>.
3.  **Small letters** represent Sovereignty <note>Malkhut</note>.

The intention is that when a letter is large, it hints at a great illumination and spirituality emerging from the "window" of Wisdom. Similarly, medium letters emerge from the "window" of Beauty, and small letters from the "window" of Sovereignty. In the Zohar, regarding the "Large He" <note>original: "ה' רבתי"</note> in the verse "Do you thus requite [the Lord]?" <note>Deuteronomy 32:6</note>, it says this is a great light in Understanding <note>Binah</note> when the Moon is full and at its greatest strength. To understand these matters clearly, one must know that when it says a certain "entity" hints at a certain Sefirah, the intention is not that the light itself is the essence of 

<column-break/>

that Sefirah. For there are no "powers" within the essence of the Sefirot themselves. Rather, those "entities" are lights that spread out and divide from above the Sefirot. It is not proper to think that these lights are independent entities like "Palaces" or "Chariots" outside the Sefirot; rather, they are part and parcel of the Sefirot.

The matter is that in every single Sefirah, there are millions upon millions of types of emanations, worlds, and levels that the mind of man or angel cannot contain. There is a letter that reveals a small "branch" of a certain Sefirah, and another letter that reveals different branches of that same Sefirah. Some letters reveal the matter more comprehensively, and these branches might be the collective of four or five letters. Some are contained in a single letter due to its extreme subtlety and its closeness to the pure essence. There is a letter that depends on Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, but that Beauty might be a Beauty that is blessed through Foundation <note>Yesod</note>. This explains why the letter *Vav* <note>ו</note> is in Beauty, yet is included in the labial letters (B, V, M, P) which correspond to Foundation. This is the general rule for all Sefirot, following both generalities and particulars.

Furthermore, it must be said that all the "Chariot," the "Living Creatures" <note>Chayot</note>, and the "Wheels" <note>Ofanim</note> that are close to the letters receive an abundance of spirit from within the Sefirot. Each one is a branch in a known understanding. According to this, the "smallness" that clothes itself in the letters proceeds level after level until it ascends the "Ladder of the Chariots." For this reason, the letters of the Divine Name <note>Yod and He</note> are sometimes added to Beauty and Sovereignty, and sometimes to the faces of the "Living Creatures" that are directed by them. Sometimes these "Living Creatures" are distant, like expansive branches that stretch out and draw from their roots and upper sources. At other times, they hint at their ascent to their essential sources, beginning with the lower branches.

By this, you shall contemplate the entities in their spirituality and their existence. The letters have power according to their shapes—like the *Yod* <note>י</note> being at the top and the *Vav* <note>ו</note> below it—one in the Crown <note>Keter</note>, one in Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, and one in Foundation <note>Yesod</note>. Yet despite this, everything is one unified thing, bound and tied to one another. In the Zohar, regarding the "Incense" <note>Ketoret</note>, it explains how everything is bound together. A lack of knowledge regarding the "Foundation of the Worlds" and their descent from one another leads to a lack of knowledge regarding the "Sacred Work." This is why contradictory lights are found in different books; one might emphasize the bad as good, or the end in the bad. Therefore, the wise person should strive to know them, to know the greatness of the Name. Then the "Result" <note>original: "עק"ב" - heel/result</note> will be joined with the "Reason" <note>original: "מס"י" - likely a shorthand for 'cause' or 'reasoning'</note> in the knowledge of the Torah and its attributes, in order to perform the Work.

# Gate Twenty-Eight: Explaining the Secret of the Vowels

There is another point called the "Hebrew Servant," which is the "Reduced" vowel <note>Chatuf</note>. It is a compound vowel, riding with the *Patach* and the *Segol* in the same way they combine with the *Qamatz*. As we said, the simple vowel points are nine: *Qamatz, Patach, Tzere, Segol, Shva, Shuruq, Chiriq, Cholam*. The three compound ones are: *Chatuf Qamatz, Chatuf Patach,* and *Chatuf Segol*.

### Chapter 2: Know that the Vowel Points hint at branches held
within the source of the matters of the Upper Sefirot, and in the general category of the vowel points...

<column-break/>

### Chapter 1: Know that according to Kabbalah, there are ten vowel points. 
Five of them are "Kings" <note>Long vowels</note>, and they are: *Qamatz, Tzere, Cholam, Shuruq* (written as a *Vav* with a dot), and *Chiriq* (with a *Yod*). Their mnemonic sign is "The Engravings of the Seal" <note>original: "פיתוחא דחותמא" - Exodus 28:36</note>. These five are the "awakeners of action."

Five of them are called "Servants" <note>Short vowels</note>. The "Servant" is to the "King" as the "All" is to the general categories. For the vowel *Chiriq* has five variations, and the differences between them are in the *Yod*. Each one is a *Qamatz* in the Foundation, a *Patach* and *Segol* on the lips, and a *Shuruq* with three dots. Their sign is a shorthand...
