# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 27 — On the Explanation of the Secret of the Letters

Beauty <note>Tiferet: the central Sefirah of harmony</note> is like a crown, the palm of merit <note>original: "כף זכות" - a play on the letter Caph (כ), which means "palm"</note>. For Kindness and Strength <note>Chessed and Gevurah</note>, it serves as a foundation... and the Leviathan <note>A primordial spiritual creature representing encompassing light</note> is like the numerical value <note>original: "כמ"ז" - likely referring to a Gematria calculation</note> etc.
Understanding <note>Binah</note> is represented by the letter *Caph* [כ]... for it is written that Understanding is like a "tower flying in the air" <note>A Talmudic expression used here to describe the elevated, abstract nature of the Sefirah of Binah</note> and a voice.
The dripping of the World of Emanation <note>original: "הלב"ע" - likely referring to the world of Atzilut</note>: the book of Kindness and Strength from the side of Beauty; the wines of Kindness are dripped to it.
The "doubled" *Caph* [כ] is from the side of Strength <note>Gevurah</note>. The *Samekh* [ס] is in Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note>, founded in the Line of Mercy, and of it, it is said: "The Lord supports [*Somekh*] all who fall" <note>Psalm 145:14; the letter Samekh represents support</note>. The *Ayin* [ע] is from the side of Kindness <note>Chessed</note>, in which there are "fountains of water" <note>original: "עינות מים" - a pun on *Ayin*, which means both "eye" and "fountain"</note>, and it is the right eye. The *Pe* [פ] is from the side of Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, and thus it is the "Mouth [*Peh*] of the World."
The *Lamed* [ל] is from the side of Strength <note>Gevurah</note>, for there was the decree of judgment, the place of justice, and there is righteousness.
The letters *Qoph, Lamed, Mem* [קל"ם] are in Splendor <note>Hod</note> and the Crown of Judgment, formed from the "Crown of Falsehood" in the secret of the "Shell" <note>Kelippah: the external husk of impurity</note> mentioned.
By means of Judgment: *Qoph* [ק] is from the side of Kindness, referring to "The Lord is near [*Karov*] to all who call Him." *Resh* [ר] is from the side of Beauty, for it is the "Head" [*Rosh*] of the three Patriarchs <note>Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who correspond to the Sefirot</note> and binds the seal of authority. And so it returns in the *Sefer HaBahir* <note>An early and influential Kabbalistic text</note>, taking a face from its rounded beginning. *Shin* [ש] is from the side of Understanding <note>Binah</note>, the shape of the "vessels." *Tav* [ת] is Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note>; sometimes *Tav* is "death" <note>original: "תמות" - Tamut</note> and sometimes *Tav* is "life" <note>original: "תחיה" - Techiyah</note>, all according to the reception of the light. These are the matters hinted at by Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>Rashbi: the 2nd-century sage and traditional author of the Zohar</note>, peace be upon him, regarding the general nature of the letters arranged as a Menorah. And this is their form:

->Like a Menorah and spreading through the spiritual branch<-
->Crown, Strength, Beauty, Aleph, Foundation, Splendor, Endurance<-
->[Groups of Hebrew letters arranged by Sefirotic correspondence]<-
->The All<-

### Chapter 3: After the way of the secrets of the letters has been explained in general
The totality of their vitality and their suspension. For there are those that are pure Mercy [the letters *Chet, Tet, Ayin, Yod*], and those that are intermediate Mercy, and those that are complete Judgment [the letters *Caph, Pe, Qoph, Resh, Shin, Tav*]. When you come to bind names and life-forces and words according to the desired actions, you shall perform the combination of the word according to its need. They shall take the seal for the three spiritualities [the letters *Bet, Nun, Dalet, Caph, Pe, Resh, Tav*] for the secret of the "Building." There are "doubled" letters that receive both Judgment and Mercy.
And the other twelve letters take the Strength of the "Line of Judgment"... for they are in specific places within the Sefirot, being both individual and general within each Sefirah. For example, the *Mem* [מ] of the "Lower Mother" <note>Malchut</note>... it is possible for there to be a branch of Understanding within Wisdom, or the reverse.
Furthermore, they said in the Zohar that the *Aleph* [א] includes all the letters and is the source for them. Therefore, they proceed from it. Afterwards, they are divided into groups: How? *Nun, Bet, Dalet, Chet, Yod, Vav, Zayin* are in the Line of Kindness; *Nun, Bet, Dalet* in Kindness, *Chet, Vav, Zayin* in Endurance <note>Netzach</note>, and *Mem* in Sovereignty. *Tet, Yod, Caph, Lamed, Mem, Caph, Mem* are in the Line of Mercy; *Tet, Yod, Caph* in Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, *Lamed, Mem, Caph* in Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, and *Samekh* in Sovereignty. *Ayin, Pe, Gimel, Qoph, Resh, Tet* are in the Line of Judgment; *Ayin, Pe, Gimel* in Strength <note>Gevurah</note>, *Qoph, Resh, Tet* in Splendor <note>Hod</note>, and *Chet* in Sovereignty. In Sovereignty, there are three letters from the three lines... to show that Sovereignty is comprised of all three.
How is *Aleph* [א] formed? A *Vav* [ו] in the middle and two *Yod*s [י], one above and one below, like the secret of Kindness and Strength, with the *Vav* of Beauty in the middle. Thus, it is the source of all letters in the secret that it includes the three lines.
Afterwards, they branch out: *Bet* and *Tav* to Kindness, for it is the "House" <note>*Bet* means house</note> for all the flow to be influenced. *Gimel* to Strength, and yet it "bestows" <note>*Gomel*</note> kindness. *Dalet* to Beauty, for it is the "Door" <note>*Delet*</note> for the descent of the flow. And so the reverse: *Gimel* in Beauty is the third to the line and bestows kindness; *Dalet* in Strength is "impoverished" [*Dalah*] of flow.
*Chet* and *Vav* in Endurance. *Qoph* from the side of Kindness... where judgment descends... *Samekh* by means of Kindness in the secret of Union. *Vav* from the side of Beauty and *Zayin* from the side of Strength... *Yod*... on the head of the pipe of Strength. *Qoph* in Sovereignty... *Tet, Yod, Caph* in Beauty... *Ayin* from the side of Kindness which is "hidden from all," *Vav* from the side of Beauty which spreads into ten branches, *Caph* from the side of Strength, and thus it is called the "Palm of Merit" etc.

<column-break/>

Even if one studies the words of Torah and does not reach their full depth, they should still strive to be precise. One's time and strength are not lost, for the Master of the work <note>God</note> is faithful to pay the reward for the labor. However, we would wish for the reader of the Torah to understand, for then we would merit more, as surely through the Kabbalah, one draws a more refined and perfect spirituality into their soul. This is in contrast to one who does not understand.
Therefore, one must know that the Oral Torah is meant to dig into the Written Torah. Similarly, there is a difference between the spirituality drawn by one who understands the plain meaning [*Peshat*] and the spirituality drawn by one who understands the secret of the matters [*Sod*], which is according to the Truth. Furthermore, there is a difference between understanding the secret of the matters and understanding the secret of the letter shapes and their spiritual markings.
Even through the "cycles" <note>reincarnations or rotations of letters</note>, a person can come to "know their Creator" and "create worlds." The plain meaning draws from the spirituality of the "Crown of Sovereignty," which is like the "Body" of the Torah. One who understands the secrets of the Kabbalah draws from the spirituality of the side of "Understanding" [Binah], which is like the "Soul." May all the righteous reach this level!

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 27 — The Secret of the Letters

The vitality of the Sefirot <note>The ten dimensions of Divine light</note> rests within every branch of the Sefirot. The soul and the seal of the letters are encompassing forms that spread out from the purpose of the World of Emanation. One should not think that these gatherings of forms—which are included within the Sefirot—are independent matters. Rather, they are like "limbs" and "chariots" for the Divine. Heaven forbid we should think they are separate parts of the Sefirot. Indeed, within every single Sefirah, there are many thousands upon thousands and myriads upon myriads of hosts of Emanation, worlds, and placements.

Human intellect cannot fully comprehend this. There is a letter that signifies a small branch of a specific Sefirah, and another letter that signifies several branches of that same Sefirah. These branches are distinct from one another. There is also a letter that signifies a more general inclusion, containing the power of many branches, such as the general seal of the four-letter Name <note>The Tetragrammaton, Y-H-V-H</note>. In it, everything is included.

The letter *Lamed* [ל] is elevated due to its extreme subtlety and its closeness to the "Branch of the Root" <note>The highest point of spiritual origin</note>. There is also a letter associated with Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, but even within Beauty, it might represent the aspect of Beauty that is within Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note>, according to the numerical count of the Sefirot. Furthermore, even though the letter *Vav* [ו] is primarily rooted in Beauty, it is nonetheless included within the letters *Mem, Vav, Tzadi* [מו"ץ] <note>These letters together are often discussed in Kabbalah regarding the balance of Mercy and Judgment</note>. This is according to the secret of the "scales" for all worlds and all Sefirot, according to general and specific rules.

Furthermore, it must be said that the entire Chariot <note>Merkavah: the structure of the angelic realms</note>, the "Wheels" <note>Ophanim: a high rank of angels</note>, and the "Living Creatures" <note>Chayot: the highest angelic beings</note> receive the flow of their sustenance from within the count of the Sefirot. Each receives according to its specific known "Understanding" <note>Binah</note>. These angels are designated by the letters *Bet, Dalet, Lamed* [ב'ד'ל']. Through this, one finds that the spiritualities that clothe themselves in the Living Creatures ascend level by level until they reach the "World of Levels." According to this, the letters are sometimes associated with Beauty and Sovereignty, and sometimes with the "Faces of the Living Creatures" <note>The symbolic faces of the angels in Ezekiel’s vision</note> that lead them.

Sometimes the letters hint at the Soul in its simple nature, as it spreads and expands toward its upper sources and origins. At other times, the letters hint at the "causes" and sources within a branch, extending toward the lower Sefirot. Therefore, you should grasp the letters in their spirituality and their collective essence, even though letters may appear identical in form—such as a *Yod* [י] above or a *Vav* [ו] below. One might be in the Crown <note>Keter</note>, another in Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, and another in Foundation <note>Yesod</note>. All are one unified thing, established and bound together, standing in the "Linked Flame" <note>original: "שלהבת הקשורה" - a classic Kabbalistic metaphor for the unity of Divine light</note>.

Through prayer, we come to understand the progression of these worlds, one from the other, just as we learn the knowledge of simple actions. If a person were to grasp even a small part of this, they would find "the poison of serpents" <note>A metaphor for dangerous or distorted knowledge</note> if they are not careful. One must be able to compose their mind properly—to know good from evil, or at least to recognize the "foundations of his Father" <note>The primary spiritual principles</note>. If he can understand this, all the more so. Nevertheless, it is proper for the wise to strive for this knowledge to know the greatness of God and to do good. This applies to those who grasp the "taste" of the secrets of the Torah and its attributes, in order to perform their work correctly.

### Chapter 1: Know
That from the mouth of Tradition <note>Kabbalah</note>, we have ten vowel points. Five of them are "Kings" <note>The primary/long vowels</note>, and they are: *Kamatz, Tzere, Cholem, Shurek,* and *Chirik* <note>The Hebrew vowel names</note>.

The mnemonic for this is **"The engravings of a seal"** <note>Exodus 28:11; the Hebrew "Pituchei Chotam" hints at the opening and closing of the mouth during speech</note>, for these begin the action of speech.

These five are the primary ones... The mouth is for the "King," and the tongue for... they are all included together because the phonetic separation has a specific meaning.

The "nesting" between them is through the letter *Yod* [י] or through the *Vav* [ו]. These are as mentioned above. There is also a nesting of the *Patach* [vowel sound 'ah'] and the *Segol* [vowel sound 'eh']. And there is a nesting of the lips, which is the *Shurek* [vowel sound 'oo'], represented by three dots. The mnemonic for this is **"The Kiss"** <note>referring to the pursing of the lips</note>.

<column-break/>

They were still within Kindness <note>Chessed</note>, in a state of subtlety, not yet revealed within the sound of the voice, which was a simple breath from the soul. For when they emerged from their source, through the furnace of their writing and their manifestation, they increased until they became the letters of "Water" <note>representing the fluid, expansive light of Chessed</note>. They then gave birth to the "Living Creatures of Strength" <note>Gevurah</note>, coming from the great "Burning" <note>the constriction/fire</note> of Strength. For "Water" comes from the side of Kindness, and "Strength" was then drawn toward Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>. In Beauty, they became more and more manifest until they became the letters of the "Firmament" <note>Raki'a</note>.

This is a parable for the descent of an embryo, which begins as a drop in the brain and heart, drawn down as a subtle force. At the time of manifestation, it becomes like a "drop of Water," and at the head of the drop, it begins to be embroidered into a "Firmament." In this manner, when the 22 Sefirot are completed during the days of Rectification <note>Tikkun</note>, then Beauty, Foundation, and Sovereignty include everything within the secret of the "Thirty-Seven Parts of the Body" and the secret of the "Body and the Covenant."

Therefore, in the Act of Creation, "Light" is mentioned five times, "Water" five times, and "Firmament" five times. The Sefirot and the letters are all one matter. They are categorized into three groups: Light, Water, and Firmament. The letters are also divided into five phonetic groups, each hinting at a specific Sefirah:
1. **Gutturals (אהח"ע):** Hinting at Kindness <note>Chessed</note>, which is more hidden.
2. **Palatals (גיכ"ק):** Hinting at Strength <note>Gevurah</note>, which is slightly more revealed.
3. **Linguals (דטלנ"ת):** Hinting at Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, revealed even more.
4. **Dentals (זסשר"ץ):** Hinting at Victory and Glory <note>Netzach and Hod</note>.
5. **Labials (בומ"ף):** Hinting at Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, which is the most revealed.

Each group's letters are more internal than the group following it. Just as it is with these phonetic groups, so it is with the Sefirot—each one reveals more than the one above it. The source of the existence of these letters is from Understanding <note>Binah</note>, for that is where their manifestation begins. However, the essence of their being is from the power of Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note>. Through the "paths" of the drop of light and nature in Understanding, the flow becomes the existence of the letters in Understanding.

Regarding the "large letters" and "small letters" found in the Torah: the large letters represent the spiritual light from the Wisdom of Understanding, which is "Great Beauty" <note>Tiferet</note>. The small letters represent the "Small Beauty" or Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note>. A "Large *He* [ה]" indicates the great light in Understanding, while a "Small *He* [ה]" refers to the Moon <note>Malchut</note>. To understand this clearly: when we say a letter hints at a certain Sefirah, we do not mean the physical shape of the letter itself, but its spiritual "branch."

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 27 — Explaining the Secret of the Letters

A person who speaks words of Torah, even if they do not understand them, has not labored in vain nor wasted their time. Every sound has its Master, and His work is to pay the reward for the person’s action. In any case, one who reads the Torah gains merit through the very act of reading. This is because by gazing at the letters, one draws down a spiritual light through the power of their intellect—a light that is refined and pure. This spiritual light sustains the soul in proportion to the individual’s ability to draw from the "Higher Waters" of Understanding <note>Binah</note>. For this reason, one must also know the Oral Torah in relation to the Written Torah. Similarly, there is a difference between the spirituality drawn through the sound of the voice—which is the spiritual "food" for the secrets of the words—and the spirituality drawn through the secret of combining the letters <note>Tzirufim</note>, the words, and their musical cantillation. Through the mystical combinations of letters—such as the sets *HALPACH, BAYTACH, SABSI* <note>These are likely alphabetical ciphers or permutations used in Kabbalistic meditation</note>—it is said that one can even create worlds. The one who studies the plain meaning <note>Hebrew: "Peshat"</note> draws down spirituality from the dimension of Sovereignty <note>Malchut, the lowest Sefirah</note>, which is considered the "body" of the Divine structure. However, the one who understands the secrets of the Kabbalah draws down spirituality from the dimension of Understanding <note>Binah</note>, which is considered the "soul" for Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note>. This is what is called the "World to Come," and in the World to Come, all the righteous will ascend to this high level.

<column-break/>

Beauty <note>Tiferet</note> is like a branch... connected to the Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, which corresponds to the letters as mentioned above. This is found in the unity of the three... from the Sanctuary. For the letter *Lamed* [ל] represents Understanding <note>Binah</note> in the secret of "the tower flying in the air." The sound is planted through Kindness <note>Chesed</note>. The letter *Chet* [ח] is from Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, planted on its right side. The letter *Kaf* [כ] represents the "breath" from Might <note>Gevurah</note>. The letter *Samekh* [ס] is in Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note>, which is established as the line of Mercy, and of it, it is said: "The Lord supports (*Somach*) all who fall" <note>Psalm 145:14</note>. Through the power of Might <note>Gevurah</note>, the letter *Ayin* [ע] comes from the Sanctuary, where the "springs of water" <note>Einot mayim</note> are found; it is the "Right Eye." The letter *Pe* [פ] comes from Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, and thus the "mouth" (*Peh*) of the world... The letter *Lamed* [ל] comes from Might <note>Gevurah</note>, for that is where the "lash" of judgment and the place of justice reside. The letters *Kaf, Lamed, Samekh* are in Splendor <note>Hod</note>, and the "Crown of Judgment" is formed there... The letter *Qof* [ק] comes from the Sanctuary, based on the secret "The Lord is near (*Karov*) to all who call Him." The letter *Resh* [ר] comes from Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, which is the "Womb" (*Rechem*) for the three Patriarchs and binds the three of them together. Revisit the "Book of the Engraver" regarding the law of the "Cold Circle" which has a round marking. The letter *Tzadi* [צ] comes from Understanding <note>Binah</note>, the "Higher Form." The letter *Tav* [ת] is Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note>; sometimes it represents "Complete" (*Tammah*) and sometimes "Revival" (*Techiyah*), all according to the Kabbalistic tradition. This is what appeared to the author <note>Rabbi Moshe Cordovero, often referred to by the acronym of his works</note> regarding the general nature of the letters arranged like a Menorah <note>The seven-branched candelabrum</note>. # Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 28 — The Secret of Vowel-Points and Accents

It shall be clarified that through the assembly of these matters, the hidden becomes revealed. We shall find that the upper things are the inverse of the lower things. We make known the "Seal," for there are "Living Beings" <note>Hebrew: *Chayot*, referring to the angelic beings in Ezekiel's vision, here used as a metaphor for the life-force of the letters</note> in their various designations mentioned above. Their bodies—the spiritual letters—are revealed, and they do not return until we contemplate the honor of the Emanator <note>God</note>. Through the return of these "Living Beings," all their designations are revealed as a single, unified entity. So too is the matter of their vowel-points, which are the life-forces. According to the level of the light of the vowel-point, so does the light of the "Living Being" ascend. According to the level of the light, the light of the source is revealed. For the vowels of the "Designations" <note>The various names of God</note> differ from the vowels of the "Essential Names," and the vowels of the Names differ from the vowels of the "Existences," even though the shapes of the vowel-points are identical. The vowel-points will always be superior to the letters, just as the merit of the spirit <note>Ruach</note> is superior to the soul <note>Nefesh</note> and the body. And if you should ask: "If so, why is it not forbidden to erase the simple vowel-points just as it is forbidden to erase the letters?" <note>In Jewish law, it is forbidden to erase the letters of God's name</note>. One may answer that what happens to the vowel-points and accents is like what happens to the higher soul <note>Neshama</note>. Because of its great depth, it is not revealed. Thus, the vowel-points, due to their extreme hiddenness, were not revealed except as a base for comparison between the distant "Designations" and the "Essential Names." This is the reason why the vowel-points are not written in a Scroll of the Law <note>Sefer Torah</note>.

<column-break/>

The nature of the vowel-points is that they are thin branches branching out from the "Life" <note>Chayut</note>. The vowel-point of their life is the *Kamatz* <note>A vowel making an 'ah' sound</note>, and from it comes their existence. They are born and receive life through the power of the <term>Crown (Keter)<gloss>The highest of the ten Sefirot, representing Divine Will</gloss></term>. These vowel-points descend from <term>Wisdom (Chokhmah)<gloss>The second Sefirah, representing the flash of intuition</gloss></term>, though not all its paths are extended. Rather, it is a movement within its internal Grace <note>Chesed</note>. This is the final expansion of the Crown, called the "Male Light." It unites with Wisdom at the beginning of the vowel-points' manifestation. As explained in the previous gate regarding the power of Wisdom, the vowel-points are to the Essential Names as the Spirit <note>Ruach</note> is to the Soul <note>Nefesh</note> of <term>Understanding (Binah)<gloss>The third Sefirah, representing the processing of wisdom</gloss></term>, and Understanding is like the "Body" to them. Thus, the vowel-points are branches extending from the life-force of Wisdom, and branches extending from the light of Understanding. The letters would have no recognizable form or character if not for the vowel-points, just as a body has no character except through the spirit.

### Gate 29 — Explaining the Secret of the Accents

The Accents <note>Te'amim, the cantillation marks used for chanting the Torah</note> are to the vowel-points as the Higher Soul <note>Neshama</note> is to the Spirit. These levels sit one atop the other, like the levels of the soul: Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshama. They are also considered "Givers" and "Receivers." The letters, which are sounded by the mouth, extend into physical vessels. The vowel-points "ride" upon the letters like a rider on a horse. Due to their extreme subtlety, more so than the letters, they are not perceived as physical things. Without them, there is no recognition of the life-force, just as the physical letters of the world are formed from the vowel-points. Although the letters touch their life-force, it is as if they touch and yet do not touch—like a person who is not well-integrated with their soul due to its subtlety. The Accents cannot be known at all by the masses, for they ride upon the vowels, providing a recognition that is extremely hidden.

<column-break/>

**Chapter 1: Know** that the source and strength of the Accents come from the Crown <note>Keter</note> itself. They are branches extending from the drawing down of the light of the Crown. Their essence is hollowed out within Wisdom. There is a light of the Crown that is called "Nothingness" <note>Ayin</note>. From the Crown, the lights are drawn down and clothed. As the spirituality of the letters and vowels does not change even though they are equal, so the spirituality of the Accents does not change, even though they are equal. They are divided according to their locations. Just as the vowel-points are like the Spirit to the letters...

### Gate 30 — Explaining the Matter of Combination (Tziruf), Substitution (Temurah), and Gematria

...is subtracted from our calculation because of the doubling of the letter *He* (ה). If there are five letters, etc., with two doubles, the doubling will subtract from the total number of combinations. If there are nineteen letters with two doubles, the first double subtracts from the combinations and the second double subtracts further. This is enough for the wise to understand.

**Chapter 3:** Even though the letters are as they are, the combinations of their "Body" and "Spirit" do not combine. It is possible for them to combine in the mystery of their spiritual essence, as explained in the book regarding the details of the Accents and Life-forces. These are "Male" and "Female," as it is written. The secret of Combination <note>Tziruf</note> is that as the shapes of the letters roll and ascend and descend over one another, and each is included in the other, so the secret of the spirituality clothed within them ascends and descends and is included. Through this, the spirituality of the light of the Creator is clarified and refined until it reaches the level of the Crown.

<column-break/>

**Chapter 1: Know** that Combination <note>Tziruf</note> is the exchange of the letters of a word—from the beginning to the middle, from the middle to the end, and from the beginning to the end, according to the number of letters. Their rotation is like a wheel that turns. What was at the end moves to the beginning, and what was at the beginning moves to the middle. However, the letters themselves never change; only their position in the combination changes. According to the number of letters in a word, so the "houses" <note>possible permutations</note> increase. As stated in the *Book of Formation* <note>Sefer Yetzirah</note>: "Two stones <note>letters</note> build two houses; three build six houses; four build twenty-four; five build one hundred and twenty; six build seven hundred and twenty; seven build five thousand and forty." From here onwards, go and calculate what the mouth cannot even speak.

**Chapter 2: And know** that if a word has duplicate letters, the number of "houses" is reduced because of the repetition. For example, if there are four different letters, there are twenty-four houses, but if one letter is doubled, there are only twelve houses, because half the combinations are lost. Therefore, the name *YHVH* (יהוה) rotates in only twelve houses, whereas a name with four unique letters would rotate in twenty-four.

...in my hand, and corresponding to two points, which are the two great cycles <note>referring to cosmic or astronomical cycles in Kabbalistic thought</note> and the 360 [degrees] of Harmony <note>original: *Tiferet*</note> and Kingdom <note>original: *Malchut*</note>.

### Chapter 4: On the Explanation

In the world of Kindness <note>original: *Chesed*</note> and Severity <note>original: *Gevurah*</note>, the right side and the left side, as is their way; and there they are unified between the "Arms" <note>Kindness and Severity are often called the right and left arms of the divine body</note> in the secret of gathering. And these are the "Great" and the "Small," and they precede the reality of the mundane in the eighth firmament, which is called the Sphere <note>original: *Piyunos*, likely a corruption of the Greek *Phainon* or similar cosmological term</note>. Kindness and Severity are its right and left, and the firmament is its essence. Within it, Harmony and Kingdom are unified. Therefore, the Sphere is sometimes associated with Kindness and Severity, and sometimes with Harmony and Kingdom, for all is Kindness. Sometimes the Sphere hints that within the Soul, the four personas <note>original: *partzufim*; divine configurations</note> are unified. And there, the four [letters of the Name] are found in the sphere, as explained in the Gate of Names. 

Furthermore, the Sphere refers to the *Pashta* <note>a cantillation mark</note>, the *Segol* <note>three dots in a triangle</note>, and the *Sikol* <note>likely *Zarka* or another accent</note>. One adds a point to the letters in the sphere, which represents Harmony receiving [light], and in the *Segol* it is received—this being the Foundation <note>original: *Yesod*</note> that stands between the *Tevir* <note>an accent</note> and the *Chataf* <note>a "hurried" vowel</note>. From within the internal [aspects], the seventy-two names <note>referring to the 72-letter name of God</note> are unified. Therefore, the *Pashta* is associated with the Throne, and as the Foundation ascends to the Kingdom—which is the rule of the "Whites" <note>pure lights</note>—the *Segol* is associated with them. This Foundation is so closely associated with Harmony alone that it includes everything within it. Therefore, the essence of the *Segol* in the Soul is the Foundation.

### Chapter 5: On the Explanation

The *Kamatz* and the *Patach*. The *Kamatz* <note>the 'a' vowel shaped like a T</note> is in the Crown <note>original: *Keter*</note>, in the secret of the Hidden. The word *Kamatz* implies clenching <note>as in a closed fist</note>, closing, and hiding. It is also associated with Wisdom <note>original: *Chokhmah*</note> and Understanding <note>original: *Binah*</note>, for the Crown is hidden within them. In relation to the Crown, it is revealed; but Harmony, in relation to the other emanations, is seen as hidden when looking toward the Crown. Because the revelation of the "two heads" called by the name *Kamatz* occurs through Kindness, and since the *Kamatz* elevates Kindness to be revealed, it is fitting that *Kamatz* also relates to Kindness. Kindness is spread out and elevated, yet "clenches" <note>takes a handful</note> from the higher things to add nourishment to the lower things. 

Because the entire life-force is included in the closing of Harmony and Kingdom, when they unify, the upper Wisdom and Understanding unify with them. These then overflow with abundance and blessing to the lower realms. Therefore, *Kamatz* is also associated with Kindness. Its secret is Kindness with a point beneath it, as explained previously in the Gate of Foundations regarding the *Kamatzeem*: that all which is clenched in the hidden becomes revealed. There is no wonder that *Kamatz* represents Judgment <note>original: *Din*</note>, for it performs a clenching in Understanding. Through this concealment, Kindness is transformed into an attribute of great abundance and blessing.

The servant of the *Kamatz* is the *Patach* <note>the 'a' vowel shaped as a horizontal line</note>, which represents the revealed and the opening of all things. Sometimes it is associated with Wisdom, which is the "Opening of the Heights," the "Crown within the Crown" through the thirty-two paths <note>the 32 paths of wisdom in the *Sefer Yetzirah*</note>. There are those who explain in the *Zohar* that it is the opening for all emanation. 

The *Shva* <note>two vertical dots</note> is the "servant of servants" that serves all the vowel-points. It moves within Understanding in the sphere. It represents a "Third Kindness," hinting at the two Great Lights. The *Shva* hints at the Small Light <note>the Moon/Kingdom</note> which, when sanctified, pursues the flow of abundance downward. Some say the *Shva* is the light of Foundation and Kingdom, which is why it joins the end of the seven [days/emanations] of Kingdom as it is swallowed into Foundation. It is "clenched in the *Kamatz*" <note>referring to a *Kamatz Katan* or grammatical rule</note>, where the sound is full so that one does not recognize the diminishment, for the sake of the honor of the "Nekiam" <note>the pure ones</note>. Furthermore, the *Shva* alone returns to Judgment, and there the *Chataf* is the Foundation that repairs it. So it is with the "Grapes" <note>metaphor for vowel clusters</note>, as we have written in the Gate of Accents, with God's help.

### Chapter 4
Just as the variations of permutations increase due to the "peeling of the shells" <note>original: *Kelipat Kelipot*; removing outer layers of meaning to find the core</note> of the letters, so too do they increase based on the permutation of the **vowel points** <note>original: *Nikudot*</note> and their precedence over one another. And when the letters are added, they will rise to five times 20 <gloss>known as the "25-count" and such</gloss>. If a third letter is joined, it will rise to 25 times 25, which is 625. Thus, every added letter increases the permutation by 25 times, as is known.

### Chapter 5
The matter of the **Substitution of the Letter He** <note>The letter H (ה) in the Divine Name</note>: when we wish to bind the Divinity to the letters, the choice of permutation in the "inner chambers" must follow the order of the letters. This is not just according to the standard Alphabet order used by the author of the *Book of Creation* <note>original: *Sefer Yetzirah*; an ancient foundational text of Jewish mysticism</note>. Rather, every letter must be bound to every other letter. In the way the Alphabet is substituted, where one letter stands for another, all the "houses" of the Alphabet mentioned will rise to **231 Gates** <note>original: *RLA Shearim*; the 231 possible two-letter combinations of the Hebrew alphabet</note>. The Kabbalists wrote that these 231 gates are shortened versions of "Face and Back" <note>referring to forward and backward permutations</note>.

### Chapter 6
To understand the matter of **Substitution** <note>original: *Tmurah*; a system where letters are swapped based on a specific key, like AT-BaSh</note> and its sign: the letters descend with their primary source and are formed in the "binding" of the **Firmament** <note>original: *Rakia*</note>. In the beginning, the order of the Alphabet is "Direct" (A, B, C, D, E, etc.). But in the "progeny" <note>the secondary effects</note>, the order of the Alphabet is reversed (Z, Y, X, etc.). The reason for this is **Male and Female**. The Male is in the Direct order and the Female is in the Reversed order. This is the way of the emanations: the light that is engraved in its vitality from top to bottom turns around when it rests below to go from bottom to top. This is all within the mystery of Direct Light and Returning Light, as explained previously. In the mystery of the World, it receives the Alphabet in the mystery of Returning Light from the Firmament. All are in the "Direct" order, which signifies the Alphabet in its Hidden state, where Judgment is sweetened. However, from the side of **Strength** <note>original: *Gevurah*; the attribute of judgment and restraint</note> itself, it is Direct. Because there are two levels here in the Direct order, the letters of the Alphabet are doubled, for they are clothed and grasped one within the other. In the Firmament, the **Kingdom** <note>original: *Malchut*</note>—which is the **Moon** <note>original: *Levanah*</note>—is rolled.

This is the secret of the different Alphabet systems. The Sun, in its standing, receives the combinations from the Crown. Every letter is comprised of ten, and every single letter is comprised of 22 letters. The power of **Substitution** <note>original: *Tmurah*</note> is not like the power of **Permutation** <note>original: *Tzeruf*</note>. ### Chapter 7
The intention regarding the vitality of the **Foundation** <note>original: *Yesod*; the ninth Sefirah, associated with connection</note> is that in every "house," it follows the number of the day. The number of the first letter follows the one preceding it, and so they go up from beginning to end. This indicates the cleaving to the Alphabet that exists in the "Higher Point." Therefore, it rises level by level according to the number of the letters. An "ascending and descending" Alphabet indicates the strength of its elevation, until it has no further descent. Every Alphabet that rises and falls—like the one in **Harmony** <note>original: *Tiferet*</note>—will rise until it reaches the end and then descends. This is a higher level than other Alphabet systems. When they descend and then rise, or rise and then descend in a row, it indicates a specific level of descent and ascent. According to the measure of the descent and ascent, so is the level of that Alphabet system. This applies not only to the Alphabet, but to the **Divine Names**. A Name formed through an ascending and descending Alphabet substitution is more hidden and superior to a Name formed by a standard Alphabet.

-> **Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 31: The Soul** <-

When a man focuses his mind and joins with his wife, fulfilling this commandment to be remembered upon his bed, it is so that through this act the child may be revealed, as mentioned in the Zohar <note>The foundational work of Jewish mysticism</note>. This process is called "Balah," which is the mystery of the "Shadow" <note>original: *Tzelem*; the spiritual blueprint or "astral body" that accompanies a person</note> that surrounds him all his days, as it is written, "In a shadow man walks." These four foundations are for the brain, for since the Shadow precedes him at birth, so too does it depart thirty days before death, taking his wisdom with it. During those thirty days, the Shadow is hidden to show the matter of his closure toward death. This is the meaning of "blackness upon his head" during those thirty days, where his funeral procession is prepared; it departs and does not return. I have written regarding the Zohar that when the Shadow is revealed, it is renewed as one, guarding him in his life. Near death, both aspects of the shadow depart, and then he is as mentioned above. This is the secret of "Until the day breathes and the shadows flee" <note>Song of Songs 2:17</note>.

### Chapter 6: After explaining the necessity of the Soul's descent to this world, one must

know what the righteous occupy themselves with in the Garden of Eden <note>original: *Gan Eden*; Paradise</note>. To understand this well, know that when the First Man <note>Adam</note> was created, he was created in a garment of "Supernal Light." Within that garment, God brought him into the Garden of Eden to be "the counter of the spheres" <note>to contemplate the divine emanations</note>. Everything he did and thought was focused on the "Intellectual Commandments"—meaning the contemplation of spirituality—such as not completing a study without ensuring he did not unify the two spiritual "shells" <term>Kelippot (husks of evil)</term> in a way that would allow them to draw power and cause harm. Similarly, he focused on the preparation for the light to reach the Kingdom <note>original: *Malkhut*; the lowest of the ten Sefirot</note>. All other matters, as explained in the Talmud <note>original: *Shas*</note>, are the inner essence of the Torah. Just as the soul is clothed in a physical garment, so too the Torah is clothed in a physical garment <note>the literal stories and laws</note>. When the soul strips away its physical garment and returns to its root to cling to Wisdom, the Torah also strips off its "physical clothes," and its generalities, details, and nuances are refined in their inner spiritual meaning. This will be the occupation of the righteous in the Garden of Eden. The intention is that one should not be drawn after the "Shell" <note>*Kelippah*</note> that surrounds the Garden. From this, one can understand the high status of one who occupies himself with the secrets of the Torah in this world, for in this world he performs actions that will manifest in the World to Come.

Regarding what I wrote about the cessation of Wisdom from Israel since the standing at Mount Sinai: why did they not enter the Lower Garden of Eden where the First Man stands? The answer is that if humans entered the Garden, how would they help the "Children of the Moon" <note>a reference to souls or beings associated with the lower spiritual realm</note>? How many garments would they have to wear if they did not yet have the merit and good deeds to clothe themselves? One cannot say they would enter with both body and soul, for even if a person could say his body is perfectly refined, he still could not enter the Garden alive until he strips off that physical clothing and it is consumed of its illness, and he is clothed in "healthy garments" of the nature of the World to Come. Therefore, they must wait and merit to be among the angels until the body is stripped away and they put on a garment like the garments of the angels. Even Rabbi Joshua ben Levi and his companions, of whom it is said they entered the Garden alive, did not enter until they were clothed in the "Nogi" garment <note>a translucent spiritual garment</note>, for the physical body...

<column-break/>

...is directed by the power of the heart's intention and understanding, the precision and nuances of one's thoughts. For through the performance of the commandments (*Mitzvot*)—within the secret of the "Spiritual Chain of Descent" <note>original: *Hishtalshelut*; the process by which divine light descends into matter</note> that clothes itself in lower things, and the secret of how the light clothes itself in the letters of the Holy Tongue <note>Hebrew</note> coming out of a person's mouth—the arousal of one's deeds ascends level by level. It travels the path of the ascents until it reaches the highest realms and is received by the Palaces <note>original: *Heikhalot*</note>. The holiness of that reception sits and arranges the deed until it is influenced by the "Higher Unions." According to one's merit, the light covers the deed with great abundance and blessing. This "Created Light" prepares for him garments according to the level of his deed and his intention. As the deed is, so is the light that acts from above. These are the "Chains of the Rabbis" <note>rabbinic traditions</note>, and these are the commandments that stand before God to advocate for their owners. According to this, one merits that the souls which a person prepares for himself through his good deeds will be a belt around him. This is a great principle in our hands. The deed itself, performed in the "wilderness" <note>this world</note> through a union like that of a man and wife, is not merely a garment in this world, but a means of unifying the Kingdom and the Foundation <note>*Malkhut* and *Yesod*</note> to receive divine flow.

### Chapter 8: After the general nature of the Soul has been explained, it is proper

to know what benefit there is for it to descend into this lowly world. The matter is that the soul has no [revealed] existence prior to birth. That is to say, when it is poured out from its root before its emanation, it is not revealed as an individual entity. Its existence comes from the "Spread of Light" through the Firmament of the Letters. Thus, the souls are like light, and through the "Higher Union" and the descent of the flow, they become like water, spreading and emerging into the Kingdom <note>*Malkhut*</note> and its inner palaces. They pass through various firmaments until the reality of the **Soul** <note>original: *Neshamah*</note>, the **Spirit** <note>original: *Ruach*</note>, and the **Breath** <note>original: *Nefesh*</note> is formed. This is the "Holy," and therefore nothing existed there except in the likeness of "the feminine within the masculine." After its form is completed in this Palace, they emerge into the Upper Garden of Eden and stand there until the time comes to descend to this lowly world. It is explained that there is great benefit for the soul in this descent, for it moves from potential to actual.

But a doubt still remains: what benefit is there for the soul to descend from the Upper Garden of Eden to the spirit of this lowly world? It seems it is closer to loss and far from gain! For even if a person acts correctly in this world, the soul will not ascend higher than where it was at first. And if perhaps he does not merit, but only overcomes his inclination, he might go to the "burning" and eternal loss. The answer is that the soul, before descending to the "sands" of this world, was naked without any garment at all. It could not approach the King, its Father, until it descends and prepares for itself garments of "Majesty and Splendor." The two garments one prepares in this world are: one for the Lower Garden of Eden and one for the Upper Garden of Eden. The reason is that there are two realities: one from the vitality of the *Nefesh* (Breath) which will be in the Upper Garden, and the second from the vitality of the *Ruach* (Spirit) which will be in the Lower Garden. For each, one must prepare a fitting garment. Thus, the soul ascends to behold the "Pleasantness of God" and to visit His Palace, and to be refined by the radiance of the Divine Presence <note>*Shekhinah*</note>. These are made and strengthened through the occupation of Torah, prayer, and commandments. The physical act creates the garment for the Spirit (*Ruach*) in the Lower Garden, and the heart's intention creates the garment for the Soul (*Neshamah*) in the Upper Garden. For according to the levels of understanding in performing a commandment, so is the height of the spiritual attire. The physical deed alone does not ascend higher than the Lower Garden; from there, the "Imaginal Matters" and intentions ascend to add strength to the body to rise...

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 31: On the Explanation of the Secret of the Soul

The matter is that even though all those who are emanated <note>spiritual beings or souls</note> from the Ten <note>The ten Sefirot or divine attributes</note> are sometimes included in thirty parts, sometimes in five, and sometimes in six, or the like.

### Chapter 2: Since we have explained the Chain of Essence
and how the Spirit (*Ruach*) <term>Ruach: the middle level of the soul associated with emotion and the world of Formation</term> clothes itself in the Soul (*Nefesh*) <term>Nefesh: the lowest level of the soul associated with vitality and the world of Action</term>, and the Breath (*Neshamah*) <term>Neshamah: the highest level of the soul associated with intellect and the world of Creation</term> clothes itself in the Soul from the level of Sovereignty <note>original: *Malchut*; the lowest Sefirah</note>, we must explain why, at the time of a person's passing, the Soul (*Nefesh*) remains in this world at the grave, while the Spirit (*Ruach*) resides in the Lower Garden of Eden, and the Breath (*Neshamah*) resides at the Veil <note>original: *Pargod*; the celestial curtain separating the divine realm from the lower worlds</note>. Why does each one not simply return to its specific source and upper foundation, to the place where they began? 

To understand this, one must know that no soul can exist below in this world unless it is clothed in the aspects of Formation <note>original: *Yetzirah*</note> and Action <note>original: *Asiyah*</note>. This is the secret of the "Chain of All Levels": a spiritual entity clothes itself in Creation <note>original: *Beriah*</note>, Creation in Formation, and Formation in Action. Thus, the Breath (*Neshamah*) of the Higher Emanations clothes itself in the Breath of Creation; the Breath of Creation clothes itself in the Spirit (*Ruach*) of Formation; and the Spirit of Formation clothes itself in the Soul (*Nefesh*) of Action. 

As they have said: the inner parts are covered—the right within the right, the middle within the middle. The matter is that the Breath (*Neshamah*) of Creation is formed from the side of the light that spreads and clothes itself in the Soul of the *Sefirot* of Creation. The Spirits (*Ruchot*) of Formation mentioned are from the light that spreads and clothes itself in Formation. The Souls (*Nefashot*) of Action are from the light that spreads and clothes itself in Action. This is the way of it: one does not merit a Breath (*Neshamah*) from Formation and Action at all; rather, the Spirit (*Ruach*) serves as the "Breath" for the world of Formation, and the Soul (*Nefesh*) serves as the "Action" for the Spirit mentioned.

Since the light of Understanding <note>original: *Binah*</note> is revealed in Creation, the secret of Beauty <note>original: *Tiferet*</note> in Formation, and the light of Sovereignty <note>original: *Malchut*</note> in Action—which refers to the Throne and the angel Metatron <note>The celestial scribe and prince of the Presence</note> within the spheres in the secret of the Names—the way of it is that light shines upon the Breath (*Neshamah*) from the Breath of Understanding, upon the Spirit (*Ruach*) from Beauty, and upon the Soul (*Nefesh*) from Sovereignty, for they are formed and nourished by them. 

And since they are all spiritual, the eye cannot see their essence; however, the light spreads into these three places. Therefore, in the case of the Soul (*Nefesh*), it departs this world and each of the levels mentioned is gathered to its source. From there, they enter before the inner Veil—literally the Throne of Glory—which is the source of Creation. The Spirits and the Souls are from the side of the Holy Palaces, which are the source of Formation and Sovereignty. 

Similarly, the Soul (*Nefesh*) may return to the secret of the light that spreads through it—meaning the world of Action, which includes all "buildings." Nevertheless, the Soul which is partitioned <note>refined through good deeds</note> ascends even to the upper firmaments in the secret of the Supernal Vitality. Sometimes the Soul and the higher Soul refine and adorn one another, ascending to the upper firmaments. Since they are included and spread from branches of the Supernal Light, the worlds are united through this, and the branches are bound to the roots, just as the Palaces are bound and ascend to the upper firmaments through the secret of prayer. This is the path of the Soul, Spirit, and Breath as mentioned in the Zohar, portion *Terumah*: Action is uplifted into Formation, Formation into Creation, and Creation into Emanation (*Atziluth*), and the Vitality into the Supernal Soul, as explained in the Gate of the Essence of Divinity.

### Chapter 3: And even though it was explained that every movement in the world of Creation [requires clothing], if it does not clothe itself in the Spirit of Formation, the Spirit cannot see

<column-break/>

of Formation; and if it does not clothe itself in the Soul of Action, it will likewise not be "appointed" <note>will not function or be recognized</note>. For it is already possible to have a Soul (*Nefesh*) without a Spirit (*Ruach*), or a Spirit without a Breath (*Neshamah*), because not everyone merits everything. A person merits according to how he repairs his "vessel" <note>original: *kanonkan*</note>; then his "companion" <note>a higher soul level</note> will shine upon him and be absorbed within him. Sometimes a Breath (*Neshamah*) will shine upon a person at times when he is occupied with the Torah or a commandment, and then it will depart. Likewise, when the gifts of a Holy Day <note>Sabbath or Festival</note> arrive, an additional Supernal Light is bestowed upon the souls of man—this is the concept of the "Additional Soul" <note>original: *Neshamah Yeteirah*</note> given from the Kabbalah—and when the day departs, this light also departs. 

When a person merits to receive a Breath (*Neshamah*) from the side of holiness, and he merits that the Holy Day should refine him with an "Additional Face" <note>a higher spiritual state</note> from the inner side, he is then helped more than usual. Therefore, during the days of work—as it says "Six days you shall labor"—the person's vitality is nourished by the "Pure Breath" <note>original: *Neshamah Tehorah*</note> from the secret of the "Servant" <note>the world of Creation is sometimes called the World of the Servant</note> and the mysteries of Creation. All of this depends on his actions. If he clothes himself in the additional soul from the side of holiness, it is said of him that "the soul of the Lord is a lamp" <note>Proverbs 20:27</note>. Regarding the levels of souls mentioned, the sages spoke in the Holy Merciful One <note>the Zohar</note> as either "Sons" or "Servants." For anyone whose root is in the goodness of Creation is called a "Servant," and whoever's root is in the goodness of Emanation <note>Atziluth</note> is called a "Son."

Aside from these three levels of service, other levels are revealed to man, which are the matter of the **Angels** who are "garments" and "vessels" for his light in all his ways. Regarding them, it is said: "For He will give His angels charge over thee" <note>Psalm 91:11</note>. This is for the soul, and they are like "sparks" for a person during his sin. 

And regarding these angels who pray for him and are included within him because of his deeds: the reason they have "wings" <note>metaphorical spiritual extensions</note> is that they act as a "garment" for the vitality of his soul. For when the soul is included in the Supernal Vitality, the angels are also included with it. These angels are his "branches"—the Good Inclination <note>original: *Yetzer Ha-Tov*</note> and the Evil Inclination <note>original: *Yetzer Ha-Ra*</note>. The Good Inclination is appointed over a person from the moment he is born, but the Evil Inclination does not join him until he is thirteen years old. 

And as we have said, the "wings" are included with the soul. Therefore, if the person behaves correctly with his soul, he merits a "holy angel" from the side of the Good Inclination. This is the Good Inclination which is a holy angel, but it is "clothed in a garment of impurity" <note>this refers to the divine spark hidden within the physical/testing nature of the world</note>, for such is the way of several holy angels. 

The chariot of the Evil Inclination is a force that spreads from the "Shells" <note>original: *Kelipot*; forces of imbalance or evil</note> which are the "Evil Eye," "Wrath," and "Destruction." Its purpose is only to stir the man. He "rides upon his chariot" <note>the soul is meant to control these forces</note>. The "holy rider" is the one who spreads from the "Seven Legs of the Holy Chariot," which are the angels **Michael, Gabriel, Uriel, and Raphael.** This rider goes alone within the person and rides upon his chariot, and through his strength and his prayer, he can weigh down and empower one of the servants <note>the inclinations</note> over the other.

### Chapter 4: There is also found with man a fourth element, which is neither
Soul, nor Spirit, nor Breath, but it is revealed even more
than them, to the point that there are those among the Seers who call it by the name "God." In the "Book of the Return" <note>likely *Sefer Ha-Yichud* or similar Kabbalistic text</note>, they said it is a "second" to the Soul, a "third" to the Spirit, and a **fourth** to the Breath (*Neshamah*). 

The strength and clarity of its existence will be explained further there. It is revealed to them because it is called for the Breath (*Neshamah*) just as a "silver vessel" is called for the light that shines within it—a small amount of its work is revealed. Before he does a thing, there is a light that is created, which the Sage calls the "internal essence." This is also true when hearing a sound—it creates an "air" in which the spiritual aspects of the Soul, Spirit, and Breath shine. This is the **fourth element** that we mentioned. It is called the "Shadow" <note>original: *Tzelem*</note>, from the language of "wings" (*kenafayim*) mentioned in the words of the Sages. And so, it is the vessel in which the Divine Lights mentioned are formed and exist. Therefore, it is a fourth for the Breath, a third for the Spirit, and a second for the Soul. This "Shadow" is formed within the Soul, and the Spirit is formed within the garments of the Soul, and the Breath is formed within the vitality of the Spirit in man.

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate 31: The Soul

[The Creator] builds and has pity, for since then (at the time of birth), the body acts as the "matter" <note>In Kabbalistic philosophy, the body is the "matter" or vessel, while the soul is the "form" or essence.</note> which is formed in a dream, lacking everything. It should be mixed with holiness and purity, in the sense of King Solomon's wisdom, to value his death and to draw from the root of holiness. One must be careful not to draw from the "other side" <note>original: *Sitra Achra*; refers to the forces of impurity or evil</note>. The holy and upper soul will cut through holy names. Especially if he approaches the union <note>original: *zivvug*; referring to marital intimacy</note> with a pleasant prayer, he will be refined by spiritual breaths. For a refined body to conquer [the physical], and specifically through the intention of the internal breaths, he will draw down a spiritual soul upon himself, in which the Soul, Spirit, and Breath (*Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah*) will be clothed.

The intention here is that through the vitality of the spiritual drop, which is the "matter" from above, the pregnancy is refined through its nourishment. According to the secret of the drop of physical matter, which is light and contains "brilliance" like an accidental emission <note>original: *keri*; a technical term for a seminal emission</note>, there are "sons of man" (meaning damaging spirits) that become "impregnated" from the physical matter of the emission. 

It may be asked: how is it possible for a person, through his actions, to cause an "impregnation" from the physical to the spiritual? The secret of this "impregnation" comes from the movement of the desire, where the man becomes heated and sows seed. Similarly, in holiness, by elevating the holy drop mentioned earlier, one influences according to their intention. With the proper intention before pregnancy, it becomes worthy for the soul to be clothed within it. Thus, one can understand the path to the "World of Man" <note>The human realm</note>, so that his soul may be pure and clear, directing its mind toward the Garden of Eden.

Therefore, this is the Secret of the Sanctuary: a person sanctifies himself at the time of intimacy. This results in the most choice and clean union, avoiding "seed destroyed in vain" <note>original: *zera levatala*</note>. Through his good intention, the Upper Groom and Bride <note>A metaphor for divine attributes in union</note> are united according to the order of the Act of Creation. He brings in drops that generate the likeness of "bridges." 

The spiritual drop, combined with spiritual intention, exists in the spirituality of the person. It will now be inside the female's womb as the "matter" of her upper power, which is drawn from above. Thus the fetus is clothed in this spiritual drop and is formed within the female's womb. This is like the path of the female who receives and is remembered by her husband, always existing in the aspect of life. For in this way, souls are "impregnated" into others, as in the case of Phinehas <note>A biblical figure</note> into whom Nadav and Avihu <note>The sons of Aaron</note> were impregnated, as mentioned in the Zohar in the portions of *Lecha* and *Phinehas*. This is also explained in the *Tikkunim* regarding the lineage of Isaac and Jacob. Therefore, if they were to unite with her, he would be impregnated within her, for the sake of the child. Just as a seed is secure within its shell, so too the souls of the child are secure and require nourishment.

### To understand the primary cause of the souls in the body
Know that the primary cause of the souls is the "External Vitality" mentioned above, and the "Matter of Wisdom," which is the nature implanted within it, in the likeness of the vitality in the souls. Every creature has power established over it, like a "Divine portion of His soul." Therefore, there is a secret called "Dead," for even if the vitality of the souls is within it, there will be no conscious knowledge at all. But this is one hidden thing that spreads throughout the entire body; it is a hidden vitality within these dust-clods of the human form, as those who delve into the Secret of the Chariot <note>original: *Ma'aseh Merkavah*; the study of the divine celestial realms</note> are able to perceive.

<column-break/>

They are like the form of bridges upon which the veins spread. Because there is vitality in the bones, he draws from the brain and the marrow. By drawing from the root of the hidden spark with the likeness of the Upper Form, and because the matter is soft and spreads, it is refined to receive further skin upon the "matter of the spirit," standing in its proper preparation. This is the nature of the structure of the human body through the mentioned "Vitality" and the "External Spirit." This is what remains with a person while he is asleep, when his soul opens and is able to ascend to the [upper] world. Then the physical actions are suspended, and his digestion and breathing are maintained through the intention of the soul, as mentioned in the portion of *Lech Lecha*.

### Chapter 10: After the external matter of the soul is explained
Now we shall explain the "Internal Matter." Know that when a man sins and sinks into the mud and filth of his actions, his Soul, Spirit, and Breath will be cut off and cling [to the lower realms]. When they [leave] to the [upper] world, they will not be entirely cut off. Nevertheless, the Soul (*Nefesh*) of the soul is internal and elevated, as explained regarding the external levels. In the context of the "Permissible Holiness," this soul is in the aspect of clothing. According to the garments of fear, it will leave its external forms in a place that diminishes and joins what was prepared for its future in the body. This creates a "Chain of Transmigration" <note>original: *shalshelet ha-gilgul*; the cycle of reincarnation</note> so that it may be refined and prepared for the time of the Resurrection.

Even though the soul leaves the physical body, the body remains related to the soul through the "Chain of Transmigration." It becomes refined in its members. Behold, just as when the soul draws a drop from above in holiness, so too the "forms" draw from the [upper] worlds. Since he sanctifies himself and refines his ways, he draws the influence of holiness from above onto his physical being. Conversely, when his ways and actions are poor, and his time and existence are not good, even his physical being—as the soul sanctifies itself from below—they loosen his being from above until it clings to the "husks" (*klipot*) <term>Klipot: Literally "shells" or "peels"; the Kabbalistic term for the forces of evil or impurity that surround sparks of holiness.</term>.

According to the measure of the sin, the form of impurity is drawn and influences the body. His soul then turns away, and the soul no longer receives its portion of vitality, except when the Holy One, Blessed be He, takes pity on his days and subdues his situation until whatever was clinging to the "husk" is removed. The "husks" will then be subdued, and his soul will return to the holy place. 

The internal vitality of the power of the "husks" and their connection through sin is a "refined matter" that is removed through the repentance of sins. Besides this, one can be refined in judgment through the subduing and breaking of the "husks" (as is known, a great person who sins is given over to his own suffering, but not to destruction, meaning the "husk" should not have power over his spirituality). 

By a man's sorrow over his sins, he subdues the power of "Severity" (*Gevurah*) and "Judgment" (*Din*). As the Sages said in the Zohar on the portion of *Vayikra*: "When God (*Elohim*) sits on the throne of Judgment, and then returns to the throne of Mercy." The intention is that the secret of "flesh" is the secret of subduing the Attribute of Judgment. He shall subdue and break the power of the small "husks." Let this not be a light thing in the eyes of sinners, for in order to subdue the power of the "husks" and the "External Side," Abraham our father had to descend to Egypt (*Mitzrayim*) to refine the seed, and the Israelites had to descend into exile. This was to prepare the nature of the body to be worthy, as mentioned in the portion of *Lech Lecha*.

### Chapter 11: After explaining the internal soul in this manner
We shall now explain the "Internal Matter" above. This is to enable the hearing of the upper vitality in a spiritual way, as explained here through human actions...

<meta>This page continues the discussion from the previous section regarding the "Chain of Essence" and the spiritual mechanics that bind the soul to the physical body. It specifically explores how the desire for spiritual ascent and descent creates a necessary tension that sustains the existence of the worlds, and how the physical body serves as a mirror to the divine structure of the Sephirot.</meta>

# Nectar of Pomegranates — Gate of the Soul

And just as the conceptual mind yearns to ascend to its root, so the Cause <note>The "Cause" refers to the Divine Source or the Emanator.</note> ordained that its dwelling be close to it. Just as the circle returns to its beginning, so is the desire of the Supernal Cause to draw near to itself, and to bind the part that is necessarily tied to its own essence. For through this, the worlds are bound together despite being composed of many separate parts. For if—Heaven forbid— the Cause only desired to ascend and the dweller only desired to descend, there would—Heaven forbid—be no existence for vitality, or for holiness, or for the connection of the living structure. By giving its vitality to the lower realms, it achieves a "Kal Vachomer" <note>A logical argument "from minor to major"; here it implies a self-evident spiritual necessity.</note>. Regarding this, it is explained: "Holy shall you be, for I [the Lord your God] am holy" (Leviticus 19:2). This is one of the reasons for the connection of His attributes. With this, the connection to His holiness does not become distant. Furthermore, all matters are chained down from the Cause and the Creation (*Beriyah*), forced down into the worlds of Formation (*Yetzirah*) and Action (*Asiyah*) <note>These are the four worlds of Kabbalistic cosmology: Atziluth, Beriyah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah.</note> at times, and everything remains in a constant bond. Such is the matter of the Soul: it descends from cause to cause until the sixtieth degree <note>original: "המדרגה הס'"; likely referring to the sixty "mighty men" or the numerical value of the letter Samekh, representing a specific level of descent.</note> and stands within the body in glory and hiddenness. For just as the soul is comprised of all the worlds and all the Sephirot <note>The ten divine emanations/attributes.</note>, so too the body, in its structure, includes and hints at all the worlds and the aspects of the Sephirot. Come and see the secret in the books of the Kabbalists regarding the beginning of all spiritual existence... according to the language of the *Tikkunim* <note>Referring to the *Tikkunei Zohar*, a classic Kabbalistic text.</note>: the upper Chariots and the crown of the "Luz" <note>The "Luz" is a legendary indestructible bone in the spine from which the body is said to be rebuilt at the resurrection.</note> bone stand and enter the "Throne of Glory" and its courthouse, overseeing every limb and returning it to its proper place.

## Chapter 9: Further 
### Having explained the reason for the soul's connection to the body,
### we shall now discuss the general nature of the human composition. Know,

that through physical matter, the form of man is recognized. The measure of the elements is what the spirit of his life rides upon. This spirit is not from the intellect or from a high place; rather, everything is formed within the body, created through the bond and the connection of the joints to the level of separation. Through this, the "Earth" and "Dust" are born into the structure of the human form (as occurs in the months of pregnancy for those who cry out in the womb). As explained in the "Gate of Introductions," upon this "Vital Spirit" <note>original: *Ruach HaChiyuni*; the basic life force.</note> the "Soul" (*Nefesh*) is established; upon the *Nefesh* rests the "Spirit" (*Ruach*); and upon the *Ruach* dwells the "Breath/Highest Soul" (*Neshamah*). It is said that the flesh is a dwelling for the *Nefesh*, and the bones are a dwelling for the *Ruach*. They find a hint for this in the verse: "My flesh upon him shall suffer..." (Job 14:22). This "grave" <note>Referring to the body as a temporary container or "grave" for the soul.</note> reveals beautiful and hidden reasons. Later, there are distinctions in the "chamber of the grave": when the flesh is consumed, the *Nefesh* departs, and the *Ruach* remains in the Garden of Eden. For the *Ruach* is simple and lacks parts, while the *Nefesh* is bound and takes pleasure there, then separates to its own place. There is also a distinction in the levels of vitality.

## Chapter 10: Further
### Having explained the matters of the composition of the human form, we shall explain the way
### of the chains from their beginning to their end. Know that it was already stated in the Gate 

of Existences how, within the secret of life, the upper spirituality spreads out. Similarly, this matter is drawn down through the intellect... downward until the end of the "Cord," where the physical and spiritual aspects are sustained. They are moved from level to level until they become the Breath/Soul (*Neshamah*) in its separate existence. This is the matter of the "Holy Foundation" that finds sweetness in the delights of the Torah, as explained in the Zohar on the portion of *Bereshit* (Genesis) and *Kedoshim*. For when a man is found to be "holy," the essential and additional spiritualities dwell within him according to his refinement. From them, he receives spirituality. This is the secret of prayer... receiving and binding the "waters" to our Master. (And through the refinement of the interior attributes, additional vitality is formed, which becomes a dwelling for the spiritualities that spread from the entire intention of the *Neshamah* through the actions of the living body. For the intention is clothed in the physical deed. Therefore, when one does not merit to rule with intention... even if the body is small, as the intention grows, the spirituality of the body grows and ascends higher and higher). Therefore, our Sages of blessed memory said: "Commandments require intention."

<column-break/>

...all its inhabitants and heirs are joined in their hearts by their good natures. If so, what is the difference between the deaths of the Patriarchs and the deaths of other righteous people? The answer is that their level is very great indeed. For one who tastes the flavor of their existence will cling to the part of the holy spiritual existence... and all actions in him are as they are shared across the whole world. For the main foundation of his body is "dust," and even if this man is righteous, he merits to be clothed in the Garden of Eden until his body is consumed. But one who has not "tasted the flavor of life," his body is consumed and destroyed by the power of the pure vitality. The one who seeks the Garden of Eden will be clothed there in glory without the taste of death, for no "worm" <note>Referring to the decay of the grave.</note> or "shell" <note>original: *Kelipah*; the forces of impurity.</note> shall rule over him.

## Chapter 7: Further
### Having explained the matter of the Garments very well in the explanation,
### we shall now clarify another matter regarding the specific form of the living.

It concerns death. There is a righteous person who may be clothed in the "garment" of a sinner. Concerning this, the verse says: "A wicked man may prepare it, but the righteous will wear it" (Job 27:17). That is to say, through the secret of "Holy Sparks," if a man who is a sinner performs a few commandments (*Mitzvot*), those deeds remain suspended... but the Holy One, Blessed be He, gives them to a righteous person who passed away in his purity but had not completed his own "garment." The Holy One can take the good action of that passing sinner and give it to the righteous. This matter is very common. How can it be that if two righteous people die, there isn't enough for both? They would cast lots to see who would receive the garment. The human being is made of parts, some from the "Lower Wisdom" and this world. If one has not merited to take another "desirable garment," their punishment is increased for their "nakedness." This is not a subversion of justice. To understand this, one must know that the soul reincarnates (*Gilgul*) through many bodies according to the opinion of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>The traditional author of the Zohar.</note>. For example, Reuben and Simeon: though they are separate, they might stem from the same root or "spark." One does not receive credit for the commandments performed by the other. This is the way of souls: one "buys" a piece and the other "buys" a piece until they are perfected as one soul through several bodies. If they merit in the final reincarnation to be perfected, all the sparks of the main soul will rise together. Each will receive the reward for his commandments, whether a little or a lot. Concerning this it says: "Go your way till the end; you shall rest and arise for your lot..." (Daniel 12:13). But regarding the soul of the sinner, the spiritual light does not stay with you; rather, the Holy One removes it and takes the few spiritual "fruits" he produced to clothe another. The body of the sinner will be consumed in the dust and destroyed, and his garment will be nullified. This is the judgment of the body. Regarding the righteous person, the Holy One will gather his changes so that he does not experience the "pit" of destruction. Even if in a previous body he did not perform certain commandments, the Holy One will complete his "garment" with the deeds he performed in a former body, even if that body was a "sinner" [in other areas]. Justice dictates he wears it, for it is from his own root. This is the meaning of: "A wicked man may prepare it, but the righteous will wear it."

## Chapter 8: Further
### Having explained the levels of the soul and its need
### to descend to this world, we shall clarify how it connects

with physical matter—that is, the structure of the body. Know that because the body resembles the upper spiritual matters in the structure of its limbs and its internal workings, we have mentioned that a spiritual thing can attach itself and connect to a physical thing through its preparation for it. The reason is that the lower realms are a dwelling for the upper realms. The "open deed" proves this, for the limbs of the body in general and in detail are spiritual [in their root] corresponding to the Upper Kingdoms. They are the "Throne" for our intention and a dwelling within the physical matter of the brain, as explained regarding the "Glory" that includes the entire Tabernacle.
